"Yes," Fang Yuan said. "Here, let me help teach you how to refine gu worms..."
It was best that Fang Zheng do it himself as one of the Liquor Worms was his vital gu, meaning that it at the very least could not die.
Fang Yuan explained how to do it to Fang Zheng three times before bringing out the refinement ingredients.
Fang Zheng instilled his primeval essence and will into his vital gu, that was easy, and then into the other Liquor Worm- more difficult. The two of them began rotating around each other before they started to fuse.
As each of the four wines was added to this ball of light, it began to shine in different colors.
Fang Yuan then began tossing in primeval stones at this point- he figured that with his higher luck (if the system could be trusted, that is), being part of the refinement would increase their odds of succeeding.
BAM!
At the last moment, the ball split into two halves, the Liquor Worms falling onto the ground. Fang Zheng spat out a mouthful of blood.
Fang Yuan took out a Vitality Leaf which he handed to Fang Zheng before taking a look at the two Liquor Worms. Thankfully, the other Liquor Worm had survived. However, it was best to wait a while for it to recover before trying again otherwise the risk of things going wrong would be much higher.
"I'm sorry... I lost concentration at the last moment," Fang Zheng said. The refinement had not failed because of luck, but because Fang Zheng was inexperienced and had messed things up. Thankfully there was still enough bitter shell wine for at least two more attempts.
But that could not be helped, and Fang Yuan simply had Fang Zheng try again a few days later.
This time, it worked out, and a two-headed Liquor Worm emerged from the ball. It shone in the four colors that represented the four flavors of sweet, sour, salty, and bitter, and Fang Zheng sighed with relief as he placed it back in his aperture.
Mission successful!
Aptitude raised to 65%!
With this done, Fang Yuan was now going to try to advance to Rank 3.
Meanwhile, Qing Shu was speaking to the clan head.
"Is this about Fang Yuan?"
"Indeed it is about him- I heard that he declined next month's mission with your group?" the clan head asked.
"Yes, Rank 2 Gu Masters can decline a mission once a year," Qing Shu said. "I wanted to reprimand him, but given the recent events with the River Swallowing Toad, it would make me seem unnecessarily overbearing." Fang Yuan's reputation in the village had begun to supersede Qing Shu's by this point, not only were there the facts of his major deeds but also the lesser known ones that he did for his daily quests that had caused his value to soar in the villager's eyes. Fang Yuan had declined the mission stating that he had 'personal reasons' for doing so, and it would make Qing Shu appear quite overbearing if he were to put any further pressure on Fang Yuan.
Not that such a thing would work on Fang Yuan in the first place.
"I see," the clan head said. "And it also appears that he bought one- or two, of the Red Steel Relic Gu from the market."
"He is at Rank 2 Peak Stage, equal to me now, so yes, that is the only logical explanation," Qing Shu said. "Either that, or he found something akin to a talent-raising gu worm while rock gambling and is now somehow A-grade."
The clan head nodded. "So the reason that he's taken this gap in doing quests is because he wants to break through to Rank 3 in a single go?"
"Yes, it appears so," Qing Shu said. "And I take it that you called me here not to discuss this, but so that I could interrupt him?"
"That is so," the clan head said. Although Fang Yuan was a member of his faction and so his advancement was to his own benefit- there was a thing such as soaring too high in the sky. That was the reason that Qing Shu had not yet been able to advance to Rank 3- though he had accepted that as a fact of life.
"Don't worry, we will do our fullest to interrupt him," Qing Shu said.
And so, late one evening, when Fang Yuan had not been seen wandering outside for several days, Qing Shu and his group paid Fang Zheng a visit.
"Where is you elder brother, Fang Yuan?" Qing Shu asked. "We're looking for him- it's quite a bit urgent."
Although other clan members looked at Fang Zheng mostly with disdain, Qing Shu had a bit of pity in his eyes as he looked at the younger of the Fang twins. Something that Fang Zheng recognized and despised. "He's in closed-door cultivation and isn't to be disturbed."
"Oh, but I bet that he hasn't gotten that far yet," Yao Hong said. "Let's just go and check up on him."
Fang Zhen rose indignantly. "What are you guys doing? You can't just barge into someone's house and disturb them for no reason like this!"
A normal Rank 1 wouldn't have dared to speak to a Rank 2 in that way, but Fang Zheng had been slightly off his rocker since being cast out and working on his own. Not to mention under clan rules, there was little that Qing Shu and his teammates could do.
"Ah, it's nothing, don't worry about it," Qing Mao said, waving his hand and trying to defuse the situation. "We're just checking up on our team mate and friend, after all..."
Despite Fang Zheng's protests they found where Fang Yuan was staying as well as a note stuck the door which said that he was in closed door cultivation and should not be disturbed.
"Fang Yuan! Are you really okay in there all by yourself?" Qing Shu asked.
"He is!" Fang Zheng said.
"You know, I haven't heard any response from him- maybe we should check up on him just to make sure-"
"Don't you dare!"
"Ah- Fang Zheng please don't push me!" Yao Hong said, 'accidentally' tripping and causing the door to collapse as she fell inside.
"I didn't push you at all! I didn't even touch you!" Fang Zheng yelled out in vain.

chapters.title: Chapter 92 - 92: Advancing To Rank Three: Part Two
chapters.content:
Qing Shu rushed into the room despite Fang Zheng's protests, though his gentle smile was replaced by a frown.
"There's no one here!"
Him and his two team members lost their easygoing looks and frantically looked around.
There was not a trace of Fang Yuan there!
"Can you feel anything?" Qing Shu asked Qing Mao.
"I... he must be too far away," Qing Mao said. He had methods to track Gu Masters, but being Rank 2, their range was limited and they could be blocked through various means- gu and non-gu included.
"Where is he?" Qing Shu asked, turning to Fang Zheng.
Fang Zheng, for that matter had a look of shock as well. His brother had told him that he would be cultivating in this room- but from the look of things he had placed a sign on his door and then crawled out of one of the windows to go elsewhere. Had he been expecting something like this?
"I... don't know..." Fang Zheng said.
Yao Hong grabbed him by the front of his robe. "Tell us where he is or..."
She was stopped by Qing Shu. "Enough. Fang Zheng, do you know where Fang Yuan is?"
"No, but if I did I wouldn't exactly tell the likes of you! What kind of teammates are you people?"
"Why you-" Qing Mao began before he too was waved aside by Qing Shu.
"We don't have time to waste then," Qing Shu said. "The village is only so big- and Fang Yuan only has a few associates. Let us look around where he could possibly be."
"The wine tavern?"
"Perhaps he went to the cave where he found the Flower Wine Monk's inheritance again to cultivate?"
"I heard he has a business partner he sells Vitality Leaves to- let's look there!"
These were all good guesses- but there were only three of them and they didn't all have good investigative abilities. The village and its surrounding areas was large, and despite asking around it seemed that no one had recently seen Fang Yuan- they all pointed them to places like the wine tavern or his apartments when pressured.
Night came and dawn as well, yet they were no closer to locating Fang Yuan when they had first started. They had looked in all the obvious places, even going to Jiang Ya's house and the old apartment
"Someone must've seen him wandering around!"
"What if he has some kind of stealth gu worm? He hasn't revealed it to use, but it doesn't meant that he doesn't have one!"
"Or he could've bought one..."
Fang Yuan, meanwhile, was focused on the dark red primeval essence in his aperture assaulting the crystal walls. The increase to his aptitude after refining the Four Flavors Liquor Worm had allowed him to prepare aptly beforehand, but even then, this breakthrough was going to set him back about two thousand primeval stones.
And while the time taken to break through had been reduced by ten hours thanks to the same, it had still taken him three days of intense focus during which he had not slept or eaten more than a few mouthfuls in between periods of attacking his aperture.
His efforts finally bore fruit as the crystal walls could not take the assault any further and shattered, and white primeval essence began to mix in with the remaining red primeval essence in his aperture.
Rank 3 primeval essence!
The crystal walls had once again been replaced with a light membrane.
In his old life, it had taken him more than a century to reach this level, which had only been possible with a talent-raising gu worm. In this life, without they system's help, he would've needed the 'cooperation' of a female Gu Master and a bear.
Main mission successful!
Advanced to Rank 3!
Details regarding the combined inheritance of Paradise Earth Immortal Venerable and Genesis Lotus Immortal Venerable are being downloaded now...
Fang Yuan let out a gasp of pain- in his current state the shock of having the information injected directly into his brain felt like someone had beat him over the head with a hammer.
'That's... where it is...' he thought to himself.
Coincidentally, the location was located at only eighty li from the village, well within the range of the Hundred Li Earth Wolf Spider. If Fang Yuan so wished, he could disembark on it the very next day to reach this location.
With that said, he could not actually do so. For one, he had nearly exhausted his primeval stone reserves and would need time to gather more resources. The Hundred Li Earth Wolf Spider was a Rank 4 gu worm, though since he was using it for movement not necessarily in a combat sense this wasn't much of an issue though he would need a good number of stones to sustain it with his Rank 3 primeval essence.
The location where it was was still outside of the village confines, and though Rank 3 Gu Masters could usually wander anywhere that was assuming that they had a set of Rank 3 gu worms with them. Fang Yuan had the Rank 4 Hundred Li Earth Wolf Spider to use as a mount but its combat abilities were not very good. The Doctor Gu was rank 3 but was only useful for healing.
At the very minimum, he needed a Rank 3 offensive gu and an investigative one if he wanted to wander outside of the village. He could somewhat make do if his other gu worms were only Rank 2- he didn't need a Rank 3 storage gu necessarily for example, but a Rank 3 defensive gu worm would be helpful even if in a less than ideal circumstance he could make do without one so long as he had a good investigative gu worm.
All of this meant that he would need time to prepare before heading out to reach this inheritance.Follow current ɴᴏᴠᴇʟs on ɴovᴇl(F)ɪre.ɴet
As for the inheritance itself, he wasn't overtly worried about what he might encounter. If this were say, Spectral Soul Demonic Venerable's inheritance there would be great cause for concern before going in- but this was a righteous path inheritance. Not only that, but half of it was from Paradise Earth Immortal Venerable, who could be said to be the most harmless Venerable. Fang Yuan was not concerned about being injured while going to explore it.
That, however, would have to wait for some time while he got his business in order.
He exited the room that he was cultivating in.
"You're done?" Yu Sai asked. Fang Yuan had been looking for somewhere nondescript to cultivate, and Yu Sai was living in a roughshod house at the village outskirts. Since he didn't do any missions just like Fang Zheng, he had been kicked out of his family's house. Not that it mattered to him, who had already pretty much given up on getting anywhere in life long ago.
Fang Yuan remembered Yu Sai from that time he had borrowed his Moonlight Gu, and thought that this would be one of the last places that they'd come look for him given he had never been here before. That made tracking him down with investigative gu worms a problem as well.
Yu Sai had been offered five primeval stones to let Fang Yuan stay there and cultivate, but he hadn't expected him to succeed so soon. To get to Rank 3 was a massive jump and he had doubts as to whether or not even a genius like Fang Yuan would be able to reach it in a single attempt.

chapters.title: Chapter 93 - 93: Advancing To Rank Three: Part Three
chapters.content:
"Here's your payment," Fang Yuan said, handing over the five primeval stones to Yu Sai.
"Hey- uh, Fang Yuan, it's okay, y'know," Yu Sai said, being able to feel his Rank 3 aura from where he was standing. Now, Fang Yuan was Elder Fang Yuan, and even if Yu Sai knew he had no future it would turn into having 'no future' in a different context if he offended someone like Fang Yuan. "I mean, we were both friends in school, right? So what's a small favor between friends when you get down to it? Matter of fact, feel free to stay a few more days if you want to. I uh, was actually thinking of getting some meat tonight so you could stay by at least for dinner..."
"Thank you for the offer," Fang Yuan said. He most definitely did not think of Yu Sai as a 'friend' and only knew his name because he had been class president and their transaction on the final exam day. "I'll be taking my leave." Although he did want to rest, he could do so at his own apartment.
It was a few hours before sunrise as he walked back home, noticing that the door to his room was broken down. 'It looks like my little trick paid off...' he thought before going to sleep, making a mental note to charge Qing Shu for the cost of fixing the door.
He woke up to see that Fang Zheng was waiting for him excitedly. "Brother! You did it! You're at Rank Three now!"
Fang Yuan got up. By now, the story of him getting to Rank 3 had probably spread all over the village.
Qing Shu and his other former teammates came by as well, bearing happy expressions and even carrying gifts for Fang Yuan. They were pretending as if their antics had not happened at all or were just a misunderstanding between parties.
Now that Fang Yuan was at Rank 3, he was an elder, and no longer needed to go on regular missions. Naturally he was not a member of their group anymore.
"With that said, I hope you will remember the times spent with out group fondly," Qing Shu said, smiling and ignoring the frosty looks that Fang Zheng, who was standing in the corner of the room, was giving them and his group.
"Of course, without senior's guidance how could I have come so far in my journey in the first place?" Fang Yuan asked.
"What senior-junior separation are you talking about now, Fang Yuan? Heh- you are now technically my superior!" Qing Shu said. His battle strength may have been equivalent to or even greater than many Gu Masters at Rank 3, but he was still not Rank 3 yet.
"Ah, how could I, your junior who lacks the experience you do, ever think of myself as your superior?"Follow current ɴᴏᴠᴇʟs on NovᴇlFirᴇ.ɴet
"Oh, Fang Yuan, you are too kind," Qing Shu said. "I can see that as an elder, you will bring great prosperity to the clan and its people. And before I forget- we had brought a little present for you. Consider it a congratulatory gift."
Qing Shu took out a Rank 2 gu worm.
"Is this- Tusita Grass?" Fang Yuan asked. It was a Rank 2 storage type gu worm that could store up to 200 kilograms. He had been lacking such a gu for some time, and it could be fed using only water and sunlight and was quite low maintenance. "I thank Qing Shu for his kindness!"
"Any time you need something, feel free to remember this former senior of yours," Qing Shu said. "Ah- but Fang Yuan, you must know that you also have to report to the elder's hall as well?"
"Indeed, give me some time to freshen up and I'll be there this afternoon," Fang Yuan said.
With that, Qing Shu and his gang took their leave.
Fang Zheng snorted. "They were really being intrusive before- to think that they're pretending like none of that happened at all!"
Fang Yuan, though, was not obsessed with taking revenge. So what if Qing Shu had decided to obstruct him? Someone else might've felt betrayed that someone who pretended to be like a mentor on the one hand had tried to trip them up, but Fang Yuan did not care about the actions of such a minor character in the grand scheme of things.
"Let it all go, brother, anger is like acid within a vessel- it damages its container the longer you hold onto it. It is time that we become unburdened by what has been," Fang Yuan said. "Think about it now- I am an elder, and you now have a Rank 2 vital gu. Give me some time and I will help you continue to boost your aptitude, and you'll soon be a true Rank 2 Gu Master!"
"Of course, right," Fang Zheng said, the discomfort in his heart somewhat eased now that he had heard those words.
Truth be told, he had always been a bit anxious that Fang Yuan might abandon him in the future, though it looked like he had no such intentions even after becoming an elder.
"But older brother, please be careful," Fang Zheng said. "Now that you're an elder, there's going to be various people looking to take advantage of you- some of the woman are especially going to try to honeypot you or something like that. You musn't fall for those vile seductress's ways!"
"Relax, I won't," Fang Yuan said, not needing this kind of lesson from Fang Zheng of all people.
Fang Yuan, for that matter, had several things to take care of now. For one, he would be allowed to check the clan's underground cavern for gu worm recipes up till Rank 3. Secondly, he could pick any Rank 3 gu worm of his choosing from below there- he was hoping to either get an investigative or defensive Rank 3 gu worm. As for an offensive Rank 3 gu worm, he already had some idea on what he would choose.
Before all of that though, he had to fulfil his formalities of walking into the clan hall and making himself known.
At the clan hall most of the elders were already present.
All of them had warm expressions towards Fang Yuan, with the biggest smile among them belonging to the clan head. Even if he had instigated Qing Shu to try and slow Fang Yuan down, he would not openly admit to that and if anyone asked Qing Shu the man would say that he had done all of that on his own.
"It's good that we have another elder right before the wolf tide starts to get worse."
"Fang Yuan- you're an excellent example for the coming generation. If only they all worked as hard as you!"
Fang Yuan got several offers and invitations for dinner and the like, though he tactfully declined all of them.
Main mission complete!
You've become an elder- now you can get 5 Human Path dao marks for every week that you remain an elder!
Fang Yuan still had not used any of his Human Path dao marks and stored them away in his inventory- so this was not much of a benefit for him. As it was he did not have many Human Path gu worms to be enticed by something like this.
New main mission unlocked!
To become Hokage is my dream! Dattebayo!
Description: Become clan head of the Gu Yue clan, and the leader of Gu Yue village.
Reward: Gain 5 Human Path dao marks for every day that you are clan head.
Even if Fang Yuan had no idea what the system meant by words like 'Hokage' and 'Dattebayo' he could do some quick maths and noted that it was promising him over 1,600 Human Path dao marks for serving as clan head. That was nearly double what one would gain from a heavenly tribulation on average, and with a simple six or seven years one's dao mark accumulation would exceed that of a Rank 6 with ease.

chapters.title: Chapter 94 - 94: Advancing to Rank Three: Part Four
chapters.content:
Despite this enticing offer, Fang Yuan had no intention of taking it up on it.
Certainly, the reward was rather large given it was risk-free. But one also had to take it into perspective. For one, it would lock him onto cultivating Human Path, which is not something he wanted to dedicate himself fully to as of yet. Secondly, it would mean that he would be bound to this location- Qing Mao mountain, for a very long time which he could not accept. There was an entire world waiting for him, after all! Third, while it sounded like a large number of dao marks- for example, by becoming an elder Fang Yuan would get 260 Human Path dao marks a year, about the same as an earthly calamity, because time moved faster within one's immortal aperture than the outside world the best way to accumulate dao marks was still through calamities and tribulations.
With these thoughts in mind, Fang Yuan left.
The elders who had all bore pleasant expressions until this point, became far more dour. Many of them had mixed reactions to Fang Yuan rising to the position of elder.
"How did he manage to reach Rank 3 so quickly?"
"He initially had the help of a Liquor Worm, and then later was able to use Red Steel Relic Gu!"
"Ah- if only I had those gu worms with me when I cultivated- life would've been so much easier!"
"Still to have gotten so far so soon- he seems to even be leaving Bai clan's Bai Ning Bing in the dust!"
These were just the thoughts that they voiced, their inner feelings were also quite complex.
'Perhaps I should have reached out to him for a marriage offer sooner,' Mo Chen thought.
'It will be harder to control him now, power changes a person greatly, and who knows what kinds of temptations will present themselves now that he is at Rank 3,' the clan head thought. His idea of stalling Fang Yuan's cultivation were not entirely out of pure self-interest, those who gained power too quickly tended to stray from the right path, and he didn't want such a thing to happen to Fang Yuan.
As Fang Yuan left, two people interrupted his path. One of them was Yu Sai, whom he had just recently met, and the other was a girl he vaguely recalled... right, her name was Li Mei.
"Elder Fang Yuan, congratulations on your ascent to Rank 3," Yu Sai said. "A few of your other classmates and I have arranged for a banquet for you, if you would, please come with us."
"Yes, we wish to give you our heartfelt congratulations," Li Mei said.
The reason that the two of them were doing so was because after it became widespread news that Fang Yuan had become an elder, his classmates naturally wanted to cozy up to him. And these two had been known as the 'leaders' of the Fang Yuan faction back during their academy days- and so had been roped into approaching him.
At least, Yu Sai had been roped in with the promise of a few primeval stones for arranging the whole thing. Li Mei though, was genuinely happy for Fang Yuan.
Also, as unrealistic as she knew it was, she was hoping that she might be able to catch Fang Yuan's attention now. As an elder he was entitled to one wife and two concubines- it was too much for her to hope to be his primary wife, but could she become his concubine? It would be wonderful if such a thing could happen!
"I need to deal with some business in the underground cavern first," Fang Yuan said.
"Of course, we will wait for your esteemed self," Yu Sai said as Fang Yuan walked off.
The underground cavern was a sacred place for the clan, and he had only entered it before when he had first awakened his aperture. Even as an elder, there was a time limit to how long he could stay there.
He first went through the Rank 3 gu recipes until he found one that he felt suited him to advance the Moonglow Gu. While there were a number of conventional advancement options, Fang Yuan was choosing to go with the Blood Moon Gu.
It had an effect of not only damaging a target, but also causing them to bleed out over time. It had its weaknesses- namely, most fights did not last long enough for the bleeding to actually be effective. Secondly if the enemy had even a Rank 2 healing gu worm they would be able to recover from the bleeding with relative ease. Third, the gu worm had a weakness where it would lose a third of its power and ooze fresh blood out once a month.ɴᴇᴡ ɴᴏᴠᴇʟ ᴄʜᴀᴘᴛᴇʀs ᴀʀᴇ ᴘᴜʙʟɪsʜᴇᴅ ᴏɴ N(o)vᴇl(F)ire.nᴇt
Despite these disadvantages, which is why most clan members chose to advance to something else like the Frost Moon Gu or the Illusory Moon Gu, Fang Yuan still went with it for one simple fact: it was very easy to feed.
All the Blood Moon Gu needed in order to be fed was fresh blood- it did not need the Moon Orchid Petals that most of the gu derived from the advancement of the Moonlight Gu did. Once Fang Yuan was free from this feeding requirement it would be much easier to leave Qing Mao mountain. Also, its third weakness, the fact that it lost some of its strength once a month, could be patched over once it was advanced to Rank 4.
He intended to refine it himself, as it was, it was not available for picking among the gu that were displayed here.
He looked at most of them and discarded them from his mind- many were not suitable for him or they had side effects or feeding problems that made them hard to use.
Among some of them he saw the Rank 3 Testicular Torsion Gu that Lord of the Mysteries had used. The unfortunate Gu Master who had fallen victim to its blow had recovered, and the clan had been able to refine it for their own use. Its food- which was the testicles of either animals or humans- were obtained from livestock after they had been slaughtered. Aside from this complex feeding requirement, Fang Yuan had no interest in it as it was useless against half the population he might have to fight in the future. Also, while it was painful it could not usually get a lethal blow.
He finally did find something that was useful to him- Rank 3 Pit Viper Gu. It took the form of a small beetle about the size of the head of a pin. It would reside near the Gu Master's nostrils and work quite similar to the pit organs that vipers possessed that let them sense heat. It worked like infrared vision goggles back on Earth- allowing the Gu Master to detect changes in temperature between different objects.
This had its own counter, being unsuitable for use in places like volcanos and the like, not to mention Gu Masters who could alter their body temperatures (though these were rare), still, it was a Rank 3 investigative gu and he could greatly benefit from it while exploring.
Feeding it was going to be a bit of a problem- as its food was snake meat. Not only was snake meat not commonly sold, it was also a bit of a pain to have to go out and hunt snakes. Given the few other options he had though, he would gladly go with this. As it was, now that he was an elder it would be easier to find others to do this kind of work for him.

chapters.title: Chapter 95 - 95: Advancing to Rank Three: Part Five
chapters.content:
Fang Yuan was approached by the Gu Master in charge of the cavern, telling him his time was up. Fang Yuan agreed to leave, and chose the Viper Pit Gu to take with him.
As they had said, Li Mei and Yu Sai were waiting patiently for him outside and led him to a small pavilion where most of the rest of his class was waiting.
Fang Yuan demonstrated some of his political acumen here- addressing nearly every single one of them by name. It wasn't that he had bothered to learn any of their names for any particular reason, but when he had been class president he had committed them to memory by sheer repetition.
"To think that Lord Fang Yuan remembers my name!"
"I always knew that Lord Fang Yuan would rise above all others!"
He was offered some of the finest wine, and there had been celebratory performances like dancing as well.
Fang Yuan was the center of attention, drinking only in moderation. Towards the end, he raised his cup and said, "All of you- I know that you've looked up to me ever since I was class president. Many of you have supported me since then. I thank you all for that support!"
There were cheers and applause when he said those words.
"Lord Fang Yuan is truly too kind!"
"The fact that I was in the same class as Lord Fang Yuan is my greatest fortune!"
"I remember looking forward to attending academy only to hear Lord Fang Yuan's voice as he called my name while taking attendance!"
"Indeed, and to have sparred with him was also my greatest joy!"
"Lord Fang Yuan was always the best of us!"
"As expected of the greatest student to have walked into the academy!"
"Heh, we already knew of Lord Fang Yuan's greatness when he found the last traces of that bastard Flower Wine Monk's inheritance!"
"Fang Yuan, thank you for helping me refine my gu worm... ehehe..." this voice was lost in the clamor of the rest of the crowd.
"Here's a small gift that we've arranged for you," Yu Sai said, indicating for some servants to bring several bags with 10,000 primeval stones. "Consider it a small token of appreciation from us for your service."
Fang Yuan nodded, instructing the servants to take the stones to his place. The problems he was having with primeval stones had resolved itself for now. As it was, the clan heavily favored the elders. They would get 100 primeval stones from the spirit spring each week, and with the upcoming wolf tide this amount would be raised to 300 primeval stones. While this was nothing to sneeze at, it would take time for him to build up some capital without this generous donation from his friends.
The system gave him no pushback for accepting this- though it could hardly be called a true 'gift.' Elders were the top brass in the clan and no doubt they wanted to get close to him.
"So many primeval stones!" Fang Zheng said, watching the bags being dropped off at Fang Yuan's room.
"Indeed, it looks like our future will be quite bright," Fang Yuan said. Fang Zheng did not miss his use of the word 'our.' "Now, I think it's high time that we get you to Rank 2, brother."
He spent the next few days supplementing Fang Zheng's aperture, and also providing him with enough primeval stones to supplement his aperture to break through to Rank 2.
While Fang Zheng did this, Fang Yuan bought a Blood Essence Gu and began the process of refining the Blood Moon Gu. He was able to succeed on his second attempt, and now had a Rank 3 offensive gu worm!
With this, he felt that he would soon be ready to head out to obtain the Venerable Inheritance whose location he had.
Fang Zheng emerged from closed door cultivation emitting a Rank 2 aura.
"Congratulations," Fang Yuan said. "Now, you can alternate days with the Nine Leaf Vitality Grass Gu, and other days to cultivate. We're not as pressed for primeval stones as before. And once you get to Rank 2 Peak Stage, I'll help you get to Rank 3 as well. Then, both of us will be elders."
Fang Zheng nodded, wanting to express his gratitude, but slumped over as he nearly passed out. Cultivating for so many days would place a heavy toll on anyone.
Fang Yuan adjusted him to sleep and rest off from the strain in his bed.
Main mission complete!
Reward: Rank 5 Equality Gu (x1) has been added to your inventory!
'What does Equality Gu do?' Fang Yuan wondered.
Equality Gu is a Human Path gu worm that contains the profundities of Heaven Path as well. Its effect is to achieve equality between two people.
This explanation made very little sense to Fang Yuan- and seemed to be nearly useless to someone like him. Even for nurturing Fang Zheng, he didn't feel like the use of another gu worm would be needed to get him to Rank 3 so long as he supplemented his primeval essence with his own and continued to supply him with primeval stones. Beyond that- sure, if Fang Yuan wanted to take him to that level, but for now, Fang Zheng's progress would be perfectly adequate.
'He really needs to take a bath though,' Fang Yuan thought. Fang Zheng spent nearly all of his time indoors that he didn't spend wandering outside visiting the inn and inspecting things indoors. He had no real friends at this point, and made no moves to try and socialize with people. Like Yu Sai, he didn't do missions either, so that was also out of the picture as a chance to socialize. Because of this, he had given up on many things like bathing and grooming himself. It had gotten to the point that even Fang Yuan was annoyed by the scent- then again, the fact that he had been in closed door cultivation up till this point didn't help with things.
Fang Yuan returned to his own room, pondering what his next step should be. Should he try to get a Rank 3 defensive-type gu worm, or should he try to reach for the inheritance just like this?
Bird die for food, humans die for wealth- Fang Yuan was without a doubt greatly desirous of the inheritance, but also didn't want to let his greed blind him to the point where it might cause him to meet his end.
On the contrary, if he waited too long he might miss out on certain things that could speed up his cultivation. With the Spring Autumn Cicada recovering day by day, he couldn't afford to sit idle and cultivate for a few years in peace. Not to mention, for some of the other inheritances from his memories that he was eyeing, he would need to make a move soon.
"As the fresh soil of spring brings,Thᴇ link to the origɪn of this information rᴇsts ɪn NovᴇlFir(e).nᴇt
Bound into the hardest clumps,
Torn apart by the farmer's plough,
Into the tiniest of fragments,
Broken up but still whole,
Later joining with each other yet again,
The Earth, no matter how damaged,
Will over the eons, repair itself,
And then blossom into flowers anew."

chapters.title: Chapter 96 - 96: Bai Ning Bussin: Part One
chapters.content:
Shortly thereafter, the wolf tide increased in intensity.
By this point, the three clans had all come to a mutual consensus to work together to weather the upcoming storm. There would be three Thunder Crown Wolves that this wolf tide had- each with the strength of a Rank 4 Gu Master. It was only if they were split up against each clan head that the clans could survive.
Not only that, but there were numerous Hundred Beast Kings and Thousand Beast Kings as well, which had to be dealt with either the strongest of Rank 2 Gu Masters or the elders. Forgetting them, even ordinary Lightning Wolves could threaten mortals and Gu Masters in large numbers.
Contests were first held as shows of strength- neither of the Fang twins were at them. Fang Yuan was an elder now and did not participate in these kinds of things anymore, while Fang Zheng was so beyond doing anything that he didn't show up either. In his previous life, Fang Yuan had been tasked with logistics during this time, but he would have to fight against the Thousand Beast Kings and perhaps even aide the Thunder Crown Wolf when the clan head assaulted him.
The clan did not favor elders without reason, after all.
'Qing Shu is fated to die soon trying to save the village,' Fang Yuan thought. Even if he wanted to, as Rank 3 he could do little to prevent that fate. It would be a different matter altogether if he was at Rank 3 Peak Stage with a full set of Rank 3 gu worms, or at Rank 4. Even in such a circumstance though, he would not senselessly risk his life for the sake of the village.
As part of the three village's alliance, a merit board had been set up with the assistance of several information-type gu worms. Primeval stones were no longer being used as the main form of currency, instead, merit points were being handed out and exchanged. There were several ways to gain merit points, though the easiest was by killing Lightning Wolves.
Merit points could be exchanged for various prizes, with gu worms being the foremost among them.
To Fang Yuan, the majority of those gu worms were not useful. There were a few that he could use to advance the Moon Raiment Gu, with the best option being to turn it into the Moonlight Chainmail Gu, a Rank 3 defensive gu worm.
The easiest way to get the materials needed, of course, was by killing many Lightning Wolves. As a matter of fact, most of the daily quests he was getting were quests to kill Lightning Wolves around some of the mortal villages, or to save villagers from the same.
He would need to kill a few Hundred Beast Kings, or even one or two Thousand Beast Kings though, if he was planning on getting the materials for a Rank 3 refinement.
All around the village, there were multiple desperate fights going on between humans and wolves. Some of them were between mortals who used sticks, arrows, or whatever they could find to deal with the beasts- while others were with teams of Gu Masters against large foes.
It was not uncommon to see two groups from different clans fighting together- as was happening right now with a group from the Bai clan and one from the Xiong clan locked in a deadly battle that had turned against them when a Hundred Beast King Wolf had appeared out of seemingly nowhere.
"Darn it!"
"Don't worry- one of our elders, Elder Bai Ning Bing has recently come out of closed door cultivation! We can rely on him to reinforce us!"
"Tch," someone from the Xiong clan said. "Rather than relying on this Bai Ning Bing, we need to use our own strength! Who knows if he'll even come here or not, there are fierce battles going on everywhere! Listen, I have a way to deal with this Hundred Beast King. I have a gu known as Plunder Gu which can steal gu worms from other creatures- and once this Hundred Beast King has lost its wild gu we'll be able to deal with it!" In their base forms, Hundred Beast Kings weren't that hard to deal with given they were just wild animals with low intelligence compared to humans, but if they had one or multiple wild gu worms it could completely change the flow of battle.
"Alright then!"
"But there is a weakness- my Plunder Gu needs time to work and has to be sustained by my primeval essence. I need some other people to hold him off while I prepare and finish this move."
"Leave it to us!"
If the Plunder Gu was successful, they would live- if not, they would surely meet their ends at the teeth of this Hundred Beast King!
What they were unaware of was that the Bai Ning Bing they had been talking about was watching the scene from high up above a cliff.
'Such a fight... so boring...' he thought.Thɪs
Bai Ning Bing had been born with one of the Ten Physiques- the Northern Dark Ice Soul Physique. Above A-grade talents there were the Ten Physiques, called so after Ren Zu's ten children. Such people had massive reserves of primeval essence and could advance at an unbelievable rate. Unfortunately, nothing in life was without a downside- this great potential was tempered by the fact that their apertures were unstable. At some point, it would reach a pint where they would self-detonate and release a massive amount of energy into the surroundings.
The three villages were actually doomed to die from Bai Ning Bing's detonation, or that was how it went back in Fang Yuan's old life. Fang Yuan had been spared this fate as he had been sent away shortly after the wolf tide.
Bai Ning Bing knew his days were numbered, and had little to live for other than excitement. Those fighting down below him- perhaps if they made a good show, he would be able to have some fun?
The fact that there was a Bai clansmen down there did not move his heart in the slightest, even if he could save all of them with what amounted to a single flick of his wrist.
As it was, he had recently begun to resent his fellow Bai clansmen due to something that had happened a few months earlier.
A Few Months Ago
"I have a new idea as to how we can try to deal with the Gu Yue clan," Bai Ning Bing had once opined at an elder's meeting.
"Oh? Do tell us what you've thought of."
"All warfare is based on deception," Bai Ning Bing said. "So, we must therefore spread misinformation to the Gu Yue clan, preferably by leaking it, so that they are confused and rattled by what we're doing."
"What kind of information."
"I propose that we spread the rumor that we've been seeding the water with chemicals that make the frogs gay," Bai Ning Bing said, quite proud of his idea. "They'll have no idea what to make of that rumor, whether they can prove or disprove it or not, and will waste valuable time trying to deal with this situation which isn't even happening."
"..."
"Is this some kind of elaborate joke?"
"What? No!" Bai Ning Bing retorted. "What would make you think that?"
"Why on earth would the Gu Yue clan fall for such an obvious lie?"
"Tch- you know what, I'll try leaking the information myself and then you'll all see how brilliant my idea is!"
Modern Day
Bai Ning Bing snorted- despite saying all of that during that time, it didn't look like his disinformation tactic had yielded any results, even now after having exited closed door cultivation.
It was because of that he was in a bit of a foul mood.

chapters.title: Chapter 97 - 97: Bai Ning Bussin: Part Two
chapters.content:
Below Bai Ning Bing, the battle was coming to a climactic conclusion.
"Plunder Gu! Activate!" the Xiong clansmen said, putting all of his primeval essence into the gu worm. Stealing someone else's gu worm was extraordinarily difficult- otherwise Theft Path would've been far more widespread than it was now. It was only Thieving Heavenly Demonic Venerable who had been truly able to take the Theft Path to its true heights. These were wild gu worms that he was trying to steal, so it was not as hard as trying to take it from a person, but it still took a massive amount of primeval essence.
His primeval essence rapidly dropped- from 30% to 20% to 10%. 'No! I can't sustain this for any longer!' His essence had already been exhausted from prior fighting, otherwise they wouldn't have been in this scenario in the first place.
When his essence ran out, the move failed and he suffered intense backlash, spitting out a mouthful of blood.
"Oh no! We're done for!"
Right as they thought it was all over, however, the Hundred Beast King suddenly howled as blood erupted from its right flank.
It turned to see that there was someone else on the battlefield who looked like they had stepped out of thin air. This person was emanating a Rank 3 aura, had long black hair and eyes which looked like pits of nothingness. This person raised his arm and a wine-red moonblade shot out, decapitating the Hundred Beast King.
It was none other than Fang Yuan!
"It looks like I was just in the nick of time," Fang Yuan said to the three people who had managed to survive until then.
"Ah... Lord... your name...?" they asked when they could find their voices. Fang Yuan was wearing the uniform of a Gu Yue villager, though none of them recognized him.
"I am Gu Yue Fang Yuan," he answered. "I saw that the three of you were in trouble, so I came to assist you."
"Ah... you have our thanks!"
"Lord is truly too kind!"
"I am moved to tears by lord's magnanimity!"
These words of gratitude came from deep within all three of their hearts. Why? Because none of them was a Gu Yue clansman. If they had been saved by a Bai or Xiong clan elder, it would be different and some of them would feel they had just gotten lucky to be next to the other party.
However, Fang Yuan had to be a true hero, else he would not have gone out of his way to help them.
Right as they were celebrating though, someone leaped down from up above.
It was Bai Ning Bing!
He had been watching what was going on dispassionately from above until now- that was, until Fang Yuan had appeared and killed the Hundred Beast King.
He normally would've written this off as things taking a turn for the boring- it was only in life-and-death situations that one could find excitement, but that was until he laid eyes upon Fang Yuan.
For one, his attacking method was quite odd- it was a crimson-shaded moonblade that he hadn't seen before. He was well versed that moonblades were the favored attacking method of the Gu Yue clan, but this was a novelty, even among their elders against whom he'd fought.
That was simply something weird he hadn't seen before- but as he looked at Fang Yuan, he felt a strange sense of comraderie that he hadn't felt from anyone before in his life.
Loneliness, isolation, uncaring for the world- all of these things seemed to be emanating from this person much like they were contained within himself.
"Hello friend!" Bai Ning Bing cackled as he observed Fang Yuan even more closely- he had no real 'friends' but felt that he could forge a friendship with this person in an instant.
"Elder Bai Ning Bing!" the Bai clansmen there exclaimed.
Fang Yuan, although he hadn't seen Bai Ning Bing in his previous life, immediately knew who this was. Although the fact that he had the Northern Dark Soul Ice physique was not well known outside of a few elders of the Bai clan, Fang Yuan was already prepared for it as he knew what the ultimate outcome of that would be.
As Fang Yuan glanced at Bai Ning Bing though, notifications began popping up from the system.
New main mission unlocked!
Bai Ning Bing Chilling
Description: Marry Bai Ning Bing.
Reward: Rank 6 Dreams of Love & Happiness Gu (x 1)
Fang Yuan: ...
'System, are you crazy? Asking me to marry Bai Ning Bing- and why is this the only other quest up till now that offers an immortal gu as its reward?'
New secret mission unlocked!
It takes a real man to be best girl.
Description: ???Thɪs No(ᴠ)ᴇlFire.nᴇt
Reward: ???
Fang Yuan, at this point, had no clue what was going on with the system or what to make of that.
"I was wondering, friend, that it would be great if the two of us would fight to the death right now!" Bai Ning Bing said, now surging with bloodlust.
Fang Yuan was unmoved. "Elder Bai Ning Bing, it is inappropriate for us to be fighting when the beast tide is on full swing. And... I wonder why you didn't bother helping your own clansmen when they were in need? Were you not watching this scene all this time?"
"Heh- clansmen? Who cares for them?" Bai Ning Bing said, shooting an ice blade into the skull of one of the people whom Fang Yuan had rescued. "Look at that- whether they died from the Hundred Beast King, or died from me, what difference did it make?"
"Bai Ning Bing- you fiend!"
"How could you do that? Elder Fang Yuan, please save us!"
Fang Yuan though, was unmoved by the person's death. He had already gotten the reward from the system which would help him refine Moonlight Chainmail Gu. So what if they died right after?
"Hehe..." Bai Ning Bing said. "Seeing your face- I know now for certain what kind of person you are! You might stand over there acting all righteous and honorable, but I know that deep down lies the heart of a true demon! Not just a demon, but a demon among demons!"
Bai Ning Bing slaughtered the two remaining survivors. "Ahaha... but if you wish to show everyone that you're righteous, go ahead and see if you can avenge their deaths!"
Now, it was just the two of them facing each other.
Fight Bai Ning Bing?
As if!
Fang Yuan knew that he wasn't his match- even if he also had Rank 3 strength. With the Extreme Physique Bai Ning Bing could easily go toe-to-toe with Gu Masters even a major realm above him, let alone someone like him who had just reached Rank 3.
In a fluid motion, he withdrew the Hundred Li Earth Wolf Spider from his inventory and then mounted it, immediately turning tail.
So what if he had to run from battle?
Only an idiot would still fight when the odds were against them!
As for the system's dumb quests, Fang Yuan had no idea what had gotten into it to even suggest that the two of them got married, but he wasn't about to stand around waiting to see if it finally came to its senses!

chapters.title: Chapter 98 - 98: Bai Ning Bussin: Part Three
chapters.content:
Bai Ning Bing snorted coldly- as if he would let his prey get away!
He had not seen the Hundred Li Earth Wolf Spider before, but chased after it without hesitation as it burrowed underground.
"Hey! Come back here and fight me like a man!"
Needless to say Fang Yuan did not turn around, using up as many primeval stones as possible to propel the Rank 4 mount forward into the earth.
Bai Ning Bing, despite having a vast reserve of primeval essence, found that he could not keep up. Although Fang Yuan could not use the spider to its full potential with his Rank 3 cultivation, the fact still remained that it was a top-tier Rank 4 movement gu. On top of which, they were burrowing through the ground, a place where Bai Ning Bing had a distinct disadvantage when it came to moving with his gu worms. The trails left by the spider would sometimes collapse, or the ice would not mix well with the soil, or something would get in his eyes.ɴᴇᴡ ɴᴏᴠᴇʟ ᴄʜᴀᴘᴛᴇʀs ᴀʀᴇ ᴘᴜʙʟɪsʜᴇᴅ ᴏɴ
This was not the kind of terrain that he or his gu worms were used to transversing.
Within minutes all he could see was Fang Yuan's form turning into a miniscule shadow on the horizon as the light became dimmer and dimmer.
"Tch! Fang Yuan, you may have escaped this time, but we will meet again!" Bai Ning Bing yelled out after Fang Yuan, even though the latter could not hear him.
He crawled up out of the earth, returning to where there three bodies were placed.
"Where was that gu worm...?" he was looking for the Plunder Gu- he hadn't seen anything like it as of yet while on Qing Mao mountain.
After a few minutes of searching, he found it, but it had self-detonated. Gu carried the wills of their owners, and could be destroyed with just a thought. Normally people would not do so while they were in a clan, because their gu worms would be recovered and go to their families. Currently, with the rules set up by the three clans coming together, this was still maintained even if someone from another clan found another clan member's gu worm. All clans kept detailed records of what gu worms their Gu Masters had, so unless they were people like Fang Yuan who were purposefully keeping some gu worms secret it was not possible to take a Gu Master's gu worms as loot.
But of course, most people were not like Fang Yuan and their gu worms were public record among the clans. And so, according to rules, their gu worms would be returned to the clans and to their families.
Rules? Regulations? What did Bai Ning Bing care for either of them?
If he had feared the clan's rules and regulations, he would not have slain these three Gu Masters so readily. It was one thing to kill the Xiong clansmen- those were people of another clan and as the Bai clan's genius and future hope he knew his clan would save him. However, killing his own clansman would've without a doubt resulted in resentment and anger from the rest of his clan members.
What did he care even for them?
What did he even care for the world?
HIs only goal was to pursue exciting opportunities wherever he wandered- no matter how dangerous or who he was up against.
That was the only way that he could ever get his blood rushing, and feel his heart pounding.
The Xiong clansmen had likely already figured such out, and had chosen to detonate his gu worms rather than letting someone else have them.
A pity, because it was quite an interesting gu worm.
However, he had found something even more interesting.
A rival- someone to compete against. Something that he could look forward to.
No doubt, eventually, the two of them would cross paths again.
'Heh- next time we meet, Fang Yuan, I will definitely take your life!' Bai Ning Bing thought.
Meanwhile, Fang Yuan was riding atop the Hundred Li Earth Wolf Spider. It was a good thing that he had obtained the Pit Viper Gu, as he could not see anything where they were currently burrowed underground.
The spider could move through earth and soil as easily as a fish would move through water, however, its defenses and offense were not that good. Fang Yuan still had to remain on alert, and with the Pit Viper Gu he could somewhat sense his surroundings. The best part of it was that most things that were a threat to him were living creatures- the downside of course was that he would easily miss nonliving things like traps that might be set up.
But, no single gu worm was perfect. That was why there was no strongest gu worm, only the strongest Gu Master.
Once they were at a safe distance, the spider burrowed them out. Fang Yuan looked around- they were truly alone.
'Its speed is truly something worthy of a Rank 4 gu worm!' Fang Yuan thought. No wonder the Flower Wine Monk had been able to spread such terror with an upgraded version of this gu worm. He would be able to wander the Southern Border and attack and retreat with impunity so long as he had the mobility of the Thousand Li Earth Wolf Spider.
Fang Yuan placed the spider back in his aperture, with it fitting inside the infinitesemal space with ease despite its size.
Fang Yuan brushed the dirt off of him- he didn't particularly care about the dirt, but the main issue with this gu worm was that it was hard to feed. Despite having 'wolf' in its name it did not feed on anything as convenient as wolf meat, rather it needed a special kind of soil that could be found on a neighboring mountain. It was easy enough to get there with the help of the spider itself, but very inconvenient and he might not be able to find large amounts of that soil where he would later go on.
He returned back to the village and turned his attention to refining the Moonlight Chainmail Gu. Despite being a Rank 3 gu refinement, he managed to succeed on his first attempt and he pocketed the newly formed gu worm in his aperture.
Now, he finally had a complete set of Rank 3 gu worms. But this was not the end of collecting gu- the next step was to assemble a group of gu worms that complimented each other and belonged to the path one intended to cultivate.
He reported Bai Ning Bing for his actions, saying that he had barely been able to run away in the nick of time, as if he didn't there was a slight chance Bai Ning Bing might end up framing him or changing the scenario in such a way to implicate Fang Yuan. As it was, from that fight, only he and Bai Ning Bing had survived, and neither had a recording gu worm with them, so it was just two people's words against each other. This could not be considered to be strong evidence, at least, not against an elder like Bai Ning Bing.
As it was though, thoughts of Bai Ning Bing were far from his mind- the only thing he could think about was the inheritance that was about to fall into his hands!

chapters.title: Chapter 99 - 99: The Two Venerables: Part One
chapters.content:
"Brother, you're leaving somewhere?" Fang Zheng asked, seeing Fang Yuan's preparations.
"Indeed, there is something that I need to look into," Fang Yuan said. "It's a secret mission, so I need you to keep the fact that I'm gone on the down-low for now. How is your cultivation going?"
"I think I might be at Rank 2 Middle Stage in a few weeks," Fang Zheng said.
"Good, let me supplement your primeval essence once before I go," Fang Yuan said. He needed a large group of primeval stones himself in order to make the Hundred Li Earthwolf Spider work, but it was not that much of an issue to supplement Fang Zheng's primeval aperture as the gap between three minor realms and a major realm meant that his primeval essence was worth sixteen times as much as Fang Zheng's.
If he had the Seven Fragrances Liquor Worm, he would be able to double his own primeval essence supply. However, refining that with Fang Zheng's help was an issue given how inexperienced Fang Zheng was. Fang Yuan could've simply taken the Four Flavors Liquor Worm back, but that would damage Fang Zheng and also affect his cultivation, something that he did not want. Also, disregarding the low probability of success he simply did not have the time or resources to attempt to do so right now.
As it was, Fang Yuan was now fully confident in being able to explore around the area of Qing Mao mountain now that he had reached Rank 3. If it had been normal times he would've packed his bags and already left the mountain to go look for a nearby inheritance he knew that existed, but given everything that was happening he intended to return after this trip was over. He would also need a method to convince Fang Zheng to leave the mountain- whether willingly or not.
Fang Yuan left early next morning.
The location of the inheritance had been engraved into his brain so thoroughly that he felt that even if he wanted to, he couldn't forget it.
It was hard to find a clearing suitable enough to leave away from prying eyes- so he made one by sending a small pack of Lightning Wolves to their graves.
He took out the Hundred Li Earth Wolf Spider- it was the size of a large horse, and had a natural dip in its body near its head for the gu master controlling it to sit comfortably.
The only issue was that some people would have trouble riding a huge spider simply because of their own squeamishness, but Fang Yuan had none of these issues as he injected his primeval essence into the spider and it burrowed deep underground.
To Fang Yuan, the darkness underground instead felt like he was wearing infrared goggles. There was not much of interest other than small insects or mammals underground. The Earthwolf Spider was also not blind and moved through the earth to avoid obstacles. Two or three times it abruptly changed course- Fang Yuan was not sure why, but it was likely to avoid some obstacle or waking up some creature that could be dangerous to it.
Fang Yuan let it navigate on its own, concentrating on replenishing his own primeval essence with primeval stones constantly. Despite this, twice during their journey he had exhausted too much of this and the spider had to surface once it found somewhere safe so that Fang Yuan could rest and replenish some of his primeval essence without expending it.
The journey normally should've taken them until sunset, but because Fang Yuan lacked Rank 4 primeval essence the moon was high in the sky and it was nearing midnight by the time they reached their location.Follow current ɴᴏᴠᴇʟs on ɴovel(ꜰ)ɪre.nᴇt
They were near the foot of Qing Mao mountain right now. The chilly night air assaulted them as Fang Yuan put the spider back in his primeval aperture. He couldn't see any life forms even with his Pit Viper Gu except far out in the distance.
Even in his former life, he had not heard of there being an inheritance in this area. What that meant was that it was likely that the inheritance was carefully hidden so that no one had found it yet- possibly there was a Blessed Land or Grotto-Heaven located in this area.
As he was wondering how it would be that he would try to discover the entrance should that be the case, the Spring Autumn Cicada in his aperture began humming as if it were reacting to something.
The next instant, a hole appeared in the middle of the air and opened up to a place where the sun was shining brightly as if it was high noon, in stark contrast to the ongoing night in the outside world.
It was the entrance to a Blessed Land, just like he'd thought. Either that, or a Grotto-Heaven where time was synched up so that it was daytime and not night right now.
Either way, there was only one direction to go if he wanted to find out what was in this inheritance- forward!
Fang Yuan stepped into the place, his eyes taking a moment to adjust to the light. The gap he had come in through closed up behind him, and the Spring Autumn Cicada which had earlier been humming now quieted down.
He was also able to feel all of his gu worms as if he could use them- meaning that this place was not suppressing the mortal gu that he had. That was good- meaning that the one who controlled this Blessed Land did not want to interfere with his usage of gu worms and was likely quite friendly.
Judging by its size, it was not enough to be a proper Grotto-Heaven, as a matter of fact now that Fang Yuan's eyes had adjusted to the bright light and could take a better look around it was rather small at only around 4,000 square kilometers. It had likely belonged to a Rank 6 Gu Immortal at one point before it had landed on the ground. Fang Yuan did not know of any Gu Immortal who had died in the area- but the affairs of immortals were so far removed from that of ordinary people that he could not rely on his knowledge of Qing Mao mountain.
From the looks of it, it seemed to be suited towards rearing Earth Path resources. It also had not seemingly opened up randomly for Fang Yuan as there was a path leading down from where he was standing to a table with two chairs, though there was nothing on the table and no one sitting on either of the chairs.
Fang Yuan couldn't detect anything with his Pit Viper Gu or his normal vision, so he went down the path towards the table.
As he was about to reach it, a figure materialized in front of him.
At first glance, one might mistake him for the Flower Wine Monk given his shaved head, but that could not be further from the identity of this man. Fang Yuan had seen images of him all around the Southern Border in reverence, and when he had been in the Eastern Sea even the mermaids had held him in high regard and erected statues of him in various cities.
Above all though, was the kind and gentle expression on his face he was known for which contrasted harshly with the look of scorn the Flower Wine Monk possessed.
Paradise Earth Immortal Venerable!
Of course, this was not the actual person, but a will manifested of Paradise Earth Immortal Venerable. In other words, it was a portion of his thoughts that had taken his form and could exist independently even if his actual body had already perished.
The will gestured to one of the chairs. "Gu Yue Fang Yuan, please take a seat, I've been expecting you."

chapters.title: Chapter 100 - 100: The Two Venerables: Part Two
chapters.content:
Paradise Earth Immortal Venerable's will took a seat. With a wave of his hand, food and drinks appeared on the table. Being a will, he would not need to eat himself, but he had likely accomplished this either by communicating with this place's land spirit or through gu worms. Wills did not produce any essence of their own, lacking natural bodies, but they could be left with immortal essence from the user and gu worms.
Fang Yuan took a seat, glancing down at the tea that had been served before him. It looked more like a chocolate sundae than anything, with specks of green sprinkles that seemed to resemble small islands of grass.
"That is my Earth Mousee Tea," Paradise Earth Immortal Venerable said. "Feel free to drink Fang Yuan, I haven't poisoned anything."
"That's what someone who had poisoned them would say."
Paradise Earth chuckled. "You and I both know what my nature is Fang Yuan- I have no intention of harming you while you are here. As a matter of fact, if you were an Earth Parth Gu Immortal I had a different kind of tea that could give you some dao marks by drinking it. Alas, there is something else that we have in store for you."
Fang Yuan took a seat and a sip of the tea. It was without a doubt, delicious- Food Path methods had been used in its manufacture, and it had likely taken quite some time to make. He could say it was the best tea that he'd had in all of his life, but he was not here for the food. Even if the materials used to make this tea might be worth more than the entirety of Qing Mao mountain. "So, I take it that you are behind the system that has been communicating with me?" Fang Yuan asked, getting directly to the meat of the matter.
Paradise Earth shook his head. "To say that I am the originator of that system would be a grave exaggeration, Fang Yuan. Much as a house is built not just by the architect, but by teams of construction workers, plumbers, and the like- I played a large part in the system's creation, yes, but I can't take all of the credit."
"Then where did the system come from?"
"...you're not ready to know that yet..." Paradise Earth said after a pause.
"Not ready?"
"Don't worry, all will be clear eventually," Paradise Earth said. "But right now, your strength and abilities are not up to the point where you can make use of that knowledge even were I to give it to you. Instead, I'm here to help you with some things that will help you reach that realm."Tʜe sourcᴇ of thɪs content ɪs NovᴇlFirenᴇt
Fang Yuan frowned. "Old man- don't think I'll be led around the nose like some donkey!"
"Calm your heart down, Fang Yuan," Paradise Earth said. "I have more than enough things to keep you interested for now. For one, I take it that despite what I have asked you to do- your inner nature has not changed whatsoever?"
Fang Yuan: ...
"Given that, it makes this next part a bit harder than it normally would be," Paradise Earth said. "However, it is still possible. I take it that you already know about the Ten Extreme Physiques very well- but what if I were to tell you that there was another physique, one that was only slightly inferior to them but without the drawbacks?"
Fang Yuan's interest was piqued. "And what is that?"
"It is called the Righteous Virtue Physique," Paradise Earth said. "Anyone can obtain it- so long as they use the Accumulate Virtue Gu and preform enough virtuous deeds. Though, this method doesn't seem to suit someone like you."
"Why not? I have done many virtuous acts."
"Out of simple desire to do good with no expectation of a reward in return?"
"..."
"That is what I thought," Paradise Earth said. "I had hoped that you could change- but can you truly wish to help people selflessly? Even if you can, I'm afraid we don't have the time for you to change so. There is, however, an alternative way to obtain the Righteous Virtue Physique."
Paradise Earth handed Fang Yuan an information type gu worm, and as Fang Yuan used it, the method of refining the Righteous Virtue Physique entered his mind.
It was a less successful method, but this success rate could be improved upon with the assistance of some gu worms and the help of one of the Ten Extreme Physiques. Is that why the system wanted him to marry Bai Ning Bing?
Disregarding that, it was still possible to obtain it without their help. The key ingredients were that the Gu Master in question had to be at Rank 5, and possess one of the gu that represented the seven virtues: Charity, Hope, Faith, Justice, Diligence, Prudence, and Moderation. Not only did they have to be Rank 5, but the Gu Master had to refine them by at least one stage themselves. Then, one hundred Human Path Dao Marks had to be used in the refinement as well.
Many of the ingredients were already there with Fang Yuan- as a matter of fact, he had a feeling that he had one of the seven gu required for the refinement.
"Once you obtain the Righteous Virtue Physique," Paradise Earth said, "then and only then do I want you to ascend to the rank of immortal as once you reach Rank 6 the same recipe will not work. It will greatly improve your prospects, Fang Yuan, once you become an immortal, I will open up the rest of this inheritance up for you."
"Is this really all that you're giving me?" Fang Yuan sneered. "Paradise Earth, don't you think you're being too stingy and poor? Does a mighty Venerable only leave these things for their inheritors?"
Paradise Earth smiled. "If you wish for more Fang Yuan, become Rank 6 and come back here. I will give this Blessed Land to you then, and on top of which, I will also give you partial ownership of one of my Paradise Grotto-Heavens."
"Partial ownership? You're not even handing me over the whole thing?"
"That paradise I made is a... how shall you say... a republic. One in which there is not the rule of simply the strong, but rule by the will of the people, after a fashion," Paradise Earth said. "Though, I can assure you that you will not be unsatisfied by what is handed to you. And who said this all that is being left to you? After you speak with me, you need to speak with Genesis Lotus Immortal Venerable. He and I have cooperated for this task, and he too has some gifts for you."
Fang Yuan was less certain about this. While Paradise Earth had a reputation of not hurting anyone, not even the worst of demons, Genesis Lotus Immortal Venerable was different. He was also a Venerable who had served as a member of the Heavenly Court- meaning that he would be at extreme odds with most of Fang Yuan's actions.
"You may relax, within this Blessed Land, no one can harm each other," Paradise Earth said. "It is one of my methods. Now, I think you've overstayed your allotted time with me, perhaps we can chat sometime later Fang Yuan over another cup of tea. For now, you need to see Genesis Lotus Immortal Venerable, it would be rude of me to keep one of my colleagues waiting."
"Wait you haven't even answered-" Fang Yuan was about to protest, but Paradise Earth waved his hand and the scenery around Fang Yuan immediately shifted.

chapters.title: Chapter 101 - 101: The Two Venerables: Part Three
chapters.content:
Fang Yuan did not even finish his protest by the time he found himself near a large pond, far away from where he had originally entered the Blessed Land.
Next to him was a man dressed up in a green robe who was working on a painting of the nearby lake. His eyes were completely focused on the task at hand, and he had not so much as blinked when Fang Yuan was transported near him.
It was a man whom Fang Yuan had also seen many portraits of, though in the Central Continent.
Genesis Lotus Immortal Venerable!
Just like with Paradise Earth, this was not the true body of Genesis Lotus Immortal Venerable, but that of a will.
The will, however, continued to pain, paying no heed to Fang Yuan.
"Oi! How long do you intend to keep painting for?" Fang Yuan asked after a moment.
"I was always ready to talk to you, Fang Yuan," Genesis Lotus said. "I was merely under the impression that you too, like me, were trying to appreciate the scenery first. But I guess we can get to business then. Are you done speaking with that half-breed?"
Fang Yuan paused. "Half-breed?"
"Ah, he didn't tell you? He is part mushroomman," Genesis Lotus said. That was news to Fang Yuan- one reason why it was widely accepted that 'man was the spirit of all things' was because all Venerables had been human up till this point in time. However, it appeared that being part variant human was not an obstacle for becoming a Venerable. But was that why Paradise Earth had never joined up with the Heavenly Court when he had been alive? Many assumed that it was because he did not agree with the Heavenly Court's methods of greatly oppressing the variant humans, but this was likely a far more important reason. "Then again, variant humans, otherworldly demons- we have quite a crowd that we are mingling with, hmm?"
"You know where I'm from?" Fang Yuan asked.
"I know quite a lot about you," Genesis Lotus said. "I had already foretold your arrival in this world long after my death. How are you finding the Painting Path gu worm that I left for you? Actually, forget that, i don't see the Human Path dao marks upon your body that I was expecting. Where are they?"
"I have not yet committed to cultivating the Human Path," Fang Yuan said.
When he heard those words, Genesis Lotus stopped painting and put his brush down, turning around to look at Fang Yuan and giving him his full undivided attention. "Why?"
"I do not know enough to dedicate myself to it," Fang Yuan said.
"You only resist right now because you are, sadly, ignorant to the powers of the Human Path, Fang Yuan," Genesis Lotus said. "If you knew of the Human Path's full potential, you would not say those words or have this kind of hesitation. Man is the spirit of all things, Fang Yuan, and the Human Path is the core profundity of all other paths. It can mimic every other path without limitation unlike the Transformation Path which has multiple restrictions - you must have seen it already in Strength of Ten Men Gu, and the future Dreams of Love & Happiness Gu which you are to receive. One mimics Strength Path and the other mimics Dream Path, but both are actually Human Path gu worms. Even though Human Path counters Heaven Path, Equality Gu has the effects of Heaven Path as well despite being a Human Path gu worm. Not only that, Human Path Dao marks do not conflict with other paths and make healing remarkably easy. But I suppose that all of that is still not enough- tell me, Fang Yuan, you desire eternal life, do you not?"
Fang Yuan didn't even feel the need to reply to that question.
"In 'The Legends of Ren Zu', it is said that the primitive hairy men tried to refine Eternity Gu using Verdant Sun, because he was the offspring of Ren Zu, the spirit ancestor. Do you know what that means- although 'The Legends of Ren Zu' is a fairy tale, there are truths buried between those lines. If there is a way to refine Eternity Gu, it will involve the human path," Genesis Lotus said.
"You know," Fang Yuan began, "back in my world there was another famous powerful leader who was a painter and also hated certain groups of people. Perhaps there is a correlation between those three things."
"Are you referring to my comments on the hairymen and Paradise Earth's ancestry?" Genesis Lotus asked before coldly smiling. "Don't be ridiculous, Fang Yuan, they are all variant humans- in other words, they don't count as 'people.' Putting that aside, know that if you were to ask any other path the question 'Is Eternal Life possible?' you would get an emphatic answer- 'no!' However, the Human Path is the only one which would instead answer, 'there is not yet enough data to answer' meaning that if Eternal Life can be achieved, it is only via the Human Path. Moreover, it is only the Human Path that can directly counter heaven."Google seaʀᴄh NovᴇlFirᴇ.ɴet
"Aren't you a member of the Heavenly Court? Countering heaven... is that not the language of the demonic path?" Fang Yuan asked.
Genesis Lotus had an unreadable expression on his face. "I am a member of the Heavenly Court... but that does not mean that I agree with all of their ideals. Primordial Origin Immortal Venerable and Star Constellation Immortal Venerable have their ideas... and I have mine. We overlap on most things and ah, disagree with some other plans. There were will come a time in history when the Heavenly Court will need the Human Path, and I will develop it for that day even if it means dealing with strange bedfellows in the meantime. Until now, heaven restricts the development of that path for the very reason that it is too powerful- only through the efforts of Venerables and otherworldly demons has the Human Path even developed remotely to the point that it has up till now."
"Well, are you only here to sell me on the Human Path, or do you want to actually give me something useful?" Fang Yuan asked.
"There are a few things I have prepared for you, yes," Genesis Lotus said. His hand went inside his 'body' which was really just made of his thoughts, and pulled out a portrait. It was blank with nothing on it. "This painting will be useful to you when you ascend to become an immortal." He handed it to Fang Yuan who kept it in the Tusita Grass Gu. Genesis Lotus then pulled out another painting- this one painted entirely black. "This will activate once your understanding of the Human Path progresses." He then handed Fang Yuan a painting which was painted in different sections in various colors of the rainbow to make a spiral pattern. "This will be useful, again, after you become an immortal. And this, is the last painting that I have to give you." He handed Fang Yuan the painting of what looked like a small girl's room, filled with teapots and furniture too small for an adult. "Actually, this one isn't intended for you- you are merely the vehicle to which it will be given to someone else."
Fang Yuan snorted inwardly- as if he was going to let someone else have it! He kept the four paintings in the Tusita Grass Gu as well.
Fang Yuan couldn't help but say, "Is this all? After all the glory of the Heavenly Court and that of a Venerable, all you can give me are a few paintings?" Much like with Paradise Earth, he had expected something far greater. "At least hand over a dozen or so Immortal Gu at minimum. Or your true meaning. How else could I truly consider this to be a Venerable's Inheritance."
"All in good time, Fang Yuan," Genesis Lotus said. "But, here is something that might more readily pique your interest."
The next gu worm that Fang Yuan was handed was also a mortal gu- but a kind of mortal gu that even Gu Immortals would badly want.
50 Years Lifespan Gu!

chapters.title: Chapter 102 - 102: The Two Venerables: Part Four
chapters.content:
Lifespan Gu!
Although this was just a mortal gu worm, it was in some ways, more valuable than any Immortal Gu. It was the only method of increasing one's lifespan without any side effects. Although the Venerables were invincible, they were all ultimately defeated by lack of Lifespan Gu, which would decrease in production whenever one of them popped up until the point that they would eventually succumb to the ravages of time. In his previous life Fang Yuan had found a 500 Years Lifespan Gu and so extended his lifespan to 600 years, though he had been cornered and killed before he could even reach the point of needing further Lifespan Gu.
To think that Genesis Lotus Immortal Venerable had one of these, not only that, but was freely given it away to Fang Yuan?ʀᴇᴀᴅ ʟᴀᴛᴇsᴛ ᴄʜᴀᴘᴛᴇʀs ᴀᴛ Novᴇ(l)Fɪre .ɴᴇt
"Why wouldn't you use this when you were alive?" Fang Yuan asked, the obvious question being so apparent that he couldn't help but voice it, even if he was benefitting greatly from it.
"Everything will eventually die, Fang Yuan," Genesis Lotus said. "A few more years of lifespan wouldn't have done anything but delay the inevitable. And there were plans to place in motion after my demise which required me to hold onto this. And so, I give it to you."
Fang Yuan took the Lifespan Gu and placed it in his aperture, though he did not use it. He wanted to inspect it further, though truth be told, if Genesis Lotus had done something to it Fang Yuan likely wouldn't be able to accurately tell that unless he was a Rank 9 Venerable himself.
Still, he currently had no need for it and could just keep it in his aperture until the time came.
"You didn't use it?" Genesis Lotus noted.
"I'll use it later, I'm still young after all," Fang Yuan said.
Genesis Lotus did not say anything further, but handed Fang Yuan another gu worm.
This was something that Fang Yuan did not recognize, but also didn't seem to belong to the Painting Path either. From the looks of it, Fang Yuan had a feeling that it was a Human Path gu worm, likely from his attainment level, though he could not make heads or tails of what this was either.
It was a gu worm in the strange shape of a koi. "I assume that you're familiar with the story of the koi that leapt over the dragon's gate to become a dragon?"
"Yes I am," Fang Yuan said. Though this world was not the same as the one he had been in, it did have many of the same fairy tales and legends. As another example, there was no 'Mt. Tai' in this world yet the saying remained popular throughout. More likely than not, it had been people who had transmigrated like him who had spread such tales.
"This is Rank 1 Human Potential Gu- a talent-raising gu worm," Genesis Lotus said. "Human Potential Gu comes from Rank 1 to Rank 5, with each use raising one's aptitude by 10%. However, one can only use the Human Potential Gu of a rank once, limiting the total boost to 50%. And each one can only be used by someone at the same rank or above it. Still, with enough, one is able to turn even one with worthless talent into a dragon capable of ascending to the rank of Immortal. Consider this one to be the last gift from me while you're here for now. Take it, you will need an increased aptitude to face what is coming."
