The ominous nature of that was not lost on Fang Yuan. "To tackle what is coming? What are you going on about? Both you and Paradise Earth have told me nothing of substance since I've gotten here, only that things will be explained later. What do you take me for? A child who can't understand the deeper meaning behind things? I demand an explanation!"
Genesis Lotus was unmoved and waved his hand. "Calm down, Fang Yuan. There is nothing in nature worth having that can be obtained through rushing forward recklessly. A plant needs time to grow, and a human needs time to mature. Surely your attainment of the Human Path, however low right now, should let you realize that?"
Fang Yuan didn't answer.
"But tell you what," Genesis Lotus said. "Let me start by explaining what this place is. This was the Blessed Land of a Mushroomman Gu Immortal. Normally that would make it untraceable even to someone like me, but while eliminating a group of them that were pestering some humans, some of the mortal mushroommen decided to flee to a refuge that they thought was safe. The Gu Immortal took pity on his fellows and let them in - unfortunately, that was what led me to finding this place. I took over, though I did not absorb the Blessed Land into my own. No, I had seen that there was a link between it and someone else in the future."
"Everything in this world in interlinked, Fang Yuan," Genesis Lotus continued. "You and I were fated to meet. This Blessed Land was fated to be the place where we would meet. It isn't just places and people which can be interlinked, however, people's destinies can also be intertwined with each other's. Which is why I wanted to speak with you regarding something - your twin brother, Fang Zheng."
"What about him?"
"You may seem him as no one important right now," Genesis Lotus explained. "But his fate and yours are inexorably linked together. No matter how much you try to resist it, that connection will always be there. The best thing for you is to continue to nurture him and make him stronger. I know that you have been promised the Immortal Beauty Gu on bringing him to Rank 3, and while that is extremely important for you to obtain, even beyond so, you mustn't abandon him. Investing in him will yield great returns."
"So you say," Fang Yuan said, neither accepting nor refuting what Genesis Lotus was saying.
"And on that note," Genesis Lotus said, "if you wish to continue on your journey of comprehending the Human Path, know that you cannot do so alone." He smiled gently. "The demonic path excels in honing individual strength in some aspects better than the righteous path, but without being around different people, without getting to know them, you cannot advance in understanding the Human Path. That is why I want you to give up on the Demonic Path- become righteous, and join the Heavenly Court. In the future, when Human Path begins to flourish, it will be mostly the righteous path who can take advantage of it."
"..."
"Though I don't expect you to agree right now," Genesis Lotus continued. "And now is not the right time anyway. Right now, is the time to return to your clansmen and advance among them, become a leader among them, and through them get greater understanding of the Human Path. I know that you would want to leave Qing Mao mountain and wander the Five Regions, but you need to understand that now is not the right time for that either."
"I might consider it," Fang Yuan said.
Genesis Lotus laughed. "Who are you trying to fool, Fang Yuan? As if I can't see through your bluster. Let me tell you something else about this Blessed Land- when I took over it, I realized that I wasn't the one who was destined to ultimately inherit it. No, there would be a Venerable in the future, one who was part mushroomman himself, who would take over it. And so, I left my Will here in order to deal with him in the future. We came to a concord, but I've never fully agreed with his methods. There is something such as being too good, or being too peaceful. Reforming Demonic Cultivators... there are some whom you can't reform, and can only deal with in the harshest manner..."
Genesis Lotus lifted up his paint brush, and then in a manner that was so natural as to be nearly unnoticeable, dipped it in blue ink before waving it in the air, the paint remaining suspended as the streaks of blue slowly morphed and formed what became a miniature river suspended in the air.
And then, Genesis Lotus Immortal Venerable attacked Fang Yuan!

chapters.title: Chapter 103 - 103: The Two Venerables: Part Five
chapters.content:
Genesis Lotus's attack was on two fronts.
One was a mental attack- his Will assaulted Fang Yuan's. Fang Yuan had little attainment in the Wisdom Path, and even if he did, there would not be much he could do against a Venerable's mental assault.
Wills were composed of thoughts, and so many methods of the Wisdom Path, in terms of attacking, involved influencing the enemies thoughts or causing them to be unable to think. Right now, Genesis Lotus's thoughts, tens of thousands of them, were bouncing around Fang Yuan's skull. Such a thing would only be possible with an Immortal Gu- though a Venerable would not lack them. On top of which, one of the 3 Venerables who had joined the Heavenly Court was Star Constellation Immortal Venerable, a Wisdom Path Venerable. No doubt he had no shortage of Wisdom Path methods.
In this state, Fang Yuan could do nothing. Moving required thoughts, and his head was too full of thoughts for him to add any more to them. He couldn't speak or even turn his head. If it wasn't for his subconscious taking over things like his breathing, they would've stopped as well.
Fang Yuan had not used any of the gu worms that Genesis Lotus had given him, but Genesis Lotus started activating them. First, the 50 Years Lifespan Gu, adding 50 years to Fang Yuan's lifespan. Next, the Rank 1 Human Potential Gu, increasing Fang Yuan's aptitude to 75%.
The second part of Genesis Lotus's attack was in the form of the small river that had appeared in the air. While the mental assault went on, the river snaked and coiled, passing through Fang Yuan's aperture.
While it did so, his aperture's rate of primeval essence generation exploded as it rapidly filled up and then emptied over and over.
"This is a time path method, as I'm sure you've already figured out," Genesis Lotus said. "It is a Painting Path method of mine that attempts to recreate the profundities of the Time Path. Without the River of Time, Fang Yuan, the world would be as still as a painting- so was said, and so I was told. Which only caused me to contemplate the reverse- if the river of time could be added onto a painting, could it move like a picture?" He repeated the motion he had done so earlier, creating a small river that entered the scenery of the lake that he had finished painting. Much like before, it was so simple and insignificant that Fang Yuan wouldn't have recognized it as an attack if he hadn't known how it worked beforehand. Whatever aura this move was supposed to leak out, it was completely undetectable- or possibly only detectable to those who had outstanding understanding of the Painting Path. Immediately, the painting that Genesis Lotus had made burst into life, as the flowers started moving along with a breeze that existed only in the world of the painting. The clouds started to move across the sky, and even animals began to wander in and out of the frame. Weirdly enough, although this painting was of a Blessed Land where there should be no day and night cycle, the sun began traveling across the sky as night fell and then day came again. It was as if Genesis Lotus had been able to transform this painting into its own little independent world.
At first, all it appeared that Genesis Lotus had done was animate the painting- as in, turning it into a video rather than something like a picture. Let alone someone from Earth, it wouldn't even impress someone in this world as you could get the same result by using Audio-Visual Gu. But there was clearly more to this technique than just that. It was as if someone could jump into the painting and the world contained within. "Ah, I was quite pleased with the results I was able to get," Genesis Lotus said. "But oh, it looks like I got a tad bit carried away, given you're far too busy dealing with whatever else is going on right now to appreciate the brilliance of my work."
Inside his aperture, Fang Yuan's primeval essence got to work nourishing its walls under the control of Genesis Lotus Immortal Venerable. With the increased rate of time that was affecting him as well as the boost to his aptitude, he quickly went from Rank 3 Initial Stage to Rank 3 Middle Stage. And then, to Rank 3 Upper Stage. Finally, to Rank 3 Peak Stage and afterwards his essence began to chip away at the crystal walls of his aperture.
Such a thing, which might've taken years under normal circumstances, went by in a flash.
At that moment, Paradise Earth's Will appeared before them. "Genesis Lotus- what are you doing? This is not part of our agreement- you are hurting Fang Yuan!"
Normally an advancement in aptitude would be a good thing... the problem in Fang Yuan's case was that the rate of time his entire body was experiencing was also affecting the Spring Autumn Cicada.
Its withered brown leaves began to regain a verdant green hue and its trunk turned into a light brown as it started to regain life.
Of course, as it did so, the pressure upon Fang Yuan's aperture increased. He could not contain the full power of a Rank 6 Immortal gu worm in a mortal aperture!
"Agreement?" Genesis Lotus asked, tapping his chin with the handle of his paintbrush thoughtfully. "Yes, you're right- I do think that we had something along the lines of not harming Fang Yuan. But tell me- what have I done to harm Fang Yuan? I am only trying to ensure that he increases his aptitude and advance in his cultivation. If anything, I'm greatly helping Fang Yuan."
The crystal walls in Fang Yuan's aperture broke, and a new light membrane appeared which began filling his aperture with golden primeval essence.The most update n0vels are published on novᴇl(ꜰ)ire.ɴet
"You could do the same thing with Silver Steel Relic Gu, by doing this you're taking away his lifespan!" Paradise Earth said.
"And that's why I gave him a 50 Years lifespan Gu earlier, surely you can't say that I'm taking something away. If anything, he's gained net lifespan," Genesis Lotus said. "Though, I suppose that's enough and I'll stop helping him out then, if you're so insistent on it." He stopped the river of time's effect on Fang Yuan, though he kept up the mental assault.
It was too late though, the Spring Autumn Cicada's aura had reached a point where even with Fang Yuan's new Rank 4 aperture, it was going to burst forth and destroy him!
This was clearly a flaw in whatever arrangements Paradise Earth had made, though the only reason that Genesis Lotus was able to do so was specifically because of the Spring Autumn Cicada- such a thing would not harm anyone else in the world.
"Is this how the righteous path is supposed to act?" Paradise Earth asked. "Looking for gaps and loopholes to exploit?"
"Indeed, you've actually managed to see some of the point of the righteous path," Genesis Lotus said with a gleam in his eye.
"What is even the purpose of doing so?"
"To ensure that Fang Yuan stays upon Qing Mao mountain for what is to come. You and I both know that he must stay with his clan."
"We can do that in other ways!"
"I've seen what 'other ways' you have, and reject them," Genesis Lotus said. "I prefer a more direct approach. It's a pity - humans are the brightest of all living creatures, but I do suppose that you're only half-human, aren't you? Perhaps if you were one hundred percent human that mind of yours would've been able to see this scheme of mine from beforehand."
Fang Yuan had no choice but to activate the Spring Autumn Cicada at this moment, but Genesis Lotus's attack was ongoing, and he couldn't form a coherent thought on that matter.
His aperture really was going to burst!

chapters.title: Chapter 104 - 104: The Two Venerables: Part Six
chapters.content:
"Ah, and here it is," Genesis Lotus said as a notification popped up in Fang Yuan's mind.
Critical issue detected!
The Spring Autumn Cicada is going to damage the host's aperture.
There is a sealing method to contain the Spring Autumn Cicada, but it has its drawbacks. Is the host willing to-
Before it could even finish, Genesis Lotus chose for Fang Yuan, picking 'yes.'
Initializing protocol to seal the Spring Autumn Cicada.
"That is all for now, Fang Yuan," Genesis Lotus said. "I mean this truly when I say that I wish you luck for what comes ahead. Perhaps when we meet again we will discuss things further."
Paradise Earth sighed. "Fang Yuan, I'm returning you to your village now."
As the assault on Fang Yuan's mind subsided, the scenery around him shifted as he was now back near the village.
He immediately attempted to use a cultivation blessing to make the Spring Autumn Cicada a guaranteed success and activate it.
The sealing process is already in motion and cannot be interrupted.
A light emerged in his aperture around the Spring Autumn Cicada, and encased it as it then flew out of his aperture, sinking through to the soil of Qing Mao mountain effortlessly.
Spring Autumn Cicada has successfully been sealed within Qing Mao mountain.Follow current ɴᴏᴠᴇʟs on novᴇl(ꜰ)ire.ɴet
Warning: As stated earlier, host cannot move too far away from the location where the vital gu is sealed off, else host will suffer backlash from losing their vital gu. In the case of a Rank 6 Immortal Gu, this will almost certainly be fatal to a mortal!
Fang Yuan grit his teeth.
He was now faced with several problems.
The first was that his cultivation had advanced to Rank 4 Initial Stage, which to anyone else, would've appeared like it happened overnight. No doubt many people would question how this happened, with the most obvious explanation being that he had found some kind of inheritance.
When questioned, how would Fang Yuan explain it away? It was the kind of secret that many would be ready to kill for.
The best thing would be to run away from Qing Mao mountain now, but thanks to Genesis Lotus Immortal Venerable, he couldn't do that.
Worst of all was the fact that he was only at Rank 4 Initial Stage, and this was likely also planned by Genesis Lotus as well. He was just weak enough that he might end up not only being suppressed by his own clan head, but if word of a Venerable inheritance got out, by the other two as well. The mere whisper of there being the existence of a Venerable inheritance would be more than enough for the three clans to put their differences aside for the time being.
Were Fang Yuan Rank 5 instead, he would have nothing to fear and could go about as the king of Qing Mao mountain, but he was not at that level yet and would not reach it for a very long time without the assistance of something like Yellow Gold Relic Gu.
Even worse was the fact that he did not have a full set of Rank 4 gu worms yet, and so could not demonstrate the full strength of a Rank 4 Gu Master.
The loss of his vital gu meant that he could not take in a new one, on top of which, he could no longer use the Spring Autumn Cicada's aura to refine gu worms. Until his aperture advanced to Rank 5, he also could not risk retrieving it to see if he could activate it and thereby reduce its burden afterwards. Even now, with it being sealed, he could still sense a faint connection to it slumbering in the depths of Qing Mao mountain. It was good that it was sealed and buried so deep, else not only would it attract all kinds of supernatural phenomenon,
System evaluating host's current predicament.
Initializing...
Initializing...
Rank 4 Training Weights Gu (x 1) has been added to host's inventory.
Fang Yuan retrieved this new gu worm- it had the appearance of a cylindrical block of steel that could've easily been mistaken for just another rock. Thankfully like everything else from the system, it came pre-refined.
As he placed it in his aperture, he found that it had an immediate effect.
Fang Yuan now felt as if he had wandered from the Southern Border into one of the other Four Regions. His cultivation was suppressed by a major realm- going from Rank 4 Initial Stage to Rank 3 Initial Stage.
To someone who had seen Fang Yuan leave earlier, it would be as if his cultivation had not changed at all.
Thankfully, his gu worms were not suppressed at all. Strangely enough, to add to this, it seemed as if his aperture was still generating Rank 4 primeval essence, and it was the Training Weight Gu that was diluting it- effectively doing the opposite of the Liquor Worm. However, because Rank 4 Initial Stage primeval essence was 16 times more concentrated than Rank 3 primeval essence, the essence that filled up Fang Yuan's aperture was nearly 16 times as fast as it would've otherwise been.
'What a strange gu worm... why would anyone use something like this? Or can it be used offensively in some matter?' Fang Yuan thought. If there was a way to give it to an enemy, it would greatly cripple their battle strength. However, from the name it seemed to imply that there was an upside to doing so to oneself.
Rank 4 Training Weights Gu only needs primeval essence to feed itself.
That was all the information that Fang Yuan could extract from the system.
Truth be told, there was also a qualitative difference between primeval essence of various ranks, not just quantitative. Although it could be said that Rank 4 essence was worth 16 times the value of corresponding Rank 3 essence, when it came to using Rank 4 gu worms it was not so simple and one would end up using 20-30% more corresponding essence. On top of which, the effect of the Rank 4 gu worm would not be as effective as it would be otherwise.
That was why, despite the increased rate of primeval essence recovery, this was still not equal to being at Rank 4 and there was still a matter of this gu worm greatly suppressing his strength.
'Even if it doesn't need feeding, it wouldn't be worth keeping around normally,' Fang Yuan thought. 'I thought when the system had a solution it would be something to hide my cultivation, not actually suppress it.'
The other drawback was that with this gu worm in his aperture, he couldn't cultivate like he normally could.
For now though, it was time to head back home and consider what his next move would be. Without a doubt, Genesis Lotus had done something that had ultimately hindered him despite the advance in his cultivation rank.
The Spring Autumn Cicada was sealed away and unusable to him right now, and he had a new secret to deal with, forgetting whatever it was that Genesis Lotus said that he would have to deal with in the future.

chapters.title: Chapter 105 - 105: The Wolf Tide: Part One
chapters.content:
Howl!
The sounds of the wolf tide increasing echoed throughout Gu Yue village even in the middle of the night.
With the horde growing in number, naturally the weaker wolves were ejected from the pack so that the strong could eat.
Whether human or wolf, both employed the same tactics. Only the humans were more indirect about it.
Initially, ordinary lightning wolves were the only dangers that the Gu Masters faced. With time however, Hundred Beast Kings had also begun to appear to the point where they were nearly commonplace, and so only Rank 2 Gu Master teams dared to venture out far from the village.
Putting them aside, it looked like the Thousand Beast Kings - the wolve's equivalent of the clan's elders, would also be making their move.
The elders of each of the three clans were naturally perturbed by this turn of events. The wolf tide this time seemed to be far more dangerous than any other in recent memory.
As a matter of fact, they were still underestimating its severity based on Fang Yuan's recollection of events. Soon, the wolf tide would reach a peak and annihilate most of the periphery of the village. It would only be held back by Qing Shu's timely sacrifice using Wood Charm Gu- though he would die as a result.
"Fang Zheng, move to the left," Fang Yuan instructed as Fang Zheng narrowly avoided the fangs of a lightning wolf waiting in ambush for him.
As Fang Zheng ducked and weave, a blood-red crescent would occasionally fly from Fang Yuan's hand, creating an opening where it cut through the ordinary lightning wolves like they were made of paper.
As an elder, Fang Yuan had no need to go around hunting ordinary wolves to meet the village's quota - but Fang Zheng did not have this luxury. Fang Yuan did not care for Fang Zheng's reputation necessarily, but if too much scrutiny was placed on him there was a chance the Four Flavors Liquor Worm might be discovered. Although Fang Yuan had a plausible explanation for the same, this initial suspicion could then spiral into an investigation into him, which could be disastrous.
Although he had skyrocketed from Rank 3 to Rank 4, it could not be said that the trade off was worth it given the fact that the Spring Autumn Cicada was now sealed away. If it had been Genesis Lotus's plot to weaken Fang Yuan, it could be said to have succeeded magnificently.
However, along with this misfortune Fang Yuan did have some gains as well. Being at Rank 4 Initial Stage was nothing to sneeze at, even if his cultivation was currently suppressed by Training Weights Gu.
Speaking of, he had discovered the reason that someone might end up using this gu worm. Although it had suppressed his cultivation by an entire stage, he found that after ten days of keeping it in his aperture, his aptitude had grown by 1%, to the point where it was now 76%.
He had done some experimenting with it over the past few weeks, and with his attainment in Human Path, had been able to deduce several details regarding its functioning.
For one, it had to be kept in his aperture continuously to have this aptitude boosting effect. This effect was permanent, as the moment he took it out of his aperture, golden primeval essence began to fill his aperture, but the 'clock' for the effect of the gu worm was also reset.
Keeping it for 10 days would give a boost of 1%, to get the next boost of 1%, one needed to keep it continuously for an additional 20 days. The next 1% boost would then take 30 days more than that and so on and so forth. Unfortunately, one could not get the initial 1% boost, take it out, and then wait just ten days for another boost - if one did so, they would have to wait 30 days (twenty and then ten) as the clock was reset.
Fang Yuan had not tested it out completely, but it was also likely that there was a limit to its effectiveness. What that was, he currently did not know.
'So this is the true purpose of this gu worm, to suppress one's cultivation for some time but increasing one's potential,' Fang Yuan thought. It was inferior to talent-raising gu worms in the regard that they did not require this long time period to work nor did they hamper one in the short term, but it had one benefit - this gu worm was not consumable.
Meaning that Fang Yuan could take it out after use and give it to Fang Zheng. The only problem was that one needed Rank 4 cultivation to use Rank 4 Training Weights Gu, but if he could deduce a recipe to reverse-refine it to Rank 2, it could help Fang Zheng break through to Rank 3.
As it was, to effectively use this gu worm, one needed to weigh its benefits against its risks. If Fang Yuan could rely on the clan to protect him, he would keep it in his aperture for as long as possible to get his aptitude as high as he could. However, he could not- but he had the benefit of hindsight. He knew when it was that the wolf tide would increase, and so knew when the best time to remove it might be.
Based on his calculations, it was best to keep it for a total of 60 days, raising his aptitude permanently by another 2% to bring it to 78%. That would bring him very close to the breakpoints needed to advance through each minor realm of Rank 4. The Training Weights Gu needed someone who was astute at balancing current and future benefits. One who focused entirely on current benefits would sacrifice his future entirely, but one could not focus entirely on the future - else they would end up starving today.Tʜe sourcᴇ of thɪs content ɪs NoᴠᴇFɪre.nᴇt
Misfortune and benefits were often tied together. The wolf tide would become increasingly dangerous as time went on, but that would also mean that if Fang Yuan then suddenly revealed his Rank 4 cultivation, the elders instead of being jealous and prying into his matters, would only be joyous and put aside such feelings for the time being until the tide was dealt with.
'What's important is timing,' Fang Yuan thought, as he sent out an attack that cut a lightning wolf in two, flying through it and into its companion as well.
Two wolves with one moonblade!
"Thank you for your help, brother," Fang Zheng said, as he now stood among a pile of corpses.
"It is no worry," Fang Yuan said, waving his hand. "Time for us to head back to the village then after collecting their eyeballs."
As they were heading back, they saw another group of Gu Yue clansmen in the distance.
Naturally, these clansmen noticed Fang Yuan. It was a mixed group of Rank 2 and Rank 1 Gu Masters, and they began calling for help.
The wolf group around them was large, but not strong individually. It would only take a few moves from Fang Yuan, and the wolf tide would be crippled and allow for a decisive human victory while minimizing casualties.
New daily quest!
Save the humans from this wolf group.
Reward: Guts Gu (x 1)
"How are you on primeval essence?" Fang Yuan asked.
"Still about 25%," Fang Zheng said.
"Good enough," Fang Yuan said, as he led Fang Zheng to strike the wolf group from the right flank.

chapters.title: Chapter 106 - 106: The Wolf Tide: Part Two
chapters.content:
While it would've taken Fang Yuan only a few moves to deal with the group himself, there was a reason beyond reputation that he was trying to get Fang Zheng to fight.
Although Fang Yuan was tied to Qing Mao mountain for now, he still planned on leaving eventually along with Fang Zheng. Between him and his brother, he would naturally prioritize his own strength first. But, he needed Fang Zheng to have some battle experience before they left the mountain, and in case they found themselves in a sticky situation in the future.
Fang Zheng still had some flaws in his combat skills, though he was vastly improved from only a few months ago. That was to be expected as progress was the easiest when one was starting out- whether it was in cultivation or something else, the higher up the mountain one went the harder it was to climb further.
The wolf group was taken by surprise, but was unable to retaliate against them without being slaughtered by the Gu Masters they had been attacking just moments earlier. Although it was just two people, they were able to put great pressure upon the wolf group by mere virtue of the fact that they had attacked all of a sudden and that the wolf group was already occupied against another enemy.
Howl!
It turned out that the wolf group was not without tricks of its own.
One of the wolves began morphing and growing in size and then glared at Fang Zheng. A Hundred Beast King- it must have had an aura-suppressing gu worm to hide in the pack like this. Fang Zheng had used up a good portion of primeval essence, and the other Gu Masters could not reach out to help him. If the Hundred Beast King pounced, he would quickly be put in a difficult position and might even lose his life.
Then again, it was for a situation like this that Fang Yuan was on standby.
Blood Moon Gu!
Thanks to the effects of the Training Weights Gu, Fang Yuan essentially had limitless Rank 3 primeval essence with how rapidly his primeval essence was replenished. It was still not worth diluting it from Rank 4 to Rank 3, but that was the price that one had to pay.
The Hundred Beast King was bisected before it could even take ten steps.
With their leader gone, the wolf group fell into disarray and gaps in their lines began to show. The Gu Masters, who had earlier been besieged, targeted these gaps to great effect. These small flaws then quickly grew into bigger ones until the wolf group was in complete disarray and unable to coordinate any kind of attack.
There was still a large divide between the understanding of a human being and a wolf, after all.
The wolves tried to escape only to be hunted down and eliminated.
"Thank you, Elder Fang Yuan!"Follow current ɴᴏᴠᴇʟs on NovᴇlFirenᴇt
"Elder Fang Yuan, you're simply too kind!"
"Elder Fang Yuan is the real hero of Gu Yue Village!"
"Elder Fang Yuan, I don't know if you remember me from our school days, but I always greatly admired you back when you were president!"
"Heh- I was a fan of Lord Fang Yuan far before you were! Back when he was reciting poems, I had already glimpsed a portion of his genius!"
"You're just small fry, I remember when Lord Fang Yuan was only a few months old but could already talk. I knew he would be a hero right then and there!"
Great praise was lavished upon Fang Yuan, who was indifferent from it. Fang Zheng couldn't help but feel slightly irritated - he had also put in great amounts of effort and put his life on the line for these people, yet they only saw Fang Yuan!
'The more things change, the more they stay the same,' Fang Zheng thought bitterly.
From their perspective, though, it was only natural. Even if Fang Zheng worked and fought his hardest, he could not compare to the strength of a Rank 3 Gu Master.
"It was nothing, it is only natural for humans to help each other. That is what it means to be part of a clan, after all," Fang Yuan said, brushing their compliments aside. "And, I was not alone- my younger brother was there to lend me aide."
Fang Yuan's words snapped Fang Zheng out of his reverie as the other Gu Masters turned to him, showering him with praise as well.
However... unlike before, Fang Zheng no longer felt his heart flutter wildly at this praise. It only caused a brief twinge if anything, before he returned to normal.
'What use is praise if I would've been killed? They only praise people to make use of them,' Fang Zheng thought. 'Praise, compliments, both are useless if one finds oneself in a shallow grave.'
To be hailed as a hero of the clan- that had been Fang Zheng's dream earlier in life. Now though, he saw what the title of 'hero' usually meant and how hollow it was.
When did people call you a hero or remind you of your duty to the clan? Only so that you would be willing to take risks for little to no reward. The praise itself was supposed to be a form of benefit given out, a benefit that required nothing more than empty words on the clan's part.
Mission Successful!
Guts Gu (x 1) added to inventory!
Fang Yuan and Fang Zheng finally returned to the village after this.
There was a leaderboard signifying where everyone's place was based on their contribution points. The Fang brothers were currently ranked at number thirty-four, a respectable position given that neither of them made a full-time job of hunting wolves, and the fact that Fang Zheng had exchanged some points before to get some gu worms to supplement his arsenal.
"Only two people and yet ranked so much higher than our group with four people..."
"Of course they are, Fang Zheng's lucky to have Fang Yuan with him."
"It's true, not even a team of Rank 2 Gu Masters can equal even a greenhorn Rank 3 elder in combat..."
Fang Yuan went over to check the rewards.
"Is there anything worth getting?" Fang Zheng asked.
Fang Yuan shook his head.
"Alright, I'll go check out the wine tavern," Fang Zheng said. By now tending to that business had basically entirely fallen on his shoulders alone, as well as the selling of Vitality Leaves. Now that he was Rank 2 and had the help of the Four Flavors Liquor Worm, it was not a huge burden to make them every day. Even if it required primeval stones to do, the net profit was greatly worth it.
The only real thing that Fang Zheng lost was time, but as long as it wasn't his time, Fang Yuan was okay with it.
"I will return home and will be cultivating until tomorrow morning, please don't disturb me," Fang Yuan said, and Fang Zheng nodded.
Fang Zheng, naturally, also wanted to advance. However, he also wanted to help his brother out- and once Fang Yuan had helped him get to Rank 2, he basically had Fang Zheng's unconditional trust at that point.
Fang Yuan did not go directly home as a matter of fact, but stopped by the underground cavern before heading back, contemplating what his next move would be.

chapters.title: Chapter 107 - 107: The Wolf Tide: Part Three
chapters.content:
Fang Yuan was not cultivating when he got home- he couldn't as a matter of fact so long as he was under the suppression of Training Weights Gu.
He could take it out and start cultivating during small periods, but this would reset the gu's timer which he didn't want. 78% aptitude was quite a decent threshold for moving forward- even making Rank 5 a possibility. Once that happened, he would be the king of Qing Mao mountain, and would not need to fear anyone.
So what if they thought that he had stumbled upon a powerful inheritance? Once he got strong enough, it would not matter- they would not dare try to find trouble with him.
With that said, to get to Rank 5 would still take him years at this rate. But he didn't need to reach that high- Rank 4 Upper Stage would be sufficient.
The three clan heads of each clan were either at Rank 4 Initial Stage or Rank 4 Middle Stage. At Rank 4, even the difference in a single minor realm could greatly impact the outcome of a battle. That was why Yellow Golden Relic Gu were so rare as to be nearly nonexistent in the market. It wasn't like super forces like the Shang or Wu clans did not have them, it was that they could not be given out casually. Even if they did sell them in mortal markets on occasion, the price could go astronomically high to the point that even Fang Yuan with his current assets could not dream of affording a single one.
'If you don't want others to find trouble with you, become so weak that no one would even want to step on you, or so strong that no one would dare find trouble with you,' Fang Yuan thought to himself again.
Earlier, when he had been at Rank 3, he was not worth trifling with for the clan leaders, and strong enough to deter anyone below them from attacking him without reason.
Now, at Rank 4 Initial Stage, he could still be suppressed by the clan leader. The worst case scenario would be the three villages teaming up against him for the sake of what they would think was a Venerable's Inheritance.
But if he was only a little bit stronger, he could dissuade anyone from attacking him.
He was at the awkward point where he wasn't strong enough to deal with all of the threats he might come up against, but not weak enough that his enemies might ignore him.
However, his heart was as calm as a sea set against a windless sky.
He had been in far worse predicaments than this.
His main goals at this time were to further his cultivation, and to refine a set of Rank 4 gu worms. The first goal was on hold right now, so that left targeting which gu worms he wanted to advance.
At Rank 4, the failure rate was not insignificant and nor were the materials needed easy to obtain. He had attempted to access some Rank 4 recipes in the underground cavern but the elder in charge of the same would only budge on that matter if Fang Yuan forfeited a number of contribution points, a number that might take him weeks to obtain. In ordinary times this would not even be feasible, it was only kudos to the wolf tide that he even had the opportunity.
The easiest for him to refine further was the Blood Moon Gu. Although part of the Moonlight Gu's evolution tree, the Blood Moon Gu could be used as a material for many Blood Path gu worm recipes. Being a Grandmaster in Blood Path, Fang Yuan could even easily deduce a few new Rank 4 gu worm recipes given enough time and some trial and error.
There was an even easier method than having to jump through all of these hoops. That was the Crimsonhoof Deer- once it fully matured it would be on par with a Myriad Beast King, and its body parts including its bone, skin, and flesh could all be used to not only refine Rank 4 but also Rank 5 Blood Path gu worms. That was the advantage of the Blood Path- it was very resource-efficient. He had even been able to refine the Rank 6 Spring Autumn Cicada thanks to this efficiency using only mostly mortal refinement materials.
However, the Crimsonhoof Deer was not fully mature yet. It would still take a few more months before it could display its full strength, and by then, the issue would be killing it.
'What to do...?'
If Fang Yuan revealed his Rank 4 cultivation, the clan would then easily let him access the Rank 4 recipes in the underground cavern. He might even be able to choose one to keep for himself. But how could he do that when the key issue was that he wasn't strong enough to reveal his true cultivation yet? It was like chasing his own tail with no solution in sight. Without Rank 4 gu worms, even if he managed to reach Rank 4 Peak Stage he would be at a grave disadvantage when it came to fighting other Rank 4 Gu Masters.
The Rank 4 recipes that he knew did not rely on the Moonlight Gu, and he did not have the base forms or ingredients for many of their refinements.
There was one solution- it wasn't necessarily an optimal one and relied somewhat on luck. He could go try to locate the Crimsonhoof Deer now and see if it had acquired any high ranking gu worms. In a few weeks, the time would be ripe for it to start having Rank 3 gu worms. If they were Blood Path, he might be able to salvage something from them.ʀᴇᴀᴅ ʟᴀᴛᴇsᴛ ᴄʜᴀᴘᴛᴇʀs ᴀᴛ NovᴇlFɪre.ɴet
The system had been awfully quiet throughout all of this- it had not offered him another cultivation blessing that might let him upgrade one of his gu worms.
Speaking of, nearly all of the daily quests rewards had now shifted from dao marks and luck to giving him Guts Gu.
Most of these quests involved saving mortals and occasionally Gu Masters from the wolf tide. An ultimately pointless endeavor as the mortals had nowhere to go afterwards and would succumb to the wolf tide sooner or later. Mortals died in large numbers, Gu Masters fewer still but succumbed as well.
Guts Gu was quite useful for strengthening the soul, the optimal resource for doing the same. That made him wonder if the system anticipated that he would need it in the future. It was not a bad thing to strengthen his soul - it was a fifteen-man soul already, but the applications of it were mainly for the Enslavement Path and for exploring dream realms - neither of which he was heavily invested in at this point.
There was another issue - what Genesis Lotus had told him. That there was something coming that Fang Yuan had to be prepared for.
Fang Yuan felt that he still had control over things for now, but who could easily rival the scheming of a Venerable, even after their death?
As he crushed the Guts Gu, removing it from his inventory, he knew that he had to find some other way to strengthen himself faster.
Regardless of what the future held, he could always ultimately only rely upon his own strength!
New main mission unlocked!
The savior's savior.
Description: Save Qing Shu from having to sacrifice himself to save the village.
Reward: Yellow Golden Relic Gu (x 1)

chapters.title: Chapter 108 - 108: The Wolf Tide: Part Four
chapters.content:
While Fang Yuan was strengthening his soul, Fang Zheng wandered over to the tavern to check up on it.
As he walked towards the tavern, the sights which were the fruit of the recent wolf tide greeted him all around.
The only reason that orphans were not more common was because they were usually eaten along with their parents. Many people were missing limbs as they trudged along, unable to afford a healer and their lost limbs being deemed as 'nonurgent' by the medicine hall which was always packed full. And truth be told, the medicine hall was correct- they just had even more urgent cases to deal with. Funerals were so commonplace that the weeping of the deceased's relatives could be heard constantly whether it was day or night.
These sounds were sometimes punctuated by the roars of the wolves which could be heard even from within the village, oftentimes causing people to wake up, screaming as they imagined the teeth of the animals wrapped around their necks.Thɪs ɴovel(ꜰ)ɪre.nᴇt
Naturally many people had PTSD from their encounters with the wolves, though it was not called such in Gu Yue village. But, the 'thousand yard stare' that some of them gave off was unmistakable to any person from Earth. Such people found it hard to distinguish the real howls of wolves from the ones in their nightmares. It had gotten to the point where someone wearing a wolfskin coat had nearly been attacked by people thinking that a wolf had found a way to disguise itself as a human.
Above all was the general sense of tension and the veil of death that permeated throughout the village. This was all new to someone like Fang Zheng- there had been wolf tides before, but he had been a child back then.
'I guess I just hadn't noticed all of this,' he thought as he moved along. It wasn't that he hadn't noticed earlier, but just that this wolf tide in particular was rather nasty.
Fang Zheng was not like Fang Yuan and these sights deeply engraved themselves within his heart. Before, he had been occupied with his own worries and troubles, but upon seeing the condition that many of the other people were in he began to feel like his situation was not that bad.
Although people drank more frequently given the general air of misery that the village stank of, there were also fewer primeval stones to go around. It could be said that the wine tavern's business was still doing average- but that wasn't the main money maker for Fang Zheng.
It was selling Vitality Leaves. The Four Flavors Liquor Worm was currently sleeping in his aperture, but when needed, would change his Rank 2 Initial Stage primeval essence to Rank 2 Middle Stage, allowing him to easily grow several sets of Vitality Leaves. Selling medicine was the best business in a time like this, with near-infinite demand. What use was hoarding primeval stones if you were dead?
It was to the point that Fang Zheng could not keep up with the increased demand, despite his Rank 2 cultivation.
Jiang Ya walked in at the usual time.
"The usual?" Fang Zheng asked him as he sat down.
"Actually there was a small matter where..." Jiang Ya began before he was interrupted by someone who had walked in just behind him.
Fang Zheng had thought that this other person was another customer and so paid him no heed, but it looks like he had been tailing Jiang Ya.
"Senior greets junior brother," this man said. Fang Zheng did not recognize this man. Many people from his class had come to visit him, or had been sent by other people, simply to try to procure Vitality Leaves first or at a lower price. Naturally Fang Zheng rejected all such requests.
"Greetings," Fang Zheng said. He had not lost his basic manners, and could tell this man was at Rank 2 Middle Stage in cultivation. "Have you come to seek business with me? Please, take a seat."
"Thank you Fang Zheng," the man said. Despite his age, he did not show any air of dominance towards Fang Zheng. This was either out of the knowledge of who Fang Zheng's brother was, or because he wanted something from Fang Zheng. More likely than not, a combination of the two.
"You have me at a disadvantage."
"My name is Gu Yue Ye, I do not know if junior has heard tales of my feats in the past, but I used to be a somewhat famous back when I was a Rank 3 Gu Master. Unfortunately I sustained an injury which caused my cultivation to drop, and with age, its now only at Rank 2 Middle Stage," the man said.
Fang Zheng strained his mind- as a matter of fact, he might've heard of someone by that name before. "That's ah... rather unfortunate to hear about."
Gu Yue Ye nodded. "That would be acceptable, but tragedy struck after that. All of my children have lost their lives over time with the wolf tides. Now, I have nothing but myself and my honor. I've been called by the elders to help defend against the wolf tide this time, but as you can understand, danger lurks at every corner." The wolf pack threw out the weak and elderly to wander the forests and be slaughtered, and the clan did the same- only using words like 'duty' and 'sacrifice' to go in a roundabout way.
The truth of the matter was that Gu Yue Ye was being sacrificed to keep the clan safe. Were he to die, no one was even left to mourn him. What would the elders care in that regard? Gu Yue Ye knew this, but still could not refuse the order. That was the restriction of living within the system of the village. Back in the day, he had been quite brave and reckless- but with age he had become tempered, recognizing the limits of his ability.
Fang Zheng already had a feeling where this conversation was going.
"In such times, Vitality Leaves could be the difference between life and death," Gu Yue Ye said. "I was hoping that you could sell the first batch that you have to me preferentially..."
Fang Zheng said, "Done." It was not an issue- Jiang Ya would still have a number of leaves to sell, and it wasn't a problem so long as he was paid.
"Ah, thank you- but there was another matter," Gu Yue Ye said. "I've heard that the going price that you've put on them is sixty primeval stones per Vitality Leaf- this old man cannot afford such a price. If you could but have some pity upon me, please sell them to me at fifty-five stones."
Gu Yue Ye knew that he could not force Fang Zheng, and so tried to appeal to his sympathy in this way.
Fang Zheng's face was stone-cold, but this was a facade. Truth was that he was quite moved by Gu Yue Ye's story, after all, he was not Fang Yuan. Fang Yuan had only become how he was after 500 years, while Fang Zheng had only tasted a single misfortune. The loss of one's cultivation was something that he would empathize with, as well as the sensation of feeling that the clan had abandoned you.
However...
"These Vitality Leaves are not my property," Fang Zheng said. "They belong to someone else, and if I were to sell them at a lower price than instructed it would be equivalent to stealing from said person."
"Junior, but you-"
Fang Zheng could tell that the man was going to press him further, and so he said them. The magic words that could get him out of nearly any situation - the sentence that, the moment it was uttered, most people began sweating and abandoned any sort of hostility they might have towards him.
"Don't you know who my elder brother is- it's Elder Gu Yue Fang Yuan," Fang Zheng said coldly. He took a sip and then turned to Jiang Ya. "Brother Jiang Ya, could you please jog my memory- this wine, though delicious, seems to have caused my mind to become slightly muddle. Was the punishment for stealing from an elder exile, or death? I think it was death- but I could be remembering things incorrectly. With that said, exile is about as good as death in these circumstances..."
Beads of sweat instantly coated Gu Yue Ye's forehead.

chapters.title: Chapter 109 - 109: The Wolf Tide: Part Five
chapters.content:
"Ah- what on earth are you talking about, Fang Zheng?" Gu Yue Ye said. "Who said anything about stealing? I was merely asking if it would be possible for this old man, who had contributed so much to this village in his youth, to get a bit of a discount..."
He could not ask for the same from the medicine hall, or even directly from an elder, which is why he was meeting with Fang Zheng. Had Fang Yuan been here instead, he wouldn't have even bothered.
Every single primeval stone wasn't just a unit of currency, it represented a resource he could rely on the future in order to either fight or cultivate.
"And my point still stands, the price is set by my brother, and I can't do anything," Fang Zheng said. This was the easiest way out for him- to place everything at the feet of his brother. However....
He took out two Vitality Leaves. "I can sell you up to two at a discount, none further."
"Ah, thank you, Junior Brother, I'll be sure to remember your kindness in the future!" Gu Yue Ye said.
'In your case, given your age, 'future' is an extremely relative term,' Fang Zheng thought as Gu Yue Ye took his leave.
"Brother, that is the third person you've taken this kind of pity on," Jiang Ya mused. "Won't your brother be upset by now?"
"It isn't a big issue," Fang Zheng said, waving his hand. He was filling in the deficit from the discount using his own personal stash of primeval stones. While he wanted to steel his heart, he ultimately often yielded to such requests.
In the wolf tide, a time of chaos, one couldn't help but feel sympathy for others - but above all - sympathy for oneself.
Thanks to Fang Yuan's position as an elder, Fang Zheng was not nearly in as bad a spot as many others were. He was in virtually no danger of dying while fighting wolves so long as he had Fang Yuan with him, and he did not lack primeval stones for the time being. Now, no one dared to look down on him. But that didn't mean that he hadn't forgotten how it felt to be small... in this vast world, the presence of one person was worth less than a single grain of sand in a vast desert.
***
"Are you still going to be holed up in here?" the Bai clan head asked as he walked into the room where Bai Ning Bing was lying down. Looking at the man, one might incorrectly assume that he was sick or fatigued, but that wasn't the issue. Bai Ning Bing... was simply bored. While everyone was in terror of what would happen during the wolf tide, his fate was already sealed. Like a sword hanging above his head, the source of his power would be the cause of his death eventually.
The clan head cleared his throat as Bai Ning Bing hadn't responded. Had it been anyone else, they would've been summarily beaten or even executed for treating him like this, but Bai Ning Bing could not be bullied. "We were looking for you during the elder's meeting."
Bai Ning Bing waved his hand. "I have no interest in joining that pathetic meeting."
"Your clansmen need to know that you stand with and support them."
Bai Ning Bing snorted. What use was their support? He had been gifted with near-limitless resources, but little to do with them. Any problem he had faced in life had collapsed nearly instantly compared to his talent. All except one, that is. "Who cares about the dumb meetings?"
"Elder Bai Jo Din was pointing out your absence to all to see and making a ruckus about it."ʀᴇᴀᴅ ʟᴀᴛᴇsᴛ ᴄʜᴀᴘᴛᴇʀs ᴀᴛ ɴovᴇl(F)ɪre.ɴet
Bai Ning Bing got up. "That senile old fool? He doesn't even know where he is half of the time. He once called me a 'lying dog-faced pony soldier' one time. If I had any clue as to what it meant, I might've beheaded him."
The clan head sighed. Bai Ning Bing, despite all of his bluster, knew what the man was going on about. He had supported Bai Ning Bing, but that would be difficult if Bai Ning Bing wasn't going to cooperate. "Alright, I'll show up. I'll also help out more in the fighting."
He had to concede that much.
"As fleeting as the morning dew,
And as ephemeral as a dream,
Human lives over in the blink of an eye,
Building sand castles in the snow,
Or snow angels in the sand."
"What is that supposed to mean?" Bai Ning Bing asked.
"It means that even if life lasts for but a second, one should enjoy it," the clan head said. "Humans do many pointless things with their lives, but they do them regardless, if only to satisfy themselves. It's a small piece of doggerel I heard of once while traveling when I was younger. Think about that for a moment, we will be waiting for you in the next meeting." His voice carried an air of authority that left no room to wiggle out, even for someone like Bai Ning Bing.
Bai Ning Bing looked out the window after the clan head left. He saw the village, and the people milling about with worried looks upon their faces.
While his own heart was in turmoil, it was due to a different reason than those walking about.
Who was he?
What was his purpose?
Despite being surrounded by so many people, Bai Ning Bing felt that he was more alone than he had ever been before in his life.
***
Of the three clans, the Xiong Clan was taking the stress of the wolf tide the worst. For one, they were the weakest, meaning that they did not have the Gu Yue clan's strength nor the rising star of Bai Ning Bing.
Because of this they occupied the lowest part of the mountain, making them especially susceptible to the wolves and their actions given it was not easy to defend against them. Their low status could also be seen in the kind of gu worms they used - Bear Strength Gu was a low cost gu worm unlike the Moonlight Gu of the Gu Yue clan. However, being cheap also had its drawbacks as it was less flexible.
"We won't be able to last for much longer," one of the elders of the Xiong clan said during a meeting. The wolf tide's fury had shocked not just the Gu Yue clan, but all three of the clans upon Qing Mao mountain.
"Indeed," the clan head said. The situation was extremely dire, and the Thunder Crown Wolves had yet to show themselves. This was just the early middle of the time period of the tide, and yet they were already in dire straits. "In such a case, we must place the clan's survival at the topmost priority."
"Clan head, you mean?"
"Of course we will fight, but a wise man knows to submit to circumstances. If the scenario occurs where we are about to fall, heh, we can even use this disadvantageous position of ours to our advantage."
Naturally, if the Xiong Clan did not have their own trump cards, they would not have been able to survive for the last thousand years. There were ways to survive other than strength, after all. So what if they were not as strong as the Gu Yue clan? So what if they did not possess one of the Ten Extreme Physiques?
When push came to shove, they would do everything for their survival. Even if it involved a little trickery...

chapters.title: Chapter 110 - 110: The Wolf Tide: Part Six
chapters.content:
One fine morning, as the morning soon had barely crested the horizon, the guard towers around Gu Yue village suddenly erupted in alarm.
"Wolf tide!"
"Three thousand strong!"
"Call everyone! Everyone!"
Back during his first life, Fang Yuan had been a logistics Gu Master and as such had not been committed to the front lines. Now though, he was standing alongside the other elders as the Rank 2 Gu Masters reached the great wall surrounding the village, using their gu worms to strengthen the wall.
Those who were more adept with fighting began flinging attacks, most of which were moonblades of varying strength out at the wolves snapping their fangs and jaws, eager for a piece of human flesh.
Most of the rank-and-file wolves so to speak had their ribs showing, a sign that things were not going well when it came to food for them. They clashed against the Gu Masters who also looked weary, many of who had already been worn down by the tide.
Human or wolf, heaven did not spare anyone. Life was a battle for survival from start to finish.
Behind the swarm of the ordinary grunts stood the Bold Lightning Wolves which were Hundred Beast kings, and behind them stood three Thousand Beast Kings, Frenzy Lightning Wolves. Those three had not made their move yet, but were instead waiting in reserve.
In much the same way, Fang Yuan and the other elders were standing at the back, behind the wall of Gu Masters, waiting for when the first line would break and they would see some action.
Fang Yuan contributed greatly during the fighting, being the savior of many low-ranking Gu Masters. Unlike the other elders, he had nearly unlimited Rank 3 primeval essence by this point, and even the Blood Moon Gu was quite formidable when stacked one upon the other in the fashion that Fang Yuan could do so.
While he was showered with praise, he was actually slightly annoyed. Not at the fighting itself, he was more than used to that, it was the fact that the fighting had delayed him from heading to where he actually wanted to go.
He could still feel the small tugging upon his soul which guided him to his destination- to where the Crimsonhoof Deer was.
He had enslaved its mother, and to his surprise, the deer had survived up till this point. The deer pack by itself was thinned down to the bare bones, but at least a small group of them had survived.
Fang Yuan would check upon them periodically to monitor the Crimsonhoof Deer's growth. Not only that, but he would often feed it or wrap it in blankets made of his clothing, so that it would grow acclimatized to his scent.
While it was rather wary at him initially, by now, he had established something of a rapport with it.
It had reached the status and power of a Hundred Beast King, but would need at least two more years by his estimates to reach the rank of a Myriad Beast King which was its true potential.
That was not to say that he did not have gains from visiting it up until now.
Several wild gu worms had already begun to live on its body, and he recognized one, refining it with the aura of the Rank 4 Hundred Li Earthwolf Spider.
Three Steps Fragrant Grass Gu!
It was only Rank 2, but was still a useful gu worm, allowing one to travel in nearly any direction practically instantly. Because it was a grass gu worm, it could be fed easily just like the Nine Leaf Vitality Grass, and there was no issue with him taking it with him.
Although he technically did have the Hundred Li Earthwolf Spider to act as a mount, it was only really useful for fleeing and could not be used in combat to weave and swerve like a true movement gu worm.
He could advance this to the Ten Steps Fragrant Grass Gu, which was Rank Three, though that would take him some time given the strain on resources with the ongoing wolf tide. Even for an elder, gu refinement was not easy especially given the higher rate of failure with Rank Three gu worms.
Howl!
With the sound of wolves nearby, the small herd of deer immediately bounded away. Fang Yuan also had no intention of sticking around, though he moved in the opposite direction of the deer herd.
After all, when given a choice, the wolves would naturally go for the numerous deer rather than Fang Yuan. The Crimsonhoof Deer would likely survive no matter what, and even if it didn't, naturally Fang Yuan would not place its well-being above his own.
He encountered almost no resistance for a distance of two li, until he spotted some figures in the distance.
He had no gu worms to enhance his eyesight, but even from here he could make out the frostiness that coated the grass where one of the figures pounced. This figure was chasing the others, who were doing their best to try to get away from it.
Bai Ning Bing!
'What a drag,' Fang Yuan thought, changing course. He had no intention of courting either Bai Ning Bing or death. However, as he took three steps in the other direction, he noted that one of the figures that Bai Ning Bing was chasing looked somewhat familiar.
It wasn't until he turned around and saw that one of the figures that was running away suddenly turned around, and then grew three times as large.
Gu Yue Qing Shu!
Fang Yuan's pupils dilated. How had these two groups met out here in the wilderness? The butterfly effect had to be at work here, else they wouldn't have crossed paths.Follow current novels on NovᴇlFirᴇ.ɴet
Fang Yuan had not forgotten about the missing that might give him a Yellow Golden Relic Gu- something that could greatly bridge the gap between him and the other Rank 4 Gu Masters of Qing Mao mountain. Of course, he couldn't complete the mission if Qing Shu was dead.
Not only that, but he could get rid of a big headache, that was to say, Bai Ning Bing so long as he cooperated with Qing Shu.
As if he was going to let an opportunity like this pass up!
Fang Yuan changed direction, heading towards Qing Shu.
The two of them were locked in a deadly battle, with Qing Shu's Wood Charm Gu showing its full effectiveness at being able to hold off even the Rank Three Bai Ning Bing. However, this was only going to be a temporary reprieve for him, given that the more he used his power, the more likely it would be that he would transform into a tree.
That was what had caused his death in Fang Yuan's first life, after all.
Blood moonblade!
Qing Shu's arms, which had grown into large vines which were rapidly being frozen and shattered like panes of glass by Bai Ning Bing's ice elemental gu worms, got a sudden reprieve by the Rank 3 attack.
However, the effect of the Blood Moon Gu was not as much as Fang Yuan had been expecting. It was likely that Bai Ning Bing had used a type of gu worm to convert most of his body into ice, greatly weakening the effect that the Blood Moon Gu would have.
"You!" Bai Ning Bing said, retreating ten paces but still emitting an intense killing aura.
"Yes, it is me," Fang Yuan said. He turned to Qing Shu, who looked shocked but still relieved to see him. It was clear that the man had been on his last legs and would've quickly been finished had Fang Yuan not come. As an answer to Qing Shu's bewildered expression, Fang Yuan said, "What can I say, Brother Qing Shu? Heroes have a tendency to always arrive at the last moment."

chapters.title: Chapter 111 - 111: Fang Yuan vs Bai Ning Bing: Part One
chapters.content:
"Fang Yuan, thank goodness you came," Qing Mao said. He was carrying Yao Hong in his arms, who had a long gash across her back and her robes were stained in blood. She was not opening her eyes and was clearly on the brink of death.
"Fang Yuan!" Bai Ning Bing said before chuckling. "Ah! Good! Good! Good! I had been feeling that there was a lack of excitement going around in this place... and to think that I would run into you once again when chasing someone else. Wonderful - let us fight to the death!"
"What happened?" Fang Yuan muttered to Qing Shu, who was retracting his use of Wood Charm Gu for the time being now that the pressure had been lifted from him. However, he was still in a precarious state, if he used it more, he would without a doubt die.
"We were helping a mixed group of clansmen fend off some wolves, but then he descended from a mountain, saying that we were interrupting his fun, and that he had been waiting to see the Gu Masters scream in horror as they were torn apart by the wolves," Qing Shu said through gritted teeth. "He then slaughtered them all himself, regardless of whether they were Bai clansmen or not. Then, he began chasing us."
"Bai Ning Bing, as an elder of the clan don't you have any shame?" Qing Mao asked through gritted teeth.
"Shame? No, I don't, if that's what you're asking," Bai Ning Bing said.
"Don't bother trying to reason with him," Fang Yuan said. "This man is a true demon- righteous path cultivators like ourselves cannot even comprehend what goes around in that messed-up head of his."
Bai Ning Bing clutched his heart as if he had been severely wounded by Fang Yuan's words before laughing. "Oh, Fang Yuan, are you still keeping up this facade? A wolf recognizes another wolf even when sneaking among a flock of sheep, Fang Yuan!"
"Don't listen to his nonsense," Fang Yuan said, passing two Vitality Leaves to Qing Mao. They would do Yao Hong little good in this scenario, but Fang Yuan had to play his part as a caring team member.Follow current novᴇls on NovᴇlFirenᴇt
Of course, if he used Doctor Gu, he likely would be able to save her life - but there was no way that he could reveal that kind of gu worm to the public.
Qing Mao thanked him, though indeed, it looked like the Vitality Leaves had done little for her.
Fang Yuan by this point had disregarded the system's dumb mission and calculated that it would be for the best to kill Bai Ning Bing here and now. Who knew when he would be able to leave Qing Mao mountain? Bai Ning Bing was a ticking time bomb that would destroy much of what was on the mountain- even the Spring Autumn Cicada in its sealed state might get implicated, let alone things like the spirit springs which Fang Yuan would need to rely on.
Best to tear out the problem by the roots! Working with Qing Shu here, with Bai Ning Bing's primeval essence expended, there would be no better chance then now. The promise of an immortal gu was useless if one was dead after all, and Bai Ning Bing caused far too many problems for Fang Yuan to
Host, this is base Bai Ning Bing that we're up against. Allow me to give you a little extra help in dealing with him.
Cultivation Blessing Received!
Can advance one mortal gu by one rank. Cannot be used to advance mortal gu to Immortal Gu.
"We need to quit biding time," Qing Shu said. "He's only going to recover more and more primeval essence the longer we wait. Qing Mao, take Yao Hong away while we deal with him."
It was naturally difficult for a person to move carrying another person, especially without a special movement-type gu worm or primeval essence. Were Fang Yuan to lend him the Hundred Li Earthwolf Spider, there might actually be a chance of them getting away. Though naturally, he would not do such a thing.
"It would greatly upset my heart if we were to part so soon after having just met," Bai Ning Bing said, sending an icicle spear at Qing Mao's retreating back, which was blocked hastily by Qing Shu.
Fang Yuan struck with a crimson moonblade, though Bai Ning Bing blocked it as a small membrane of water appeared in the attack's path.
Water Shield Gu!
Since Bai Ning Bing had the Northern Dark Ice Soul Physique, ice elemental type gu worms would be boosted in power whenever he used them. Even though he was Rank 3, they could show some degree of Rank 4 power. That was how Bai Ning Bing had been able to kill Rank 3 elders when he had only been Rank 2.
However, Water Shield Gu did not fall into the category of an ice gu worm, which is why Fang Yuan immediately pounced upon this as one of Bai Ning Bing's weaknesses.
Bai Ning Bing snorted coldly even as the crimson moonblades rained down upon his water veil. "Fang Yuan, that Blood Moon Gu truly is impressive- too bad that its offensive power is mediocre!" He had seen the strange moonblade that Fang Yuan had used to kill the Hundred Beast King, and had gone back to his own village to inquire about it. Although the Bai Clan naturally had limited information on the gu worm, Bai Ning Bing was able to pick up a few points about it. Namely that it was mainly used as a strategy to force the enemy to bleed out.
And naturally, Bai Ning Bing had already prepared countermeasures for such an event. The Water Shield Gu was sufficient enough to block all of its attacks given its weak offensive power, and he could always temporarily turn his body into ice, negating its hemorrhagic effect.
However, even as he taunted Fang Yuan, Bai Ning Bing's expression began to change.
The Water Shield Gu was rapidly being used up as Fang Yuan released crimson moonblade after crimson moonblade.
'Isn't he worried about conserving his primeval essence?' Bai Ning Bing wondered. Even if the offensive power of the Blood Moon Gu was low, if each strike was stacked upon one another like this, gaps would be exposed in his defense.
Tiny strokes fell great oaks- had Fang Yuan decided to commit himself fully to killing him? Either that, or he was confident that even if his primeval essence fell, that Qing Shu or some other Gu Masters would arrive to reinforce him.
"Fang Yuan, careful!" Qing Shu said. He had noticed Fang Yuan's reckless use of his gu worms as well, though Fang Yuan paid no attention to this warning.
Fang Yuan, of course, had no lack of Rank 3 primeval essence right now. Thanks to Training Weights Gu diluting it, his rate of recovery was even greater than that of Bai Ning Bing. Bai Ning Bing could not turn his full attention on Fang Yuan as he kept being blocked by Qing Shu's vines.
As the flow of battle turned against Bai Ning Bing, he chose to change tactics in an effort to try and tip the scales.

chapters.title: Chapter 112 - 112: Fang Yuan vs Bai Ning Bing: Part Two
chapters.content:
Bai Ning Bing's stomach suddenly swelled as something moved from it up towards his throat until finally being ejected from his mouth.
It was a gu worm that took the shape of a delicate pigeon which seemed to be made entirely of glass. Though its intricate features would make it worthy of being a great work of art back on Earth, both Fang Yuan and Qing Shu were instantly on guard.
Rank 3 Blue Bird Ice Coffin Gu!
Qing Shu and Fang Yuan could not react in time to the attack as Bai Ning Bing had timed it almost flawlessly, and the bird emerged, with the two of them being able to do little more than activate their defensive gu worms in an hurry in anticipation of the blow.
Only it never came, as the bird soared over their heads.
Bai Ning Bing was not targeting either of them- but was instead targeting Qing Mao and Yao Hong.
"Get out of the way!" Qing Shu screamed, but it was futile. Once the Blue Bird Ice Coffin Gu had locked onto its target, it would follow them like a homing missile. Only a defensive gu worm could save those two now, but neither of them had something on the level of a Rank 3 defensive gu worm.
As the bird found its target, there was a massive explosion of frost and snow. When it cleared, the two of them were incased in a massive black of ice, all signs of life gone from both of their bodies.
"Bai Ning Bing! How dare you strike two of my dearest comrades!" Fang Yuan said, enraged.
However, while he was only mock angry, Qing Shu was genuinely furious.
Which was exactly what Bai Ning Bing had been counting on!
Rank 3 aura erupted from Bai Ning Bing once again. Until now, he had mainly been using Rank 2 gu worms, likely as a way of limiting the progression of the Northern Dark Ice Soul's physique and the slow march to his own death, but he had pulled out all of the stops now.
"It looks like it's time for me to get serious!" Bai Ning Bing activated one of his trump cards, Rank Three Frost Demon Gu!
He struck at Qing Shu, who had hesitated ever so slightly, and then slowly advanced a blade of ice towards the man's chest.
A moonblade flew at him, but that was already within Bai Ning Bing's calculations. His Water Shield Gu would stop it and-
Suddenly, Bai Ning Bing's vital gu began moving in a distressed manner within his aperture.
It was said that in certain occasions, if one's vital gu noticed that their Gu Master was close to death, they would signal out to them. This was rare enough that it was only a legend as far as people like the Gu Yue villagers knew, but Fang Yuan knew that it was a fact.
Bai Ning Bing barely had time to adjust his body ever so slightly in response to this alert before he was hit.
"Guh!" Bai Ning Bing screamed in pain and coughed out a mouthful of blood, retreating.
Whatever strike Fang Yuan had used had completely pierced through Water Shield Gu's defenses, and struck him near his torso.
Bai Ning Bing had suffered backlash from Water Shield Gu failing, and the strike itself would have decapitated him if he had not moved in time.
His vital gu warning him really had saved his life, but even now, he was in a dire situation and needed time to recover.
How had Fang Yuan managed to break through his defenses when he had been unable to earlier?
Bai Ning Bing had caught a flash of the attack out of the corner of his eye, but had not seen it completely.
It was a strange, golden-yellow moonblade.
Wait... golden-yellow and not crimson?
"Fang Yuan..." Qing Shu said, coughing up blood. Bai Ning Bing's strike had not killed him, but had damaged several of his vital organs. "I... won't be able to last much longer... I..."
"Don't say that," Fang Yuan said, pulling the man closer to himself. In a manner that was quite surreptitious, a hand emerged from Fang Yuan's aperture- the hand of Rank 3 Doctor Gu, which began to work its magic on Qing Shu.
The effect was instantaneous and greatly effective. Qing Shu's internal organs were nearly completely mended, and the bleeding had stopped. Now, he was left with only an unsightly scar. If Fang Yuan had used Doctor Gu's effect for a longer time, he could've completely patched the man up, but he couldn't, else he'd end up revealing it.Follow current novᴇls on NovᴇlFirenᴇt
The only reason that Fang Yuan had risked it earlier was because being close to death, both Qing Shu and Bai Ning Bing could
"I had a single-use healing gu worm," Fang Yuan explained. "Oh... if I had used it on sister Yao Hong... perhaps she would've lived." His voice was filled with regret. "But... because I had hesitated and wanted to use it at the right time, both she and Qing Mao lost their lives. I... don't know how I could ever show my face in the village again. I'm sorry... I let all of you down..."
"No, Fang Yuan, if anything... you should've kept it for yourself and not wasted it on someone like me," Qing Shu said, getting up. "You are an elder of this clan and also likely our future clan head. You made the right call- if you had used it on Yao Hong, she would've fallen to Bai Ning Bing anyway. But, now that you used it on me, I won't let you down. Let's kill this demon together and avenge our fallen comrades!"
Bai Ning Bing was rapidly encasing himself in a layer of ice. On a normal Gu Master, such a move would be equivalent to death. However, Bai Ning Bing had converted his muscles into ice, and was using the Rank 3 Frost Demon Gu. With these two benefits, this was actually shielding him from attacks while he patched himself up. Fang Yuan didn't know what kind of healing gu worms that Bai Ning Bing had, but just chilling the wound would have a great effect in and of itself.
Naturally then, Fang Yuan could not allow Bai Ning Bing to recover. The Blood Moon Gu might've been unable to pierce through the wall of ice, but that didn't mean that Fang Yuan was out of options.
A golden crescent flew from his hands.
Rank 3 Golden Moon Gu!
In order to expand his offensive repertoire, he had recently purchased the materials needed and refined this gu worm.
Earlier, he had not been planning on refining this gu or one of the other advancement branches of the Moonlight Gu, simply because it was difficult to feed them without the clan's Moon Orchid Petals.
However, recently the benfits:cost ratio had changed. He could no longer leave Qing Mao mountain anytime soon, and it was clear that the Blood Moon Gu was not enough for offense if he was going to be up against strong enemies. Not only that, while he had to pay an arm and a leg for the clan's Moon Orchid Petals, he was receiving 300 primeval stones a week as well thanks to his status as an elder. This eased the financial strain of having to nurture this gu worm somewhat.
A crack appeared in the ice, on top of which Fang Yuan intended to strike again in the same place.

chapters.title: Chapter 113 - 113: Fang Yuan vs Bai Ning Bing: Part Three
chapters.content:
"Fang Yuan, you bought a Golden Moon Gu?" Qing Shu asked. There was no way that someone like him wouldn't have noticed one of the signature gu worms of the clan.
"Yes," Fang Yuan said. "I realized that my offense was lacking in certain aspects. Please help me, if we don't break this ice shell, he'll recover and strike out at us."
"Being incased in ice like that- wouldn't he die?" Qing Shu wondered.
"He likely has a defensive type gu worm that turns most of his body into ice. Actually, in this scenario, the low temperature would benefit him by accelerating the clotting rate of his blood," Fang Yuan said. Being a Blood Path Grandmaster, he naturally had a far better understanding of clotting than other people did. "We need to act quickly or he's going to counterattack with a vengeance."
This was why he had gone through the trouble of using Doctor Gu on Qing Shu in the first place. He was not confident in his ability to kill Bai Ning Bing on his own- moreover, Qing Shu's death would mean the loss of a Yellow Golden Relic Gu.
If Qing Shu died, Fang Yuan would genuinely have a sense of remorse from the event, unlike whatever fake remorse he pretended to have when describing Qing Mao's and Yao Hong's deaths.
Qing Shu's arms began to transform into vines, wrapping around the block of ice and trying to crack it open like you would a walnut.
Just as the two of them were about to succeed, the block of ice ruptured from within, turning into thousands of tiny motes of ice that dazzled about and glittered in the air. Multiple rainbows glittered on the ground as the sunlight struck them, acting as prisms that danced in the air.
Bai Ning Bing emerged and immediately his throat began to swell once again.
Rank 3 Blue Bird Ice Coffin Gu!
Fang Yuan was not about to let him use it though - every gu worm had its weakness, and the Blue Bird Ice Coffin Gu was no exception. Fang Yuan let out a golden moonblade at the bird as it was about to emerge from his mouth, but Bai Ning Bing lifted his arm to block the attack.ᴛhis ᴜpdated by
His left arm exploded in an icy galewind that absorbed the golden moonblade as the blue bird left, targeting Fang Yuan.
Three Step Fragrant Grass Gu!
Even though Fang Yuan moved with the help of the gu worm, the bird was locked onto its target. He activated his Rank 3 Moonlight Chainmail Gu, wrapping himself up in a layer of silvery chainmail, bracing for the blow.
Only he did not have to endure the brunt of the attack, as Qing Shu let out a vine which struck the bird midair. It exploded some distance from Fang Yuan, but he was still blinded by the ensuing icy storm.
Bai Ning Bing's head was buzzing. The wound that Fang Yuan had dealt him had not fully healed, and he had lost a large amount of blood. His primeval essence was nearly expended by that last attack, and he felt that he was on his last legs.
'Ahaha... this is the kind of life I live for!' he thought, as the nausea overcame him and he vomited out his breakfast, last night's dinner, and when that was empty, just stomach acid.
Vines had already begun to wrap around his ankles, but he slashed them away with an icy blade.
'How does he still have primeval essence after this?' Qing Shu wondered. It was as if Bai Ning Bing had something akin to the legendary Heavenly Treasure Lotus which would ensure he had limitless primeval essence.
'I... need... more... power...' Bai Ning Bing thought. The Bai Clan had tried to seal away the Northern Dark Ice Soul physique to some extent, but a lowly village like theirs had only rudimentary methods to deal with something like one of the Ten Extreme Physiques. Bai Ning Bing had removed most of them when he had started using Rank 3 gu worms, but now, he removed the last of the methods that had been placed on his aperture.
Immediately, his aperture began to fill with primeval essence. Die now, or die later- the choice was obvious!
'If I'm going down, I'm going down in flames!' Bai Ning Bing thought as his aperture began to fill with a speed that matched that of Fang Yuan's.
Qing Shu's body was once again transforming entirely into wood as he used more of the Wood Charm Gu. By this point, he had nearly given up on his own life, and made protecting Fang Yuan, who he saw as the future of the village, his main goal.
Bai Ning Bing slashed away as the icy aura among him darkened. He turned into whirlwind of frost and wind, slicing apart the vines with childish ease.
'This...!' Qing Shu couldn't help but marvel at this sight. With the full power of the Wood Charm Gu, even the elders of his clan could barely keep up with him.
