On top of which, his skill was top-notch as well. And yet, he was being pushed back and suppressed by Bai Ning Bing! 'Why aren't the reinforcement I asked for here yet?' was his second thought.
Although Qing Shu didn't know it, the reinforcement he had asked for had been ambushed and killed by the wolves and would not be arriving to save them.
Fang Yuan emerged from the debris of the Blue Bird Ice Coffin Gu, using Doctor Gu to heal whatever injuries he had. His defensive net was still active and his injuries minor, though this was thanks to Qing Shu's help.
Bai Ning Bing was fighting in close quarters with Qing Shu, to the point where ranged attacks could not be used.
As Bai Ning Bing forced himself forward, the vines around him became denser and denser, overcoming the layer of frost.
"Wait!" Fang Yuan cried out, wanting Qing Shu to back down. Qing Shu looked close to losing control of the Wood Charm Gu. If Qing Shu died, he'd fail in his mission- and while Qing Shu thought that Fang Yuan had expended all of his trump cards and so he needed to sacrifice himself in order to keep Fang Yuan safe, Fang Yuan still had certain pieces to play. Not that Qing Shu knew that.
This was the disadvantage of working together while keeping secrets- misunderstandings like this could easily happen.
By now, it was too late for Qing Shu, whose entire body had turned into a massive tree.
Mission failed!
Qing Shu is dead.
Bai Ning Bing's frosty aura was nowhere to be seen now, though Fang Yuan was not one to let his guard down.
He was right to be wary, as cracks appeared in the wooden cage of vines that had wrapped themselves around Bai Ning Bing. They widened, and a frost wind emerged as Bai Ning Bing cut himself through the branches.
Despite everything, he had a maniacal grin on his face as he lifted an ice balde at Fang Yuan. He had eliminated one of the players on the chess board, and that meant that Fang Yuan was alone and wide open.
As the time of his death drew nearer, Bai Ning Bing only became further invigorated. He wanted to have a true showdown against Fang Yuan. "Well? Fang Yuan? I killed all of your teammates- don't you want to avenge them? Ahahaha!"
Fang Yuan's face changed, turning into the cold visage of a demon who had long since forsaken the world.
"Yes! Yes!" Bai Ning Bing said. "That is the kind of face I wanted to see from you- I wanted to see your true face before I killed you!"
"It is truly unfortunate that you killed all of them," Fang Yuan sighed. "Now... there are no witnesses... and I have no need to hold back..." He removed a gu worm from his aperture, which looked like a cylindrical block of steel.
Bai Ning Bing's pupils instantly shrank.
Rank 4 aura!

chapters.title: Chapter 114 - 114: Fang Yuan vs Bai Ning Bing: Part Four
chapters.content:
Although Fang Yuan could only curse his luck at the fact that Qing Shu had died, this did have an upside for him.
He no longer needed to fight with a hand tied behind his back!
He had already made use of the Training Weights Gu to bring up his aptitude to 78% and it was unlikely that he would be able to use it further.
Now, Rank 4 yellow primeval essence began to fill his aperture. But, it was not enough.
He began withdrawing primeval stones to replenish his Rank 4 essence.
Bai Ning Bing had already turned tail and fled the battlefield.
"Bai Ning Bing! Didn't you want the two of us to have a grand fight to the death? Where did your bravado suddenly go?" Fang Yuan demanded.
Bai Ning Bing did not bother looking back. He wanted to fight, yes, but he was not stupid. Who knew what other cards Fang Yuan was hiding up his sleeve? As it was, the chance that he could fight against a Rank 4 Gu Master in his current state even with the Northern Dark Ice Soul physique were slim.
'Your death anniversary will be a year from now on,' Fang Yuan thought as he had finally replenished his primeval essence to an acceptable amount.
Among the thoughts racing through his brain was wondering what gu worm he should use his cultivation blessing on- he had not activated it yet, but he could not think of an appropriate candidate.
He could try advancing Three Steps Fragrant Grass Gu, but that would make it only Rank Three still and would not be able to bridge the distance between them fast enough.ɴᴇᴡ ɴᴏᴠᴇʟ ᴄʜᴀᴘᴛᴇʀs ᴀʀᴇ ᴘᴜʙʟɪsʜᴇᴅ ᴏɴ
He could use it on the Hundred Li Earthwolf Spider, but that would make it Rank 5 and would not mix well with his Rank 4 primeval essence.
Either of the Moon Gus could be advanced, but so could the Moonlight Chainmail Gu. Offense or defense- which one should he focus on?
He really didn't see how this helped him in the slightest- why had the system handed him this power?
He took out the Hundred Li Earthwolf Spider and this closed the distance between the two of them, while Fang Yuan took the opportunity of riding a mount to replenish his primeval essence even further.
Bai Ning Bing's battle instinct kicked in even as he fled, using the Blue Bird Ice Coffin Gu and directing it at Fang Yuan's mount.
Fang Yuan dismounted and kept the Hundred Li Earthwolf Spider back in his aperture. It was excellent for moving around but not very durable, and with Bai Ning Bing's power would likely die in a single hit. The use of the spider was mainly to run away from enemies, after all, rather than towards them.
Still, he had managed to cover quite the distance between the two of them, but now had to deal with the Blue Bird Ice Coffin Gu instead. As its original target had vanished, it now locked onto Fang Yuan instead.
Fang Yuan used his cultivation blessing on the Rank 3 Moonlight Chainmail Gu- advancing it to Rank 4 Moonlight Plate Armor Gu!
Fang Yuan was encased in a silvery set of armor, making him look similar to European knights back on Earth, though his armor had a mystical tinge to it.
Using this, he endured the Blue Bird Ice Coffin Gu head on, with it delaying him by only a few breaths.
Three Steps Fragrant Grass Gu!
Even if he pushed Rank 4 primeval essence into it, it was still only a Rank 2 gu worm and could not fully cover the distance between them.
Golden Moonblade!
He shot one out, though Bai Ning Bing deflected it with his own ice blade.
In a fit of desperation, Bai Ning Bing threw a gu worm out from his aperture.
Even back on Earth, this tactic was sometimes used by scouts. If they were found out, they would drop behind coins or other precious items to buy time for them to save their lives. Or, how some women would 'accidentally' drop their purses if they thought they were being followed.
It was a Rank 3 Aperture Gu, quite useful to Bai Ning Bing, but he didn't value it more than his own life, naturally.
'If only I still had the Spring Autumn Cicada, I could've refined this gu worm instantly and taken it, but as it most likely has his will imbued within it, I won't be able to refine it that easily,' Fang Yuan thought, squishing the gu worm under his foot like a cockroach. It was worth several thousand primeval stones, but he put a greater value on Bai Ning Bing's head right now.
As Bai Ning Bing saw that his strategy had failed and thought that he was done for, he heard something.
There were voices ahead!
If there was a group of Gu Masters, there was a one in three chance it belonged to any of the three clans.
If they were Bai Clan Gu Masters, he might have a shot at saving himself.
If they were from the Gu Yue clan, he was done for. If they were from the Xiong Clan, they would likely not interfere, meaning he would still be dead.
In other words, he only had a one in three chance of survival, but that was better than nothing.
Fang Yuan knew this, so he didn't let up in his pursuit.
As Bai Ning Bing burst through a line of trees and saw the people in front of him, a smile of relief blossomed on his face.
'What kind of dogshit luck is this?' Fang Yuan thought, noting the Bai clansmen that had appeared in front of him, trailing only a few moments behind Bai Ning Bing. 'No... if there is no one strong among them... I can still kill them and...'
"Ah! Help me! Fang Yuan is trying to kill me!" Bai Ning Bing cried out.
Among the Bai clansmen there was a Rank 3 elder. Fang Yuan, in his current situation, would not be able to kill all of them before word got out back to the Bai clan or reinforcements would arrive.
That would not matter in ordinary circumstances, but Fang Yuan was going to be tied to the mountain for the foreseeable future.
He had lost quite a bit in his pursuit of Bai Ning Bing, but he also knew when to cut his losses. Fighting would no longer yield him with any further benefits.
"What? Fang Yuan?"
"He masquerades as a righteous path cultivator, but he's trying to kill an elder of our clan!"
"Hmph- all Gu Yue villagers are just a bunch of hypocrites!"
"Ahaha- let's get him!"
"Wait, is that Rank 4 aura I sense from him?"
The Bai clansmen froze. To go up against a Rank 3 Gu Master was one thing, but to go up against one at Rank 4 was something else entirely.
"He's... almost out of primeval essence," Bai Ning Bing choked out. "We can still take him!" He had figured how it was that Fang Yuan could use his abilities so freely earlier on in the fight, and noticed that he was not so carefree with it any longer. He was able to put two and two together like that.
"That's right! We just need to buy time for Elder Bai Ning Bing and he'll turn the tide around like he always does!"
"Correct, how could anyone stand up to the genius that is our clan's Bai Ning Bing?"
"Bai Ning Bing could fight even Rank 3 Gu Masters when he was only Rank 2, no doubt he can succeed here with all of our help!"
"That's right, he's still Rank 4 Initial Stage, and probably doesn't have full Rank 4 strength yet!"
Fang Yuan turned around, withdrawing the Hundred Li Earthwolf Spider and mounting it before going on his way back to Qing Shu's and the other corpses, and then to Gu Yue village.

chapters.title: Chapter 115 - 115: Lightning Lycan King: Part One
chapters.content:
Fang Yuan went to retrieve the gu worms from Qing Shu's and the others corpses. He could gain quite a number of merit points by exchanging them, and if this small incident was a portent of future events, he would need as many as he could gather.
There was no hiding his Rank 4 cultivation level anymore. Several Bai clansmen had already seen it, and with it, word would spread throughout the mountain.
There were too many witnesses now for Fang Yuan to hide it. If it was only Bai Ning Bing spouting nonsense he might've been able to suppress it, but he couldn't now.
All in all, the fight with Bai Ning Bing had been a massive loss for him. He had not gained anything save for perhaps the Moonlight Plate Armor Gu, and had lost the chance to get a Yellow Golden Relic Gu, and also revealed his Rank 4 Initial Stage cultivation to the world.
Fang Yuan could get around the story regarding what had happened simply enough. He had found Bai Ning Bing but was too late to stop him from killing Qing Shu and the others before he pursued the latter and was forced to turn back.
The clan bought this explanation well enough- he had a reputation after all.
The issue was his Rank 4 cultivation!
It had been two days since news had gotten out, yet, no one from the elder's hall had come to investigate him.
He had expected that there would be some investigation into his sudden burst in strength, perhaps even the clan head might visit him, but no such event happened.
He knew the village was in a storm upon hearing it- how could he, someone who had graduated little more than a year ago, have reached Rank 4 so quickly?
In a way his strength protected him from people questioning him openly- because no one wanted to mess with him. But that was only for the time being, once the elders gathered their strength- that was when the axe would descend upon them.
"Brother... you didn't tell me that you were so far ahead!" Fang Zheng said. While it might be expected that he was a bit shocked that Fang Yuan had hid this from him, at the same time, he had realized how important strength was in this world and was partially happy- not realizing the problems that this would create for Fang Yuan.
Fang Yuan now asked for permission to enter the underground cavern to search for Rank 4 gu recipes, and to his mild surprise, was allowed to enter without any resistance.
He now had recipes for the Rank 4 advancement of both the Blood Moon Gu and the Golden Moon Gu. He had tried one attempt at advancing the Blood Moon Gu, but had sadly failed.
Two days after that, as he tried to gather the materials for another attempt, the time finally came when the clan head came to visit him.
Fang Yuan had anticipated this, and prepared the necessary stories to explain away his newfound strength.
"Elder Fang Yuan, I apologize for not being able to come earlier, but I wanted to congratulate you on reaching Rank 4," the clan head said.
There was no air of arrogance from the man at this point, because Fang Yuan was almost his equal now. Almost, but not quite.
"I thank you for your kind words," Fang Yuan said. "I only wished that I could have intervened sooner on Brother Qing Shu's behalf... perhaps he would still be alive were that the case..."
"It cannot be helped, the Bai clan has reared quite the demon," the clan head said. "However, we have to put that matter aside for now. There is a more pressing issue that has come up that we need to deal with..."
Fang Yuan began putting the pieces together- he had not been questioned until now, so it was likely that this matter was so important that it had saved his neck for the time being. "What is it?"
"A group was fighting a group of wolves, and things were going well enough," the clan head said. "However, suddenly, among the wolves, one of them began behaving differently. Most of the people who witnessed this event are dead, but they were able to leave a few information-type gu worms for us. One of the wolves suddenly stood up on its hind legs, almost like a human, before surrounding the battlefield in thick black smoke. It also had a gu worm that allowed it to shoot lightning- even the elder's defensive gu worms failed when faced with it."
Fang Yuan already had a good idea at to what kind of creature it was based on that description alone, but he let the clan head finish.
"It was a Lightning Lycan King - this wolf is quite dangerous as it is a mutant," the clan head explained. "It has the strength equivalent to a Rank 4 Gu Master, but that isn't all- what makes it truly dangerous is the fact that it possesses an intelligence that rivals even that of humans. With that, it is even more dangerous than a Thunder Crown Wolf."
"Wait, but clan head..." Fang Yuan began. "That means that combined with the three Thunder Crown Wolves we've seen- there are four beasts with Myriad Beast King strength in the wolf tide!?"
"Indeed it looks like we've greatly underestimated the amount of trouble that we're in," the clan head said.
Before, when it had only been three Thunder Crown Wolves, each clan could take care of one. But now, there was a fourth- and it was more likely than not that the Gu Yue clan would end up facing not one, but two foes. The Lightning Lycan King, with its intelligence, might naturally wish to take them, the strongest of the three clans down first.
With Qing Shu dead, there was no way that the clan head could even dream of kicking Fang Yuan out. On the contrary, he would feel the need to arm Fang Yuan. Even though Fang Yuan was a potential rival for the position of clan head, the current clan head could do nothing to suppress Fang Yuan. One could only think of the future and their position if they were alive, after all.
Fang Yuan's assessment was correct as the clan head handed him some refinement materials. "I have taken them from the clan's storage, they should help you advance your Golden Moon Gu to Rank 4." Naturally between the Blood Moon Gu and the Golden Moon Gu, he would prefer that Fang Yuan advance the latter. "Also, I have spoken to the underground cavern, you can take a single Rank 4 gu worm with no cost. I hope that will help you increase your strength- we will need it in the coming days."
The clan head's face was pale and he had clearly been under a lot of stress the past few days. It even seemed to Fang Yuan that there was something that the clan head was hiding from him, but he couldn't piece that together right now.
However, with the clan head acknowledging him as such, no one else in the village would dare find trouble with him in current circumstances. Of course, once the wolf tide was over, it would be a completely different story, but that meant that Fang Yuan would be left alone until then.
Fang Yuan's weekly allowance had also been increased from 300 primeval stones to 2,000.
Using this new fortune, he was able to successfully turn the Golden Moon Gu into a Rank 4 Electrum Moon Gu, with far greater offensive power than before. He needed more Moon Orchid Petals to feed it, but with his increased allowance this was manageable.
Secondly, he refined the Three Steps Fragrant Grass Gu to Rank 3 Ten Steps Fragrant Grass Gu. To advance it to Rank 4 would take too much time as some of the resources were simply not available regardless of how much one paid for them.
Then, it was time for him to pick out a Rank 4 gu worm.

chapters.title: Chapter 116 - 116: Lightning Lycan King: Part Two
chapters.content:
Fang Yuan walked into the underground cavern once again.
It was filled with gu worms, though as he was only interested in those of Rank 4, he had a far more limited selection to talk a look at.Follow current novels on ɴoᴠel Fɪre.nᴇt
The clan had only a select Rank 4 gu worms. If there were any Rank 5 gu worms, they were not kept here, but rather, in a secure spot where only the clan head knew. Fang Yuan had not yet earned the right to go down to that place, but it would greatly surprise Fang Yuan if the clan didn't have a Rank 5 gu worm or two.
After all, any clan that could last for a thousand years had to have a secret weapon of sorts. Whether that was an ancestor or some kind of gu worm- each clan would have something along those lines. Fang Yuan did not know what the Gu Yue clan's secrets were, after all, even in his previous life he had never made it far up the clan hierarchy.
Whatever it was though, it had not been enough to save the clan from Bai Ning Bing's detonation.
With only about ten Rank 4 gu worms, Fang Yuan quickly made his decision before leaving.
Wherever he went, people bowed to him. They had been subservient before, but ever since he had reached Rank 4, they were practically prostrating themselves on the streets when he walked by.
Even the other elders were quite the same - their invitations to various events had increased in frequency, though Fang Yuan tacitly declined them citing the current wolf tide as the reason.
There was a reason behind such toadying- up until now, most people had thought that Fang Yuan was a good candidate for future clan head, but with him entering the realm of Rank 4, this was nearly confirmed.
Of course, while becoming clan head would bestow a number of benefits upon Fang Yuan, they were not worth the trouble of being anchored down to Qing Mao mountain.
Granted, he was anchored down due to another reason now, but he still saw no merit in challenging the current clan head for the position. For now, he could support the current clan head so that he would be under less scrutiny. If he shook the boat too much, the elders would gather around the current clan head and start pressing Fang Yuan regarding his secrets.
As a matter of fact, Fang Yuan was still quite surprised that he had not been interrogated further. It was a bit... eerie. Even given the nature of the wolf tide, he'd have assumed that the clan head must've had several questions, but he had not even broached the topic with Fang Yuan.
It was almost as if... he had already formed a conclusion regarding what had happened, and so did not feel the need to ask Fang Yuan about it further.
'Is there something missing? Or something that I don't know about?' Fang Yuan thought. He could not get rid of the feeling of unease that permeated his mind. There was no way that the clan head could've possibly known about the Immortal Inheritance else the entire mountain would be in an uproar to get to it, even if it was intended entirely for Fang Yuan. So what was the lie that the clan head was assuming was the truth?
The fact that Fang Yuan was clearly missing a piece of the puzzle was annoying, but there was little that he could do. He had reached out to the other elders, but they were either as ignorant as he was, or were hiding it from him. He had only been an elder for a few months, and had not had time to develop deep relations with any of the major factions.
Even as he considered this, he went to do his daily quest for the system- giving a homeless man a primeval stone. The man thanked Fang Yuan for his kindness, but then Fang Yuan was jolted out of his reverie by something responding in his aperture.
Could it be...?
He had been wondering what the gu worm he had obtained from rock gambling was for the longest time, the one that he hadn't had to feed. When Paradise Earth had mentioned that he would need one of seven gu worms to refine the Righteous Virtue physique, he seemed to be implying that Fang Yuan had one of them.
Fang Yuan had a guess regarding what the gu worm was, but now, he was nearly certain as to its nature. He only had to confirm it.
He walked into the wine tavern. The waiter there greeted him, bowing deeply.
"Is my younger brother in?"
"Yes, Young Master Fang Zheng is sitting at one of the tables in the back. Is there anything this lowly servant can get for you?"
"No, that's fine," Fang Yuan said, walking into the tavern.
Fang Zheng was speaking to Gu Yue Ye, regarding a similar matter as last time.
As a matter of fact, Fang Yuan had come in initially to tell Fang Zheng off for selling some of the Vitality Leaves at a discount to some customers and not others. Even if Fang Zheng was not doing it to further his own bottom line, it was causing issues when it came to their business. Once one person realized that they could get a discount, all of them began clamoring for one.
"Like I said, I can't keep selling it to you for lower than-" Fang Zheng was telling Gu Yue Ye when he saw Fang Yuan.
Fang Yuan was seldom seen in the wine tavern now-a-days, so his presence immediately put Fang Zheng on guard. "Ah, elder brother, welcome!"
Jiang Ya also bowed when he saw Fang Yuan, and Gu Yue Ye immediately became subdued upon feeling Fang Yuan's Rank 4 aura.
"Lord Fang Yuan!"
"Elder Fang Yuan!"
Fang Yuan waved his hand and asked them to sit down. "I didn't come here to drink, but because I had a matter to take care of. Fang Zheng, I had heard that there were some people who were bothering you about a discounted sale?"
Fang Zheng gulped. It was true, but if he let Fang Yuan find out, what kind of punishment would he give Gu Yue Ye? It wasn't that Fang Zheng felt too much sorry for the old man, but he didn't want to throw him under the bus either.
"Ah... no... Elder Fang Yuan it isn't like that..." Gu Yue Ye said, stuttering. His face began to become coated with sweat. "It's just I was wondering if certain mercy could be shown to this old man..."
Fang Yuan pulled out two Vitality Leaves. "I can give you these two for free, but I request that you tell no one else about this." His face then morphed into a gentle expression. "I understand that with the wolf tide becoming fierce, we need to look out for one another. The wolves may eject their elderly and starving, their weak and feeble, but we are humans after all. To look after those less fortunate than us is our duty."
Gu Yue Ye almost didn't dare take the Vitality Leaves. He had been adamant about getting them earlier, but now that Fang Yuan was freely offering them to him for no cost, it was like trying to put his hand into a scorpion's nest. Was this some sort of sick joke from Fang Yuan?
"I am unworthy of such kindness!" Gu Yue Ye said, shaking his head.
"I insist."
That sealed the deal, and Gu Yue Ye took the leaves, not believing his own luck. He had been looking to save a few primeval stones, but this would save him at least a 100!
As Fang Yuan did this, something in his aperture changed as well. The Rank 4 gu worm which had been a mystery up until now began glowing, changing, until it grew a fifth finger and now looked entirely like a human hand in a position of pronation.
The refinement process had succeeded- he had indeed turned it into a Rank 5 gu worm as he had been expecting!
This also confirmed the gu's identity to Fang Yuan, something that had been a mystery for quite a while - it was Charity Gu!

chapters.title: Chapter 117 - 117: Lightning Lycan King: Part Three
chapters.content:
"With that matter settled," Fang Yuan said. "Gu Yue Ye, if that is all, I need to speak with my two associates alone."
"Understood, Lord Fang Yuan," Gu Yue Ye said. Inwardly, the part of him that remembered being a Rank 3 elder and bristled at the tone that Fang Yuan was using. It was nothing but polite on the surface, but Gu Yue Ye couldn't help but feel like Fang Yuan was treating him like a dog he had thrown a few treats at and then demanded to get lost.
However, he once again felt Fang Yuan's Rank 4 aura and these thoughts evaporated like moisture in the hot desert wind.
Even if he was still an elder, his reputation would pale before that of a Rank 4 Gu Master! If Fang Yuan was treating him like a dog, so be it! If asked to bark, he would let out a loud 'woof!' as much as he could muster!
He took the two Vitality Leaves, thanked Fang Yuan once again, and left.
Once he was out of sight, Fang Yuan sighed. "Fang Zheng, your heart might be in the right place, but by entertaining such people you are only encouraging more of them."
Fang Zheng lowered his head. "Big Brother... I'm sorry..."
Fang Yuan waved his hand. "It is ultimately a small matter. I came to actually discuss the matter of the Vitality Leaves with you."
He took a seat, and it was only when he sat down that Fang Zheng sat. Jiang Ya, however, remained standing.
"Ah, Elder Fang Yuan, this one wanted to congratulate you on reaching Rank 4. Truly you are the clan's rising star, skyrocketing above all others. The kind of genius that only appears once a century- I knew the moment I laid eyes on you when you were a student that you were spectacular!"
Jiang Ya inwardly greatly envied Fang Yuan now- he was sure that the latter had somehow stumbled himself into some kind of inheritance with the kind of dogshit luck that he had.
As a matter of fact, most people thought the same. However, it appeared that the clan head's thoughts were going in a different direction. What that direction was, was a mystery.
Regardless, it wasn't like Jiang Ya was going to say anything to Fang Yuan. He didn't say anything earlier, and had no intention now either.
"Sit down," Fang Yuan said and it was only then that Jiang Ya obliged. "What I came here was to discuss the price of the Vitality Leaves we are selling."
In truth, he could've had this discussion back home, but he had wanted to teach Gu Yue Ye a lesson... until he had stumbled across what he thought was the secret to refining Rank 5 Charity Gu, that is.
It was likely that Charity Gu either fed on charitable acts as its food, or on human qi, given that Fang Yuan had not fed it anything ever since he had refined it. Either of those was fine for now, but would be an issue if he decided to leave the mountain in the future.
"Yes, brother, you're right," Fang Zheng said. "I think we should increase the going rate to eighty per piece-"ɪꜰ ʏᴏᴜ ᴡᴀɴᴛ ᴛᴏ ʀᴇᴀᴅ ᴍᴏʀᴇ ᴄʜᴀᴘᴛᴇʀs, ᴘʟᴇᴀsᴇ ᴠɪsɪᴛ NovᴇlFirᴇ.ɴet
"I was going to suggest the opposite," Fang Yuan said. He turned to Fang Zheng. "Fang Zheng, I want you to attempt to double the production of Vitality Leaves- you can use primeval stones for the purpose if need be. I also want to lower the price back down to sixty-five per Vitality Leaf."
"Sixty-five?" Jiang Ya muttered under his breath. On the one hand, he made his money from commissions, though it was Fang Yuan and Fang Zheng who essentially set the price by how much they sold to him. He could try manipulating it on his end, but that would mean the ire of the clan members who were desperate for the same would fall on him. While technically not illegal, it was the same as hiking up the price of an essential good like water back on Earth. Someone like Fang Yuan who was an elder could withstand that pressure, but could he? He could make it up by selling more, but what surprised him was that Fang Yuan was the one who made this suggestion.
While Fang Yuan had a reputation for being kind, he was also shrewd when it came to business.
"Big Brother, won't we lose out by doing so?" Fang Zheng asked. "If anything, the demand just keeps on increasing..."
"That's true," Fang Yuan said. "But look at the village around you, Fang Zheng. The villagers are injured and need Vitality Leaves now more than ever, especially with the upcoming fight. That is why I also said to increase the production. Right now, we have more than enough when it comes to streams of revenue, and I think it is more important that the leaves be more easily accessible to our clansmen."
Ordinarily Fang Yuan would not hesitate to jack up the price even further- so Fang Zheng did have the right idea there. But, ordinarily, Fang Yuan was not bound to Qing Mao mountain for the time being.
On the one hand, the villager's strength was his strength for the time being given the nature of the wolf tide.
On the other hand, he couldn't completely disregard his reputation now. He might need it if it came to a fight between him and the clan head. He wasn't sure why the clan head was behaving in this way, but the benefits of a few more primeval stones was not worth it.
"And on that note, Fang Zheng," Fang Yuan continued. "I need you to start preparing. The upcoming beast tide will be like none that has happened before."
The entire village was in a new level of alertness given the huge loss of Gu Masters secondary to the Lightning Lycan King's attack.
Any day now, it would without a doubt turn its attention to the villages. And more likely than not, they would be the first to attract its fury. Qing Shu, who had been an earlier pillar of the village, was dead now.
Preparations were underway, the medicine hall was overflowing like always, and everyone was waiting for the time when the attack would come.
The only thing that gave them some relief in their hearts was that Fang Yuan was there, a new Rank 4 Gu Master, and would be watching over and protecting them. The increased supply of Vitality Leaves was greatly appreciated and contributed to his reputation as a hero.
'No doubt, Paradise Earth and Genesis Lotus might have even anticipated that,' Fang Yuan thought. Even if that was true, however, it didn't mean that it was the wrong thing to do.
The loss of the Spring Autumn Cicada wasn't just the loss of a Rank 6 Gu Worm, far worse was the fact that Fang Yuan had lost his freedom. The freedom to fly away like the wind, and he was instead trapped in a giant iron cage by the name of Qing Mao mountain.
And not only was he trapped in a cage, but a feral animal had been released into it- whether in the form of the wolf tide, or in Bai Ning Bing's impending self-detonation.
'Still, to desire is to lose one's freedom,' Fang Yuan said. Even he was tied by his desire for Eternal Life. 'Who can be said to be truly free in this world?' There was a reason the Buddhist monks on Earth thought that the release from desire signified the release from attachment to the wheel of Samsara, and the release of the soul.
Howl!
His musings were interrupted by the sound of wolves. And not just the few that one might hear from time to time- no, there were multiple of them.
'It looks like the attack is here,' he thought to himself.

chapters.title: Chapter 118 - 118: Lightning Lycan King: Part Four
chapters.content:
"They are far more organized than I'd thought," one of the Gu Masters near the wall muttered under his breath.
Earlier, when the wolves had attacked, they had attacked as a massive swarm. Organized, but only in the most rudimentary way. Being wild animals, they would sometimes impede each other's attacks or even occasionally small fights would break out between them, even with the authority of a beast king.
However, now they were no longer in a large circle around the village. They were gathered into four neat groups near each of the gates of the village. This was no doubt the work of the Lightning Lycan King.
An army that maintained its formation had the fortitude of stone, while a disorganized army did not even have the permanence of a pile of sand.
Thankfully the formations around the village were still quite inferior to that a human might make. The Lightning Lycan King might have near-human intelligence, but it did not have the tactical genius or expertise of humans.
Still, this was bad news for the village.
New main mission!
Would you choose a man or a bear?
Description: Rescue Gu Yue Yao Le during the upcoming fight.
Reward: Yellow Golden Relic Gu (x 1)
Fang Yuan had lost his chance to get one with Qing Shu's death, but the system had given him another chance to obtain one. The only thing is that he couldn't understand why Gu Yue Yao Le might be in danger in the upcoming fighting given that she should've been working in the medicine hall, though he would keep a close eye on the fighting.
Howl!
The enemy wolves began to advance and the walls were reinforced.
Fang Yuan was still watching from a distance.
Earlier, he would've been unable to do anything against such a foe. Even at Rank 3 it was difficult to make a big difference in the outcome of a fight that was so widespread, unless maybe if he was at Rank 3 Peak Stage and had a complete set of complimentary gu worms.
Rank 4 was a completely different matter altogether. Qing Shu had to sacrifice himself to save the village using Wood Charm Gu, however, Fang Yuan's mere presence on the battlefield could greatly change its outcome.
For one, since he was there, the clan elders could act more freely knowing that they had backup in the form of an extra Rank 4 Gu Master helping them. Because of this, they could be deployed to the front lines earlier, while the Thousand Beast Kings were still holding themselves in the rear.
Second was the morale boost from having Fang Yuan around.
New Main Mission!
Five tigers one lamassu, three hounds one molossus, ten wolves one lycan.
Description: Kill the Lightning Lycan King.
Reward: ???
The third, was Fang Yuan's own battle strength!
He had been holding back in the beginning, but an opening soon appeared in front of him.
It was time for him to use the Rank 4 gu worm that he'd taken from the clan storage.
Pain coursed through his back as thin blades began to emerge, cutting through his robes in the process. Fang Yuan endured this as two pairs of wings erupted from his back.
Rank 4 Lightning Lord Wings Gu!
It was an upgraded version of Lightning Wings Gu, with the main upgrade being that this was a true flying-type gu worm. Lightning Wings Gu could help one fly, but that was closer to flailing about in the air rather than true flight.
The best thing about this gu was that its food was the meat of lightning wolves- which were in great supply currently.
Without a doubt it was a first-class gu worm. The clan only had one in its storage which had been won after a long and difficult battle by a clan head against a Thunder Crown Wolf three hundred years ago and one could only imagine the difficulty in killing that beast if it had this kind of gu worm on itself.
It was valuable to the point that Fang Yuan was sure that if these were ordinary times, even the elders would gather to protest him taking it. But these were not ordinary times.
Even the best gu worm, however, was useless if you didn't know how to use it properly.
Fang Yuan leapt into the air, soaring above the heads of those who were striking out at the tidal wave of wolves at the door.
"Is that Lord Fang Yuan?"
"Is he flying away?'
"Don't be ridiculous, he's going to fight."
"Fang Yuan, what're you doing?" the clan head muttered, seeing Fang Yuan soar out over the enemy. While the wolves were usually limited when it came to long-ranged attacks, the beast kings would have gu worms and the like that could strike at a distance. The Lightning Lycan King, in particular, was already known to have a ranged attack. So why was Fang Yuan risking his life like this? While he was flying, if struck, he would plummet to the earth and would be dead meat for the wolves.The most update n0vels are published on NovᴇlFirᴇ.ɴet
In that case, he wouldn't be able to stand by while of their strongest warriors was attacked. The elders would be forced to sally forth to rescue him, but that would expose multiple flaws in their defense.
Fang Yuan must've known about this- and had also been told about the Lightning Lycan King's attacks, so why had he made this decision.
"This...!" the clan head said, suddenly speechless upon seeing what Fang Yuan was doing. "Such natural-born talent with flying?"
Of all movement-type gu, flying types were the most useful in combat. No matter how good the gu was, if one was bound to the ground they were limited to a two-dimension space while moving about. One could jump, but it was not the same as flying as one could not turn in mid-air.
Flying though- that opened up the entire range of 3-dimensional movement. One could go up, down, left, right, and any other combination of directions in-between.
Of course, flying took practice. Decades of practice even for someone to be good to the point where they could say that they had truly mastered how to fly. Otherwise, like newborn chicks opening their wings for the first time, they were likely to crash down to earth.
Fang Yuan had more than a few decade's worth of experience. Unlike mortal gu masters, all Immortal Gu Masters frequently flew, and so at minimum were masters in flying. Fang Yuan was no exception, and was able to swerve and weave over the heads of the wolf tide, letting out golden moonblades wherever he saw an appropriate target.
His main target, however, was the large wolf at the back. The Lightning Frenzy Wolf, which gnashed its teeth at him and leaped up, though Fang Yuan easily avoided its fangs. At the crest of his ascent, he folded his wings, pirouetting in the air as he fell, releasing two Rank 4 moonblades as he did so.
"Incredible!"
"What kind of talent is that?"
"He can change direction on a whim!"
A satisfying howl of pain reached his ears. Even if it had a defensive-type gu worm, it would not be the match of two Rank 4 moonblades.
Fang Yuan then soared back over the heads of the wolves. The Lightning Lycan King had not seen fit to strike him during this time, but that was why he was keeping his Moonlight Plate Armor Gu in reserve.
He had only killed over a dozen wolves, but they had all been Hundred Beast Kings and the commanding Thousand Beast King.
Was the Lightning Lycan King not here after all? It was a possibility that it had gone for one of the other villages. A Thunder Crown Wolf also had not made an appearance as of yet.
With their leader and a few hundred beast kings dead, this portion of the wolf army began to greatly lose cohesion. Without the Thousand Beast King to worry about, the elders were even more aggressive with their attacks now, beating back the snarling jaws which threatened to tear the wall down. The sheer number of wolves was what was greatly distressing and could possibly cause the village's defenses to collapse, but with the added help from the elders who were now free to act, their numbers began to slowly dwindle.

chapters.title: Chapter 119 - 119: Lightning Lycan King: Part Five
chapters.content:
"Hold the line," Fang Yuan instructed. "I need time to replenish my primeval essence."
Out of the four attacking groups of wolves, he had already crippled one, and his primeval essence was around 20% at this time.
He used up primeval stones without care, his essence rapidly growing back to its peak before he sailed out into the air again.
Just like this, he sallied forth and beheaded the leader of another group of wolves, as well as several of their stronger members which the other Gu Masters were having difficulty dealing with.
"Lord Fang Yuan, please reinforce us!"
"Lord Fang Yuan, the southwest section is nearing collapse!"
"Lord Fang Yuan, one of these Hundred Beast Kings has over four Rank 2 gu worms! Please get rid of it!"
Cries like this arose as people saw how Fang Yuan was fighting.
"Giving him those wings was not a mistake then," the clan head muttered. He was still lying in reserve, watching what was going on in case the Thunder Crown Wolf or the Lightning Lycan King made its move. In ordinary circumstances he would be unable to do much if the walls were breached, and could only rely on people like Qing Shu to possibly use Wood Charm Gu to hold the line.
However, Fang Yuan had greatly surpassed what Qing Shu could accomplish even with the Wood Charm Gu. While it was said that two fists cannot rival four palms, there was a great difference in the strength of Gu Masters between ranks. Fang Yuan could fly out like a fighter jet, destroying the enemy's most valuable pieces and removing them from the board. With the Thousand Beast Kings removed from the equation, and many of the Hundred Beast Kings as well, the elders could act and mow down the ordinary wolves like wheat before a farmer's scythe.
'It looks like we might weather this storm after all,' he thought to himself.ɴᴇᴡ ɴᴏᴠᴇʟ ᴄʜᴀᴘᴛᴇʀs ᴀʀᴇ ᴘᴜʙʟɪsʜᴇᴅ ᴏɴ ɴoᴠel Fɪre.nᴇt
However, before Fang Yuan could go and assault the third group of wolves, a group of howls erupted far in the distance.
Fang Yuan was one of the first to spot what was going on from his perch in the air.
"Reinforcements! Enemy reinforcement are arriving!"
The clan head got up from where he was seated. Fang Yuan was right, a large group of wolves was coming towards their village.
"I think there's a Thunder Crown Wolf among them!"
"The Lightning Lycan King might be with them!"
"Damn it, when it looked like things were under control!"
"Where did so many of them come from?"
"The direction that they're coming from... isn't that where the Xiong village is?"
It took the elders a moment to ponder what the implication of that was.
"Could it be... that the Xiong village was completely wiped out?"
That seemed to be the most logical explanation as to why so many wolves were now rushing here, and why they hadn't been here at Gu Yue village before.
But... the idea was difficult for everyone present there to wrap their heads around.
The Xiong clan had lasted for a thousand years! Had they really been annihilated like this?
While they were rivals to the Gu Yue village, it was also true that the village needed them to deal with a portion of the wolf tide.
But there was a bigger concern- the Xiong Clan, despite being the weakest clan, still had some hidden trump cards. An ancestor, or a Rank 5 gu worm that they could use partially... if all of these measures had failed to save them, what would become of Gu Yue village?
"Those useless Xiong Clan idiots! Couldn't they have stalled the wolves for at least some time?"
"They used to scream and beat their chests about how strong they are, hmph, look at them now! Nothing but food in the wolves's gullets!"
Fang Yuan knew there was no point in bleating about and complaining like that. If anything, he needed to deal with these other two wolf groups as soon as he could before the reinforcements could arrive.
However, as he was about to be done with the third group, a wolf larger than even an elephant emerged from the woods.
Thunder Crown Wolf! A Myriad Beast King, which had been lying in wait for a chance to spring!
It roared and a shockwave emerged, moving at Fang Yuan. This was a sound-type attack, though Fang Yuan was able to swerve and duck out of the way. He drifted closer and closer to the Thunder Crown Wolf, whose full attention was upon him.
As it leapt up, Fang Yuan folded his wings once more, allowing himself to plummet down to earth, and then striking the Thunder Crown Wolf at its underside.
It would've been a fatal blow in normal circumstances, but it only cut through about a third of the wolf's abdomen. It clearly had a defensive-type gu worm.
'For this circumstance, something like the Rank 4 version of the Blood Moon Gu would be better,' he thought. However, he had exhausted most of his primeval essence and would be in a bind if he kept fighting like this. 'If only I had the Yellow Golden Relic Gu right now, or someone like Qing Shu to fortify another one of the gates...'
The Thunder Crown Wolf could only gnash its teeth as Fang Yuan made his way back to the village.
"Were you able to get it?"
Fang Yuan shook his head. "It's injured, but it is not dead."
And just then, the words that no one wanted to hear echoed from another part of the battlefied.
"It's here! The Lightning Lycan King is with the reinforcements!"
"So that's why the Xiong clan fell, huh? Because of the strategy of the Lightning Lycan King!"
"Damn it... if that group beat the Xiong clan, how can we fight it off alongside the other wolves we're already dealing with?"
Despair began to creep around the Gu Masters of the Gu Yue clan. The force that was nearly upon them had wiped out one of the three clans of Qing Mao mountain which spoke to its strength. Could they truly stand up against such a foe?
Fang Yuan frowned. How was it that the Xiong clan had failed? This did not line up with his memories, so it would be the butterfly effect taking root. But, he could not recall doing anything that would greatly weaken them.
"All of you, calm your hearts! Naturally, if the reinforcements had to defeat the Xiong clan to get here, they are weakened and exhausted. And we've almost taken care of our side of the fighting as well. We also have two Rank 4 Gu Masters. Commit yourselves to the clan, we will get through this!" the clan head said.
He had gotten up and was ready to head out into battle himself. Although this words were met with cheers from the Gu Yue clansmen, he felt a deep terror within his heart that he could only barely suppress. As the clan head, he had to maintain a brave face, or all chaos would indeed break loose.
He glanced over at Fang Yuan, who was using primeval stones, but his essence would not be replenished in time for the two of them to deal with the Thunder Crown Wolf.
With two Rank 4 enemies on the battlefield, they would likely need to split up to deal with each of them. However, the threat of the Lightning Lycan King dwarfed that of the Thunder Crown Wolf. The natural solution was for both of them to fight the Lightning Lycan King together, but that left them vulnerable from another side.
Needless to say, the situation did not look good.

chapters.title: Chapter 120 - 120: Lightning Lycan King: Part Six
chapters.content:
The Lightning Lycan King was a mutant wolf- it had strong hind legs but its forelegs were about as thin and skinny as that of a human's. Because of this, it jumped around on its hind legs like a kangaroo. If anything, this sight would be in any other circumstance quite funny to watch, but there was nothing amusing about the kind of damage it was dealing.
It was a good thing that Fang Yuan had already weakened the majority of the forces that they were dealing with, otherwise they would be overrun by now for sure. But, even with that in mind, they were just barely hanging on.
"Clan head, we need to kill the Thunder Crown Wolf," Fang Yuan said. Without dealing with it, their hands would be tied when dealing with the Lightning Lycan King. It likely knew that already, which is why it had not committed itself to the fighting fully.
"It isn't at the front lines yet," the clan head said, gritting his teeth. Without that, there was little way for them to get through the massive number of ordinary wolves, Hundred and Thousand Beast Kings that surrounded it.Tʜe source of this ᴄontent ɪs NovᴇlFirenᴇt
This was a hammer-and-anvil tactic, with the Thunder Crown Wolf serving as a stationary threat, ready to leap in the moment the Lightning Lycan King was threatened, with the Lightning Lycan King and its allies slowly whittling down the other end of their defenses.
Slowly but surely, they would end up falling.
Destruction was already spreading through the battlefield.
"Lord Fang Yuan he-" a Gu Master barely got these words out of his mouth before wolf fangs wrapped around his throat, dragging him outside the walls.
Some distance away, Fang Zheng was having trouble dealing with the wolves. Although he had greater primeval essence than one would expect with the Four Flavors Liquor Worm, it was still not enough to keep with the fighting.
In another corner, Li Mei screamed as a wolf nearly gnawed off her leg. She would normally be conscripted to be a logistics Gu Master, but with the recent loss of so many fighters the clan wanted all hands on deck.
Another wolf jumped out at her, and would've succeeded in dragging her away if she had not been saved by a swift moonblade. The wolf that had been struck did not die, speaking to the low power of the moonblade sent, but it had been gravely wounded enough that it turned back.
"Come on!" a familiar voice called out to her. She turned to see Yu Sai offering her a hand, barely pulling her away in time.
Both of them then shot out moonblades to clear the area.
However, the reprieve was short-lived, as there were too many for them to handle.
In a different location, Gu Yue Yao Le was patching up some injured Gu Masters.
"Young Missy, you should get away..." one of the injured warriors said as he limped away. "If you die... what will your grandmother do...?"
"It's no problem," Yao Le said, thumping her chest heroically. "The wolves in this area have been killed. And I couldn't just stand back and watch as... eek!"
From the surrounding tree line, a large figure emerged. The surrounding wolves, were, as a matter of fact indeed dead thanks to the efforts of Fang Yuan and the other elders, but it was not a wolf that had staggered out.
"What's a bear doing here?" Yao Le muttered as the animal roared. It had clearly been starving for quite a while, and upon the sight of a tasty young girl before it, it had already begun salivating.
Had it followed the trail of the wolf pack, hoping to pick up on their remains like a vulture?
It didn't matter what the reason was, as the bear launched itself at Yao Le. What mattered was getting away.
"Grandma, save me!" she shrieked as she ran, all traces of earlier valor completely gone.
Similar situations were occurring all across the battlefield.
So many people in need, yet Fang Yuan, even with his greater strength, could not do much to shift the tide of battle now.
Unless...
His will went into this aperture to find Charity Gu. He was now a Human Path Master, and had some understanding of what this gu worm did.
Since he couldn't be everywhere, and the tide of battle had changed like this, there was only one option to go forward with- he would need to activate it and see if it truly worked the way his instincts told him.
He activated Charity Gu, and at the same time, activated Moonlight Plate Armor Gu.
What was Charity Gu's effect? It was to share the beneficial effects of other gu worms upon the user to other people. It could not share the power of offensive gu worms, but it could share the power of other effects with others.
As for the range of effect, Fang Yuan was unsure of that, or the extent of the effect shared. His instinctual knowledge could only go so far at the Master level.
The effect was instantaneous- as for range, everyone in Gu Yue village was now cloaked in an aura of blue plate armor.
"Aieeee!" Yao Le screamed as the bear swiped at her, only to break its forepaw, and then its teeth as it couldn't get through the effect of the defensive gu worm. She was then able to get out of the way as it turned tail to nurse its injuries.
A wolf launched itself at Yu Sai and Li Mei, but similarly met with a sad fate.
A Hundred Beast King launched an attack at a Rank 2 Gu Master, only for it to do nothing.
All around the village, people suddenly found that the enemy attacks were doing little to them as they had some strange blue force protecting them. As if they were using a gu worm, but it did not take any of their primeval essence.
This effect was more than enough to change the flow of battle. Hundred Beast Kings were beaten back, holes in the wall were repaired, and even another Thousand Beast King met its end as an elder killed it with ease.
'What kind of effect is this!?' Fang Yuan screamed within his mind. 'Isn't heaven supposed to be fair and balanced? This is one of the most unbalanced gu worms I've ever laid my hands on!'
This effect and its range was phenomenal. The Gu Yue village could easily conquer the other two villages if it had this gu worm. There were many righteous and even demonic sects which would kill to have this kind of gu worm. To be able to give an army the defensive power of a Rank 4 gu worm- it was incredible! This was not just giving his gu worm's effect to other people, but actually amplifying it over the entire army!
Furthermore, Fang Yuan found that his primeval essence was depleting steadily from use of Moonlight Plate Armor Gu. Even if the other people were attacked, it didn't take away anything other than a steady supply of primeval essence from him. Granted, this defense could be broken, but he wouldn't have to endure the backlash in that case.
Then again, upon further reflection, perhaps this was heaven's way of balancing it out. After all, who better to give it to than Fang Yuan, who would be the least likely to ever use it.
He then had an idea and activated Doctor Gu as well, casting a healing effect on himself.
This also resonated throughout the battlefield. Doctor Gu's healing ability was phenomenal. A Gu Master who had lost his hand found it regrowing, another whose abdomen had been opened by a wolf claw found it closing up on its own, and the medicine hall found that the patients waiting had been somehow fixed all on their own.
By this point, Fang Yuan's primeval essence had run out. To maintain the Rank 5 Charity Gu for so long was not easy with Rank 4 primeval essence, though its primeval essence expenditure was surprisingly low. He had made a mistake advancing it to Rank 5 so fast- it increased its activation cost, but he was only using it with a Rank 4 and Rank 3 gu worm, so it did not need to be Rank 5.
Then again, its range might've been limited in that case if it was still Rank 4.
Mission Successful!
Saved Gu Yue Yao Le from the bear.
Yellow Gold Relic Gu (x 1) has been added to your inventory!

chapters.title: Chapter 121 - 121: Lightning Lycan King: Part Seven
chapters.content:
Fang Yuan did not hesitate to use the Yellow Golden Relic Gu. He couldn't afford to hold back anymore, not in this kind of fight.
"Fang Yuan," the clan head said to him. "There is an opening in the fighting near the Thunder Crown Wolf. We should go take care of it."
Fang Yuan nodded and both of them used movement gu worms to head towards the Thunder Crown Wolf.
"What was that earlier?"
"My injuries just healed!"
"I had some kind of weird armor on me!"
"It was like I couldn't be hurt! I felt like I was invincible for a few seconds!"
"Have the gods sent a miracle to save us?"
"It had to be, what else could have saved us?"
"I don't know of any gu worm that can do such a thing..."
"If only they had acted earlier, my younger sister might still be alive then..."
Fang Yuan continued to move, aware of the talk going around the village. It seemed that Charity Gu left no traces of its action, but that was to be expected. Charity was best if it was done in private, away from prying eyes. People who flaunted giving money and the like to the poor did it for their own reputation, not for genuine aide.
Then again, perhaps there was a way to deduce when Charity Gu was being used. After all, no gu worm was invincible.
Fang Yuan continued to replenish his primeval essence with primeval stones even as they moved. Now that his essence had essentially doubled, this was something that was actually possible. There was a reason that even a minor realm could greatly affect the outcome of battle at this level.
The Thunder Crown Wolf howled in defiance. Its wound that Fang Yuan had dealt earlier had almost completely healed, either by its own healing gu worm or from one of its minions.
The clan head moved the left. He had a movement gu worm that was similar to Ten Steps Fragrant Grass Gu, the Fifty Steps Fragrant Grass Gu which allowed him to strike out at the beast from its blind spot.
Fang Yuan took advantage of this opportunity to soar into the sky. Its gaze turned towards Fang Yuan, hatred etched into its eyes as it glared at the person who had dealt it such a blow earlier. Not only that, but naturally it would be more concerned with the flying enemy before it.
A frosty moonblade struck its hindquarters from the clan head, immobilizing it to some extent. This was the side effect of the Tundra Moon Gu, an upgraded version of Frost Moon Gu.
The Thunder Crown Wolf howled, only to take another blow from Fang Yuan. When it looked like it was going for the clan head, he backed away with the help of Fifty Steps Fragrant Grass Gu.
A gu worm on its back jumped up and it let out another soundwave, though Fang Yuan swerved out of its way to chop its right foreleg off.
Whatever defensive gu worm that it had seemed to have its effect weakened so that it could not longer be used. Two moonblades to its neck decapitated it.
"Rank 4 Middle Stage..." the clan head muttered, noticing Fang Yuan's increasingly powerful moonblades and the aura of the more condense primeval essence he was using. "Fang Yuan, you went up a cultivation rank in the middle of battle...?"
Fang Yuan was prepared to bluff his way out of this situation using only his strength, but to his surprise, the clan head had a strange look of... pity on his face. Like he was visiting a close friend who had a terrible illness. "Fang Yuan... I understand why you might've thought that you needed to keep this hidden. However... we can still find a solution... whatever, we will talk after this fight is over."
Fang Yuan was as confused as ever. He wished he had some kind of Wisdom Path gu worm or the like with him, or something that could give him the slightest bit of inspiration regarding what the clan head thought was going on.
Some distance away, the Lightning Lycan King howled. It had noticed the loss of the Thunder Crown Wolf, and was not going for an all-out offense to see if it could breach through the walls of the village in one go.Follow current novels on No(ᴠ)ᴇlFire.nᴇt
Fang Yuan began replenishing his primeval essence. The ones manning the wall would just need to hold for now.
Once he was done, he leapt up to the sky, spreading his wings and going towards the Lightning Lycan King. It had noticed Fang Yuan, and let out a bolt of lightning which passed harmlessly over his head. Despite having a direct line of sight to target, Fang Yuan was incredibly difficult to hit.
It yelped out, hopping back on its hind legs as Fang Yuan came within range to launch a moonblade at it.
The next few moments of the fight involved Fang Yuan flitting around its head like a mosquito, with the Lightning Lycan King being able to do nothing to counter. At least, nothing that was actually able to strike Fang Yuan.
By this point, the clan head had also managed to catch up, and when it saw two enemies, the Lightning Lycan King decided to cut its losses and retreat.
It howled, demanding its subordinates for a wall of flesh and bone around it, but it was too late by this point. The elders had also joined in, paving a way for the clan head. Perhaps it could have gotten away using a movement-type gu worm, but unfortunately for it, Fang Yuan was hot on its tail.
When two moonblades crashed into its back, it howled, and then a dark object emerged from its mouth.
Wolf Smoke Gu!
Once this collided with the ground, the surrounding area in the distance of one li was covered in smoke entirely. It was so dense that one couldn't see one's hand in front of one's face. Granted, the Lightning Lycan King's vision was likely also obstructed to some extent, but it had resorted to this desperate ploy in order to save its life. It had hoped that in the resulting chaos it might be able to escape.
Unfortunately, it would not work against Fang Yuan. His Pit Viper Gu made the Lightning Lycan King stand out even among the black clouds.
It had clearly not been expecting to be hit by three moonblades in quick succession, one of which was nearly successful in bisecting it. Its two halves were connected simply by a short string of intestines- it was on its last legs.
The elders and the clan head were scrambling. Without a doubt they had their own investigative methods, though nothing that could deal with the fog in its entirety. Nor did they seem confident enough in attacking without hitting Fang Yuan in the meantime, and so, no help would be coming from their end for now.
Not that Fang Yuan intended to rely upon them in the first place.
Fang Yuan did not bother with primeval essence for the last blow. He had had an incredible increase in strength, and used it to tear the remains of the Lightning Lycan King in half.
Mission successful!
Lightning Lycan King killed.
Rank 4 Stone Aperture Gu (x 1) has been added to your inventory!

chapters.title: Chapter 122 - 122: Blood River Graveyard: Part One
chapters.content:
Stone Aperture Gu...
It had the effect of taking one's cultivation to the peak of that rank. If Fang Yuan used it right now, he would become a Rank 4 Peak Stage Gu Master instantly!
Of course, it had its own drawback. Once used, one's aperture would no longer be a crystal walled aperture but be made of stone, making further progress impossible. It could grant great strength, but this strength came at a massive price. No one would use it unless they had no resort.
Bai Ning Bing had dropped the Rank 3 version of the gu worm back when fleeing from Fang Yuan. He had likely intended to use it to limit the explosive power of his Northern Dark Ice Soul Physique.
Fang Yuan could use it in another way, however. The stone walls of a Rank 4 Peak Stage aperture could withstand the aura of a Rank 6 Spring Autumn Cicada for some time. He had initially been planning to only retrieve it once he reached Rank 5, which could also somewhat withstand its immortal aura, but this was another viable option.
'If I use this, I could withdraw the Spring Autumn Cicada and use it, going back in time,' Fang Yuan thought. With that, he would be freed from the need to continue squatting on Qing Mao mountain.
Although this pathway had opened up to him, Fang Yuan did not immediately take it. One reason was that Fang Zheng, and therefore, a pathway to a Rank 6 Immortal Gu was still on the mountain. The second was that for now, the immediate danger that he had been in previously was gone. The wolf tide was quelled with two of the Rank 4 beasts killed, and the Bai clan having killed another Thunder Crown Wolf.
That meant that there was only one Thunder Crown Wolf left, and with the huge losses to the wolves, they would likely simply retreat and lick their wounds, waiting for their numbers to increase once again in a few years. Then, this cycle would repeat itself.
The clan knew where the wolves were housed, but they could not try to go out and strike at them to tear out the problem from the root. Why? Because they lacked the strength to do so. The wolves were too plentiful in number in their own territory, and by Fang Yuan's estimation only a Rank 6 Gu Master could actually be successful in taking them down. He felt that even the peak of Rank 5 might fall short of being able to wipe out every single one of the wolves left, even if one killed most of them.
As for the danger that was posed from the clan because of his rapid rise in cultivation, that seemed to have never been there in the first place. For whatever reason, the clan leader was keeping the older clan elders in check.
If he used the Spring Autumn Cicada, who knows how far back in time he'd go or to when? As it was, the Spring Autumn Cicada was more useful the further in time one used it.
It was a joyous celebration for the village, as the major threat had been eliminated with the death of the Lightning Lycan King.
Li Mei and Yu Sai wandered through the rubble, arm in arm. Yu Sai had happened to chance upon Li Mei when she needed help, but had ended up saving her. She, like the rest of the village, didn't know why she had suddenly been protected at the last minute, but she wouldn't have even survived that long had it not been for Yu Sai.
"You're so cool!" she said to Yu Sai.
Yu Sai shrugged. He already knew that Li Mei had a massive crush on Fang Yuan, so he wasn't about to get his hopes up.
That said, it certainly felt good to be wandering around the village, with a girl in arm. It made him feel less like a loser.
Made him almost feel like he should be doing more with his life. Who knows? If he put his mind to it, he could definitely become Rank 1 Peak Stage, maybe even Rank 2 Stage. Were that to happen, he might have an actual woman wrapped around his arm.
Fang Zheng, meanwhile, was examining the wreckage where their apartments used to be. Now they were no longer as reliant upon the income from the apartments as they were earlier, but it still left a bitter taste in his mouth to see that they had been destroyed in spite of Fang Yuan's efforts.
'Oh well, the important thing is that we all survived,' he mused. 'So long as we survived, we can rebuild.'
They still owned the land that the buildings had been built upon, and given how land was at a premium in the village, that meant that by itself was worth quite a lot.
A massive surprise came the next morning when, out of the ether, it seemed that the Xiong clan had reappeared.
It took some time to piece together what had happened, but it turned out that they had a Rank 5 gu worm left behind by one of their ancestors which was able to deceive the Lightning Lycan King. The Lightning Lycan King had not attacked Gu Yue village first as expected, but had instead chosen to target the weakest of the three villages to eliminate it, gather its forces, and then strike at the others.
That plan might've even succeeded were it not for Fang Yuan's help.
Naturally though, the other two clans had very low opinions of the Xiong clan.
"To think they hid like scared rabbits while we were fighting for our lives!"
"Hmph! I'm sure that their spirit spring is unguarded now and hehe... they only have about half of their members left. Seems like an excellent opportunity to expand our territory..."
"No doubt they thought they could take over our village if we were killed. It only serves them right!"
Ultimately, the Gu Yue clan decided to place pressure upon the Xiong clan, forcing them into an alliance against the Bai clan. When faced with the prospect of facing a clan with two Rank 4 Gu Masters, the Xiong clan had little choice but to play along.
However, that was a matter for the future.
Right now, the clan head had a matter to discuss with Fang Yuan.Tʜe source of this ᴄontent ɪs NovᴇlFɪre.nᴇt
"Fang Yuan, I want to let you know that I'm extremely proud of what you've accomplished," the clan head said. "Ever since you entered the academy, no, even before, you have been one of the most illustrious clan members in all of its history. Your name is worthy of being remembered for generations because of your accomplishments up till now alone. I... I think of you almost as if you are my own son, Fang Yuan."
Fang Yuan bowed his head. The two of them had come to a secluded place for this talk, so there was clearly more to it. "Ever since my parents died, I will not lie, clan head, I have always longed for the warmth of family. And now that I have been embraced by my village, I think I have indeed found it. For I see every member of Gu Yue village as being part of my family."
The clan head nodded. "That is good, Fang Yuan. And that is why I wanted to ask why you were keeping this secret within yourself for so long?"
Fang Yuan paused. "I don't follow...?"
The clan head sighed. "When I first became clan head, I got to know that our clan has a secret. A prophecy made by our first generation clan head, our founder. That one day, within the clan, someone would appear with the Desolate Yin Ancient Moon Physique. I just didn't think that the day would come during my lifetime..."
The gears in Fang Yuan's head turned as the pieces fell into place. So that was why the clan head was behaving like so instead of torturing him for where Fang Yuan had found an immortal inheritance - because the clan head thought that Fang Yuan had the Desolate Yin Ancient Moon Physique!
Fang Yuan had never heard of this clan legend before in his previous life, which is why he had been unable to guess it.

chapters.title: Chapter 123 - 123: Blood River Graveyard: Part Two
chapters.content:
"Not many people know about this legend, of course," the clan head said. "I think only two elders know of it in the case that I pass away before I can pass it down. I thought that you might be the one the prophecy foretold of some time ago when I heard you had become an elder, but my suspicions were confirmed when I heard you had become Rank 4."
Fang Yuan nodded. This... was perfect! He could easily avoid scrutiny if there was this kind of preexisting legend going around the village until he was Rank 5, by which time it would no longer matter whether anyone believed him or not.
"I understand why you suppressed your own cultivation using that gu worm earlier as well," the clan head said. "Because the further you advance, the more likely it is that you will detonate. However, there is a second part to the legend as well. As the prophecy foretold, it is said that once someone with this physique is found, they should go to the Blood River Graveyard which is located beneath our clan's spirit spring. There, our clan founder has left a way to mitigate the negative effects of the Ancient Yin Desolate Moon Physique."
The clan head had a gentle smile, but Fang Yuan's mind was racing. While it was one thing to pretend to have the Ancient Yin Desolate Moon Physique, if there indeed was something that could 'solve' a problem that he did not have, he might get into trouble.
"I... am not in any danger of detonating right now," Fang Yuan said. "We can hold this issue off for now..."
The clan head sighed. "So be it if you wish, Fang Yuan, but the time will come when we have to descend. I hope you come with me before it is too late. I know you might not understand the danger of the detonation of the physiques, but it is nothing to scoff at. The entire mountain may very well crumble!"
The clan head didn't know that Bai Ning Bing's detonation had caused the death of everyone on the mountain back in Fang Yuan's previous life. Had someone with the Ancient Yin Desolate Moon Physique been discovered before then? Fang Yuan did not know- he had left the clan shortly after the wolf tide had been dealt with. There was still some time in between when someone like that could pop up, as a matter of fact, were that the case that person could currently be a teenager right now.
For Fang Yuan though, such a smokescreen was greatly welcome for the time being. He only needed to focus on cultivating now, with a 78% aptitude, he had a good chance of reaching Rank 5. The 'breakpoint' for the same was 80%, but with an abundance of primeval stones, it was more than doable.
What Fang Yuan did not know, however, was that the clan head was already taking a stroll down to the Blood River Graveyard right now himself.
If there was a method to save Fang Yuan, he wished to know it. If it required Fang Yuan's presence, then so be it.
But he needed to know the secret regardless...
The Blood River Graveyard was a peculiar place, being located beneath the clan's spirit spring. Blood from the mountain collected there as if drawn by some magnetic force.
Nearby, the clan head could see the Rank 5 Blood River Python Gu. It had been refined by the first generation ancestor, and he knew that it would not hurt him. Not unless it was provoked.
The Blood River Graveyard drained into a large lake which was filled with blood that had been drawn from everywhere in the mountain. Strangely enough it did not clot no matter how much blood there was, but was instead being used to feed various gu worms.
"Ancestor..." the clan head said, walking over a small pathway that was barely wide enough for one person to walk upon. This pathway led to a coffin. The clan head already knew what was inside the coffin, if rumors were to be believed, but he had also been told by the prior clan head to never come down here until the promised time had come. "...the current clan head greets you!"
There was no answer for over a minute, and as the clan head's heart began to race, the coffin lid opened by just the tiniest crack.
A zombified hand reached out, and a monstrous form walked out of the coffin.
Rank 5 Blood Wight Zombie!
It was a zombie created from Rank 5 Blood Wight Gu. By using this gu, one could temporarily transform oneself into a Blood Wight Zombie, which was capable of flight and possessed great strength.
If one used it for too long, much like with the Wood Charm Gu, they ran the risk of transforming into a zombie permanently.
It was clear though that this person had used this effect on purpose. By becoming a zombie, one could theoretically live indefinitely without suffering from the ravages of time. It had its drawbacks, the greatest of which was that one's aperture would become dead and unable to generate primeval essence on its own.
'So the rumors were true, first gen Gu Yue is still alive,' the clan head thought. "Descendant greets his ancestor!"
First gen Gu Yue had a terrifying expression, as one would expect of a monstrosity that was not accepted by either heaven or earth. "You have disturbed my slumber..."
"Descendant apologizes, but there is good reason for the same," the clan head said. First gen Gu Yue did not say anything, but seemed to be waiting for a response. He had been approached by the prior clan heads in the past, usually when the clan was in danger. Depending on his mood, First gen Gu Yue might help. The survival of the clan was necessary for his own plan, after all. "I believe that we have found the one who bears the Ancient Yin Desolate Moon Physique..."
First gen Gu Yue's eyes widened. "Could it be? The time has finally come- after a millennium of waiting... where is this person?"
"They... they did not wish to come down here right now..." the clan head said. "But I fear for their ultimate safety. I heard there was a way to deal with the problem of the physique, so I came down here..."
"Hmm... there is a way, yes," first gen Gu Yue said. "But it requires me to personally meet with this individual."
"Then I will bring him to you next time!"
First gen Gu Yue shook his head. "It looks like there's no need given what's going on up there..."
"I don't follow...?"New ɴᴏᴠᴇʟ ᴄhapters are published on NovᴇlFirᴇ.ɴet
All of a sudden, a man's voice echoed throughout the mountain. "Senior brother, junior brother is finally here to meet with you! Won't you come out and greet your junior, ehehe..."
The voice was unknown to the clan head, but first gen Gu Yue had heard it many times before. 'To think that he found me here... Lord Sky Crane, you truly are far too tenacious for your own good...'

chapters.title: Chapter 124 - 124: Blood River Graveyard: Part Three
chapters.content:
Earlier that day...
A few members of each clan had gathered near a clearing to discuss future business. The Gu Yue clan was placing great pressure on the Bai clan, to the point that they had even roped in the Xiong clan successfully in this endeavour.
From the Bai clan, other than the clan head, Bai Ning Bing was the only one with any real fighting spirit. The others had already felt that they were going to be trampled on by the other clans, but Bai Ning Bing did not care.
'The sunrise over the mountains is truly beautiful...' he mused.
Fighting so desperately with Fang Yuan had broken all of the seals placed on the Northern Dark Ice Soul Physique, and he could feel death at his aperture's door.
Today would likely be the final day of his existence...
He turned to the other Gu Masters squabbling over things like rights, territory, primeval stones, etc.
All so tedious and boring. The only one who interested him was Gu Yue Fang Yuan, and he was not present here.
"Are all of you idiots done yapping?" Bai Ning Bing asked, interrupting the gathering.
"Bai Ning Bing you...!"
"Can't you see the grown-ups are talking?"
Bai Ning Bing snorted and beheaded a Xiong clansmen.
"Why you!?"
"Bai Ning Bing, we were negotiating with each other under a flag of truce. How dare you strike one of our clansmen!"
"Bai Ning Bing, your death anniversary will be one year from now!"
"Bai Ning Bing killed my cousin, let me take revenge for that day today!"
"Gather around and strike him with all that you have, he can't fight all of us at once!"
'Finally, a grand death,' Bai Ning Bing thought, preparing himself for one last, glorious battle.
That is until there was a scream from some distance away.
The fighting paused then- Bai Ning Bing had not even made a move, and yet someone was dead, their body having been pierced by the beak of a crane.
"A crane?"
"Where did that come from?"
Large cranes were a beast that existed in this world, however, they were not native to Qing Mao mountain. As a matter of fact, they were not seen in many places in the Southern Border.Tʜe source of this ᴄontent ɪs No(ᴠ)ᴇlFire.nᴇt
Before they could consider this matter further, another one dropped from the sky. A Xiong clansmen tore it in half with his strength, only for a dozen more to descend.
"So many cranes?"
Thinking this was just an aberration of sorts, they began fighting.
Only the number of cranes did not stop.
Thousand beast king!
Even a myriad beast king!
"Why are there so many, and why so strong?"
The clouds overhead parted, to reveal the sight of nearly ten thousand cranes.
"This isn't just some kind of migration, someone is controlling these cranes!"
"An enslavement Gu Master? Why would-"
The Gu Master in question got no further as they were killed.
Soon, the fighting with Bai Ning Bing was forgotten entirely as the Gu Masters began scrambling for their lives.
'I suppose this is as good a death as any!' Bai Ning Bing thought, taking down several cranes in a whirlwind of ice.
Above the clouds, a Rank 5 Gu Master was riding an Iron Beak Flying Crane King- a myriad beast king which could command ten thousand cranes with ease.
This Rank 5 Gu Master was Lord Sky Crane- and there was a good reason that the villagers below had not expected to be attacked by an army of cranes. These cranes had come all the way from the Central Continent, far away from the Southern Border.
He was a member of the Immortal Crane Sect, and he had a singular purpose for coming all this distance to this place.
"Senior brother... are you really hidden here...?" he wondered.
The man who called himself the first gen Gu Yue used to be a compatriot of his, until he betrayed him and stole an extremely valuable gu worm from the man.
