He had harbored a grudge for a long time, but had been unable to find his enemy. Naturally first gen Gu Yue had not stayed around after stealing from him, and had migrated elsewhere while changing his name and altering his identity.
The world was massive- any of the regions was several times the size of earth. Lord Sky Crane had no real hope of finding first gen Gu Yue and could only harbor the resentment in his heart, preserving his lifespan through means other than Lifespan Gu in the vain hope that he would find an answer one day.
That is to say, it was a vain hope- until he had been awakened from his slumber as news had reached him that someone in the Heavenly Lotus Sect had found a clue to the thief who had stolen his inheritance.
The Heavenly Lotus Sect was another one of the Ten Great Sects of the Central Continent and had been founded by Genesis Lotus Immortal Venerable. Lord Sky Crane had had basically no contact with them other than some inter-sect competitions, so the fact that they of all the sects had information on the thief who had stolen what was rightfully his greatly surprised him.
To deepen the mystery further, they had only asked for a sum of primeval stones for the information. If they had truly known what first gen Gu Yue had stolen, they would've undoubtedly asked for a portion of the inheritance. So, it could only be inferred that they were ignorant of the matter, but how did they know where to find the thief in the first place?
No further information could be pried from them, and as it was, Lord Sky Crane's lifespan was coming to an end despite all of the measures he had undertaken. Being a member of the Ten Great Sects, he did not have the option to become a zombie like first gen Gu Yue did.
It was a pity that he was so close to death- that was why he had to come here in such a hurry. Otherwise he could've arranged for some valuable pawns in the Southern Border- either the Shang clan or the Tie clan would be possible candidates for people he could work with.
But he did not have time, and did not trust anyone else in his sect. As it was he had been betrayed once already, and betrayal was so terrible particularly because it came from someone you trusted.
He had been somewhat skeptical of the information that the Heavenly Lotus Sect gave him given they just gave him a location and no other information on how they had deduced the same, but it looks like they were correct.
He took out a gu worm which looked like a cicada dipped in blood, although its body was translucent given it a very odd appearance indeed. It was emanating a faint light- he had refined this gu worm after killing both of first gen Gu Yue's children. Since they had been so young, not even seven years old, he had not gotten enough blood to refine this gu, turning them both into living sources of blood which he farmed for decades to refine the Rank 5 gu worm. They died soon thereafter, but a Rank 5 gu worm's detection ability was naturally limited.
Right now though, it was vibrating and letting out a loud noise.
Without a doubt, he had managed to finally find him!
Before that though, he would do good to kill as many of the Gu Yue descendants that he could. As for the other two clans on the mountain- they could all go to hell for what he cared. It was better to get rid of them as well.
Ultimately, he was a righteous path cultivator. Best to leave no witnesses.

chapters.title: Chapter 125 - 125: Blood River Graveyard: Part Four
chapters.content:
The cranes assaulted the Gu Masters down below, herding them towards the peak of the mountain where Gu Yue village stood.
The Gu Masters of Gu Yue village quickly encountered the cranes as well, dying in large numbers, being scattered like leaves before the wind.
At least, that was what Lord Sky Crane imagined in his head would happen.ᴛhis ᴜpdated by
While that was how the battle started out, there was a shift sometime later.
For some reason, his cranes were unable to damage the Gu Masters down below. He didn't know what the cause was, but even the Rank 1 Gu Masters seemed to have some kind of defense that made them immune even to the strikes of Thousand Beast Kings.
"What kind of defensive gu worm is this...?" Lord Sky Crane muttered. Contrary to his expectations, he found that the villagers were actually turning the tide, slaughtering many of his cranes. He would need to dedicate more of his forces to this assault if he wanted it to succeed. "Is this some kind of Blood Path defensive method?"
That was not an issue, but he still had to keep in mind that he would have to deal with first gen Gu Yue afterwards. If he was weakened before that fight even started... that very well might have been that traitor's plan in the first place!
He sent a Myriad Beast King to descend and deal with the annoying villagers. As it was, it seemed that at this level, the villagers were susceptible to its attacks.
His pupils dilated, however, when he saw that the crane was intercepted mid-flight by a Gu Master with wings. This Gu Master demonstrated an excellent proficiency while flying, first breaking the crane's wings so that its mobility was limited, and then striking it down after it fell to the ground.
"What kind of flying proficiency is this...?" he muttered. Even among the Ten Great Sects, there were only four mortal Gu Masters who could fly like that. No wonder his Myriad Beast King had been defeated, this Gu Master could maneuver better than an animal that was naturally trained its entire life to fly.
Fang Yuan glanced up at the Iron Beak Flying Crane King. He recognized it as a beast from the Central Continent.
'As a matter of fact, the Gu Master controlling these cranes most likely belongs to the Immortal Crane Sect. But why come here? This never happened in my previous life, unless it had been covered up somehow,' Fang Yuan thought. How strange for a Rank 5 Gu Master to come out of his way to try to destroy Gu Yue village, especially given that this Gu Master was supposedly from the Central Continent. Had he gotten a whiff of the Immortal Inheritance located at the foot of the mountain? That was the only reasonable explanation he could think of, but that would not explain how this person had found out about it. The person had also not made any demands and only started slaughtering villagers ruthlessly left and right.
Activating Charity Gu was taking a major toll even with his now Rank 4 Middle Stage primeval essence. He could try decreasing the amount he poured into the gu worm but.... that would also decrease its effectiveness.
Unless...
'System, those Human Path dao marks I have saved up, give them to me now,' Fang Yuan thought.
Done!
262 Human Path dao marks are now inscribed upon the host's body.
That was how much he had accumulated after all of this time, roughly equivalent to what one would gain after undergoing an earthly calamity. This would boost the power of his Human Path gu worms by around 26%, and its effect was seen immediately in the increased power of Charity Gu's range and decreased need for primeval essence.
'Strange... the other gu worms don't seem to be affected...' Fang Yuan mused, killing a Thousand Beast King with a single golden moonblade. 'So Genesis Lotus was not lying about that... these dao marks do not interfere with other path's gu worms...'
Secret mission complete!
Favored Child of Humanity I
Description: Get 100 Human Path dao marks.
Reward: A set of dream realms.
Would the host like to explore this dream realm right now?
'In the middle of battle? Of course not!' Fang Yuan said. So there was a reward for getting more Human Path dao marks... was this why he had gotten Guts Gu so often from his daily rewards.
Secret mission complete!
Favored Child of Humanity II
Description: Get 200 Human Path dao marks.
Reward: Rank 5 Integration Gu (x 1)
He didn't have time to try out what Integration Gu did given the current situation.
Another Myriad Beast King descended upon him. This was not good... the village had barely been able to take down two equivalents of the same, and this one was controlled by a Gu Master.
His primeval essence was on the decline, and his ability to fly masterfully was useless without primeval essence.
However, he did not need to do anything for the moment as a massive ice fist collided into Myriad Beast King. It did not kill it, but did disrupt its movement and broke one of its wings, exposing a vulnerable neck for a moonblade to dig into.
While the cranes did have the advantage of flight when it came to combat, they also had the weakness of their wings- they would plummet down and their movement greatly hampered if their wings were injured.
Who had the strength other than Fang Yuan to seriously damage a Myriad Beast King? He turned his head to see a figure nearly encased in a thick layer of icy mist.
"Bai Ning Bing...?"
"Fang Yuan, what a wonderful day to die, isn't it?" Bai Ning Bing mused. The fighting had caused his aperture to deteriorate with even greater vigor. He was on his last legs, and Fang Yuan knew this, having no wish to be within a hundred li of Bai Ning Bing when that happened. However, knowing the latter's nature, he did not express such.
"That's right, Bai Ning Bing," Fang Yuan said, grinning. "Today is a wonderful day to die. How about we fight to the death, here and now?" If he had openly asked Bai Ning Bing for cooperation, there was no way that they could reach an agreement. It was only this way that there was a hope of success.
"I would love for nothing else!" Bai Ning Bing said. "However... I think that these pesky birds need to be dealt with first!" He leapt out of the way of another Myriad Beast King, nearly cutting its head off before Fang Yuan finished it.
"I don't have time for this," Lord Sky Crane muttered, gritting his teeth. He amplified his voice over the battlefield. "Senior brother, junior brother is finally here to meet with you! Won't you come out and greet your junior, ehehe..."

chapters.title: Chapter 126 - 126: Blood River Graveyard: Part Five
chapters.content:
From the center of a village square in Gu Yue village, a fountain of blood suddenly burst forth as a coffin emerged from the earth. Beside it was the current clan head, who was stupefied seeing the destruction that was occurring around the village.
They had only recently defeated the wolf tide- yet the damage done now seemed to be many folds greater than that caused by the wolves. What had happened?
Even with Fang Yuan's help using Charity Gu, the villagers could not last for that long against a Rank 5 Peak Stage expert like Lord Sky Crane. Especially with Fang Yuan's limited primeval essence.
The coffin opened up and a Blood Wight Zombie walked out. "So... junior brother, you finally found me."
Lord Sky Crane halted his assault on the other villagers to focus on the Blood Wight Zombie. "Traitor... thief... you finally showed your face?"
"Since when was I hiding?" First gen Gu Yue responded. "I see that it's you who seems to be finding fun in tormenting the weak."
"Hmph! Big talk coming from a liar who was hiding from me for over a thousand years..."
"Hmm... on that matter, how did you find me, junior?"
"You can thank the Heavenly Lotus Sect for that. They seem to have as much of a grudge against you as I do..."
First gen Gu Yue paused for a second. The Heavenly Lotus Sect? He could not recall having ever done anything to directly offend them, nor for a reason for them to seek him out. Could Lord Sky Crane be lying? It was entirely plausible. "And yet, despite all this help you are so surprisingly lonely junior..."
Many of the villagers were confused- a zombie had suddenly appeared out of the earth, and they were being attacked by cranes all of a sudden. The clan head moved around to inform them, "Everyone! This is our first generation ancestor- he's been sleeping underground for all this time and waiting to help us out. That Gu Master is an enemy of his and so is an enemy of our clan's! We must unite to defeat him..."
"That's right! We should unite and help our ancestor!"
"Wait- could it be that ancestor was the one who saved us during the wolf tide and right now?"
"You mean that he is the source of the strange power that healed us and protected us?"
"Who else could pull off that miracle other than another Rank 5 Gu Master?"
"That's right! It had to be our ancestor protecting us!"
First gen Gu Yue frowned- he didn't know what these villagers were going on about, but he welcomed their support. Since he was a zombie, his strength was inferior to that of a living Gu Master's simply because he could not regain any primeval essence on his own. Not to mention he was outnumbered without the villagers given the fact that Lord Sky Crane could rely on his flock of cranes to fight as well.
"Your descendants have so much hope and faith in you..." Lord Sky Crane said. "If only they knew of your wicked deeds in the past."
"Liar! You're only trying to defame ancestor!"
"Indeed, he's just trying to sow discord between us and ancestor!"
Lord Sky Crane snarled. "Liar! Me!? This man over there was my most trusted compatriot at one point. We were known as the Righteous Twin Cranes back in our day, for the way that we attacked and defeated many demonic path cultivators. Until one day we found an inheritance that belonged to Blood Sea Ancestor... and I emerged victorious as the inheritor. But that could not lie well with you, did it, thief? You stole it! You stole what was rightfully mine! MINE! The screams of your two sons while I tormented them were like lullabies that sang me to sleep every night, but nothing could truly quell the hatred that I had burning within my heart! And now, traitor, you will meet your end!"
First gen Gu Yue coldly snorted. "Traitor? Thief? What are those but words flung around by those who wish to keep those beneath them weak? Despite both of us being orphans, who was the favored one between the two of us? Who got an extra portion of meat during dinner? Who did Master treat with greater care? It was you! Why? Because I was only a C-grade talent, while you were A-grade. Because of this difference, despite the fact that I was elder than you, I had to scrape and claw my way to the top with countless difficulties. But heaven was not content with just giving you greater talent, it was by pure luck that you managed to defeat me when it came to the Blood Sea Inheritance. Not only did you have greater talent, but heaven also blessed you with such a valuable inheritance on top of that. What happened to heaven being fair and balanced? Oh, how my blood boiled when I got to know that- it was heaven's final insult to me! I, who had always lived in your shadow, would now be eclipsed by the grandeur you would achieve when you ascended to become an Immortal!"
There was a strange tone to his voice now, as if first gen Gu Yue was almost weeping. Combined with his monstrous form and appearance, it looked quite disturbing indeed.
"And so, it was then that I decided," First gen Gu Yue continued. "If heaven would continue to suppress me, if I had no chance of moving up in the world so long as I stuck with the rules, than the rules would be broken. I would become a demon- hated by both heaven and earth, if that was the only path forward open to me. If the heavens wish to suppress me, then I shall seal the heavens!"
Lord Sky Crane had an ugly expression on his face. "So to patch up your inadequacy, you resorted to petty thievery. Gaze upon your visage- one that not even a mother could love. I'd say that it is a tragedy that you look like you do right now, senior brother, but it seems you are finally as ugly on the outside as you are on the inside. Your flesh is as corrupted as your soul. Spiteful, filled with hate, a demon whom both heaven and earth would shun. You should've died quietly somewhere where I couldn't see you before you coveted what was rightfully mine. But it matters not, I'm quite overjoyed to know that you're still... alive in some way. Else how would I be able to calm my heart other than by taking your head?"
"It's too late to stop me now, not when my plan is so close to fruition..." First gen Gu Yue said. His eyes then turned to Fang Yuan, the only other Rank 4 Gu Master there other than the clan head. "That is the boy? The one who has the Ancient Yin Desolate Moon Physique?"
"Yes-" the clan head barely got these words out when first gen Gu Yue launched himself at Fang Yuan.
Fang Yuan's pupils dilated. The Blood Wight Zombie was an excellent flyer with top-notch speed. If he had been just the slightest bit slower to react, or had not had such battle experience as he did, he would've met his end at the Blood Wight's claws.
Instead, first gen Gu Yue only managed to scratch Fang Yuan, droplets of blood hanging like rubies from each of his fingers.Follow current novels on ɴo(v)elFɪre.ɴet
"Wait..." first gen Gu Yue said, licking a drop of Fang Yuan's blood. His expression became extremely contorted as he now sounded furious, turning towards the clan head. "You! You said that he had the Ancient Yin Desolate Moon Physique! You mislead me!"
"What? No," the clan head said. "Ancestor, this one would never lie to you. How else could Fang Yuan advance to Rank 4 so rapidly without one of the Extreme Physiques."
First gen Gu Yue turned to Fang Yuan. The clan head was not wrong... to see someone so young already at Rank 4 Middle Stage. But he was extremely confident in his Blood Path methods, and knew that Fang Yuan did not have an Extreme Physique. So there was only one other explanation for this.
"Boy! You found an inheritance? Something that allowed you to cultivate so fast? Tell me the truth and where this inheritance is, and I might consider sparing your life!"

chapters.title: Chapter 127 - 127: Blood River Graveyard: Part Six
chapters.content:
"Certainly, ancestor," Fang Yuan said. "I will lead you right to where I found the inheritance. However, don't you think that we should deal with Lord Sky Crane first?"
"Fang Yuan... you deceived me...?" the clan head wondered.
He had placed his trust in Fang Yuan absolutely- as Fang Yuan had been the model Gu Yue clansmen up until this point. But there was something entirely different going on. Just how much had Fang Yuan schemed against him, he wondered? How many secrets was Fang Yuan hiding? What was this about an inheritance?
"Hmph! You have a point there," First gen Gu Yue said, glancing up at Lord Sky Crane. "Let me squash this mosquito first, then we can discuss this inheritance that you found."
Fang Yuan hoped that he could draw first gen Gu Yue into the Blessed Land, where his Rank 5 cultivation would be meaningless. There, Fang Yuan could either kill him, or Paradise Earth would deal with him.
However, this required Lord Sky Crane to be dealt with first.
First gen Gu Yue spread his arms. "Join me, my clansmen, and let us rid the world of this righteous hypocrite. Remember the ones who have already fallen as a result of this monster's actions, steal your hearts, and join me for the fight." There were cheers from the Gu Yue clansmen.
"That's right- lets tear this overgrown pigeon's wings off!"
"Ancestor is correct, this man pretends to be righteous but killed so many of our innocent villagers!"
"Fools!" Lord Sky Crane said. "That man over there has the Blood Skull Gu, and is only rearing you all like chickens to be slaughtered in order to benefit himself!"
"Hmph! As if we would listen to him!"
"Trying to slander our righteous ancestor!"
'What these idiots don't realize is that he is telling the truth,' Fang Yuan thought. He had heard of the Blood Skull Gu before, and from the way he had been attacked it was obvious what first gen Gu Yue wanted to do. Thankfully, the carrot hanging in front of him, a potential inheritance, would save Fang Yuan for now.
The current greater enemy was Lord Sky Crane. Once he was dead, Fang Yuan planned to deal with first gen Gu Yue himself, either indirectly in the blessed land, or directly. Although the gap between them was immense, a zombie could not make primeval essence on its own. In that aspect, Fang Yuan had a clear advantage.
First gen Gu Yue launched himself into the air, going for Lord Sky Crane. From behind him, the Blood River Python, a massive snake nearly the size of a subway train back on earth, erupted and trailed behind its master.
The Blood River Python and the Iron Beak Flying Crane King began fighting as their masters separated and launched themselves at each other.
Most Rank 5 Gu Masters did not have a single Rank 5 gu worm to their names, let alone a full set. However, both Lord Sky Crane and first gen Gu Yue were old monsters and could not be judged by those standards, possessing multiple Rank 5 gu worms. Not only that, both were at Rank 5 Peak Stage, the pinnacle of mortal Gu Master cultivation, and had centuries of experience.
The two collided like two meteors meeting in midair. The resultant explosion was almost deafening as they clawed and struck each other. Forget Fang Yuan, even an ordinary Rank 5 Gu Master would be torn to bits if they were caught in the fray.
Right now, all that Fang Yuan and the others could do was deal with the numerous cranes which were still alive. In the scenario that first gen Gu Yue failed, they would serve as further hurdles for them in case they wished to fight Lord Sky Crane.
New main mission unlocked!

Reward: 4% permanent increase to your aptitude.
New main mission unlocked!

Description: Stop first gen Gu Yue
Reward: The system will gift the host a will created for the host that can last for several years. In addition, this will will have a single bead of Grape Green Immortal Essence associated with it (cannot be used by the host directly as this is considered 'foreign' Immortal Essence)
Did the system really expect that Fang Yuan had the power to change the outcome of any of these fights?Google seaʀᴄh
Is this what Genesis Lotus had meant when saying that Fang Yuan had to be stronger to last against what was coming up in the future?
Even if he used the Stone Aperture Gu, he would be no match for either of them.
First gen Gu Yue and Lord Sky Crane separated in the sky.
"Heh- you are just as green as you were before," First gen Gu Yue said. "It looks like being gifted by heaven made you truly soft- if only you improved in the last thousand years."
"Hmph- take this!" Lord Sky Crane said, activating a gu worm which struck first gen Gu Yue in the torso nearly instantly, though it seemed to do no damage to him.
However, everyone on the ground who was a Gu Yue clansmen coughed up a mouthful of blood as they felt dizzy.
"Bloodline Elimination Gu!" Lord Sky Crane said. "Did you think that I wouldn't come prepared when facing a Blood Path Gu Master? Do you think the Ten Great Sects don't have their answers for such a contingency after so many centuries of Blood Path demons wreaking havoc! Allow me to turn your advantage on its head! Tainted Bloodline Gu!"
This gu worm was not directed at first gen Gu Yue, but rather, at several Gu Masters on the ground. However, the moment it made contact with them, the first gen Gu Yue's body suddenly had multiple holes in it as if it was a piece of clothe being eaten by moth worms.
Fang Yuan activated Doctor Gu, recovering from his own injuries nearly immediately. As he thought to use Charity Gu to heal the other clan members- something struck him. Charity Gu could be used on everyone- but could also be used exclusively on clan members.
The latter effect seemed to mimic the aspects of the Blood Path. Being a Human Path master, and a Blood Path grandmaster in terms of attainment, the two aspects began to somewhat merge in his mind.
There was an idea for something there- a mortal killer move, but he did not have the time in the middle of battle to perfect it.
First gen Gu Yue snarled and launched himself at Lord Sky Crane again, trying to find a way to disrupt the attack that was eating away at him. Lord Sky Crane was being pushed back, but he only needed a way to stall for time it seemed. As it was, he had the advantage in a battle of attrition.
At a moment during the fight, first gen Gu Yue no longer had the advantage and it had reached a stalemate. Then, Lord Sky Crane pushed him back, with him eventually breaking free and landing in the village.
"Ahaha, it seems that you are not as strong as you once boasted of," Lord Sky Crane said, gathering his power for a final strike.
First gen Gu Yue then retrieved a gu worm from his aperture, though he didn't activate it, instead throwing it on the ground and slashing at it. "Everyone, help me destroy this!"
Attacks rained in on the ball of blood, until it burst, activating its effect.
First gen Gu Yue and a large portion of the village, including Fang Yuan and Bai Ning Bing, were suddenly trapped inside of a large barrier tinged with red.
Lord Sky Crane snarled and attempted to barge in, but couldn't.
First gen Gu Yue laughed. "This is my own invention- how will you rate it, junior? I call it the Blood Curtain Skyflower Gu, I was inspired to create it upon seeing the Water Curtain Skyflower. But this barrier's effectiveness is even higher than those! Don't worry though, even though you can't come inside, I can go outside. Let me rest and recover, and then I'll deal with you!"

chapters.title: Chapter 128 - 128: Blood River Graveyard: Part Seven
chapters.content:
"Everyone! Give me your primeval stones!" First gen Gu Yue said. Without primeval stones, he could not regain any primeval essence being a zombie.
"Don't you idiots see you're only fueling your own demise!" Lord Sky Crane shouted in vain as hundreds of primeval stones were tossed at first gen Gu Yue, who greedily scooped all of them up.
Fang Yuan knew that Lord Sky Crane was right, but there was little alternative that the villagers had. Most of them had already been gravely injured by Bloodline Annihilation Gu, with only the efforts of healing gu worms keeping them going.
Outside, Lord Sky Crane began slaughtering whoever he could find, whether Gu Yue clansmen or not.
Fang Yuan for his part used the Rank 4 Stone Aperture Gu. It was clear that the time for action had come, and if his cultivation was any lower he was without a doubt going to get crushed before the might of such giants.
"Ah, thank you all," first gen Gu Yue said once he was done eating the primeval stones, before he struck out into the air, decapitating a Gu Yue clansmen.
The Gu Yue clan members were shocked by this display. First gen Gu Yue took the blood of the clan member, taking out a skull-shaped gu from his aperture. All of the blood gathered within that skull, and as he poured it over himself, not a single drop spilled onto the ground surprisingly enough.
'Blood Skull Gu...' Fang Yuan thought.
"Thief!" Lord Sky Crane screeched, looking like he was about to burst every single vein on his forehead out of anger. "That gu is mine! MINE! I will pry it from your cold, dead, hands before I piss on your corpse!"
"Ancestor! What are you doing? Didn't we help you? Why-" the clan head was protesting this action before he too, was swiftly killed and his blood added to Blood Skull Gu.
"Silence! You wanted to help, didn't you! Then help- with your blood. Ah, its such a misfortunate that the one who was to have the Ancient Yin Desolate Moon Physique still hasn't awakened, else you all would not need to die," First gen Gu Yue said.
"Demon! Paying our kindness back with such slaughter!"
"We never should've trusted him in the first place!"
Fang Yuan sighed. Most clans got an ancestor who would save them when awakened- why was he unlucky and transmigrated into the body of someone whose ancestor himself was the biggest threat to their lives?
"No!" Yu Sai screamed as Li Mei was also slain, having not even an instant to say her farewell. "Why you bast-"
"Don't worry, don't worry, you can join her," First gen Gu Yue said, killing Yu Sai as well. "A pity... given that I had worked so hard to raise all of you. But, what can be helped? That little mosquito up there is a lot more pesky than I'd imagined."
He then wandered over to Fang Yuan, but was pushed back by Bai Ning Bing.
"Ancestor, don't forget, I know where a valued inheritance is," Fang Yuan said. "I can lead you there so long as you spare my life."
"Hmph! What would a mere mortal inheritance interest me-"
"It is an Immortal Inheritance," Fang Yuan said.
First gen Gu Yue paused. Bai Ning Bing's attempts did little to stop him, only slow him down slightly. "Ah... a delectable lie, but a lie nonetheless I think. But even if it is true, don't worry, I will find a way to soul search your body after your demise. You've shown yourself to be far too crafty to be easily controlled. I had initially thought of keeping you alive as a breeding stallion to replenish the stock of Gu Yue villagers once I was done here given your Rank 4 cultivation prowess, but I can already tell it is not worth the hassle. I will see if what you're telling me is true after you've been slain." He extended a talon towards Fang Yuan, but an icy blast swatted it aside.
"Fang Yuan," Bai Ning Bing said, stepping between him and first gen Gu Yue. "I have a favor to ask of you... though I can help you right now..."
"A favor? Like what?"
"I am nearing the end of my life," Bai Ning Bing said. A swipe from first gen Gu Yue nearly decapitated him, but this wound healed up instantly as it was covered by a layer of frost. It was clear that this was the Northern Dark Ice Soul Physique at its peak. "Since I can't make my life interesting... I want you to live on for me. Live an exceptional and full life, Fang Yuan."
"Agreed."
"Hmph- the Northern Dark Ice Soul Physique? If only you were a Gu Yue clansmen, then the others wouldn't have to die," first gen Gu Yue said. Even with its full power, Bai Ning Bing was not a match for first gen Gu Yue currently.
That was, until he erupted.
In an instant, all of Qing Mao mountain was encased in a thick layer of ice- ice so dense that it would not melt even under the heat of the midsummer sun.
Everything and everyone was caught up in this icy blast, whether human, wolf, or crane.
Only one small area remained untouched- that was around Fang Yuan!
First gen Gu Yue was encased in ice, but Fang Yuan was not naive enough to think that it would kill him. An old monster like him must've had numerous methods to defend himself against an attack like this.
Lord Sky Crane still hovered overhead, having avoided the blast, and just waiting for the Blood Curtain Skyflower Gu to dissipate.
There was only one option left for Fang Yuan to survive now.Tʜe source of this ᴄontent ɪs ɴoᴠel Fɪre.nᴇt
'System, retrieve the Spring Autumn Cicada.'
Unsealing and withdrawing the Spring Autumn Cicada...
A moment later, a bright flash of light erupted from the mountain, flying fast as a plane towards Fang Yuan's aperture.
As it was unsealed, there was no hiding its aura anymore.
"Rank 6 aura!" Lord Sky Crane screamed. "So you weren't lying when you said there was an Immortal Inheritance? Quickly, tell me where it is, and I'll help you kill this bastard ancestor of yours, and even consider sparing your life!"
Cultivation blessing activated- using the Spring Autumn Cicada now has a 100% success rate!
The gu's Rank 6 Aura was such that it was beginning to crack even the stone walls of Fang Yuan's aperture. However, he only need it to last but a few moment's worth of time.
First gen Gu Yue burst out from the ice as if it were nothing. Why had he pretended to be encased all this time? Perhaps he had been biding time, or the method to break the ice so fast took a lot of resources.
Without a doubt though, what had awakened him was the Rank 6 aura of the Spring Autumn Cicada. Who wouldn't be moved when presented with the prospect of a Rank 6 gu worm?
"Junior, hand me that gu worm and I will consider sparing your-" he began, but Fang Yuan never heard what he had to say.
He exploded, as his will was carried through the River of Time, going backwards. During his first such journey, he had not noticed much about the River of Time itself, though he was now able to make out certain details.
The river itself was vast and narrow seemingly at the same time. Strange creatures moved through it, and much of it was veiled by a thick mist. Fang Yuan was able to see this all through the cicada's eyes, given that he was nothing more than a collection of thoughts.
The Spring Autumn Cicade took his will over a strange island of stone that suddenly appeared through the wall of mist. Upon this island, there were several red lotuses blooming, and Fang Yuan swore he could see a figure standing atop the island, looking at him, before the Spring Autumn Cicada descended back into the river.
He had regressed once again!

chapters.title: Chapter 129 - 129: Rematch Against Bai Ning Bing: Part One
chapters.content:
Fang Yuan was gently stroking the fur on the Crimsonhoof Deer, snatching a Three Steps Fragrant Grass Gu before heading back to the village.
In the middle of his journey, he suddenly felt like his mind had collided with someone else's for a brief moment.
"This is... all the way back here!" Fang Yuan muttered, looking into this aperture and seeing that he was still at Rank 4 Initial Stage, though it was being suppressed by Training Weights Gu.
There was one massive difference, however. His vital gu was finally back- the Spring Autumn Cicada was once again near the brink of death from its journey through the River of Time, but this meant that its aura was now greatly suppressed and weakened. His aperture could very easily contain it.
It fluttered lightly in his aperture. He had felt very... odd in its absence, as if a part of him was missing when it had been sealed away. Being his vital gu, perhaps such a feeling was normal? Such a thing had never happened to him before. His vital gu had died in the past, yes, but was rapidly replaced generally speaking.
Naturally, this also meant that he was no longer bound to Qing Mao mountain. He did not need to stick around for the upcoming disasters that were on the horizon, most of which had been plotted out by Genesis Lotus Immortal Venerable.
He could take Fang Zheng and flee now, however...
Mission complete successfully!
Save Me Spring Autumn Cicada-chan, You're My Only Hope!
Reward: Rank 4 Yin-Yang Gu (x 1) has been added to your inventory.
The addition of this gu worm only solidified a plan in Fang Yuan's mind regarding what he could do in the future.
Yes, the fighting between Lord Sky Crane and first gen Gu Yue was going to be chaotic- but as Sun Tzu said- 'In the midst of chaos, there is opportunity.'
Fang Yuan would be walking upon a thin tightrope, in danger of being killed by either of them. It was risk, but at the same time, he could reap huge rewards if his gamble paid off.
Those of the demonic faction loved to gamble, though Fang Yuan would not gamble unnecessarily of course. There was also the issue to keep in mind that Genesis Lotus might've even kept this possibility in mind and there was some other kind of trick or trap waiting to keep him contained on the mountain.
He was still on the fence regarding his future course of action, but then resolved himself to stay for now. There were several benefits that he could reap in the meantime, and if push came to shove, retreat was always an option in the future.
The first thing he needed to do was to use the Human Path dao marks that he had accumulated up until now. He had been unsure of committing himself to the Human Path up until now, but upon seeing the power of even one first-class Human Path gu worm, that being Charity Gu, he had changed his mind. Additionally, it did not conflict with other path dao marks, that bit that Genesis Lotus had told him was true.
So there was no downside to doing so! He had accumulated 202 of them right now, though with every passing week he would gain 5 more.

Description: Get 200 Human Path dao marks.
Reward: Rank 5 Integration Gu (x 1)
While there were some secret missions the system told him about, some were completely hidden, which were these two. He had gotten their rewards far too late last time, but now, he was quite interested in knowing what kind of dream realm he had fetched.
Though, that could all be done later.
He now began dashing forward in the direction where he knew that Qing Shu was going to be. As was to be expected, he soon saw the figures materializing on the horizon. Qing Shu and his gang were being chased by Bai Ning Bing.
Last time, Fang Yuan had failed in the mission to prevent Qing Shu from dying during the wolf tide- because Qing Shu had died here.
However, with the benefit of knowing what was to happen in the future, he could act differently now.
"Brother Qing Shu!" Fang Yuan called out, as the man briefly turned his head to look at Fang Yuan.
"Ah, good timing, we were helping a mixed group of clansmen fend off some wolves, but then he descended from a mountain, saying that we were interrupting his fun, and that he had been waiting to see the Gu Masters scream in horror as they were torn apart by the wolves," Qing Shu said through gritted teeth. "He then slaughtered them all himself, regardless of whether they were Bai clansmen or not. Then, he began chasing us."
"Bai Ning Bing, as an elder of the clan don't you have any shame?" Qing Mao asked through gritted teeth. He was carrying Yao Hong in his arms just like last time.
"Shame? No, I don't, if that's what you're asking," Bai Ning Bing said.
"There is no need to bother reasoning with such a demon," Fang Yuan said. "Brother Qing Shu, please retract your use of Wood Charm Gu, it will not be needed in this fight."
"Not needed? You sure are confident in yourself," Bai Ning Bing said, taking out an ice blade. "But for me, this is like losing a single primeval stone and finding a spirit spring instead! I would much rather fight someone like Fang Yuan rather than you all..."
Fang Yuan gave him a slight smile as Qing Shu retracted his vines. He had not used Wood Charm Gu too much- not yet that was.ʀᴇᴀᴅ ʟᴀᴛᴇsᴛ ᴄʜᴀᴘᴛᴇʀs ᴀᴛ No(ᴠ)ᴇlFire.nᴇt
"I hope you don't regret those words," Fang Yuan said, as he took a cylindrical gu worm out of his aperture, dropping it on the floor.
Immediately, a new aura permeated through the surroundings.
Bai Ning Bing's pupils shrank. "This is...!"
Yellow golden primeval essence began filling Fang Yuan's aperture. He had been cautious during their last fight to an extreme to not reveal his actual cultivation level in public, but it had been revealed anyway. Now that he knew the prophecy of the Ancient Yin Desolate Moon Physique awakening in the clan, there was no need to hide it.
"Fang Yuan- you've reached Rank 4?" Qing Shu asked, completely shocked. He was one of the most prodigal Gu Masters of his generation, and even if he put his full focus behind it, he would only be Rank 3 Middle Stage right now. He had assumed that Fang Yuan got slightly lucky with the aide of the Liquor Worm and so had managed to reach Rank 3 faster than he did thanks to that and a greater access to resources.
But Rank 4?! Even for an A-grade talent, that would be unheard of.
Host, this is base Bai Ning Bing that we're up against. Allow me to give you a little extra help in dealing with him.
Cultivation Blessing Received!
Can advance one mortal gu by one rank. Cannot be used to advance mortal gu to Immortal Gu.
The system gave him the same cultivation blessing, but he had a different target in mind this time.
Qing Mao was speechless as Fang Yuan reached over to him, placing a hand on Yao Hong's back and using Doctor Gu combined with Charity Gu to patch up her injuries. By the use of this combination, he did not need to take Doctor Gu out to heal her like he had to with Teng Ru.
"Ah, could I ask you all to stall for just some time?" Fang Yuan asked, using another primeval stone. Now, Qing Mao was fighting fit, assuming that she still had primeval essence. "I need a bit more time to get some Rank 4 primeval essence and can fight him off..."

chapters.title: Chapter 130 - 130: Rematch Against Bai Ning Bing: Part Two
chapters.content:
Fang Yuan's Rank 4 aura permeated throughout the battlefield.
To Bai Ning Bing's credit, he reacted almost instantly despite the insane turn of events, turning around and running away. "Well, at least he's off our tail," Qing Shu muttered. He turned towards Fang Yuan. "Elder Fang Yuan, thank you for that, but when did you reach Rank Four? Is that genuine Rank Four aura? Or did you use a gu worm to imitate Rank 4?"
Fang Yuan did not answer them immediately. He just said, "I will explain things later. For now, you three should head back towards the village. I'm going after Bai Ning Bing."
"Jun-Elder Fang Yuan, you might be stronger than we initially thought," Qing Shu said. "However, Bai Ning Bing is no ordinary Rank Three fighter either. He was able to kill many Elders when he was only Rank Two. I'm in no position to command you, but I do believe that it is ultimately not worth the risk of pursuing Bai Ning Bing. The village requires strong Gu Masters such as yourself to better weather the wolf tide, and it would be a great tragedy if you were injured. In our current state, we can do little to shift the tide of battle compared to a Rank 4 Gu Master. ."
"Don't worry," Fang Yuan said. "I am the predator, and he is the prey. Go back to the village." Fang Yuan then began running after Bai Ning Bing, using Three Step Fragrant Grass Gu. He used it multiple times in order to close the distance between them. It was only a Rank Two Gu worm, and even with Fang Yuan pushing it using his Rank Four primal essence, it could not compare to the Hundred Li Earthwolf Spider.Google seaʀᴄh NovᴇlFir(e).nᴇt
However, Bai Ning Bing was also out of primal essence, mainly. It also appeared that he lacked an appropriate movement-type Gu worm. Either he wanted to conserve his primal essence for the purpose of fighting or defending himself, or he had never thought that the situation would arise where he needed to flee.
Fang Yuan kept up his chase as the distance between them narrowed. "Bai Ning Bing!" Fang Yuan yelled out. "Didn't you want to fight to the death? Why don't you turn around and fight me for 300 rounds, then?"
Bai Ning Bing did not respond, but Fang Yuan hadn't expected him to. Seeking excitement was one thing, but jumping off a cliff was another, and Bai Ning Bing must have realized that he wouldn't be able to defeat Fang Yuan, especially with his primal essence already partially depleted.
Although Fang Yuan was radiating killing intent, he had no true desire to kill Bai Ning Bing. If anything, Bai Ning Bing was important towards his plan later on. However, that didn't mean that there weren't benefits to be gained. Just like last time, Bai Ning Bing cast a gu worm behind him just like last time: Rank Three Stone Aperture Gu.
Fang Yuan picked it up and instantly refined it using the Spring Autumn Cicada's aura.
'What was that?' Bai Ning Bing thought to himself. Fang Yuan had instantly refined his gu worm!
He then resorted to another strategy. His throat began to swell up as an ice-blue bird emerged from it, soaring out towards where Qing Shu was. At this distance, there was still a chance that he could hit them, and he was likely hoping that Fang Yuan would hesitate or turn around to help his compatriots.
Fang Yuan, however, already knew about this gu worm and sent out a golden moonblade at it. The resultant icy explosion trapped Bai Ning Bing, though it also made it harder for Fang Yuan to go through the thick layer of ice. Such a thing would have been near fatal for any ordinary Gu Master, but Fang Yuan knew that Bai Ning Bing had his ways of surviving this. As a matter of fact, this icy prison actually helped Bai Ning Bing more than hurting him because it would give him time to recover his primal essence.
Fang Yuan began carving away at the block of ice, though even with his Rank Three moonblade, it could do little. Then the block of ice suddenly burst out, and Bai Ning Bing stumbled. He sent two icicles at Fang Yuan, which Fang Yuan dodged before Bai Ning Bing around to run away again.
Fang Yuan continued to run after him. Bai Ning Bing threw out a different Gu worm this time: a Rank Two Red Steel Relic Gu. Why did someone like Bai Ning Bing have it? It could've been spoils of battle from some unfortunate Gu Master or something his clan gave him which he no longer needed.
Fang Yuan picked it up and refined this one instantly as well. 'This isn't going to work, Bai Ning Bing,' Fang Yuan thought.
Fang Yuan maintained a comfortable pace. He had no need to fight Bai Ning Bing seriously, but he did need to undo whatever barriers the Bai clan had put on him in order to control the Northern Dark Ice Soul Physique. If Bai Ning Bing did not detonate like last time, it would ruin his plans.
An icicle struck his right shoulder, but the Rank Three Moonlight Chainmail Gu stopped most of the blow. Doctor Gu's healing quickly patched up the wound.
'This is bad,' Bai Ning Bing thought. 'If I want to... no, if I just want to survive, I'm going to have to go all out.' He removed the restrictions on his aperture, and it began rapidly filling with primal essence.
He then turned on his heel and struck out at Fang Yuan. If it had been anyone less experienced, this would have caught him off guard. However, Fang Yuan had honed his battle experience over a span of 500 years and had been expecting such.
In this scenario, his response was simple: to back away using the Three Steps Fragrant Grass Gu, while avoiding Bai Ning Bing's attacks.
When there was an opening, he shot out a Rank Three golden moonblade. Its golden contour ripped through the air before it struck Bai Ning Bing's arm. The resulting gash would have been disabling on anyone else, but it rapidly filled itself with ice.
'As I thought, I really can't keep up with him for any longer than five minutes,' Bai Ning Bing quickly assessed. 'Even with all the restrictions removed, the gap between Rank Three and Rank Four is just too much. I also haven't had the full time needed to recover.'
Voices could be heard ahead of them as Bai Ning Bing ran towards the line of voices. 'There's a one in three chance that these people belong to the Bai clan, in which case, I might have a chance at survival.'
Fang Yuan would have normally tailed him given the odds were in his favor. However, he already knew what the result was going to be and turned around. He had already accomplished what he wanted to.
The Rank Two Red Steel Relic Gu was more of a consolation prize than anything. However, things were already set in motion, and he had built up the base for what he was going to do in the future.

chapters.title: Chapter 131 - 131: Preparations: Part One
chapters.content:
Fang Yuan returned to the village, much to Bai Ning Bing's relief. Not that he realized this before he burst through the forest, finding that the people in front of him were indeed Bai Clan villagers, and turning around before realizing that Fang Yuan was no longer pursuing him.
When Fang Yuan returned to his village, there was already a commotion. Qing Shu had reported what had happened to the clan head. Even if he hadn't, Fang Yuan's Rank Four aura spoke for itself as he walked down the street.
He walked home and began devising a plan. Although he had something in mind already, he needed to piece together everything and ensure that it went smoothly.
This time around, he no longer had the cultivation power which allowed him to use the Spring Autumn Cicada with guaranteed success. However, the knowledge of the future would prove greatly instrumental in whether or not he would succeed this time.
He wanted to explore the dream realm that he had been given by the system. However, that could end up taking a few days, and in the meantime, there were things that he needed to do.
The very next morning, Fang Yuan walked over to the clan head's pavilion. He spoke to one of the guards. Normally, mortals would be used as guards. However, given that this was the clan head's pavilion, Rank Two Gu Masters stood guard instead. Well, what were Rank Two Gu Masters compared to Fang Yuan anyway?
"Tell the clan head that Elder Fang Yuan would request an audience with him." The guards glanced at each other nervously. The clan head had said that he was busy this morning. However, there was no doubt, especially given the fact that they could feel Fang Yuan's Rank Four aura, that this was quite important. Fang Yuan was led in immediately, but was asked to wait for half an hour before the clan head came in.
"Greetings, Clan Head," Fang Yuan said, cupping his hands.
The clan head returned the gesture. "Fang Yuan, your advancement to Rank Four is... interesting, but at the same time poses many questions."
Fang Yuan nodded. "That is why I came here to report to you. Although I think the clan head is already aware of this going on."
"Oh, and what is that?" the clan head asked. The two of them were alone right now, without anyone to eavesdrop on their conversation.
Fang Yuan pretended to be nervous, shifting slightly before saying, "Clan Head, I must apologize for lying to you. The truth is that I possess a secret which I've been holding in for quite a long time. The reason why I was able to advance to Rank Four was because I possess the Ancient Yin Desolate Moon Physique."
The clan head took a deep breath. He had already assumed that this was likely the case. However, he had not confronted Fang Yuan about it, waiting for the right time to bring the topic up. But right now, Fang Yuan had admitted to it himself.
"There's no need for clan head to tell me about the legend of the Ancient Yin Desolate Moon Physique or the prophecy made by our first generation ancestor. I already know of such."
The clan head raised an eyebrow. "You already know this? How did you find out?"
Fang Yuan gave him a wry smile. "If one wanted to find out, they only needed to look for the clues and piece things together. So long as you asked the right people, you'd be able to find out."The source of this content ɪs ɴoᴠel Fɪre.nᴇt
The clan head assumed that one of the other elders who knew about the situation had told Fang Yuan, and Fang Yuan was speaking in this roundabout manner to protect that elder in question. He didn't appreciate this, but also did not want to press Fang Yuan further. "In that case," the clan head said, "you must realize the importance that you must go to the Blood River Graveyard, correct?"
"I won't lie. I am a bit disappointed that you lied to me. I thought that we were closer than that." With that said, the clan head could understand Fang Yuan's situation. He was also willing to forgive everything if Fang Yuan indeed had the Ancient Yin Desolate Moon Physique.
"Once again, I must apologize, Lord Clan Head," Fang Yuan said, "both about keeping the secret from you and about another matter."
"Oh, what matter?" the clan head asked.
"The fact that I have already been to the Blood River Graveyard."
The clan head nearly jumped back in shock. "You have already been there, Fang Yuan? That is forbidden!"
"I know that it is forbidden," Fang Yuan answered. "However, it was the only way to control the downside of the Ancient Yin Desolate Moon Physique. I've already communicated with our first-gen ancestor who lies there."
The clan head took another deep breath. If Fang Yuan had met with the first-generation clan ancestor and already received his blessings, there was little that he could do about it. "Did you really go to the Blood River Graveyard?" he asked.
"Indeed. I saw the massive pool of blood there. I also saw the Blood River Python, which had been tamed by our first-generation Clan Head. I also saw the coffin where his zombie body was placed." The clan head realized that these words left no room for doubt. This meant that indeed, Fang Yuan was telling the truth: he had been to the Blood River Graveyard. If he had been any normal clan member who wandered there, the first-generation Gu Yue likely would have killed him merely for trespassing. The fact that he was still breathing meant that he indeed was the person prophesied.
"Did the first-gen clan head say anything else?" the current clan head asked.
"There was one thing, however..." Fang Yuan said. "I'm not sure that it is something which I should bring up. It is not really that relevant."
"Fang Yuan, I implore you," the clan head said. Before, when Fang Yuan had been a Rank Three Elder, there was still something that he could do to try to suppress Fang Yuan or force him to obey him, granted at the time Fang Yuan was within his camp, so he would not do so openly. However, now, Fang Yuan was not only Rank Four, but also the possessor of the Ancient Yin Desolate Moon Physique. Given that he had to be careful while treading around Fang Yuan.
"The other thing that he said," Fang Yuan began, "was that he wished for me to take over as clan head." The current clan head had expected this. After all, so long as he had a controlled Ancient Desolate Yin Physique, he was worth more than even an A-grade talent. His chance of getting to Rank 5 was nearly 100%, and he could very well end up becoming the first Rank 6 in the clan's history.
However, he was not expecting the next words that came out of Fang Yuan's mouth.
"However, I refused," Fang Yuan said.

chapters.title: Chapter 132 - 132: Preparations: Part Two
chapters.content:
"Fang Yuan, how could you deny the wishes of our founding ancestor?" the clan head asked.
"I did not outright reject him," Fang Yuan said. "I merely said that such a thing would involve me challenging you, and how could I possibly repay the kindness that you have shown me by attacking you and attempting to seize your position by force? You have raised me almost like a parent- what child could possibly usurp their parent? Would heaven forgive a prince who overthrew his father? When I said this, the first-gen ancestor simply acknowledged my loyalty and said that when I was ready, then I would become clan head, and he dropped the matter for the time being."
"Still, Fang Yuan!" the clan head said. "You shouldn't have done something like that. You should have accepted the position, and I would have stepped down right away." He then sighed. "However, I suppose that can be dealt with later. It is good that you met with him and found a way to control the detonation of one of the Ten Extreme Physiques."Follow current novels on NovᴇlFɪre.ɴet
Fang Yuan nodded.
"However, there is one other thing that I would like to report."
"Oh, and what is that?" the clan head asked.
"It is the fact that there is a Lightning Lycan King among the wolf tide."
"A Lightning Lycan King?" the clan head asked, shocked. "Are you sure?"
The clan head did not know about this right now. It would only become apparent in about two week's time when a scouting regimen they would send out would be completely annihilated.
The presence of the Lightning Lycan King completely changed the equation when it came to how the villages would deal with the wolf tide. Before, they only had to deal with three Thunder Crown Wolves, but now they had to deal with the Lightning Lycan King as well. On top of that, it was not simply a matter of power. The Lightning Lycan King's intelligence was also something that they could not ignore and made the already precarious situation one that threatened the foundations of each village itself.
"I also happen to know the vague area where the Lightning Lycan King will be," Fang Yuan said. "I managed to find this out today while I was chasing Bai Ning Bing from the Bai clan. Although he got away, I was able to deduce this and escape." He then paused. "The reason why I was forced to escape and not able to kill the Lightning Lycan King was because I lacked the required set of Rank Four gu worms. If I had them, then I would have been able to deal with him. I know the general area where this Lightning Lycan King might be, and I would like to request a group of Gu Masters to accompany me while we go to hunt this creature. If we can catch it off guard and kill it before it can rally up a force, it will make dealing with the wolf tide ultimately much easier.Of course. What I am also requesting is access to the clan's Rank Four Gu worms and Gu recipes."
"I was going to give you access to a single Rank Four Gu worm regardless," the clan head said. "And I also think that your allowance needs to be increased. Beyond that, though, Fang Yuan, it is rather difficult for me to justify things..."
"In that case, let a few elders accompany me in this mission," Fang Yuan said.
Fang Yuan currently occupied a unique position among the villagers. He was the only other Rank Four Gu Master other than the clan head. None of the other two clans had an extra Rank Four Gu Master.
As such, there is no real use in leaking the information to one of the other villages and having them coordinate an attack. Only a Rank Four could deal with a Lightning Lycan King. However, the clan heads themselves could not head out, of course. They had to defend the villages, and if one of the clan heads was killed, who would defend the village? Because of this they were limited in how they could move out and were tied down to the village.
In that case, whichever village managed to kill the Lightning Lycan King would only make it easier for another village to conquer them. However, Fang Yuan was not restricted by that. As an analogy, if each clan was a chessboard, then each of them had a single queen before which had to remain to guard the king. However, the Gu Yue clan had gained another queen which could freely move. The advantage that this gave them did not need to be stated. "All right, then, I will consider your proposal," the clan head said.
Fang Yuan then went to the merit board. "It was here last time," Fang Yuan thought. "I'm sure I would be able to... there it is."
It was a gu worm from the Bai clan which he wanted: a Rank Three Gu worm. Nonetheless, it would be hard to obtain it ordinarily.
However, he had something that the Bai clan would want: the Rank Three Stone Aperture Gu. They might call him shameless for essentially trading away something he had stolen from Bai Ning Bing in the first place. But all Fang Yuan had to retort when they asked him about this was, "Do you not want it back? Is it more important to call me shameless or to help Bai Ning Bing!" The Bai clan eventually agreed to the trade despite complaining all the way. Bai Ning Bing was one of their geniuses after all, and he badly needed the gu worm.
'Heh- even if you use the Stone Aperture Gu, it will not be enough to withstand the power of the Northern Dark Ice Soul Physique when it bursts,' Fang Yuan said, already plotting for when this event would occur.
Fang Yuan took his new Gu worm and went to pay the Crimsonhoof Deer a visit.
Once he was done, like last time he went to take the Lightning Lord Wings Gu from the cavern. This would still be as helpful as always, as well as looking at certain recipes.
There were other things that he wanted, but those could wait until he became clan head properly.
He tried examining the paintings that Genesis Lotus Immortal Venerable had given him. They had not come in handy whatsoever with the last run of things, and he had half a mind to throw them out or destroy them given he didn't exactly trust Genesis Lotus, but found that he was unable to as whatever attack he launched at them just sank in.
For now then, they would remain in his storage gu.
Now, he wanted to go ahead and explore the dream realm while the strike force was prepared to attack the Lightning Lycan King.
Just like last time, Fang Yuan had Fang Zheng guarding him while he took the dream realms out.
He needed to do this before he became clan head, because otherwise there was no way that he would be able to get three days' worth of time alone with the wolf tide raging.
This time, his soul had been strengthened with the help of Guts Gu and he also had Guts Gu stored away from the daily quests in case his soul got injured.

chapters.title: Chapter 133 - 133: Refining Hope Gu: Part One
chapters.content:
Fang Yuan found himself in a rather familiar location once he entered the dream realm. 'No wait', he thought. 'This only looks familiar on first glance.' He was in an underground cavern, much like the one that the Gu Yue clan had. However, the faces around him were completely different from the time of his ceremony. Whoever he was embodying in this dream realm was currently undergoing their aperture awakening ceremony.
That meant that they were somewhere in the Southern Border as the awakening ceremony varied slightly from region to region.
The cavern itself was also slightly different from that of the Gu Yue clan's once he took a closer look around, though this wasn't as apparent as the varying faces around him. 'Who am I here?' Fang Yuan thought to himself.
This clan's surname seemed to be Teng, as there was an elder here who called out their names one by one. Fang Yuan examined himself. He was not that much different from how he was currently, perhaps a few inches shorter.
Without any gu worm or primal essence, there was little that he could do other than observe. For now, the elder called out "Teng Mingyu!". No one moved forward. It was only when he called out the name again, and people started looking at him, that Fang Yuan realized that he must be Teng Mingyu.
"Ah, I'm sorry," Fang Yuan said, and then began walking towards the primeval spring.
"You can daydream after you've awakened your aperture!" the elder, who was reading out names, snapped. Then Fang Yuan took several steps forward. The numerous lights representing Hope Gu entered this space that would become his aperture.
He kept walking until suddenly he felt a pressure against him, and a small explosion occurred in the area where the Hope Gu were entering. "Thirty-xix steps!" the Elder called out. "B-grade talent!" He was no longer scowling and had a smile upon his face.
The other youngsters had jealous looks, though there were two within the crowd who were cheering.
"Great job!"
"Well done!"
However, this person was not done. Fang Yuan felt himself lose control over the person's body as he reached into the spirit spring to retrieve something that was shining brightly. "Come on out there! We don't have all day!" the elder who was calling out names, yelled out.
"Coming," the person in question said.
Teng Mingyu then took one of the Hope Gu, placing it in his aperture and then refining it instantly.
'This is... this person decided to take Hope Gu as his vital gu?' Fang Yuan thought.
It was a very peculiar choice. Hope Gu had not use other than awakening one's aperture, and so to choose it as one's vital gu worm was a massive waste.
Whoever this person was, they were destined to become an elder at the very least. It was odd that they had gotten no guidance regarding this beforehand, unless it was assumed that they were a surprise talent.
'Perhaps if one could refine Immortal Hope Gu- but even in my previous life, I had not heard of anyone possessing Rank 6 or higher Hope Gu,' Fang Yuan thought. The Immortal version of it was mentioned in 'The Legends of Ren Zu', but even then, it had little power other than being able to drive away Predicaments. What ultimately happened to Hope Gu once Ren Zu and his children had entered Derivation Gu was not mentioned in the tales, so it was anybody's guess as to what that was.
Even then, Hope Gu was essentially a consumable gu as a mortal gu. It was a bad idea to make it into your vital gu for that reason, even if it might have gained a function when it became an immortal gu.
The scene then shifted to Fang Yuan facing off against someone.
Thanks to his reflexes, he was able to just barely dodge the fist coming his way before he tripped his opponent.
The attack had come out of nowhere from his point of view, and he had not been given time to observe his surroundings before the dream realm had shifted.
He only had a breath's time to take the field into account, but that was more than enough.
It appeared that these two people were sparring somewhere in private, one-on-one. His vital gu within his aperture was the Hope Gu, as well as a different gu worm that he did not recognize. Rank 2 Initial Stage primeval essence filled his aperture.
"Not bad, I really thought that I'd gotten you there," his opponent said with a smile.
Based on how they were fighting, Fang Yuan quickly assessed that this was not a serious life-or-death battle and more likely than not a spar.
Out of the corner of his eye, he spotted a girl.
Both the boy he was sparring against and the girl who was watching the two of them looked vaguely familiar- they were the two who had cheered this person on when they had found out that he was a B-grade talent.
'Should I use a gu worm?' Fang Yuan thought. It seemed that this fight was restricted to physical fighting as it was, and his opponent had not used anything as of yet.
If he used a gu worm if the terms of this fight beforehand had been to refrain from using them, he would fail the dream realm and be ejected. His opponent was Rank 1 Peak Stage, so it could be a possibility.
He only briefly thought of this as the opponent struck out at him.
'His moves are rather wild and inexperienced,' Fang Yuan noted. He placed his opponent's fighting prowess as slightly lower than Fang Zheng's current level.
Fang Yuan swept out his opponent's feet from under him before dealing several blows to his solar plexus.
"Ugh!" the boy said, rolling around the arena, clutching his chest. He struggled to get up. "Couldn't you have gone a little bit easier, man?"
Fang Yuan did not really know what the meaning of 'going easy' was, but if this was a friendly fight, he should probably avoid certain blows.
"I got carried away, is all," Fang Yuan said.
They charged at each other again, with Fang Yuan limiting his attacks somewhat and trying to disable his opponent without causing much pain.
"Argh!" his opponent said, falling to the ground. He stared at Fang Yuan with gritted teeth before saying, "Alright, I concede, you've won."
Fang Yuan walked away, though as he did so, a sudden sense of regret and sadness assaulted him.The latest_epɪ_sodes are on_the
'What's going on? Didn't I win?'
Those were his last thoughts before he was ejected from the dream realm.
The damage to his soul was rather minimal, thankfully, and he had Guts Gu to repair his soul.
However, he still couldn't wrap his mind around what he had done wrong. He didn't have [Unravel Dream] or a similar ability to make exploring this dream realm easier, so he could only reflect and somewhat try things through trial and error.
'I did something wrong...' Fang Yuan thought. 'Was I supposed to lose on purpose? No, I wasn't ejected after winning, but after I had walked away after my victory. If those two people were friends than that means... was something else supposed to happen?'
Fang Yuan entered the dream realm once again.

chapters.title: Chapter 134 - 134: Refining Hope Gu: Part Two
chapters.content:
Fang Yuan entered the dream realm once again.
This time, he was fully prepared for the punch that was being thrown at him, and so he was able to weave away. "That was a good one," the boy in front of him said yet again.
They continued to spar, though Fang Yuan was holding back. His reasoning was that he had already failed at this juncture and was trying to determine what it was that he had to do to succeed.
Based on what he understood, this fight was entirely physical and did not involve gu worms at all. More likely than not, that was because the person he currently was had Rank Two cultivation, while the other only had Rank One. That meant that there was a massive gap between the two of them when it came to cultivation and that he would win without a doubt if they had a real fight. They had likely agreed to fight using only their fists so that this would not become an issue.
However, at the same time, they were not fighting in a public place, but rather a rather secluded arena away from prying eyes.
Aside from the girl standing there, who seemed to already know the two of them well. Additionally, there was no true malice in his opponent's strikes.
He didn't seem to be trying to actually hurt Fang Yuan, but at the same time, he did not want to give up either.
'What are these two fighting for?' Fang Yuan thought to himself. He felt that if he knew what the purpose of their match was, whether it was a simple practice match or something else, it would make him realize what the purpose of this dream realm was and what the criteria for solving it were.
"You're a bit distracted," Fang Yuan noted, as his opponent kept glancing over to a certain spot on the field, towards the girl. 'Could it be?' Fang Yuan thought to himself, feeling that he had solved it. There was only one real way for him to figure it out. He went in this time fighting for real, though he once again avoided hitting his opponent in any painful area.
"Whoa, whoa! Calm down there," his opponent said. Once he had caught his breath, "Gosh, where did you learn to fight like that? And were you holding back all the way up until now?" He let out a small chuckle.
Last time, Fang Yuan had walked away after winning the fight, expecting the dream realm to be over. But that clearly wasn't all of it. He instead walked over to his opponent and extended his hand. "Need some help getting up?"
"Yeah, I'd appreciate it," his opponent said as he grabbed onto Fang Yuan's hand and then pulled himself up. His opponent then slapped him on the shoulder. "All right then, Fang Yuan. Like we said, it looks like you won. You really are the better man, huh?"
"Are the two of you done now?" the girl asked, sighing. As Fang Yuan got a closer look at her, he noted that she had some rather striking features. Her cheeks were a bit fuller, but she had a pair of striking blue eyes, which was rare in the Southern Border. She also had Rank One Peak Stage cultivation. Her dress was somewhat above average so she likely had somewhat wealthy parents.
Her features were marred slightly by the fact that she had crossed her arms and was pouting. Still, it could be said that she appeared somewhat cute, even then.
"Yeah, we're done. You don't need to worry, Teng Mei," his opponent said.
Fang Yuan found that he was no longer in control of this person's body anymore. So he had passed this section of the dream realm, although it had not concluded as of yet.Thɪs updatᴇd by
"You didn't need to take things so far, Teng Ling," the girl answered. "And don't you think it's a bit much? Teng Mingyu only just returned from a difficult mission, and then you already challenged him to a fight. You should have some concern and respect for the position he's in and the fact that he might be tired. Couldn't you have challenged him another day?"
"Hey, Teng Mingyu, isn't tired, and he could have always said no if he wanted to, right? Yeah, that's right," Teng Ling answered. "Hey, uh, listen, Teng Mei, you can go on ahead. I have something I just wanted to speak to him about."
"All right then. I'll wait for you. Do you want to meet up at the same wine tavern shop?"
"Of course," Teng Mingyu said. "This time, the drinks are on me. Consider it a celebration of my victory."
"All right then," she said. "I'll look forward to it." She trotted off.
Teng Ling turned towards Teng Mingyu. "So I guess that really settles it. Then you are the better man between the two of us. I won't get in your way, as promised." The person who Fang Yuan was inhabiting was filled with a degree of remorse and sorrow, though it was not as much as before, and he was not kicked out of the dream realm this time. "Hope that you can keep Teng Mei happy!"
Fang Yuan had indeed managed to figure out what was going on. These three people had likely been friends since childhood, based on how they had reacted towards this person when he was revealed to have B-grade aptitude even if both of them were ordinary.
Now, they had graduated from the academy, and he was leaving the others behind in the dust when it came to cultivation. While these two boys were friends, something had come between them. Ultimately, what was the most common reason for men to fight? It was over a woman. Both of them likely loved that girl, and so to settle things between them without it turning sour, they had arranged this little spar in her presence, agreeing to not use gu worms so that Teng Mingyu would not have that much of an advantage.
The reason that Fang Yuan had failed the dream realm last time was because although Teng Mingyu had wanted to win, he also didn't want to jeopardize his friendship either. When Fang Yuan had just walked off after defeating his opponent, such a cold gesture would not have been received well.
"You fought bravely," Teng Mingyu said. "You have nothing to feel ashamed about, and I'm sure you'll find someone."
"Yeah, yeah," Teng Ling said. "Listen, before you go, I just want to give you this to show that there were no hard feelings between the two of us." He took out a gu from his aperture, which looked like two tiny human hands clasped together, though it seemed to be made out of woven grass rather than actual flesh.
"This is..." Teng Mingyu said, "isn't this Friendship Gu? Didn't you have to spend a large amount of time to get this? Are you really giving it to me?"
"Well, it is Friendship Gu after all," Teng Ling said. "It has a portion of my will inside and also has a portion of Teng Mei's inside as well. No matter where you go on your missions or however you manage to climb, or even if all of us become separated sometime in the future, this way we can always be with you."
Fang Yuan had heard of Friendship Gu in his past life, so as he took it, it seemed to be a Gu that could store the wills of one's friends for some time. It also appeared to be a Human Path Gu worm, much like Charity Gu.
"Thank you," Teng Mingyu said after receiving the Friendship Gu.

chapters.title: Chapter 135 - 135: Refining Hope Gu: Part Three
chapters.content:
The dream then shifted. Fang Yuan felt a portion of his understanding of the Human Path increase. It was still at the Master level, but there were still grades within each attainment level, and he felt like he understood the Human Path more deeply, even if it had not undergone a qualitative change to the next level. One could still make gains by exploring even parts of dream realms successfully.
He then found himself inside a house. 'So this is the next stage of the dream realm, then', Fang Yuan thought to himself. An elderly man was sitting across from him, and as Fang Yuan examined his aperture, it looked like he was still Teng Mingyu, as his vital gu was still the Rank One Hope Gu.
"Teng Mingyu," the elderly man said. "Are you sure that you wish to do this? There are other ways around this, you know."
"I'm sure of it," Fang Yuan felt that person say. He no longer had control over this person's body. "I want to try to refine my vital gu further."
"I honestly don't even know what you were thinking," the man replied. "Why did you choose Hope Gu as your vital gu? No one has ever done that before."
"Father, I..." he began. "I don't know what it was, but while I was there in the primal spring, I just felt it, almost as if it was calling to me, as if it was meant to be my vital gu. That was how I refined it so quickly."
His father shook his head. "Regardless. Do you really think that you can advance Hope Gu further?"
"I do think so, Father. Please, as one of the elders of the clan, can't you just get me at least 10 minutes? The underground cavern is a sacred place."
The man's father answered, "However, I will see what I can do. If you were an elder by this point, you would have no problem arranging for this by yourself."
"That would take a large amount of time, Father," Teng Mingyu said. "And I would prefer to start getting to it faster."
The dream shifted to another scene.
"I'm sorry, my boy," his father said. "The clan rejected your request."
"I guess there's nothing that can be done to help it," Teng Mingyu said, returning to his room to cultivate. "Once I become an elder, I'll see who stops me then."
The scene shifted again. Now Teng Mingyu was holding the arm of a woman dressed as his bride. That woman was Teng Mei. It looked like Fang Yuan had been transported to the day the two of them were married.ɴᴇᴡ ɴᴏᴠᴇʟ ᴄʜᴀᴘᴛᴇʀs ᴀʀᴇ ᴘᴜʙʟɪsʜᴇᴅ ᴏɴ
The marriage ceremony differed slightly from Gu villages' tradition, but that was to be expected. There are small variations in tradition from village to village, even on the same mountain, let alone between such large time periods. Even if this also occurred on the Southern Border, Fang Yuan felt that Teng Mingyu had finally advanced to Rank Three, although his vital Gu was still the Rank One Hope Gu.
Many people came up to congratulate him. Among them was Teng Ling, who had now advanced to Rank Two. "Congratulations!" he said, smiling widely.
Even though Tang Mingyu was smiling as he took the man's hand, Fang Yuan could feel his remorse and sorrow. There were still some regrets emerging from this interaction. For a moment, it was just the three of them together, and then an odd, awkward pause passed between the three of them before it ended. "Thank you," he said.
The scene then shifted once more as Teng Mingyu was walking down a set of stairs. "I will only need 15 minutes for this small project," he explained to the guard leading him. "I intend to try to advance my vital gu here."
"As it is, Elder Teng Mingyu," the guard said, bowing before he left. The clan's primal spring was an area that could not be accessed by anyone. After all, if it was damaged in any way, it would completely cripple the foundation of the clan.
Such was the case everywhere as Fang Yuan hadn't been allowed to visit his until he had become an elder.
The guard left Teng Mingyu alone as he walked back up the stairs.
Teng Mingyu approached the primeval spring and took out his vital gu from his aperture. He also had a storage-type gu worm from which he removed a large number of primeval stones.
Then, Fang Yuan found himself in control once more.
'What am I supposed to do here?' Fang Yuan thought. The numerous Hope Gu emitted faint lights in the primeval spring, which in the darkness made them shine like a sea of stars at night.
The sight, while beautiful, did nothing to help him with this current problem.
'Refining Hope Gu to the next step?' he thought would be the logical next step, only he had no idea what kind of experiment that Teng Mingyu intended to do here. Neither did he have any experience with something like this. 'Why couldn't he just pick a normal Vital Gu?' Fang Yuan mused as he examined his aperture.
There were a number of gu worms there of Rank 2 which he did not recognize- but in addition to Rank 1 Hope Gu there was one gu worm that he could identify as likely belonging to the Human Path, though he had never seen it before. Friendship Gu still dwelled in his aperture, appearing to have been unchanged since Teng Mingyu had obtained it all those years ago.
With no leads, Fang Yuan went to Teng Mingyu's storage-type gu worm to see if he had left anything there. There was something- a piece of paper which had scribbling on it.
'This person's handwriting is atrocious,' Fang Yuan thought to himself. 'He would be a perfect physician back on Earth judged on that fact.'
The writing was not only bad, but also written haphazardly in various directions with sections crossed out. It also looked like Teng Mingyu had spilled some kind of dark liquid over the paper.
What he could make out read out as:
