While it looked like the battle was over with the Gu Yue clansmen now easily chasing and hunting the lightning wolves with ease, Fang Yuan immediately noticed the anomaly on the battlefield. A place where the wolves were gathering en masse even though it was not the ideal place ot gather to either fight or flee.
And as expected, one of those wolves suddenly burst forward with a Rank 4 aura, standing upon its hind legs and waddling around like a kangaroo, eyes radiating murderous intent as it glared at Fang Yuan.ɴᴇᴡ ɴᴏᴠᴇʟ ᴄʜᴀᴘᴛᴇʀs ᴀʀᴇ ᴘᴜʙʟɪsʜᴇᴅ ᴏɴ NovᴇlFɪre.ɴet
The Lightning Lycan King had made its appearance!

chapters.title: Chapter 147 - 147: Strike Force: Part Ten
chapters.content:
The Lightning Lycan King roared as it revealed itself.
Fang Yuan no longer felt it necessary to hold back, tossing aside the Training Weights Gu and revealing his Rank 4 aura.
He had barely used up a single primeval stone to recover some essence when the Lightning Lycan King launched a thunderbolt at him. Then again, this is exactly what he had been preparing for, activating his Moonlight Plate Armor Gu.
It absorbed the impact, even if it drained away much of his remaining primal essence. The silvery armor still stood firm under the assault, and more importantly, this meant that the same attack could not be used again for some time.
The Crimsonhoof Deer gave Fang Yuan a small snort. He understood what that meant.
It was saying that its debt had been repaid and that it was going now. Fang Yuan felt his mental connection with its mother break.
From now on, if Fang Yuan wanted its help, he would have to find a way to enslave it directly.
With his Rank 4 strength and the resources of the clan freely available to him along with his Grandmaster attainment in the Blood Path, this was not impossible. However, it could not be done in the middle of a battlefield.
As it was, the Crimsonhoof Deer had already played its role, blocking off the retreat of the wolves so that they were in their current situation, boxed in, and finally put in a difficult spot.
Fang Yuan let the deer leave as the elders who had been kept in reserve now launched forward. As its most powerful offensive option could not be activated again for some time, Fang Yuan revealed another one of his trump cards.
His Lightning Lord Wings Gu activated; a set of wings bursting from his back as he made a beeline directly for the Lightning Lycan King once he had recovered more of his primal essence. This time, however, had allowed it to recover to some extent. And it roared, assembling the wolves in a tight formation as it launched yet another lightning bolt at Fang Yuan. This time, he did not activate his defensive Gu worm and simply avoided it., folding his wings so he dropped through the air before opening them up again, dodging crashing with the ground by a hair's breadth.
"What skill!" someone yelled out, seeing this.Nᴇw novel chapters are publɪshed on
"Where did he learn to do that?" another person exclaimed!
Mo Chen and Chi Lian were both dumbfounded. What Fang Yuan had done right now had required extreme control and maneuvering in a three-dimensional space. Most people, of course, were only used to fighting in two dimensions.
For Fang Yuan to do this, dodging an extremely fast attack from the Lightning Lycan King, spoke to a level of skill which would have required years of practice.
To its credit, the Lightning Lycan King seemed to realize that the odds were stacked against it, as a dark ball began to emerge from its mouth. However, before it could unleash its Wolf Smoke Gu, Fang Yuan was already in range to strike.
"Rank 4 Testicular Torsion Gu!"
Fang Yuan had been able to take this gu worm from the clan's underground storage after he had become Rank 4 after spending some primeval stones. He had used his cultivation blessing on it to advance it to Rank 4, since he didn't know the recipe for advancing it further.
This was not the first time that Fang Yuan had brutally assaulted a wolf's reproductive organs, nor would this be the last.
Its effect was immediate- the Lightning Lycan King abandoned the use of Wolf Smoke Gu to create a smoke screen and instead used it to heal its own wounds. If Testicular Torsion Gu had only been Rank 3, this might have healed it completely. But for now, it could only somewhat dull the pain as Fang Yuan let out a Blood Moonblade at it.
It howled in pain as it could not use Wolf Smoke Gu to deal with this new injury as it began bleeding out.
It snarled at Fang Yuan. However, it could not use its lightning bolt strike again in such a short interval of time. The other wolves came to support it given its situation. However, they were blocked by a wall of vines.
"Fang Yuan! Go ahead!" Qing Shu shouted. "We'll hold the others back!" The other elders had also caught up with him, clearing out the battlefield so that Fang Yuan could concentrate on the Lightning Lycan King. Fang Yuan did not land throughout the fight. Instead, he deftly weaved through the air, completely confusing the Lightning Lycan King. It, despite its intelligence, had no idea what to do against such a foe. That said, even a trained Rank 4 Gu Master, such as any of the clan heads, would have had trouble dealing with Fang Yuan with his flying mastery.
The Lightning Lycan King howled once more, but this was less of a thundering command from a powerful monarch and more of a pitiful cry for help. As Fang Yuan landed another blow on its chest, it could sense that its time had come.
Someone shouted, "Thunder Crown Wolf!" It looked like another Rank 4 Beast King had been in the area and was coming in to reinforce it.
Either that, or its cry right now had been a signal for that other Rank 4 Beast King.
Fang Yuan responded, "Tell everyone who is in the way of that Beast King to retreat. Let us all regroup after I finish off this Lightning Lycan King. Then give me enough time to replenish my primal essence, and we will deal with it."
"Are you sure you can fight two of them in a row?" Qing Shu asked.
He had not been forced to expend much of his own primal essence up till now even while fighting the Thousand Beast Kings, given that he was Rank 3. But he would not be much use even with Wood Charm Gu against a Rank 4 opponent. And though he had seen Fang Yuan's battle prowess, to fight a Rank 4 Beast King was one thing, but to fight two of them was something completely else.
"Yes, it'll be fine," Fang Yuan said. He had an advantage that the others didn't know about, as he decapitated the Lightning Lycan King, ending its life.
Mission successful!
Yellow Gold Relic Gu (x1) has been added to your inventory.
Fang Yuan immediately withdrew it and used it. The yellow primal essence within his primal aperture immediately concentrated and became darker. To break through another realm in cultivation while in the middle of a fight was unheard of. Though, even if anyone had realized what he had done, which they would soon enough, they could have little cause to complain given the situation they were in.
The scouts had abandoned their position, fleeing from the Thunder Crown Wolf. The remaining wolves were invigorated at the sight that they were going to be reinforced before they were swiftly killed by the neighboring Gu Masters. Fang Yuan, as he replenished his primal essence, went to go retrieve the Rank 4 Testicular Torsion Gu from the Lightning Lycan King.
Once this gu was used, it fused to the opponent's testicles. So, if one wanted to reuse it, they would have to remove them from their opponent after use. However, it took time for the gu worm to detach and so could not be used rapidly in succession.
So, Fang Yuan would have to deal with this Thunder Crown Wolf without relying upon it.

chapters.title: Chapter 148 - 148: Fang Yuan Becomes Clan Head: Part One
chapters.content:
The Thunder Crown Wolf glared at their formation. There were several elders in front of Fang Yuan, with Qing Shu and Gu Yue Han Lin at their head.
The Thunder Crown Wolf must have noted the numerous Rank 3 Gu Masters which stood in front of it. For a Rank 4 Beast King, even dealing with a dozen of them would not have been impossible.
However, it could still sense Fang Yuan's aura from behind them. It had likely come in a hurry in order to reinforce the Lightning Lycan King. However, the Lightning Lycan King was already dead. Upon realizing that, while it was angry, it was not stupid either.
It might have lacked the intelligence of the Lightning Lycan King, but it could make simple calculations on risks and benefits. It realized that it could not get to Fang Yuan in time before he could recover. Even if it charged with all of its might, in order to get her as fast as it could, it had abandoned the wolf pack which normally surrounded it, so it did not have reinforcements either.
Now that the Lightning Lycan King was already dead, there was little to no benefit of it attacked anyway. Although both of them were Myriad Beast Kings and potential competitors for resources, it was also true that they cooperated much like the clans did so that they could deal with the Gu Masters to some capacity.
However, it was too late.
Given this fact, it snarled, gave them all a death glare, and decided to turn tail and fight some other day. The Gu Masters cheered, though Fang Yuan did not relax yet. He continued to refill his primal essence, and by now, his Rank 4 middle stage aura had leaked to everyone there. While there were only two Elders who knew of the prophecy of the Ancient Yin Desolate Moon physique, the knowledge of the Ten Extreme Physiques was less closely guarded.
Mo Chen and Chi Lian might've connected the dots by now.
Even if they knew though- what could they do at this point? Fang Yuan was powerful enough now that he could almost disregard them entirely.ɪꜰ ʏᴏᴜ ᴡᴀɴᴛ ᴛᴏ ʀᴇᴀᴅ ᴍᴏʀᴇ ᴄʜᴀᴘᴛᴇʀs, ᴘʟᴇᴀsᴇ ᴠɪsɪᴛ NovᴇlFɪre.nᴇt
With the departure of the Thunder Crown Wolf the Gu Masters cheered.
Fang Yuan considered going after the Thunder Crown Wolf, but then changed his mind. If they went after it, they would also run into its own reinforcements.
They had barely been able to succeed today, mainly because they had the element of surprise with them, and also because of help from the Crimsonhoof Deer and its herd.
As it was, with one of the Rank 4 Beast Kings taken care of, the wolf tide was no longer as threatening as it had been before.
The Gu Masters returned to the village victorious. Casualties were extremely low, mainly thanks to Fang Yuan's quick work and foresight, which had allowed this mission to be successful in the first place.
While many were happy about their success, there was also the fact that this would greatly increase Fang Yuan's reputation, which is something some of them may have wanted to avoid. However, faced with the threat of the Lightning Lycan King, they had no real choice other than to band together for this effort.
Fang Yuan gently walked the steps towards the clan head's house. "We were successful," he told the clan head.
"Good work, Fang Yuan," the clan head said.
There was a small ceremony to celebrate their victory as good news was rather rare during these dark times. And since they had been able to deal with the Lightning Lycan King, the future wolf attacks would likely be less lethal. As it was, they still had the benefit of having two Rank 4 Gu Masters, unlike the other villages.
There was music and dancing and some food stalls set up. The weekly quotas for many of the Gu Masters were decreased given the slaughter that the elders had engaged in made such things unnecessary.
The head of the Lightning Lycan King was placed on a pike and then passed around through the village as a symbol of what Fang Yuan had accomplished.
As for its other parts, they were harvested as resources that could potentially be used. Fang Yuan had collected some of its blood for a project he had in mind in the future.
It was one of the few bright days in the villager's memory ever since the wolf tide had begun.
"Hello, everyone!" the clan head announced towards the end of the ceremony. "I'm sure that all of you have heard of Fang Yuan's valor in dealing with the Lightning Lycan King. Thanks to him, our village is in a far more secure position than it was before." The clan head had not been blind to Fang Yuan's sudden increase in cultivation, which now matched his own level. At Rank 4, even the difference of a minor realm could greatly affect the outcome of any battle.
And to the clan head, it was clear that with the Ancient Yin Desolate Moon physique, Fang Yuan would soon become the strongest Gu Master on Qing Mao mountain.
He continued, "Fang Yuan's actions have proven that he is a capable leader, despite his young age. And that is why I feel that I would be quite comfortable leaving the running of this village in his hands." There were several audible gasps at that from the crowd, although many of the elders had already been expecting this.
A mountain could not hold two tigers, and with two Rank 4 Gu Masters with similar cultivation, it was obvious that there would be a clash between the two of them sooner or later. Such a thing had not happened up till now, mainly because Fang Yuan already belonged to the clan head's faction and because of the wolf tide.
But sooner or later, one of them was bound to give, and there would be a fight to determine who the next clan head would be.
'So, it looks like he would prefer to step down rather than force Fang Yuan to fight him,' Mo Chen thought.
He did not know the prophecy of the Ancient Yin Desolate Moon physique, nor did he think that Fang Yuan had managed to get approval from the founder of their clan. As a matter of fact, he did not even know that the first generation Gu Yue was still alive, so he did not have an idea about the bigger picture as to why the Clan Head had decided to willingly step down.
Fang Yuan pretended to act surprised as he made his way to the front of the stage. Everyone calmed down at that point, wondering what their new clan leader was going to say. "Everyone, I must say that I am so grateful to have obtained this opportunity!" Fang Yuan began. "I have been nurtured by this village ever since I was born, and I would love nothing but to continue working for the happiness and safety of all of my fellow clansmen, much as my Senior Brother Qing Shu and esteemed Clan Head Gu Yue Bo have done in the past. It is with this heart filled with aspirations that I accept this role of Clan Head and hope to guide you all through the tumultuous times that this wolf tide has brought upon us. However, I want you all to remember that the Gu Yue Clan is the strongest clan on Qing Mao Mountain, and we will continue to be for the future as well!" There were many cheers at this.

chapters.title: Chapter 149 - 149: Fang Yuan Becomes Clan Head: Part Two
chapters.content:
A notification popped up in Fang Yuan's mind even as he accepted everyone's congratulations.
Main Mission accomplished!Tʜe source of this ᴄontent ɪs NovᴇlFɪre.ɴet
Congratulations! You have become clan head and will get five Human Path dao marks every single day that you continue to be clan head.
There are some requirements in order to still be considered clan head, however.
For one, the clan itself must exist, and the population of Gu Yue clansmen must be at least3,000 or higher.
Secondly, the host must continue to perform his duties as Clan Head, with the exception of a few emergencies that might make it difficult for him to continue with or require deferment of the same.
Thirdly, the host must strive to create a safe and secure environment for the rest of the clan to grow or endeavor for the same as much as possible.
Fang Yuan frowned slightly. There was no such requirement when he had become class president or a clan Elder.
Then again, their reward was much higher- seven times the amount of dao marks he was getting before. He could, in a single month, get as many dao marks as one would normally get from an earthly tribulation.
One could not consider that to be a small amount. However, it was clear that the system wanted him to take an active role as clan head and not merely exploit the clan for all of its resources and then bail after he had finished extracting them.
'What are all of these restrictions, system? Aren't you being too shameless- offering me a reward and then adding in terms and conditions afterwards?'
System is simply setting up restrictions. If the host believes the rewards are not adequate, the host is free to do whatsoever the host wishes.
Fang Yuan sighed inwardly. The rewards were indeed great- which is why he would have to put up with things for the moment.
That didn't mean Fang Yuan wasn't going to try milking the clan for all it was worth, though.
Fang Yuan, now that he was clan head, had access to multiple things that he didn't before.
For one, he could choose to borrow almost any gu worm or gu worm recipe within the clan storage without even having to pay any contribution points - with certain small restrictions, though even those were negligible.
Of course, even with his increased wealth as clan head, he could not feed so many gu worms by himself.
The reason why he wanted access to many of these gu worms was for the future. The Crimsonhoof Deer would not reach Rank 4 for a while, even with the help of Rank 3 Beast Mutation Gu, and so it would not have many Rank 4 or even Rank 3 Blood Path Gu worms on it by the time that Fang Yuan needed it.
However, there were many gu worms and resources for refinement in the clan's underground storage.
Fang Yuan's experience as a Grandmaster in the Blood Path allowed him to use these resources to recreate some of the Blood Path Gu worms he had made during his previous life. There was a limit to this, of course.
Despite all of his efforts, he was only able to create and/or obtain a total of fourteen Blood Path gu worms. Many of them were only Rank 1 or 2, with only six of them being Rank 3 or higher.
However, even if they were weak individually, they could create an extraordinarily powerful Blood Path mortal killer move when combined.
Fang Yuan was basing all of this on a killer move that he had created in his past life as a Blood Path Gu Immortal, though he had to make many modifications given the lack of Gu worms. It also required some testing, though thanks to the simplicity of working with only a few gu worms as compared to hundreds, he succeeded relatively easily.
The main problem, of course, was the fact that Fang Yuan did not have the required primal essence to use so many gu worms at once!
That was why his plan for the future relied upon killing the first generation Gu Yue and gaining access to that drop of green grape immortal essence that the system had promised him.
Fang Yuan could, with some experimentation, modify these gu worms to create a small mortal Gu House that could use that bead of immortal essence so that it could be used over and over without limit.
It was not possible for Fang Yuan to use foreign immortal essence directly- but that was the benefit of Gu Houses. They could take the immortal essence of multiple people without any issues.
Gu houses could be considered to be similar to killer moves in the fact that they used multiple gu worms, however, Gu Houses were far less flexible when it came to modifying them. That was why they had their downsides as well as upsides. Fang Yuan had not attempted to create one before. Lack of resources was only one of the reasons why, but the main reason was that he wouldn't have had enough primeval essence to be able to use one.
During the time that he had been the Supreme Elder of the Blood Wing Demon Sect, he had attempted to use his knowledge to create a Gu House that might give his disciples an edge during combat. His creation at the time had involved about sixty mortal gu worms- which was by no means huge by the standards of Gu Houses, but even that proved impossible for the other members of his sect, who were all mortal, to use for longer than a two breaths of time.
It was just that the demand placed on one's primeval essence in order to use a gu house was immense- there was no way that a mortal could possibly sustain it. It was only when one turned immortal- and had the equivalent of infinite primeval essence when speaking of mortal gu worms, that one could begin using them.
The Gu House in question was too weak for his own usage, and Fang Yuan had eventually abandoned it, but it served as good experience for his current endeavor in creating a much smaller one.
Aside from attempting to formulate this Blood Path Gu House, Fang Yuan also started to refine the Hope Gu located in the underground cavern. He could now leave and visit whenever he wanted, and with the help of Integration Gu and some trial and error, he was able to advance Hope Gu to Rank 2 at first and then Rank 3.
He had also thought of another killer move which he could use with his primal essence, which involved the use of Integration Gu, Hope Gu, and a Blood Path Gu worm- as well as modifying the killer move that he had used during the dream realm involving the Teng Clan.
While it was well and good to have a plan to try and deal with Lord Sky Crane, he first needed to figure out a way to deal with first gen Gu Yue.
'A pity that I cannot have access to his gu worms yet,' Fang Yuan thought. Those Blood Path gu worms could've been helpful in constructing an even bigger gu house, but there was no way that he would be able to do so in the middle of a fight.
He thought of sneaking into the Blood River Graveyard, but then dismissed that idea. He didn't actually have first gen Gu Yue's blessing, after all, and that would just be courting death at this point.

chapters.title: Chapter 150 - 150: Fang Yuan Becomes Clan Head: Part Three
chapters.content:
Fang Zheng's life had been somewhat hectic as of late.
Things had been relatively simpler before, especially when compared to the other members of the Gu Yue clan.
With Fang Yuan's help, he did not lack for primeval stones nor a secure place to sleep at night. He also had someone who would help him with his required quota of wolf-killing missions, on top of which no one dared to create trouble or problems for him, because even when Fang Yuan had just been just Rank 3...
...
Fang Zheng shook his head. To think that there had been a time when he thought Rank 3 was the pinnacle of what his brother would reach... only for his brother to have broken that barrier completely and reached Rank 4 and making a nonsense of the reputation of a Rank 3 Gu Master.
Not only that, his older brother was now clan head. While Fang Zheng was quite happy for Fang Yuan's advancement, especially as Fang Yuan had not thrown him out like he had feared, Fang Yuan, after becoming clan head, was now far busier than before.
Fang Zheng no longer bothered wasting his time trying to work on the Nine Leaf Vitality Grass Gu. That was small fry compared to the resources that Fang Yuan now had, which was 10,000 primeval stones each week.
With that said, of course, such resources did not come without any strings attached to them. The weight of the village now rested entirely on his elder brother's shoulders.
Fang Zheng found himself dealing with many of the matters that Fang Yuan thought were either too troublesome or just beneath his notice. So he sent Fang Zheng to do them instead.
Other than Fang Zheng, Qing Shu and Han Lin were both firmly in Fang Yuan's faction, and were also assisting him with tasks so that Fang Yuan could take some time to cultivate.Tʜe source of this ᴄontent ɪs NoᴠᴇFɪre.nᴇt
Fang Zheng did not fully understand what kind of experiments his brother was working on, but hopefully they would bear fruit in the upcoming fight.
While it was common for the clan head to neglect his cultivation once he achieved that position, Fang Zheng found that he was also neglecting his own cultivation while simply running around to get Fang Yuan's tasks done. However, he also understood that with the threat of the wolf tide, Fang Yuan couldn't help him as he had promised earlier.
And though Fang Zheng had to work hard, Fang Yuan had now told him that he would start to help him get a leg up and get to Rank 3 once the threat of the wolf tide was done. He had already been given a Red Steel Relic Gu by his elder brother and was promised another soon enough.
'Was this the location?'
Perhaps. It was dark and dirty, which many of the alleyways within Gu Yue Village were, given the current circumstances. However, there was something in particular that he was looking for. 'It was supposed to be here.'
He fidgeted with some of the stones which looked like they had been moved, before making his way through a narrow passage.
There's a voice coming out from up ahead.
"Welcome! Welcome! I see that you're looking for some... entertainment during these trying times."
"Yes, some cheap entertainment."
"One primal stone is more than enough for a night."
"One primal stone?" the other voice asked angrily. "Wasn't it half just a week ago?"
"Yes, it was half just a week ago, however, times change. The clan head has begun cracking down on one of our other locations- AIEEEE!" the man who was speaking shouted out as Fang Zheng crawled out of the side entrance and gripped onto his shoulder.
This was a Rank 1 Gu Master, judging by both his plate and his aura, and he was stooped over a counter in a small room, which was extremely grimy and very dimly lit. The person who was speaking to him was actually one of Fang Zheng's former friends who was helping him out with this little mission.
The Rank 1 Gu Master tried to bolt, perhaps thinking that Fang Zheng was actually Fang Yuan. Actually, now that Fang Zheng thought about it, if he thought that it was Fang Yuan, he wouldn't have thought that he would've had a chance to escape.
The man didn't get any further than five steps before Fang Zheng tripped him. "Now, do you want to come quietly, or should we do this the hard way?" Fang Zheng asked. He unleashed his Rank 2 aura, which was nowhere near as threatening as Fang Yuan's Rank 4 aura. However, to a Rank 1 logistics Gu Master, this was more than enough.
"Uh, Lord Fang Zheng," the Gu Master replied, trying to act innocent despite the clear evidence of what he was doing. "What could possibly bring you here?"
"Your gig's up," Fang Zheng said. "I know all about your little business here."
In times like the wolf tide, death was hanging above nearly everyone's head.
It would naturally promote risky behaviors and other mechanisms to cope as many people didn't know whether tomorrow would be their last: like smoking or drinking or gambling, or in certain people's cases, visiting brothels.
After all, fighting all day kicked something in the survival instincts of many male Gu Masters, and the release of such energy helped them calm down.
Brothels by themselves were not illegal within Gu Yue village. The issue was that this Gu Master had been inviting mortal women who had nowhere else to go and exploiting them for his own gain. Some of the women employed in the other locations that they had raided, were not even aware of what they had signed up to do until they were dragged to a dark room to do whatever the customer asked.
The old clan head had let such matters slide, mainly because it was only happening to mortal women, and he did feel that the soldiers needed some form of relaxation. However, Fang Yuan had decided to put his foot down and close down these sorts of places.
"It is... do you want a cut of the profits? I can give you 20, no, 30, if you just..." the Gu Master began to mumble before Fang Zheng rolled his eyes and dragged him outside. "Relax, so long as you don't blabber more, at most we'll give you some beatings, and then you can get back to work." The reason for such treatment was that the clan did not want to lose any fighters, not even Rank 1 Gu Masters.
This person was just a logistics Gu Master, and as such, could get back to work relatively quickly, even after being forced to endure several strokes of the bamboo rod.
Fang Zheng signaled for some of his other comrades to step inside the building and take care of the women trapped inside. "I don't like having to deal with women," Fang Zheng said, dragging the Gu Master back towards the Clan Head's Pavilion for punishment.
While Fang Zheng was more than happy to comply with Fang Yuan's request, he couldn't help but feel that Fang Yuan was being a bit too generous and kind.
Many of his requests involved distributing food or primal stones to certain beggars and the like. Fang Zheng solidly believed that he needed to strengthen himself.
Otherwise, if he was too generous, then someone would take advantage of his weakness.
After all, although Fang Yuan was quite strong, it wasn't like the other clans had nothing up their sleeves. It was rumored that the Bai clan's Bai Ning Bing could somewhat even fight on the level of Rank 4 Beast Kings now.
If such were the case, then Fang Yuan needed to be on guard and needed to focus on his own cultivation. He had expressed such to his brother many times, though his brother had simply waved his hand during these occasions and said that they still needed to look after the welfare of everyone living in the village. "After all, that's what being a righteous clan leader means," Fang Yuan had said.

chapters.title: Chapter 151 - 151: Fang Yuan Becomes Clan Head: Part Four
chapters.content:
Three weeks later, the wolf tide attacked in full force, matching up with Fang Yuan's expectations.
The Lightning Lycan King had struck them in a pincer movement after wiping out the Xiong Clan last time around. However, the Lightning Lycan King had now been removed from the equation completely.
The Thunder Crown Wolf would soon make its appearance though, but they would not have to deal with reinforcements like they had to last time around. This time, the old clan head stood near the front lines, while Fang Yuan stayed in the rear, ready to intervene in case anything went wrong.
New main mission unlocked!
Would you choose the man or the bear?
Description: Save Gu Yue Yao Le from the bear.
Reward: One Yellow Gold Relic Gu (x1)
This was what Fang Yuan had been expecting. And Charity Gu was already primed for use, even though things should have gone far smoother this time.
With that said, although the enemy was weaker now, Fang Yuan was no longer soaring over them and striking them with his Rank 4 attacks like his previous lifetime. The former clan head out there fighting instead, but he could not rival Fang Yuan's skills with flying.
While it would have been better for Fang Yuan to have set out, this was another restriction of working as the clan head. He had to respond to other things going on in the battlefield, and had to keep himself reserved in case something unexpected happened.
Casualties were now beginning to pile up despite their best efforts. Qing Shu began taking a more active role in the battle, vines emerging from his arms and legs as he formed a literal wall between the wolves and the other villagers. 'He is going to end up turning into a tree this time as well at this rate,' Fang Yuan mused before letting out the Lightning Lord Wings and soaring out over the battlefield, despite some of the protests from the other elders.
He rained attacks down upon the enemy wolf tide, causing them to turn tail and flee or break up in formation. Qing Shu was stronger now than before, but still needed external help to get through this predicament as he had only just become an elder a while back.
On another corner of the battlefield, Gu Yue Yao Le was scouting out for injured Gu Masters in what was considered a "safe" location, when suddenly something charged at her from the bushes. It was a mass of fur and claws that roared loudly, even drowning out the surrounding wolf howls in the vicinity.
'Why is there a bear here?' she thought, panicking as she didn't have any good offensive gu worms. The bear in question had been trailing alongside the wolf pack, and so had found its way near this place. With food become evermore scarce, it had turned into an opportunistic scavenger, feeding on the scraps left behind by the weaker wolves that it could chase away.
With a tasty meal now in front of it and no wolves to compete against; it immediately began drooling as it chased after her.
"Grandma, save me!" she shouted out.
And in another corner of the battlefield, Li Mei barely avoided having one of her arms torn off, thanks to Gu Yue Yu Sai intervening. However, both of them were in a tough spot.
"Once the wolves close in, you should just run away and save yourself," Li Mei said.
Yu Sai privately agreed, but did not say this openly. They were in a sticky situation, though if the wolves were distracted while eating Li Mei, he might have a chance to flee.
Somewhere, someplace deep within him, he cursed his own lack of strength up till this point. He had given up on advancing in life, but if he was a bit stronger he might've been able to get both of them out of this situation.
Qing Shu, meanwhile, was still dealing with many of the wolves.
A few Frenzy Lightning Wolves had come to join the fray and were now pushing him to his limits. It'd be one thing if he was just fighting for himself, but Qing Shu was also concerned about many of his fellow villagers and erecting a barrier to save them as well.
Not that he would have to for much longer.
Fang Yuan activated Charity Gu, sharing the effect of Moonlight Plate Armor Gu with everyone on the battlefield once again.
The bear chasing Gu Yue Yao Le found its fangs and claws broken the moment that it clashed with the Moonlight Plate Armor.
These defenses allowed Yu Sai and Li Mei to escape and reach safety.
It allowed many of the Gu Masters to attack without restraint for a few seconds, freeing up Qing Shu to be less aggressive.
It also provided the small nudge needed to kill some of the Thousand and Hundred Beast Kings, thereby turning the tide of battle greatly in the Gu Yue clan's favor.
Mission accomplished!
Saved Qing Shu from being killed.
Yellow Gold Relic Gu (x1) has been added to your inventory.
Mission successful!
Would you choose the man or the bear?
Gu Yue Yao Le successfully saved.
Yellow Gold Relic Gu (x 1) has been added to your inventory.
Fang Yuan used both of them without hesitation, and Rank 4 Peak Stage primal essence began to fill his aperture.
No one other than first gen Gu Yue could rival him on this mountain.
Howl!New ɴᴏᴠᴇʟ ᴄhapters are published on Novᴇ(l)Fɪre .ɴᴇt
The Thunder Crown Wolf decided to show itself at this time, crashing into the walls with the momentum of an elephant. The Gu Masters reinforcing the wall squinted as their primeval essence was pushed to the limits.
Vermillion Blood Moonblade!
Fang Yuan shot out two of them simultaneously from the air, greatly damaging the Thunder Crown Wolf which backed off, narrowly avoided a third moonblade which struck its hind legs instead of its abdomen like Fang Yuan had planned for.
While it began hemorrhaging blood, it was far less than one would have expected and it stopped after a few seconds.
Fang Yuan's pupils dilated. This Thunder Crown Wolf had a healing-type gu worm, meaning that the bleeding effect of the Vermillion Blood Moon Gu was greatly reduced.
Such had not been the case last time around. Did a different Thunder Crown Wolf attack this village for some reason, or had something he had done changed the gu worms that it had?
The Thunder Crown Wolf lashed out at Fang Yuan, though it had no chance of striking him with the latter's flying mastery.
"Need a hand?" a voice called out to him as Gu Yue Bo appeared, launching a frosty moonblade at the Thunder Crown Wolf, and immediately becoming its focus of attention.
Five other elders leaped over the wall to join them in the fight, unleashing moonblades of varying colors at the Thunder Crown Wolf.
Fang Yuan let out two more moonblades. Even if the hemorrhagic effect was ignored, with his Rank 4 Peak primeval essence backing it, his attacks packed quite a punch.
The Thunder Crown Wolf lunged at an elder, only for Fang Yuan to intercept it with the help of Moonlight Plate Armor Gu. As its fangs wrestled to try to pierce through Fang Yuan's flesh, it was immediately bombarded with multiple attacks as it let go, leaving Fang Yuan unharmed.
'Time to test something out,' Fang Yuan though to himself, knowing that a better opportunity would not come by anytime soon.
He reached out to Charity Gu, Hope Gu, Doctor Gu, and Integration Gu within his aperture.
Mortal Killer Move - Hope of the Clansmen!
He had to alter this move slightly as he lacked Friendship Gu, but he had managed to make it work with what he had, focusing the majority of the buffs upon himself.
He immediately began feeling a boost to his strength.
The hopes and aspirations of his clansmen resonated through the air, powering up Fang Yuan.
Vermillion Blood Moonblade!
With a single strike, the Thunder Crown Wolf was completely bisected!
Such was the power of the Human Path.
The Gu Masters around Fang Yuan cheered, though he knew that this wasn't the biggest hurdle that they were going to face.
While his clansmen were celebrating what they thought was the end of the wolf tide, Fang Yuan was busy experimenting to ensure that he would be ready for what was to soon follow.

chapters.title: Chapter 152 - 152: Fang Yuan Becomes Clan Head: Part Five
chapters.content:
Despite trying to find the Crimsonhoof Deer to see if he could tame it or get a few more gu worms, Fang Yuan had been unsuccessful. His scouts had found nothing and he couldn't really go out to search himself.
As it was, it was likely that the Crimsonhoof Deer was hiding alongside its herd and waiting for the wolf tide to wane, assuming that it had survived up until now.
He had therefore been forced to go ahead without it.
'This should work,' Fang Yuan thought to himself as he put the finishing touches on his project.
He had managed to take his earlier killer move and then assembled it into a Gu House. The Gu House consisted of a large wooden wheel with iron spokes. The gu worms were placed inside it. It was small enough that he could carry it in one arm, but still large enough to carry the twelve gu worms he had placed inside.
'Now to see if this will work,' Fang Yuan thought.
He had not had as much time or as many resources as he would have liked to complete the Gu House. In terms of Gu Houses, it was quite simple in terms of design and number of gu worms used - but he was not trying to match the strength of an Immortal here, just a Rank 5 Gu Master. And anything more complex would've been impossible for him to make with what he was working with. However, it still had three Rank 4 gu worms at its core, and with the support of multiple other gu worms, it could easily even threaten those like the Sky Crane Lord or the first generation ancestor.
The only issue, Fang Yuan thought, is the fact that this was only one killer move. Gu Houses could usually do multiple things, but he had only been able to design this to do one.
If his enemies managed to find a counter for it, it would be an issue. With that said, he had to first see if he could even use it properly.
Even with all of his primeval essence at Rank 4 Peak Stage right now, he could only sustain the move for four seconds.
He injected his primal essence into the wheel as it advanced forward, shooting out crimson moonblades from its rim as it rotated, also possessing the ability to fly for short durations of time and protect itself slightly from physical strikes.
After the time was up, Fang Yuan could no longer maintain it, and it collapsed onto its side.
However, he was not disappointed, because this meant that the combination even though not ideal, was successful.
Not many people could create a killer move on their first try, but it was possible here simply because of the simplicity of gu worms involved and because of Fang Yuan's attainment level. 'What should I call this Gu House?' he thought to himself, spinning the wheel around his arm.
It reminded him to some extent of the Battle Bone Wheel, which was a Rank 5 gu worm that was part of a Gu House called White Bone Chariot. It had been quite a famous Gu House as despite only having mortal gu worms, it was able to to match a Rank 6 gu worm in terms of offensive power!
The gap between Rank 4 and Rank 5 was not as large as the gap between Rank 5 and Rank 6, which is why it was much easier for Fang Yuan to create a Rank 4 Gu House that could eclipse Rank 5 in strength. This Gu House was stronger and faster than the Blood River Python, though its expenditure of primeval essence was also much higher.
He had thought of creating his own version of the White Bone Chariot in the past which he intended to call the Blood Chariot, though he had managed to find the recipe for the Spring Autumn Cicada before he could make any significant progress towards this goal.
With this in mind, he decided upon a name - Blood Chariot Wheel!
In the future, perhaps this invention could go towards creating a genuine Rank 5 Blood Path Gu House that could rival a Rank 6 offensive gu worm. Even if he didn't intend to pursue the Blood Path as his main path in this lifetime, since the Human Path did not conflict with other path's dao marks he could still work on a potential
Now, so long as he managed to deal with first gen Gu Yue, he had a method of countering the Sky Crane Lord.
Working on this Gu House had reminded him of his days as a Blood Path Gu Immortal, dwelling and ruminating on new recipes for Blood Path gu worms as well as mortal killer moves. While the Blood Sea Inheritance had been what started him on his path, it was through experience and meticulous experimentation that he had been able to build upon this foundation.
He had prepared another mortal killer move during this time, using 'Hope of the Clansmen' as a foundation.
As he left his private residence, he saw that there was a festive mood around the village. They had no idea about the bloodshed that was soon to follow. Fang Zheng, who was at Rank 2 Peak Stage now, would need some Rank 4 primeval essence in his aperture if he was to be given the Traveling Son Gu.
This would cause damage to his aperture, to the point that Fang Yuan would have to hold off on advancing him to Rank Three until he got his hands on a Cleansing Aperture Gu. Still, Fang Zheng was only useful to him so long as he was still alive.
He had already told the Bai and Xiong clans that he wanted to have a large-scale competition between the three clans. The other clan heads feared his sudden rise to power- he was Rank 4 Peak Stage meaning that without a doubt, Gu Yue village was still the strongest of the villages on Qing Mao mountain.
Their greatest fear was that he might one day break through to Rank 5- were that the case, they truly would be finished and have no choice but to submit to the Gu Yue clan's yoke.
They likely were wondering why it was that Fang Yuan wanted them to gather for a show of strength- whatever their speculations were though, they were all wrong.
Fang Yuan wanted them to appear simply because their appearance and intermingling among the Gu Yue villagers would mean that there were even more meat shields to draw away Lord Sky Crane's firepower.
Between the first gen Gu Yue and Lord Sky Crane, Fang Yuan estimated that the latter was stronger by simple nature of Enslavement Gu Masters in general being stronger in many battles so long as they didn't expose themselves, and the fact that first gen Gu Yue was a zombie.
It was fine if first gen Gu Yue died, that was what Fang Yuan was banking on as it was, but he also needed him to weaken Lord Sky Crane so that he could then land the finishing blow. For that, it would be for the best that he drag along as many of the other clan's forces as possible. It would also save the lives of the Gu Yue clansmen, which was not only important for the system to continue giving him Human Path dao marks but also for his killer moves.
He had invited the other clan heads to this contest as well, stating that he would also be making an appearance. With two Rank Four Gu Masters dragging the fight along, even Lord Sky Crane couldn't just come barging in unobstructed.
***
The villagers slept easily now that the howls of wolves were far less frequent. The mortals would be leaving back towards their villages, and soon life would return to normal.
Mo Chen and Chi Lian both vowed to uncover the secret behind Fang Yuan's meteoric cultivation rise once that happened.
Fang Zheng was calculating how best to break through to Rank Three.
Yu Sai and Li Mei were sitting together by a fire, admiring the stars above them.
"It really is beautiful tonight, isn't it?" Li Mei asked.
"Yes," Yu Sai said. He almost ended up adding 'but not as much as you'- but held off on it.Tʜe sourcᴇ of thɪs content ɪs NovᴇlFirenᴇt
He already knew that Li Mei was smitten with Fang Yuan, and no matter how much he tried, he knew that was a height that he could never reach.
He wanted to tell her his feelings anyway, but couldn't find it in himself to do so now. What if it made things awkward between them? They had just become friends.
'Later on,' he told himself. Now that the wolf tide was over, he would have all the time in the world to find the right time to confess to her.

chapters.title: Chapter 153 - 153: Dollhouse: Part One
chapters.content:
The sky was clear and the birds were singing as the fresh morning air blew across the valley on this beautiful day on Qing Mao mountain.
The next morning, three groups of people had gathered near the peak of Qing Mao mountain. The Xiong, Bai, and Gu Yue Clans were all here, each with some of their most outstanding members.
Unlike the previous timeline, the Lightning Lycan King had been slain before it could wreak havoc on the Xiong Clan. As a result, not only were the Xiong Clan in much better shape, but they also didn't have the negative stigma that was attached to them of being cowards during their last meeting.
The official purpose of this gathering was to discuss matters now that the wolf tide was over. In reality, many of the clan members were trying to perform feats to display their strength. The balance of power on Qing Mao mountain had shifted the moment Fang Yuan became a Rank 4 Gu Master, and now that he was reportedly at the peak stage of Rank 4, the balance of power had massively shifted towards the Gu Yue Clan.
Last time, the Gu Yue Clan had coerced the Bai Clan into joining them to suppress the Xiong Clan. This time, the Bai and Xiong Clans were somewhat united against the Gu Yue Clan, which posed such a threat that they felt they needed to put their differences aside to focus on a common enemy.
Bai Ning Bing stood among the members of his clan. 'Fang Yuan... a Rank 4 peak stage already? Either you have the help of an immortal, or...' Bai Ning Bing didn't think that Fang Yuan had the help of an immortal, as there was no record of one anywhere near Qing Mao mountain. This could only mean that he, too, possessed one of the Ten Extreme Physiques. However, it seemed he had also managed to find a way to contain it, given that he was rocketing up the ranks of Gu Master cultivation even faster than he was. 'What is your secret? I must find a way to get my hands on it.'
Bai Ning Bing did not fear death, but at the same time, he wasn't going to leap into its jaws without hesitation. If there was a possible secret that could help him survive, he would naturally want to obtain it. The main issue was that he didn't know of anything he could offer Fang Yuan that would satisfy him.Nᴇw ɴovel chaptᴇrs are published on NovᴇlFɪre.ɴet
Despite Fang Yuan's reputation as a righteous path Gu Master, Bai Ning Bing was sure that he alone understood him correctly: he was a demon even among demons, one with no bottom line or guiding principle. He would not help him out of the pure kindness of his heart, and whatever price he would ask for his secret would without a doubt be quite steep.
Speaking of which, where was Fang Yuan?
The clan heads of the Xiong and Bai Clans were here, but he was conspicuously absent.
"What is with youngsters these days?" the Xiong clan head grumbled. "Isn't he the one who requested this meeting? He set it up himself as well as the time and still can't show up. Perhaps he's nothing more than a paper tiger, like the rest of the Gu Yue Clan, and was afraid of revealing it if he came here."
The Bai Clan head laughed gently along with the other Bai clan members.
The Gu Yue Clan members frowned, shouting out their own retorts. Gu Yue Chi Shan challenged several of the Xiong clan members to tests of strength in the meantime, though this was all a distraction from the bigger picture.
In truth they were also somewhat perplexed.
Why wasn't Fang Yuan here? He was the one who had specifically ordered them to gather in this location. The Gu Yue clansmen had not taken note that no one extremely important to Fang Yuan or his political faction was standing among them.
"Should we send a runner to the clan head?" one of the Gu Yue clansmen asked.
"What if he's dealing with an emergency?" another pointed out. "Maybe there is a fourth Thunder Crown Wolf somewhere?"
At the mere mention of that, the clan members all shuddered. They did not want to think that another Rank 4 equivalent Beast King existed. However, given the existence of the Lightning Lycan King which had only been discovered late into the wolf tide, such an idea could not be completely discounted.
'How much longer do we have to wait?' Bai Ning Bing was about to complain when suddenly someone screamed. A Bai clan Gu Master had been stabbed through the chest by a creature that had flown down, catching him by surprise and piercing right through his ribcage as it extracted his still-beating heart from his torso before gulping it down its gizzard in a single motion.
It then gave a murderous look all around, as if scouting for who its next victim should be.
"Look up! There are more of them!" someone shouted.
It looked like a storm cloud had gathered near the peak of Qing Mao Mountain, but this was no storm cloud. It was a flock of ten thousand cranes that Lord Sky Crane had brought with him from the Central Continent.
"Remember, no witnesses," Lord Sky Crane said, waving his hand slightly as he gave a mental command to the rest of his flock.
He could tell there were two Rank 4 Gu Masters down there, and he needed to deal with them so that striking at first gen Gu Yue would go smoothly.
Meanwhile, in Gu Yue Village, Fang Yuan saw the cloud of birds from a distance. He had been expecting it, and he had an investigative gu worm specifically tailored for this situation.
It was now time to put his plan in motion.
There was one small issue: Fang Yuan did not actually know how to get to the Blood River Graveyard. During the last fight, first gen Gu Yue had burst out from the ground after the clan head had gone towards him, though this had likely been in response to Lord Sky Crane's taunts.
The only people who knew the best way to get down there were the clan head and the other elders who knew about the prophecy of the Ancient Yin Desolate Moon Physique, but he couldn't very well ask them that now. They all assumed that he had already visited the place.
However, he had been scouting the area for some time and found a location that seemed promising. If it had been reasonable to the clan head that Fang Yuan had managed to find his way down there himself, it couldn't have been too well hidden or too impossible to reach.
There was a spot in an underground cavern where, upon reaching it, Fang Yuan took out the Thousand Li Earthwolf Spider and instructed it to start burrowing. While he was correct in that he ended up where he wanted to go, he burst through the ceiling and into the open air above the massive lake of blood that existed below, meaning this was most definitely not the right path that one was supposed to use. However, the cavern was massive enough that there were several potential entry points.
Fang Yuan hastily put the Hundred Li Earthwolf Spider back into his aperture and extended his Lightning Lord Wings to slow his descent toward the coffin in the center of the lake.

chapters.title: Chapter 154 - 154: Dollhouse: Part Two
chapters.content:
New main mission unlocked!
Stupid Birds!
Description: Repel Lord Sky Crane
Reward: 4% permanent increase to your aptitude.
New main mission unlocked!
Defender of the Clan
Description: Stop first gen Gu Yue
Reward: The system will gift the host a will created for the host that can last for several years. In addition, this will will have a single bead of Grape Green Immortal Essence associated with it (cannot be used by the host directly as this is considered 'foreign' Immortal Essence)
The Blood River Python, nearly as long and thick as a subway train, glared at Fang Yuan but did not strike as Fang Yuan finally landed, folded his wings, and bowed while announcing himself, "Lord Ancestor, my name is Gu Yue Fang Yuan and I am the new clan head of the Gu Yue Clan."
There was no response initially, so Fang Yuan continued. "Please forgive this unfilial descendant for disturbing you during your cultivation. However, there is a problem with which your strength is needed, oh great ancestor!"
A lid of the coffin twitched slightly. "Rank 4 Peak Stage... and here I thought the bloodline had completely thinned out. It is good to know that you all are not completely worthless." A macabre face peered out to look at Fang Yuan. "Rank 4 Peak Stage at your age, truly fortunate. Perhaps you might also be able to reach Rank 5." His voice suddenly turned far more irate, with murderous undertones. "I am not some dog to be summoned whenever you need me. What is it? Has the Ancient Yin Desolate Moon physique finally shown itself?"
Fang Yuan shook his head. "No, Lord Ancestor."
First gen Gu Yue snarled. "Then why, oh why, are you here bothering me?"
"We need Lord Ancestor's help with a predicament," Fang Yuan said.
Now first gen Gu Yue was within arm's reach of his own body, and the Blood River Python slithered closer, as if ready to pounce on Fang Yuan if he gave the wrong answer and it turned out that he was just wasting first gen Gu Yue's time.The source of thɪs content is NovᴇlFirᴇ.ɴet
Without a doubt, Fang Yuan was skating on thin ice here, a fact he had known ever since he began concocting this plan.
"There's a Gu Master in the sky who came here riding upon a flock of cranes."
First gen Gu Yue paused in his advance as these words began to register in his mind. The thoughts of zombies were slower than living people, but that didn't make them complete morons. "Cranes, you say?"
"Yes. This person calls himself Lord Sky Crane and said he came from the Central Continent. He brought with him an army of ten thousand cranes, among which are several Myriad Beast Kings. He has started slaughtering the villagers, and he has a Rank 5 aura, which we cannot match. I beseech you to help us."
"So, he's finally appeared," First gen Gu Yue said. "To think I managed to hide from him for a thousand years without incident up until now... what gave it away, I wonder? What kind of clue allowed him to find me?"
"Does Lord Ancestor know about this person?" Fang Yuan asked, feigning innocence.
"You could consider him an old enemy of mine," First gen Gu Yue said. "All right, junior, let's go deal with this threat." He motioned for the Blood River Python to follow them as a stream of blood erupted from beneath them. Several bats flew around them- Bladewing Blood Bat Gu Worms.
'What other kinds of Blood Path gu worms does he have?' Fang Yuan wondered. He knew about the Blood Skull Gu from his last encounter, and all such Blood Path gu worms would have been extremely helpful in the construction of his own Blood Path Gu house.
Speaking of which, Fang Yuan had not carried it with him for the obvious reason that it would be incredibly odd for him to be carrying around something like that. There was no doubt that first gen Gu Yue would've recognized what it was even if no one else did.
Since it was a Gu house and not just Gu worms, he could not put it in his aperture without disassembling and then reassembling it, which would have wasted time. It was instead in a secure location outside, ready to be activated once Fang Yuan got that bead of Grape Green Immortal Essence.
Fang Yuan had been plotting on how to kill first gen Gu Yue for some time.
Based on the system's previous missions, it seemed to suggest that it would be easier to kill first gen Gu Yue and then Lord Sky Crane.
However, Fang Yuan could not rely on either of them.
First gen Gu Yue, despite being the clan's ancestor, would gladly wipe them all out if it suited his own goals. As for Lord Sky Crane, even if first gen Gu Yue was killed, he would not spare the rest of the villagers.
The only one Fang Yuan could rely upon, and by extension the only person the Gu Yue clansmen could rely upon, was Fang Yuan himself!
They burst through the ceiling of the cavern and then through to the center of the village, emerging through a fountain of blood that marked their entrance.
The screams of the villagers had not yet reached this place at this point, meaning Fang Yuan had likely arrived early. First gen Gu Yue's zombie body could fly on its own, and he already began soaring as he saw the cloud of cranes in the sky.
"So, Junior Brother, you've decided to come pay me a visit," he said. He turned his head towards Fang Yuan. "Junior, gather all the members of the Gu Yue Clan here. It'll be easier for me to protect them if they are in one spot."
'More like, easier for you to drain them of their blood,' Fang Yuan thought. Of course the wolf would prefer that all of the chickens in the chicken coop were in a single location so he wouldn't have to run around chasing them! But Fang Yuan did not express any such thoughts. "Lord Ancestor, I've brought these to help you during your fight." He took out a bag filled with over 5,000 primeval stones.
"Excellent, descendant, excellent," first gen Gu Yue said, descending while taking several of them and munching on them as he soared upward. Because he could not regenerate primeval essence, he was at a massive disadvantage when compared to the living Lord Sky Crane.
That said, Lord Sky Crane himself seemed to be fighting at some kind of a disadvantage. Fang Yuan did not know the details, but it looked like he had used some kind of life preservation method which had weakened him. Not only that, but he was also being suppressed by having come from the Central Continent to the Southern Border. Even if he had time to adapt; his gu worms which he brought from the Central Continent would not have been able to adapt at all and would have been an entire rank lower here.
Both first gen Gu Yue and Lord Sky Crane were old monsters which were once at the peak of Rank 5 Gu Master Cultivation, though several factors had caused them to decline. Despite this, they still stood head and shoulders above ordinary Rank 5 Gu Masters. Many Rank 5 Gu Masters did not have a single Rank 5 gu worm, and were also not necessarily at Rank 5 Peak Stage. But at Rank 5, much like at Rank 4, even the difference of a minor realm could make a huge impact on the outcome of a fight. Lastly, in terms of battle experience neither of them could be underestimated, allowing them to punch far above their weights despite their handicaps somewhat limited them.

chapters.title: Chapter 155 - 155: Dollhouse: Part Three
chapters.content:
"So, you finally come out of hiding, senior brother," came the transmitted voice of Lord Sky Crane as he drew near. "And here I thought I would need to kill a few more of your clansmen before you decided to come out like the cockroach you are."
"Ah, Junior Brother," first gen Gu Yue said. "While I had stolen many things from you, the one thing I was unable to steal was your life. That was one of the few regrets I had before leaving the Central Continent. How wonderful that you've come so that such a mistake can be rectified and I can finally put you six feet underground, right where you belong."ᴛhis ᴜpdated by ɴoᴠel Fɪre.nᴇt
"So you admit it," Lord Sky Crane called out, almost crying indignantly, losing the demeanor of an old monster he had carried earlier and instead both sounding and appearing like a toddler accusing another of stealing his favorite toy. "You are a thief!"
"Am I a thief?" first gen Gu Yue asked, seemingly equally flustered. "Or was heaven itself a thief when it stole anything I could have accomplished and gave it to an unworthy person such as yourself? If you continue to let jealousy overwhelm you, junior brother, you might end up turning an unsightly green completely!"
"Hmph," Lord Sky Crane scoffed. "Don't let my turning a different color concern you. Look at you. There's no need for me to call you a demon; it is obvious to anyone with eyes to see what you have become. A stain upon the world itself; to call you a hollow shell of a Righteous Path Gu Master would be an insult to hollow shells!"
The two of them continued to bicker as below, Fang Yuan began putting his own plans in motion.
"Fang Zheng!" he yelled, finding his brother without even having to use the Doting Mother and Traveling Son Gu. Fang Zheng handed him the Blood Cherry Wheel.
"What's going on, elder brother?" Fang Zheng asked.
"We're being attacked," Fang Yuan answered. "Get yourself to safety." He paused as he saw an icy flash approach Gu Yue village. The cranes were slaughtering everyone they could find, and to make sure they missed no one, they were moving in a concentric fashion up towards the mountain.
If he sent Fang Zheng somewhere else when Bai Ning Bing detonated, Fang Zheng might be caught in the blast. He changed his mind. "Stay close by me!"
A Myriad Beast King landed near them, its beak dripping with blood and its eyes radiating murderous intent.
Mortal Killer Move: Bond Between Clansmen!
The hopes and aspirations of the Gu Clansmen who were currently being hunted like deer before a pack of lions - their will to survive, their desperation - all gathered with the help of Integration Gu before forming the basis of the mortal killer move, which greatly increased Fang Yuan's powers as well as their own.
Unlike last time, Fang Yuan had far more human path dao marks now. He also had the benefit of this killer move.
'I have over 500 human path dao marks,' Fang Yuan thought. 'That alone is over a fifty percent boost to this move's power.'
On top of which, there was the simple fact that the Human Path seemed to just be completely broken when it came to buffing others.
However, Fang Yuan was not done yet. This was only one of the tricks up his sleeve.
Mortal Killer Move - Blood is Thicker Than Water!
This was a combination Blood Path and Human Path killer moves, which allowed him to further buff himself based on the number of blood relatives he currently had. There was a reason, after all, that Lord Sky Crane had chosen to kill as many of the Gu Yue clansmen as possible before going for the head of the snake. Human Path also excelled in buffing one so long as they had the support of others it seemed - meaning that they synergized quite well in this scenario.
A single Crimson Moonblade decapitated the Myriad Beast King, ending its life right then and there. A silvery light began to surround many of the other Gu Yue Clan members, protecting them from the jabs of the cranes and also increasing the power of their strikes.
'Very soon, I'll have more dao marks than most Rank 6 Gu Immortals,' Fang Yuan thought. The idea of a mortal having more dao marks than an immortal was ludicrous; then again, the idea of a Rank One Gu Master having a Rank Six Gu as their Vital Gu was equally ludicrous. 'I am probably the only person in history who can make such a claim.'
Lord Sky Crane noted that his army was very quickly losing. With all of the boosts that Fang Yuan had managed to accumulate, along with his dao marks, he could now fight on the level of an ordinary Rank 5 Gu Master just by himself. This was an incredibly feat in and of itself, but the rest of the villagers were also packing quite a punch now.
Fang Yuan decapitated two more myriad beast kings and several thousand beast kings, allowing the Gu Yue members to gather in the square for safety.
Lord Sky Crane was not having a good time. The Blood River Python was engaging his Ironbeak Flying Crane King, meaning that it could not aide him or the rest of his army.
He glared at Fang Yuan, but had no time to spare from his struggle with first gen Gu Yue. But despite this advantage, as time went on, first gen Gu Yue began to become suppressed. The downside of not being able to replenish one's own primeval essence was catching up to him. Fang Yuan had also excluded him from receiving any boosts from his mortal killer moves. He landed in the square and shouted, "I am your ancestor! Give me primeval stones! I need to recover my primeval essence!" He looked around for the bag that Fang Yuan had shown him, but it was nowhere in the square.
"Ancestor, I have it," Fang Yuan said, taking out the bag. "Everyone! This is indeed our first generation ancestor, the one who had founded our village! Lord Ancestor, I had been afraid it might get stolen in the middle of the fighting, so I had kept it safe with myself."
"Good work, good work," first gen Gu Yue said. "As expected of the one who has been entrusted to lead the clan. Everyone, help me and we will rid ourselves of this menace who has descended upon us."
"Idiots!" Lord Sky Crane cried from above. "Don't you see that you are only hastening your own demise? You're practically signing your own death warrant there, junior!"
Naturally, as he had spent most of the day killing Gu Yue clansmen, they were not going to listen to him.
"He's only trying to sow seeds of discord between us!"
"If he's saying that we don't need to give ancestor our primeval stones, we should give him even more!"
"That's right!"
"Lord Fang Yuan, you can take some of my primeval stones too!"
"And mine as well!"
"Give everything so our ancestor can save us!"
"He was probably the one who was the source of that sudden burst of strength we all felt a while earlier!"
"That's right, my wounds also miraculously healed themselves!"
"First gen ancestor must've had some kind of secret that let him accomplish such a miracle."
"Don't forget, the real enemy is that person atop that giant crane!"
"Remember your fallen comrades and prepare to aide ancestor!"

chapters.title: Chapter 156 - 156: Dollhouse: Part Four
chapters.content:
Lord Sky Crane snarled as he assembled his cranes and ordered them to dive down. Up until this point, his attention had been somewhat split between fighting first gen Gu Yue and controlling his cranes.
That was one reason why Fang Yuan was able to deal with many of them very successfully. After Fang Yuan had killed the more powerful cranes, the other Gu Yue clan members had been able to overwhelm those who remained.
Now, however, Lord Sky Crane was completely concentrated on controlling his flock.
But before they could descend upon the village square, a massive membrane the color of blood erupted all around them. No matter how much the cranes tried, they could not pierce through it. Not even the Ironbeak Flying Crane King could make so much as a dent in this barrier.
No matter how much Lord Sky Crane tried using his own methods, he also could not pierce this veil.
"How do you like this?" first gen Gu Yue asked. "It is my unique invention. Blood Curtain Skyflower Gu. Once activated, no Rank 5 Gu Master can pierce through it!"
"Damn it! Damn it! Damn it!" Lord Sky Crane began cursing under his breath. A good portion of his flock had been killed, and a disproportionate number of high-ranking cranes had died thanks to Fang Yuan's actions. He could only curse as Fang Yuan approached first gen Gu Yue and handed him the bag of primeval stones.
"Very good, filial descendant of mine," first gen Gu Yue said. "You will be richly rewarded when all of this is over."
"Actually, your descendant has another present for you, first gen Gu Yue," Fang Yuan said. He took the Blood Wheel Chariot and motioned as if wanting first gen Gu Yue to take a closer look at it.
"What is this? Is that a Rank 4 Gu house?" First gen Gu Yue wondered, intrigued. "And so tiny at that - but it seems to be from the Blood Path, if I'm not mistaken."
"Indeed, I managed to find this," Fang Yuan said. "I was wondering if you could examine it and tell me more about it."
With this pretense, Fang Yuan brought the wheel even closer to first gen Gu Yue, who had not been expecting Fang Yuan to suddenly inject it with his own primeval essence, launching it at his chest.
Because of the short time interval, Fang Yuan had not been able to activate its full power, but it had still been more than strong enough to knock first gen Gu Yue outside the range of the Blood Curtain Skyflower.
The injuries dealt to first gen Gu Yue as a result of this assault were negligible, especially given that he was a zombie and any attack that did not destroy his brain would not be fatal.
However, the moment that first gen Gu Yue landed outside the barrier, there was silence throughout the battlefield. Nobody had been expecting events to take such a turn.
Lord Sky Crane stopped striking at the Blood Curtain Skyflower Gu's barrier.
The Gu Yue Clansmen around Fang Yuan looked at him with dumbfounded expressions until they finally found their voices.
"Clan head Fang Yuan, are you an idiot? He was our only hope to defeat Lord Sky Crane!"
"You bring shame upon all of us who share the Gu Yue name!"
"Indeed, how could you not support your own bloodline?"
"What are we going to do now - do you have the strength to challenge a Rank 5 Gu Master? You've just doomed us all!"
Fang Yuan raised his hand and said simply, "He was going to kill all of us. You were all going to be sheep foolishly nursing a maimed wolves' injuries until he finally recovered enough to eat you whole."
Most of the Gu Yue clansmen did not believe Fang Yuan and continued to berate him with insults.
Throughout this admonishment, laughter echoed throughout the village and cut through all of the cries of disbelief.
It was Bai Ning Bing.
"Very good, very good! Yes, Fang Yuan! That's what I'm talking about! Finally, something exciting happened today!"
Lord Sky Crane didn't fully understand what was going on but he did understand that first gen Gu Yue was now open to attack, and he immediately went to target him. "Hmph, look at that! Not even your descendants will aid a thief. This is only the fitting fruit of your treachery, senior brother. You betrayed me, and you have been betrayed by others. It is only fair. Truly, Heaven is just and balanced."
First gen Gu Yue was speechless. It took him the longest time to recover from what Fang Yuan had done as well as process it not because of pain from the attack or anything like that, but simply because he had not been expecting the attack.
Up until now, he had not shown any threatening motions towards any of the Gu Yue clansmen without reason, and Fang Yuan, despite his strength, would still need him to deal with Lord Sky Crane. That is why he had not thought that in a million years that Fang Yuan would do something like this.
He had also let his personal curiosity at seeing a Rank 4 Blood Path Gu house overcome him momentarily.
Now that he fully comprehended what had happened, he screamed in fury. "Junior, you dare! Courting death! Damn you! Damn you, you unfilial descendant! I will tear out your entrails and hang you from the nearest tree with them! I will grind your bones to dust! I will fill your sinuses with molten lead before I kill you! Even if you scream and beg for mercy, I will not stop torturing you until you die a thousand deaths before your true death, junior!"
Even as he screamed this, he began chomping on primeval stones, quickly swatting off the cranes which came to attack him with his massive claws.
"Lord Ancestor, come back within the wall to safety!" someone yelled out.
"There's no use," Fang Yuan said. "Once you leave the barrier, you can't come back in."
Several people completely disregarded what he said and rushed outside the barrier anyway to help first gen Gu Yue.
They quickly found that indeed, they couldn't come back, however, when he started slaughtering them, collecting their blood within a gu worm shaped like a skull that was all too familiar to Fang Yuan.
"Lord Ancestor? Why?" one of the Gu Yue clansmen asked before dying. He had tried to run away, but his back was now pressed up against Blood Curtain Skyflower Gu. The means that would've protected him had now turned into a wall that cut off his only route of escape.
"Because your surname is Gu Yue!" first gen Gu Yue said calmly after he had slaughtered the man, pouring the blood gathered from the gu worm over his head even as he fought.
"Like I told all of you idiots, he was going to kill us all," Fang Yuan said calmly, with the other Gu Yue clansmen still within the barrier now understanding that Fang Yuan had been correct all this time.
"What a vile ancestor!"
"Indeed- don't most ancestors come to help their clans in times of need?"Tʜe sourcᴇ of thɪs content ɪs NovᴇlFir(e).nᴇt
"How misfortunate we are to have an ancestor who is out to kill us instead!"
"I hate the fact that I'm related to him!"
"I think we should all change our surnames to something other than Gu Yue!"

chapters.title: Chapter 157 - 157: Dollhouse: Part Five
chapters.content:
"Elder brother, how are we going to get out of this?" Fang Zheng asked even as the other clansmen created a ruckus behind the barrier. It was clear that Lord Sky Crane had the current advantage when it came to fighting and was likely going to kill first gen Gu Yue.
The barrier would naturally not last forever, and they needed a plan for what to do when it faded.
While Fang Yuan had killed many of Lord Sky Crane's flock, that had only been mostly possible when Lord Sky Crane hadn't actually been actively commanding them, and then there would be Lord Sky Crane himself to deal with.
"Bai Ning Bing," Fang Yuan said, turning to the man whose laughter had echoed throughout the village moments earlier. "I know that you have the Northern Dark Ice Soul Physique."
Bai Ning Bing scoffed.
"And I also know that you're close to detonating," Fang Yuan said. "If I'm not wrong, that Rank 3 Stone Aperture Gu might have extended your time until now, but you've been fighting quite a lot, haven't you?"
"So what?" Bai Ning Bing asked. It was true; the stone walls of his aperture were already beginning to crack under the pressure of the Northern Dark Ice Soul Physique. The pressure within was more than enough to eclipse the Rank 6 aura of the Spring Autumn Cicada.
"I have a way that you can deal with your problem," Fang Yuan said.Thᴇ link to the origɪn of this information rᴇsts ɪn ɴo(v)elFɪre.ɴet
This piqued Bai Ning Bing's interest.
"But first, you will have to detonate. I have a way to bring you back," Fang Yuan said.
Bai Ning Bing frowned. "Is that how you came back?"
Fang Yuan shook his head, realizing that Bai Ning Bing had also fallen for his little ruse. "Also, the method to bring you back isn't entirely guaranteed. However, if it works, you should be able to come back."
"Should be?" Bai Ning Bing asked, frowning.
"It's a better chance than nothing," Fang Yuan said. "Can you control the direction in which you explode?"
"How can I possibly know that?" Bai Ning Bing snarled at him.
"Well, if you can, try to explode away from me and Fang Zheng," Fang Yuan said.
The battle outside raged, but Fang Yuan could do nothing about it other than preparing by replenishing his primeval essence - the use of the Blood Chariot Wheel even for a small amount of time had depleted nearly all of it.
Speaking of, the Blood Chariot Wheel was still lying there within the boundaries of the Blood Curtain Skyflower Gu and he picked it up.
Eventually, one side managed to win. Lord Sky Crane pierced first gen Gu Yue's brain, killing the zombie even as he cursed Fang Yuan, cursed Lord Sky Crane, and above all cursed fate for not favoring him and letting him fall into this situation in the first place.
Lord Sky Crane, of course, was not going to let them off, even if first gen Gu Yue was dead.
The barrier began to thin, and at that moment, Fang Yuan nodded toward Bai Ning Bing, who detonated just as the barrier vanished and Lord Sky Crane came down for the kill. A massive block of ice erupted from Bai Ning Bing, which avoided the area that Fang Yuan and Fang Zheng were in and covered the entire mountain in a thick layer of ice within a single breath of time.
Lord Sky Crane barely managed to avoid getting caught in the blast, backing away as most of his flock was killed off. He had not come out of his fight with first gen Gu Yue unscathed; he had numerous wounds and likely lacked primeval essence, though he would recover it all soon enough and then come after Fang Yuan and the rest of the Gu Yue clansmen.
Main mission successfully completed!
Defender of the Clan
First gen Gu Yue has been dealt with.
Reward: A will has been added along with a single bead of Rank 6 Immortal Essence (foreign) to your inventory.
Fang Yuan then unleashed the Yin part of Yin-Yang Rotation Gu at Bai Ning Bing, who was encased in a deep layer of ice.
Fang Yuan could no longer rely upon the Human Path methods he had earlier, as the wills of his clansmen were dissipating given their current condition.
'Perhaps there's a way to preserve their wills so that I can continue to use them even if they die or I leave them,' Fang Yuan thought to himself. There were several ways he could think of doing this, but he would need a few high-ranking Wisdom Path gu worms to do so.
Bai Ning Bing burst out of the ice, her aptitude reduced but still quite alive.
Secret mission completed!
It takes a real man to be best girl.
Reward: Purple Crystal Relic Gu (x1) has been added to your inventory.
As he prepared to withdraw his will and his drop of immortal essence to activate the Blood Chariot Wheel, something happened in his aperture.
'What's going on?' Fang Yuan thought.
His storage-type gu worm spat something out of his aperture and onto the ground. It was one of the paintings that Genesis Lotus Immortal Venerable had given him, which depicted a room filled with elaborate furniture that seemed to be too small for an adult.
This was the painting that Genesis Lotus Immortal Venerable had said was for someone other than Fang Yuan. It was apparently reacting to something now, as the room began to shimmer and shrink, revealing that it was just one room in a larger structure.
The image of a blue dollhouse appeared in the painting before it emerged, enlarging as it left the frame until it was nearly as big as the clan head's house. While most of it was painted blue, several of its walls were a bright pink color. It was three stories tall with multiple windows.
"What is this?" Lord Sky Crane wondered, bewildered. This was a Gu House, and not just any Gu House. A Rank 5 Gu House! He could sense the aura of multiple Rank 5 gu worms emanating from it. It looked like the structure contained thousands of gu worms! Even if they were all just mortal gu worms, this was still incredible in and of itself. "Where did a backwater clan like this manage to find something on this level?"
The house flew through the air for a moment before landing on the snowy terrain, sending small puffs of ice into the air. Its doors opened, and a hand reached out which grabbed Bai Ning Bing and pulled her inside before the doors closed shut.
The painting crumbled into tiny pieces before being carried away with the wind- its purpose now complete.
