Zuo Chen pivoted as he had been expecting this, activated his killer move again, and went for another strike.
However, just as he was three paces away from Fang Yuan, something happened. The synergy between his Gu worms suddenly broke, and he coughed out a mouthful of blood. Fang Yuan sidestepped him, striking him in the ribs, breaking several of them with his fist and tossing him to the side.
Zhu Chen coughed out another mouthful of blood at the injury. However, he began focusing himself despite the pain.
'What on Earth was that? What had happened?' He had gone to strike at Fang Yuan. But somehow... the mortal killer move had failed, causing him to undergo backlash! This had never happened before, and he glared at Fang Yuan with wary eyes.
"Not a bad mortal killer move," Fang Yuan said. "Too bad that I can spot at least eighteen different flaws within it. You truly do need to work on it better."
'Eighteen flaws?' Zuo Chen thought to himself. He himself knew of only six flaws within the killer move, though he had been unable to patch them up simply because he lacked the requisite gu worms. How had Fang Yuan spotted so many flaws within his technique so quickly? Not only that, he had also responded by breaking it after only seeing it once, causing him to undergo backlash.
During his earlier life, Fang Yuan often had to fight other Blood Path Gu Masters after the Blood Path exploded in popularity after the Five Region's War and had developed various ways of countering them.
It was difficult to do so to one of Rank 5 with his current strength, such as when facing off against the first gen Clan Head. However, he had been able to spot the fatal flaw within Zuo Chen's killer move and had been able to respond appropriately.
It was a rather rudimentary killer move, Fang Yuan felt, though it would be overwhelming indeed to any ordinary Gu Master.
Zuo Chen healed himself before launching himself at Fang Yuan once more. This time, he did not activate all of his Gu worms, only using Blood Claws Gu and Blood Agility Gu.
As Zuo Chen felt his strength being sapped from him, Fang Yuan sidestepped his blow once more, shooting out a Vermilion Blood Moon Blade, which nearly bisected him had he not dodged in time.
"Blood Path methods!" he yelled out. "To think that Fang Yuan, who maintains the facade of a Righteous Path Gu Master, was actually dabbling in the Blood Path!" It explained how he had managed to unravel his killer move so quickly before. 'Is he also a Master when it comes to the Blood Path and its attainment?' Zhu Chen thought to himself.
He had not been expecting this development at all.
"I will ask you only once more," Fang Yuan said. "Hand over your Blood Path gu worms, and I may consider sparing your life."
"I've said the same words multiple times to others. Do you think that I would fall to them myself?" Zuo Chen scoffed. "Zuo Ming! Zuo Lin! Come on out and let's teach this brat a lesson."
As part of his investigative methods, he was able to sense those with a similar bloodline as himself. He was mainly using this so that Zuo Ming would not betray him. He could therefore tell that those two were nearby, and he was calling upon them to strike at Fang Yuan.
Only that help never came.
It was only when he turned his eyes to see what those two idiots were doing instead of attacking that he realized why they hadn't attacked.
Because those two were not standing near the battlefield. Instead, there was a woman with long white hair and blue eyes that were as clear as crystal. She was as beautiful as an ice sculpture and carried an expression as cold as the frost that enveloped the base of the mountain. In each hand, she held a severed head- the heads of his teammates.

chapters.title: Chapter 188: Blood Tiger: Part Eight
chapters.content:
'Impossible,' Zuo Chen thought to himself.
Although those two were not as strong as he was, there's no way that a single Gu Master could beat them unless they were somewhere around Fang Yuan's or his own strength. He had not brought them along simply to be eye candy, after all.
"Good to see you can make it, Bai Ning Bing," Fang Yuan said. He noticed something... off about her that wasn't present earlier, not to mention the fact that she wasn't wearing a mask anymore.
A while ago...
Bai Ning Bing had placed a mask upon her face as they headed out.
"I will deal with the leader among them. Can you handle two Rank 3 Gu Masters?" Fang Yuan had asked. Bai Ning Bing would have normally been offended by such a question.Follow current novᴇls on novel·fire·net
However, she no longer had full power of the Northern Dark Ice Soul Physique with her. She was limited to only ninety percent primeval essence right now, a fact that Fang Yuan was quick to remind her of.
"Don't you worry," Bai Ning Bing said. Their plan was simple: with the enemy divided, each of them would go after a different group.
Bai Ning Bing emerged some distance from where Zuo Chen was.
Fang Yuan had dropped her off here atop his Hundred Li Earthwolf Spider before burrowing down and going to confront Zuo Chen.
Bai Ning Bing walked slowly. It had been a while since she had been outside the Dollhouse. At some point, she thought she ran into a group of Gu Masters and hid herself behind a tree quickly.
However, it had only turned out to be a small flock of wild deer. Their ribs were showing, a sign of the lack of food on the mountain.
Bai Ning Bing sighed. She had been in somewhat of a deep depression ever since the Yin Rotation Gu had been used upon her. The reason she had hid was because she didn't want to see the Bai clansmen's reactions to what had happened to her. It would have been one thing if all of the Bai clansmen were dead. However, she could not tolerate their looks if they knew what had happened to her. 'What had happened to this once proud genius of the Bai clan?' they would think.
The Legends of Ren Zu, Chapter 4, Section 31:
Blazing Glory Lightning Brilliance had managed to use a combination of Lightning Gu and Hatred Gu in order to break through the heavenly Qi Wall, thereby destroying Blue Heaven in the process. The shards of what had once been Blue Heaven fell to all four corners of the world, while the creatures which had made Blue Heaven their home fell to the earth.
He and his sister, Myriad Gold Wondrous Essence, had finally managed to escape!
However, Blazing Glory Lightning Brilliance was not unaware of the destruction he had just caused.
"What? What did I just do?" he thought to himself.
All the lives that had been shattered, countless organisms which lived in Blue Heaven were now stranded, homeless, without any place to return.
Their cries and laments of anguish reached his ears, pounding away at his heart like the strikes of a hammer. Beneath this, even his Heart of Hatred began to bend.
'What in the world have I done?' Blazing Glory Lightning Brilliance thought to himself. In his hatred, he had not seen the damage that he was doing to others or the world.
Myriad Gold Wondrous Essence urged her brother, "Brother. Now that we've managed to get out of Blue Heaven, I think that we should make our way back to Father as soon as we can."
However, Blazing Glory Lightning Brilliance had now changed. Upon seeing the state of what he had done and the cries of pain coming from those who used to call Blue Heaven home, he no longer felt like moving.
One of the Nine Heavens that had stood above the world were now gone, forever, all because of him.
"How could I have done something like this?" In his hatred, he had completely lost his sense of self.
While Myriad Gold Wondrous Essence urged her brother to get going, she found that he had instead simply dug a hole in the ground with his hands and then dived straight into it. "Brother, what are you doing?" Myriad Gold Wondrous Essence asked.
"I'm hiding here," Blazing Glory Lightning Brilliance said. "I'm hiding where no one can see me. I don't want anyone to see me. If they don't see me, then they will not be able to judge me. I cannot withstand their judging looks. Sister, please leave me be and go find Father on your own."
Hatred Gu no longer controlled Blazing Glory Lightning Brilliance and had already flown off.
Once people abandoned their hatred, they usually found themselves empty and desolate. Hatred was like acid, which damaged the vessel that kept it in more than what one intended to throw it upon.
Lightning Gu, now that it was free, also found no use of staying with Blazing Glory Lightning Brilliance, and had also fled.
Myriad Gold Wondrous Essence was at a loss of what to do.
While she did want to go back to her father, she did not want to abandon her brother like this. "Brother! Brother! Please come along with me!"
In response to this, Blazing Glory Lightning Brilliance simply dug the hole in the ground further and then covered the top with dirt so that he couldn't be seen. "Forget that I ever existed."
"How can I possibly forget that?" Myriad Gold Wondrous Essence asked.
In response to her, a voice came from beneath the hole. "There's no point in trying to reason with him. Your brother isn't going anywhere."
"Who are you?" Myriad Gold Wondrous Essence asked.
"I am Pride Gu," the voice answered, coming from beneath the ground. "Once I have lodged onto a person, they will cling to me, even if it leads to the loss of their life. Blazing Glory Lightning Brilliance, don't listen to her, you won't be able to handle it if you come out. Let us keep staying underground where no one can see us. It is better that way. We will be safe here."
Blazing Glory Lightning Brilliance dug even further. It was dark where he was going, but he couldn't bare the thought of going up into the light.
"Brother, come back!"
"Human, your brother cannot even see what is right in front of him right now because I blind him."
Myriad Gold Wondrous Essence started pacing around. How could she get rid of Pride Gu? At that moment, Cognition Gu answered her. "Oh, human. Wherever one thinks, so do I appear," Cognition Gu said, materializing in order to come to her aid.
"How can I get rid of Pride Gu?" Myriad Gold Wondrous Essence asked Cognition Gu.
"Oh, human. What is the source of Pride? It is shame. Your brother is currently ashamed of what he had done in his hatred, and because of that, his pride will not let him leave. If you want to get rid of Pride Gu, you must get rid of Shame Gu first."
The only person who had no sense of pride, was one who had no sense of shame.
A truly shameless person would feel indifferent to how they were treated, or how the world treated them. Such a person would be indifferent to whether they were exalted or derided - honored or dishonored.
While if one felt shame, they would naturally feel pride, and feel the need to do anything they could in order to protect it.

chapters.title: Chapter 189: White Form Immortal Snake: Part One
chapters.content:
Bai Ning Bing continued trekking towards her goal.
Even now, she wore a mask upon her face, hoping that none of the Bai clansmen would be able to recognize her if they happened upon her.
She suddenly stopped as something descended from above.
She was immediately on alert, of course.
Whoever this was, they had managed to approach her so fast that she had been unable to react.
This was not a Rank 3 aura emanating from what stood before her like she had expected.
No, this was Rank 5 aura!
'This is...!' Bai Ning Bing thought to herself.
Although she had only heard descriptions of this Gu from the clan head, as he had never been able to show it to her as he had once promised before passing away, she was able to identify it almost instantly.
It was a massive white snake with a slender appearance, closer to a dragon than a snake given its elegance, with cold and indifferent eyes. Two long ribbon-like whiskers flowed out from near its snout, completing its regal appearance.
White Form Immortal Snake Gu!
It was a Rank 5 gu worm which had been left behind to the Bai clan by their founding ancestor.
Much as the Gu Yue Clan had a prophecy around the Ancient Moon Desolate Physique, the Bai clan also had a prophecy around the White Form Immortal Snake Gu!
It was said that in the future, there would be a Bai clansman who had earned the recognition of the gu worm, after which this gu would take them into the sky to an inheritance left behind to them from the Bai clan founder.
The Bai clan head had thought that this person would be Bai Ning Bing. However, before Bai Ning Bing could gain an opportunity to approach the gu worm in question, they had been attacked by Lord Sky Crane, and all the subsequent events had happened.
'Why is this here?' Bai Ning Bing wondered to herself.
The most obvious answer was that the Bai clan had been unable to feed it after her detonation, and so it had wandered off.
'Why was it here before me though?' was her next thought.
The snake glared at Bai Ning Bing, as if challenging her.
Even now, as stubborn as a mule, Bai Ning Bing glared right back at it, wondering if it could still recognize that she was a Bai clansman despite the effect of Ying Rotation Gu and the mask she wore upon her face.
The truth was that it was a Water Path Gu worm and had been attracted here by the presence of Bai Ning Bing's small amount of Northern Dark Ice Soul Physique.
With a roar, it entered her aperture, suppressing all the other gu worms within it with is Rank 5 aura. Despite this, she had not actually been able to refine the gu in question and could not use it freely. She had only managed to somewhat befriend it for the time being.
It looked like while it was residing in her aperture, it had not acknowledged her as the true Bai clan's inheritor.
That was for the better, she felt, as otherwise it would be known to all the world that she was really Bai Ning Bing.
The Legends of Ren Zu, Chapter Four, Section 31 (continued)
Myriad Gold Wondrous Essence had resolved to save her brother before going to find Ren Zu.
She began digging into the ground as well, trying to find Blazing Glory Lightning Brilliance.
"Brother! Listen to me!" she shouted out once she saw him.Latest content published on N()velFire.net
"It is of no use, human," Pride Gu said. "The only thing that your brother can listen to right now is me. Other than that, he may as well be blind and deaf, ahaha!"
Myriad Gold Wondrous Essence went to go and take Pride Gu, however, Blazing Glory Lightning Brilliance turned around away from her, shielding something in his hands.
The thing that he was shielding was a miniscule gu worm that seemed to be made of glass. It seemed to be so fragile that even blowing upon it might've shattered it.
However, to Blazing Lightning Brilliance, the gu worm in question appeared as strong and tough as iron, adorned with countless diamonds and rubies - one of the most precious things in the world, even more wondrous than Wealth Gu.
"That is Pride Gu," Cognition Gu told Myriad Gold Wondrous Essence. "It once resided within the heart of Great Strength True Martial, but has come here instead. You need to get rid of it."
However, no matter how Myriad Gold Wondrous Essence approached her brother, he kept turning around, trying to shield Pride Gu with all he could.
"Oh human, people will shield their pride above all else," Cognition Gu said. "You won't be able to reach it without hurting your brother."
"How can I find Shame Gu then?" she wondered. Although Pride Gu was being sheltered by Blazing Glory Lightning Brilliance, she thought about starving it out.
"Munch, munch, munch," Pride Gu said, feasting upon Shame Gu. It was for this that it had come here and abandoned Great Strength True Martial - this was far more delectable! The strong were prideful, but sometimes, even the ordinary could have extraordinary pride. "Give up human. No one can convince someone to give up their pride. It can only be rid of someone on their own."
Myriad Gold Wondrous Essence was frustrated, but she still refused to give up on her brother.
"Human, your brother does not want to be seen by the world," Cognition Gu continued. "You need to find a way to hide him, only then will he give up on some of his shame."
Myriad Gold Wondrous Essence climbed out of the hole she was digging. If she still had Wealth Gu, she would've been able to conjure up something to help them, but for now, she could only go around looking for another solution.
Attitude Gu, which was a mask, was still with their father, and was out of the question.
Ultimately, she could find no solution and began kicking the soil in frustration when a thought struck her as she looked closer at the soil.
There was brown soil, of course, but other kinds as well. Near a river, she found dark red soil made from clay, and near a pond, found green soil that was mixed with moss.
"I've found it! I've found a solution!" she said. She took out parts of the soil, in various colors, and took them down with her to Blazing Glory Lightning Brilliance.
"Sister, please go away," her brother said once more.
"Brother, I have a solution to your worries," she answered. "Look here at what I was able to make! Face paint! Place this on, and no one will be able to see your face!"
Blazing Glory Lightning Brilliance took a look at it and then slowly, at his sister's encouragement, began applying it to his face.
In his sister's shiny and reflective hair, he watched his own appearance dissolve and turn into something new.
He was no longer Blazing Glory Lightning Brilliance. If he walked out into the world, no one would recognize him. With this, he could be whoever he wanted.
By abandoning himself, he had also abandoned his sense of shame. And without shame, there was no source for pride left.
"No! Human, what are you doing?" Pride Gu asked before it shattered into a thousand pieces, having starved to death.
"Now come on, brother," Myriad Gold Wondrous Essence said. "Let us go and reunite with father!"
"Alright," Blazing Glory Lightning Brilliance said, following his sister out of the hole in the ground he had dug. He looked around, no longer blinded by Pride Gu. "Just how deep a hole did I dig for myself?" It looked like it would take forever for them to just climb out!

chapters.title: Chapter 190: White Form Immortal Snake: Part Two
chapters.content:
Bai Ning Bing's mask had slipped off.
Unlike Ren Zu, who had found it impossible to place on Attitude Gu no matter what he did until he had obtained his Heart of Loneliness, she had no difficulty placing it on her face.
And yet, its burden seemed to be far beyond what its weight would suggest. 'There was a job to do,' she thought to herself, trying to break herself out of this odd train of thought she had found herself in.
The White Form Immortal Snake had not recognized her, apparently, so there was little to do in that regard. It did not seem to want to attack her either.
It was not hard to find those two demonic Gu Masters.
They weren't trying very hard to be discreet.
As it was, in this sort of wide area, barren of most life, anyone who was approaching would be quickly visible unless they were using methods like Fang Yuan's.
They were far away from the village perimeter, so they likely thought they had nothing to
Bai Ning Bing herself made no attempt to hide as she approached the two of them.ᴛhis ᴜpdated by novel•ﬁre.net
Zuo Lin and Zuo Ming were bickering at the time over what to do.
They had very differing ways of dealing with various situations. One of them had joined up with Zuo Chen willingly, while the other had been forced into things.
One was a Blood Path Gu Master, and the other was a Strength Path Gu Master. Although both paths required few resources, they truly could not be compared.
However, they stopped their quarrel once they noticed Bai Ning Bing approaching.
She was not dressed in the uniform of any of the Gu Masters on Qing Mao Mountain, instead wearing a white and blue robe. As she approached, both of them were somewhat awestruck by her appearance.
'What was someone like her doing in an area like this?' Although Zuo Lin couldn't see her face behind the mask, his instincts told him that there was a delicate beauty behind it. As it was, her graceful and voluptuous figure and small, white, and delicate feet were still visible, beckoning the imagination.
"Wait, what are you doing?!" Zuo Ming asked as Zup Lin approached this stranger. They had no clue who this person was. Why was this guy just walking up to her?
"Oh, relax, watch and see how I-" Zuo Lin was about to say before Bai Ning Bing shot out an ice blade. It would have struck Zuo Lin in the heart, killing him, had he not swerved away in time.
"What?! What is this?! What kind of person attacks like that without warning or announcing themselves?!" he muttered to himself.
"I told you to be careful!" Zuo Ming said, getting ready for a battle stance.
Although he had no real desire to fight, the fact remained that he was now tied down to these other two demonic Gu Masters.
If push came to shove, he would have no option other than to fight.
A Rank 3 Blood Lance shot out from Zuo Lin at Bai Ning Bing.
She swerved around it with ease. Wherever her feet landed, ice immediately began to spring out coating the earth. 'Could it be?' Zuo Lin thought to himself.
He had heard that the entire mountain was encased in ice from the actions of a demonic Gu Master who apparently commanded cranes, which made little sense. Could it be that it was actually this lady who was responsible for the ice?
Bai Ning Bing activated several of her gu worms in succession.
Although she had lost all of her original ones after detonating, she had been given a set from Fang Yuan. Although the Gu Yue Clan did not specialize in Ice Path gu worms, they were able to purchase certain ones from the Bai clan, who were willing to part with a few of them given the current situation. She had also been able to refine one of her own using ingredients that could still be found around the mountain.
Still, it could not be said that her battle strength was anywhere near what it had been before.
Regardless, she had no fears about losing here.
The reason was that although she had lost some old methods of attack, she had some new tricks up her sleeve thanks to the Dollhouse.
She honed her primeval essence into a small figurine that expanded until it formed a clear, ice-like image of herself. She didn't stop there, pouring in more primeval essence as it duplicated itself once more.
The loss in her primeval essence was noticeable, and her eyes flashed as she stopped creating more puppets. It would've been one thing had this been her from earlier, but her aptitude was currently capped and so was her rate of primeval essence recovery.
Fang Yuan had warned her about this, and she had felt that she would be cognizant of it before the fight. But it was another thing to be mindful of her primeval essence in practice entirely.
This was the first time she was fighting with this kind of limit on her primeval essence and she couldn't go on activating gu worms one after the other without restraint. She would need to be careful of how she used it.
One of the ice puppets launched itself at Zuo Lin, who clicked his teeth. Most of his methods were far less effective against an opponent made of ice, who would not bleed.
"Zuo Ming! Come here!" Zuo Lin roared.
Zuo Ming, on the other hand, was busy dealing with his own ice puppet. Any attempt by him to rescue Zuo Lin was thwarted by Bai Ning Bing, who was continuously striking out at them, aiming for their weak spots and trying to end this fight quickly.
Zuo Ming finally managed to shatter the ice puppet he was fighting against with a decisive blow, leaving Bai Ning Bing momentarily open.
However, as she was about to respond, something leaped out of her aperture without her commanding it: the White Form Immortal Snake!
It hissed as it spat out a large amount of mist on Zuo Ming.
Both Zuo Ming's and Zuo Lin's eyes widened.
A Rank 5 Gu worm from a Rank 3 Gu Master? How is that possible?
However, Bai Ning Bing did not have full control over the White Form Immortal Snake. It was merely helping her out. And so she had to capitalize upon the situation it had created.
As it retreated back into her aperture, the mist gave her a chance to close the distance between her and Zhu Lian, allowing her to drive an ice spear into his back.
He screamed, coughing out a mouthful of blood. 'It's been a long time since I had been injured like this!'
But before he could activate any of his healing Gu worms, the ice puppet was already upon him.
It was clear that he was going to die if he didn't do anything soon.
By now, Zuo Ming had escaped from the mist and saw that Zuo Lin was in trouble.
"Wait!" he said. Even as Bai Ning Bing drew another icicle to throw at him. "I... I don't know who you are, but I had been forced to join up with these people against my will. I don't see a need for us to fight. If there's something that you would want, I can see if I can provide for it."
"Traitor!" Zuo Lian screamed out, even as the ice puppet drove the icicle into his back further, finally piercing his heart.
His healing Gu was not be sufficient enough to counter a blow like this.

chapters.title: Chapter 191 191: White Form Immortal Snake: Part Three
chapters.content:
Bai Ning Bing pretended to think about Zuo Ming's offer of surrender for about a second before she said, "I think I'd rather just kill you."
Zuo Ming barely got out of the way before Bai Ning Bing was upon him. With the matter reduced to a one-on-one, it was clear who had the upper hand. Bai Ning Bing had killed multiple Rank 3 elders back in the day when she had only been Rank 2. Although her might was somewhat suppressed, her killing intent was not.
As Bai Ning Bing moved to land the final blow, however, one of his strikes shattered the mask upon her face. The gap in attention from Zuo Ming as he saw Bai Ning Bing's face was what allowed her to close the match in rapid succession.
As she saw that her task was done; her mask on the ground shattered - she hadn't thought to bring another one.
She gritted her teeth. 'Who even was she now?'
Since the events following her detonation, she had been wandering around, basically aimlessly from one point to another, hiding her face from everyone. 'Was this the kind of fate the genius of the Bai clan would have wished upon herself?' The greater the kind of being a former genius was, the harder it was to look in the mirror and accept yourself for what she currently was. That was why she hid herself, metaphorically going into a cave, much like Blazing Glory Lightning Brilliance had.
"Honestly, if I were to continue living like this, it would be worse than death," she said, coming upon an epiphany as she saw the sunlight reflect prismatically off the ice shards that still remained nearby. New hope began to rise within her. 'So what if I've been turned into a woman? Did that mean that I continue living my life stuck in that dollhouse, not moving outside? Who would worship someone who's searched for excitement wherever they came?'
'What kind of excitement would I find hiding very deep inside? So what if people laugh at me? So what if they shun me for having turned into a woman? There's nothing a single ice stab to the heart wouldn't fix.' 'Since when had I cared for insults before that? Why did I care for them now?' Bai Ning Bing said to herself. She kicked away the fragments of the mask. "I don't want to need any mask."
***
"Well, what are you going to say?" Fang Yuan asked Zuo Chen, who was on his last legs. "Hand over your Blood Path Gu worms, and I might consider sparing you."
"Screw your eighteen generations of ancestors, righteous path hypocrite!" Zhu Chen said before Fang Yuan landed the killing blow.
He examined Zuo Chen's aperture afterwards and confirmed that his gu worms had all detonated. "A pity," Fang Yuan said.
"What happened to your mask?" Fang Yuan asked, glancing at Bai Ning Bing.
"Destroyed," Bai Ning Bing said.
"Well, then. Our job here is done," Fang Yuan said, stretching lazily.
"Fang Yuan, there's something I want to say," Bai Ning Bing said as she watched the noon sun cast its brilliant rays upon the surrounding area, its prismatic reflections occasionally bouncing off the ice. "I no longer want to stay cooped up there in the dollhouse. I want to come out and wander around - which I'll do as I please!"
"Oh, is that so?" Fang Yuan asked her, smirking slightly. "Have you finally come to terms with your identity as a true woman?"
Bai Ning Bing coldly snorted and glared at Fang Yuan. She still wasn't ready to tell the world who she truly was. But that didn't meant that she had to hide, either. "Introduce me as some kind of lone cultivator or external elder for the clan."
Fang Yuan scratched his chin. He would have actually preferred introducing Bai Ning Bing herself as the former genius of the Bai clan. After all, that would make it easier for the Gu Yue clan to take them under their wing by manipulating her. "Oh well," Fang Yuan said, "but we'll need to find a new name for you then. How about Nai Bing Ning?"
Bai Ning Bing snorted. "Think of something better than that next time!" She barely got these words out as something emerged from her aperture.
Fang Yuan took five paces back, slightly shocked at the Rank 5 aura.
Bai Ning Bing had little time to react as the White Form Immortal Snake Gu flipped her over with its snout and then placed her on her back before carrying her away into the sky.
'The prophecy, was it true?' Bai Ning Bing thought.
Wings erupted from Fang Yuan's back as he prepared to follow them.
"Bai Ning Bing! What's going on?!"
The White Form Immortal Snake glared at him, letting out a hiss before he swerved away.
"I'll explain later!" Bai Ning Bing yelled out.
Fang Yuan considered following them. However, he found that his speed could not match that of a Rank 5 Gu.
He had enough human wills collected via Integration Gu to use his Human Path killer moves, but he had been saving them as a last resort in case he needed it against those demonic Gu Masters.
He decided that it wasn't worth it to chase after Bai Ning Bing and then fluttered down tot he ground.
Bai Ning Bing was carried by the White Form Immortal Snake higher and higher, above the clouds overseeing Qing Mao Mountain. The cold wind tore at her.
However, she endured without complaint as they happened upon an area which seemed to be no different from any of the other areas in the sky.
'Is this where the first-gen Bai clan ancestor's inheritance is hidden?' she wondered to herself.
The White Form Immortal Snake landed upon a certain cloud which, strangely enough, was able to bear its weight.
Someone like Fang Yuan wouldn't have found this to be out of the ordinary, although it was the first time Bai Ning Bing was encountering something like this.
She stepped off the snake, landing lightly on her feet. The cloud was able to support her weight, meaning it had likely been constructed this way for a reason.
The snake approached a section of the cloud, sinking its claws beneath the white, fluffy surface, and then pulling out a gu worm.
Bai Ning Bing took it. It was an Information Path Gu.
She was able to refine it with ease, as it was suppressed by the White Form Immortal Snake. Bai Ning Bing's mind began filling with information from the Information Path Gu worm.
The first generation Bai Clan ancestor had realized that in the future, someone with the Northern Dark Ice Soul Physique would be born within their clan.
The Information Path Gu worm, first of all, contained a way for someone with the Northern Dark Ice Soul Physique to continue surviving. One had to keep cultivating if one had one of the Ten Extreme Physiques so that their aperture would be strengthened, but the more that one cultivated, the more that the Extreme Physique would manifest, leading to a vicious cycle. As per the information written here, this would continue until one could ascend to the level of an Immortal. 'Hmm, I need a Rank 6 Ice Type Gu before I can ascend to immortality,' Bai Ning Bing thought to herself.
The inheritance had been created by a Rank 5 Gu Master and as such did not contain an Immortal Gu worm, as one would expect.
There was, however, something there.
The first generation Bai Clan had, through a fortuitous encounter, managed to find an incomplete recipe for a Rank 6 Ice Type Gu worm.
The recipe was left inside this inheritance, along with the recipes for many other mortal Ice Path gu worms.
Additionally, a location was marked down to her in the mountain below, where she could find additional gu worms from the inheritance.
Finally, the White Form Immortal Snake had acknowledged her as its true Master, and she was able to refine it instantly.
'To think! As a Rank 3 Gu Master I have direct control over a Rank 5 Gu!' She was sure that Fang Yuan would throw jealous looks at her once he told him - the Dollhouse notwithstanding, which was somewhat shared between the two of them.
Laughing, she climbed atop it before flying back down to the ground.

chapters.title: Chapter 192: Tie Clan Investigators: Part One
chapters.content:
A small distance from the foot of Qing Mao Mountain, two figures were approaching.
One of them was wearing the uniform of a Gu Master. The number '5' was inscribed upon the plate on his belt. He wore a plain copper mask over his face, hiding his features, though even one look at him and anyone worth their salt in the Southern Border would know who he is. He was an investigator famous throughout the entire Southern Border: Tie Xue Leng.
Next to him was a young girl. She had long legs and a serious expression painted with a tinge of eagerness. This was his daughter, Tie Ruo Nan who had Rank 3 cultivation. Both of them came from the Tie Clan, one of the major clans of the Southern Border.
"So this is it? Qing Mao Mountain?" Tie Xue Leng said, gesturing towards his daughter. "Well, tell me, what do you think?"
There was a reason why Tie Ruo Nan was accompanying him on this mission. She also intended to become an investigator, much like her father.
As a matter of fact, the Tie Clan was a clan involved deeply when it came to maintaining law and order in the Southern Border.
Many demonic Gu Masters had been brought to justice by Tie clansmen, and many of them were still in prison within the Demon Suppression Tower controlled by the Tie Clan. Tie Ruo Nan was eager to work and join her clansmen in this journey; however, she had seen little of the world, which is why Tie Xue Leng had brought her along.
It was one thing to want to become an investigator who pursued justice, and it was another to realize what that actually meant.
Tie Ruo Nan took a look at the mountain. It looked ordinary, much like most of the other mountains in the Southern Border. However, there was a thick layer of ice and snow which covered the base of the mountain despite the fact that it was summer.
Much of it had already begun to melt under the summer heat already, leading to large puddles as well as the soil being incredibly muddy. They would need to watch out for mudslides while they tried to ascend as well.
The top of the mountain was free of ice, but at the same time, it looked extremely bare. The contrast between the rest of the surroundings and the top of the mountain was evident. The greenery greatly thinned out, almost like the hair on the top of a balding man's head.
"It looks like someone used a very powerful Ice Path attack here," Tie Ruo Nan said. She couldn't imagine what kind of force could possibly cause this kind of damage to the mountain. However, she had heard that Rank 5 Gu Masters at the peak of their strength could rival the strength of a mountain though she had always thought that was more figurative than literal. From what her father told her though, it could very well be taken in the literal sense. "That means that we won't be able to find clues here easily," she told her father.
Her father nodded.
"But Father, why are we really here?" she asked him.ɴᴇᴡ ɴᴏᴠᴇʟ ᴄʜᴀᴘᴛᴇʀs ᴀʀᴇ ᴘᴜʙʟɪsʜᴇᴅ ᴏɴ novᴇlfire.net
They had been requested to come to the mountain initially because one of their clients had an issue with a demonic Gu Master.
However, such issues were numerous throughout the Southern Border. A mid-size clan like the Gu Yue Clan could not truly offer a reward fitting of her father, nor did it seem like an incident that was large enough to draw their attention. After all, as per the reports, the demonic Gu Master in question had not even killed anyone. Someone's cultivation had been crippled, but that was small fry compared to some of the other cases that Tie Xue Lang had to deal with: entire villages which had been wiped off the map, a fortress which had once stood that had suddenly sunk into the earth without a trace, merchant caravans which had completely vanished off the face of the world.
Without a doubt, these things took precedence over something small like this.
Tie Ruo Nan understood that.
As a matter of fact, she was rather sure that her father had intended to decline the request but had simply kept it at the back of his mind for one reason or another. It was even possible, she felt, that he had kept it just as a potential training exercise for her. However, this was far more than a training exercise that they were engaging in right now. They were not here to investigate the matter of that demonic Gu Master alone.
Something had happened on the mountain, and they had been called to investigate. The only thing was that Tie Ruo Nan didn't know who that person was.
She expressed these concerns to her father, to which he replied, "One of my long-term contacts told me that there was something going on on the mountain, namely, that there was a Blood Path Gu Master."
That long-term contact was someone from the Immortal Crane Sect. Lord Sky Crane had been forced to act quickly and had not been able to arrange for Tie Xue Leng to intercede before he had arrived, but he had set up this beforehand in case something untoward happened to him.
And multiple odd things had happened, Tie Xue Leng noted. The mountain had been nearly obliterated, supposedly by the hand of a demonic Gu Master who had attacked the clansmen there.
However, the demonic Gu Master who was said to have attacked them was said to have used not Blood Path methods - but cranes instead.
It seemed that Lord Sky Crane had attacked this village. This no doubt caused many doubts to form in his mind - he had reached out to him yet again, but no response had come from Lord Sky Crane.
Even more worryingly, it turned out that Lord Sky Crane had been found deceased soon after crossing the barrier between the Southern Border and the Central Continent.
'So he had come here... but then what happened?' Tie Xue Leng thought to himself. 'And where is that supposed demonic Blood Path Gu Master now?'
"Father, I asked you something," Tie Ruo Nan said, noting that her father had seemingly dozed off. He was getting along in years, that was true, but he was far from having a 'senior moment' like this.
"Right, sorry," Tie Xue Leng said. He cleared his throat. "Unfortunately, the water is rather murky when it comes to the events that happened here." He was the kind of person who would not tolerate the smallest of lies, and had unraveled countless tangled yarns in the past; so for him to say that a situation was quite murky was a testament to just how difficult it would be to solve. "I was told to investigate this place by a colleague who I had once trusted... though now I wonder about the truth of what he had told me. Anyway, I'm told that a demonic cultivator attacked this mountain and that led to this thick layer of ice. And that this demonic Gu Master used Blood Path methods..."
Tie Ruo Nan nodded, but that was little to go on.
"Hopefully the situation will get clearer once we start exploring," Tie Xue Leng said.
The incident that had occurred here was causing ripples all over the Southern Border, and numerous organizations were interested in what had happened. As a mater of fact, the Tie Clan had considered sending a group here to investigate before getting word that Tie Xue Leng was already on his way.
"Don't worry father," Tie Ruo Nan said. "I won't let you down! I'll get to the root of what happened here!"

chapters.title: Chapter 194 194: Tie Clan Investigators: Part Three
chapters.content:
"Oh, you must be here to investigate the demonic Gu Master, right?" the shopkeeper asked, shaking his head. "Terrible thing, what happened. My wife and youngest son were both killed in the fighting there. Only my oldest and I remain. I hope you can find whoever did this and stick something right up their rear!"
"Uh," Tie Ruo Nan said, not sure how to respond to that, but she continued her questioning. She didn't find out much which was new from this man.
All he knew was that one day he was simply lying around after the wolf tide was over, thinking that it was safe. He and his family had even made plans to visit a nearby pond in a few days. But before he could do that, something that he had been looking forward to, the cranes had attacked from nowhere, killing most of them. He had barely managed to escape with his life.
His wife at the time had been stationed somewhere else and had been killed far away from where he could've helped. And as for his youngest son, he had just recently enrolled in the Gu Master Academy, and as such, had been away from home.
"I thought he would be safe there," the man, the shopkeeper, continued. "You know, safe at school. However, the elder in charge of keeping them safe there also died, and all of the youngin's there perished."
The man then started to tear up and took a moment to compose himself before continuing.
Tie Ruo Nan wasn't sure what to say in this situation.
She tried to keep herself neutral, and her expression calm. However, she couldn't help but feel overwhelmed by sadness upon hearing the man's words. It wasn't just him who had suffered; nearly everyone on the mountain had also lost a great deal at the hands of that demonic Gu Master.
However, the fact remained that while his story may have been quite emotional and heart-wrenching, there was very little actual information Tie Ruo Nan could get about it.
Much of what he knew was hearsay and confirmed what she knew: that a demonic Gu Master who could control cranes had attacked their village until being defeated by the Gu Yue Clan and forced to retreat. He had not seen the demonic Gu Master in question use an Ice Path Gu worm to freeze the mountain, but he did not doubt the truth of that statement.
Tie Ruo Nan was interested in other things though. "I heard that there was some demonic Gu Master activity even before then. Can you tell me about that?"
They had been told that there had been a Blood Path Gu Master on the mountain for some time, and she wanted to see if she could find anything about that particular story.
"Oh yes, as a matter of fact, there was one thing..." the shopkeeper said, as if he had been struck by some kind of epiphany. "But... I don't know how reliable it was because I'd never seen it with my own eyes, y'know?"
"It's okay, even if it was a rumor. It's at least something to go on," Tie Ruo Nan said, urging him.
"Well, like I said, this is just a rumor, so I never really heard about it, or like, saw it with my own eyes. But they say that there was a demonic Gu Master from the Bai Clan... " the shopkeeper said, his voice dropping to a whisper dramatically. "And they say that the Bai Clan was pumping chemicals- alchemical solutions- into the rivers in order to make the frogs gay!"
Tie Ruo Nan blinked several times. This was not the kind of information she had been expecting, nor was it something that she had ever heard of before. "I'm sorry... did you just say... alchemical solutions to make the frogs gay?" she asked.
The shopkeeper nodded. "I heard I overheard some people talking about it, and everyone seems to think it's true. So it must be true. Why else would someone spread something so ridiculous?"
"Um," Tie Ruo Nan said. "Why exactly would someone dump alchemical solutions for that purpose, and what would they gain from making the frogs gay?"
The shopkeeper shrugged. "Who knows? Demonic Gu Masters tend to be messed up in the head. And maybe they were just trying to feminize all three of the clans on the mountain, you know, to make it easier for them to conquer? No offense," he said, noting the fact that Tie Ruo Nan was a girl after all.
Tie Ruo Nan shook her head. "Thank you," she said, realizing that she was not going to get any more information out of this person, at least not more useful information.
She visited several other areas of the village.
Some people outright shut their mouths whenever she asked them something. However, her father had told her that this was to be expected.
People tended to be wary of strange people wandering around asking them questions. However, there were a few who were willing to talk with her.
Two male Gu Masters had even declared their love for her and asked to marry her. Though when she dropped the name of her father, they both shut their mouths rather quickly.
Most of the information she got confirmed just the same things she knew already - or just brought a tear to her eye. That shopkeeper did not have a monopoly when it came to misery within Xiong village.
She didn't get much more that was new and substantial. However, when she mentioned the story about the demonic Gu Masters mixing things into the water to some people, several people said that they'd heard those rumors, and they thought that it must be true, but they had never seen it themselves.
By this time, her father called upon her that it was time to go. She had not made much progress, she felt. As she went to speak with her father, "Father, were you able to find out anything?"
"There is something indeed," Tie Xue Leng said. "A Blood Path Gu Master was indeed on Qing Mao Mountain a while back."
"Really?" Tie Ruo Nan asked.
"However, I don't think that that is the Blood Path Gu Master we were chasing." Tie Xue Lang sighed. "As per the clan elder, someone by the name of Zuo Chen came to extort the people on the mountain."
"Extorting people when they're weak and suffering like that? That's just terrible!" Tie Ruo Nan said.
"Indeed. But what else can we expect from demonic Gu Masters?" Tie Xue Leng said. "I know about this Zuo Chen, actually. He is a rather infamous demonic Blood Path Gu Master in the Southern Border."
Tie Ruo Nan's eyes widened. She didn't know much about the Blood Path, but from whatever tales she had heard, they were reviled even amongst demonic Gu Masters. The pinnacle of wickedness - the grandmasters of everything bad with the world!
"Yes, there are numerous warrants out for him, and even our clan was looking for him," Tie Xue Leng said. "It looks, however, that he had met his end at the hands of the Gu Yue Village Head. In other words, that hero you so greatly admire, Gu Yue Fang Yuan."

chapters.title: Chapter 195 195: Tie Clan Investigators: Part Four
chapters.content:
"I... I don't admire him that much," Tie Ruo Nan stutteringly said, once again, her cheeks flushed. "And anyway, you're the greatest hero in the Southern Border, Father!"
"Thank you for saying that, daughter, even if it is praise that I feel like I do not deserve. But, like I said, it seems like Zuo Chen was only here to extort them after he had heard of what had gone on the mountain, not before that. So, he isn't the man that we are searching for. Did you happen to find anything?"
Tie Ruo Nan related what she had heard. Tie Xue Leng noted many amateur mistakes that she had made while interviewing people, which he pointed out. However, he was left speechless when she got to the point about the alchemical solutions in the water.
"I'm sorry," Tie Xue Leng said, incredulous. "Are you pulling my leg here? Is this payback for all of the jokes that I made?"
"No, Father," Tie Ruo Nan said. "I thought that it was hard to believe as well, but I've heard it from too many sources for it to be just a rumor. There has to be some sort of foundation or seed of truth to it, right? If everyone is saying so... have you heard of anything like this in the past?"
Tie Xue Leng admitted that he had never heard of anything even vaguely similar to this. There were demonic Gu Masters who used aphrodisiacs as well; the Flower Wine Monk had used the Mist Perspiring Butterfly as an example to ensnare his women.
However, naturally, dumping such things into the water would greatly dilute them and their effect. Not to mention, you couldn't target anyone in particular. He couldn't see why anyone would even want to do something like that.
"Perhaps we'll find more details in the Bai Clan," Tie Ruo Nan said, finally giving up.
"Indeed," Tie Xue Leng said.
Both of them made their way to the Bai Clan.
However, while the Bai Clan was about the same size as the Xiong Clan, and also without proper wall surrounding the village, they seemed to be in much higher spirits than the Xiong.
'What on Earth is going on here?' Tie Ruo Nan wondered.
The two of them had basically been allowed to walk into the village without any resistance.
With the Xiong Clan, where an elder had come to greet them, Rank 5 Gu Masters were the kings of the mortal world, after all, and no one would dare risk offending one.
That was why an elder had come out to greet them in person at the Xiong Clan, but the Bai Clan did not follow their example. They seemed to have gotten word from the Xiong Clan that they had arrived, and so the two of them were simply waved in.
It was a far less cumbersome process, but it did also make Tie Ruo Nan's thoughts swirl in her head as to why this was happening.
It looked like a great portion of the village was busy with something else, and it seemed almost that they did not have the time to pay attention to them, as if a visiting Rank 5 Gu Master was something that this village could ignore.
"Oh, about that," someone replied to her. "We were accepting our new external elder."
"External elder?" Tie Ruo Nan asked.
Large clans like the Tie Clan did accept elders from different clans to become external elders. However, it was odd to think of a small clan like the Bai Clan accepting one, especially when they had been so thoroughly decimated already.
"Yes, it's quite the story," the man answered her. He seemed to be wondering whether or not he should actually be telling this kind of story to outsiders, before deciding that it couldn't hurt when Tie Xue Leng handed him a primeval stone. "A few days ago, the White Form Immortal Snake, one of our signature gu, which had been left behind by our ancestor, left the place where it was being kept. We thought that our ancestor had abandoned us... and this was merely a sign of their dissatisfaction with us. However, it turned out that the gu in question found someone who had wandered onto the mountain and was accepted by this Gu. There's a legend in our Bai Clan Village that whoever would be accepted by them would lead our clan to great prosperity. Even though this person wasn't from our village, the fact that they had gained the recognition of our ancestor told us all that we needed to know, and we welcomed them as an external elder."
Tie Ruo Nan tried to process this information. This was completely new, and so must have been quite a recent event. She had also not heard of any sort of legend or tale regarding the Bai village, though many clans had some sort of similar tale regarding an old ancestor. More times than not it was just fanciful wishing from a downtrodden clan, but there were times indeed when it turned out to be true.
"Is it possible to meet with this external elder?" Tie Xue Leng asked.
In ordinary circumstances, a visitor wouldn't be able to so casually, but with his authority as a Rank 5 Gu Master, he would have been able to secure a meeting - the only question was when. They didn't intend to stay in Bai Clan Village for too long, after all. It was a bit rude to demand a meeting the moment that they walked in, but at the same time, not exactly beyond reason for Tie Xue Leng.
"Sure, sure, but I think they might be busy. You'll have to ask someone over there," he said, pointing towards what remained of the Bai Clan's Clan Hall. Its roof had caved in and none of its windows were intact, but it was a semi-functioning building currently even if it couldn't properly hold off the elements or fend off the rats and other vermin that scoured the villages for any remaining crumbs.
"And if you don't mind me asking," Tie Ruo Nan asked, "what was the name of this person who suddenly became your external elder? Maybe the two of them had heard of him."
"Oh, someone who I've never met before, but maybe you guys have heard of... oh wait. that's right, it's a woman, not a man. Her name is Ling Ding Ching."
"Ling Ding Ching - can't say I've ever heard of a name like that," Tie Xue Leng said, but this could be a new person or an old lone cultivator. "Thank you for your time."
The two of them set off to go meet with this Ling Ding Chng and wandered into the Bai clan's clan hall.
The door was at the very least still functioning, and the clan member guarding it bowed his head lightly before opening it up so that they could step inside.
The smell of damp and rotting wood, as well as something else, still permeated through the air. The numerous incense candles lit in the place only masked the odor - they did not remove it.
The people inside seemed to be somewhat used to this though, as there was a large crowd gathered in the building around one person. As the crowd parted, Tie Ruo Nan got a glimpse of someone with radiant white hair and glowing skin - even with a small glance she could tell that this was a peerless beauty.
Upon sensing the Rank 5 aura permeating throughout the room, many of the Bai Clansmen turned around to see what the source was before doing a double-take at Tie Xue Leng's appearance. Some of them seemed to not know who he was, but as Tie Xue Leng motioned for them to step aside, they complied.
"Are you Lady Ling Ding Ching?" Tie Xue Leng asked the woman in the center.
With a frosty scowl, the woman answered, "Indeed I am. Who's asking?"

chapters.title: Chapter 196 196: Tie Clan Investigators: Part Five
chapters.content:
Tie Xue Lang took a better look at the person who had addressed them. To call that person frosty was an understatement. They seemed to embody the beauty of an ice-filled, desolate tundra, and at the same time, also carried no warmth or kindness, much like the snowy plains themselves.
In short, they embodied 'ice' in both the physical and mental sense of the word completely.
"My name is Tie Xue Leng," her father answered. Normally, people would be somewhat astonished facing a Rank 5 Gu Master, particularly in small clans like this. However, this lady seemed to have no fear whatsoever as she walked up to them.
"Well, if you're here to deal with those Blood Path Gu Masters, then you're too late," Bai Ning Bing said. "They're already dead." Her tone had an edge to it, as if she was blaming the two of them for not arriving on time and forcing her to deal with the problem instead of dealing with it themselves.
"Oh, so you know more about that incident?" Tie Xue Leng asked, nonplussed by her attitude.
"Know about it? I was involved hand and foot in it!" Bai Ning Bing responded.
After she had gained the approval of the Immortal Snake, she had landed back in Bai Clan Village. Upon seeing that their most prestigious gu worm was back, many of the villagers came around to greet it and see if they could finally feed it as they thought this was the underlying reason as to why it had flown away in the first place. It would be more accurate to say that it was given sacrifices rather than food, however.
They quickly noted that it had been refined, and Bai Ning Bing stepped off the gu worm.
'Did you really want to name yourself Ling Ding Ching? That sounds like a fake name. That also sounds even worse than the example I gave, and that was a joke,' Fang Yuan's criticism was still ringing in her ears, even as she said that name while introducing herself, too stubborn to change it.
The Bai Clan villagers were initially quite fearful of her, though to her immense relief, none of them seemed to recognize her.
While some of them did mention that her frosty demeanor and cold attitude seemed to match that of their former genius, Bai Ning, none of them would reach the conclusion that the person standing before them was that former genius, only gender-swapped.
Once Bai Ning Bing showed the remaining elders proof that she had indeed found the first generation Bai ancestor's inheritance, they were far more open to accepting her.
As it was, before the might of one who controlled a Rank 5 Gu worm, they did not want to risk offending her, even if she only had Rank 3 cultivation. It wasn't like they had a Rank 4 Gu Master within their ranks either.
Bai Ning Bing, therefore, was in the process of becoming an external elder of her own clan. The Bai Clan had not taken an external elder before, at least not someone who they hadn't nurtured from being a Gu Master to being Rank 3.
It was odd for them to take in someone who was already Rank 3. However, given the pressure that Gu Yue Village was exerting, they chose to temporarily take their chances with this stranger. As it was, it wasn't like Bai Ning Bing was competing for clan head, only for a position of external elder.
'If only I could've gotten my hands on those gu worms,' Bai Ning Bing thought to herself. The inheritance had mentioned the location of several more gu worms for the inheritor to take. However, when she had visited that area, she found that, thanks to her own detonation, those gu worms had already been killed.
Before the might of the explosion of an extreme physique, very few mortal methods could last the test of time.
"I would like to ask a few more questions about that incident then, if you don't mind," Tie Xue Leng requested.
Bai Ning Bing scoffed, but she didn't refuse them either.
The three of them walked outside.
Bai Ning Bing told them the same story she had told the clan: that she had been a lone cultivator who cultivated the Ice Path and had been somewhat attracted to the recent disaster on Qing Mao Mountain. While the ice could be said to be a detriment to the mountain's overall ecology, blessings and misfortunes usually came together when it came to heaven's tribulations.
Under the thick layer of ice, many Ice Path resources could potentially form, so it was only natural for someone like her to seek them out. And when she had done so, the White Form Immortal Snake had found her and then acknowledged her as its master.
Since the story said that the White Form Immortal Snake would only acknowledge a Bai clansman, some people began to speculate whether she was some kind of long-lost child from some Bai clansmen who had wandered away from the mountain and settled down somewhere else.
It was not entirely unreasonable or impossible, and Bai Ning Bing would rather prefer that they think that compared to the truth.
"Actually, now that you mention it," Bai Ning Bing told them, thinking quickly in the heat of the moment. "I do think that one of my grandparents was said to have once come from Qing Mao Mountain..."
Clansmen generally tended to live in their villages their whole lives, but occasionally someone would strike out into the wider world. Fang Yuan had been an example of such in his first life - though he had been thrown out; people left for other reasons as well.
"Come to think of it, Lady Ling Ding Ching looks somewhat close to Lord Bai Ning Bing..."
"Maybe they were long-lost cousins or something..."
"Ah, a pity that he died before being able to meet with one of his relatives."
"Right, ah, this Bai Ning Bing fellow seems to be quite the character," Bai Ning Bing said. "He seemed to have been quite heroic and daring. I can only hope to live up to his example as I start living as a true Bai clansmen..."
There were cheers at this. Some of them were still not fully convinced - even if this Ling Ding Ching somehow had Bai clan blood in her veins, she had not been raised as a Bai clansmen from birth. Could they really trust her?
For now though, those people were in the minority - as many people just wanted some kind of good news after all the tragedies that had happened.
With this mystery solved, the Bai clansmen had welcomed Bai Ning Bing under this new alias with open arms and very little further probing.
Tie Xue Leng, however, was far more astute. He did not completely buy this explanation.
"Well, there's unfortunately not much more that I can tell you," Bai Ning Bing said. "I only just came to the mountain recently, you see. But if you ask the Gu Yue clan leader, Gu Yue Fang Yuan, he might be able to tell you more."
"Understood," Tie Xue Leng said. "Thank you for your time."
By now, the sun was about to set, so there was not much more they could do. They chose to stay near Bai Village - which had been so badly damaged that there was no tavern for them to stay in- so instead they camped out in the wilderness. They declined any invitation to stay with some of the elders.
Not that they were unused to this, having traveled all the way here through the wilderness in the first place.

chapters.title: Chapter 197 197: Tie Clan Investigators: Part Six
chapters.content:
Tie Ruo Nan found no more useful information from any of the Bai Clan villagers before they left. While she heard the name 'Bai Ning Bing' occasionally as a famous personality within the clan, she never would have connected it to the person she had just met, and Bai Ning Bing's secret of holding the Northern Dark Ice Soul Physique was now known only to those who had passed on to the next life.
One thing that did surprise Tie Ruo Nan, though, was the fact that many of the Bai clansmen, even more so than the Xiong clansmen, seemed to also say that there were demonic cultivators putting alchemical solutions into the water.
However, there was something off in how they said this, many of them smirking slightly, as if there wasn't some kind of inside joke that they weren't sharing. Or maybe they just found the rumor ridiculous? Her father certainly seemed to think so, dismissing the entire thing as being nothing more than the 'odd fantasy of some person.'
"I doubt that there was much truth to it," Tie Xue Leng told her. Tie Ruo Nan, on the other hand, was new to this and more easily misled, thinking that if so many different sources said the same thing, it had to be true.
The next morning, they set out for Gu Yue Village. The village had managed to repair the wall which surrounded it, differentiating it from the other villages on immediate inspection.
In addition, its population was over eight times that of the other two combined. Some of that was because mortals had flocked to this village rather than the other two, but there was no doubt that when it came to strength, whether it be in numbers or just cultivation, this village was the king of Qing Mao Mountain.
That said, the balance of power would shift once again once the Gu Yue Clan heard that the Bai Clan had someone who could use a Rank 5 gu worm freely.
Someone was there to greet them at the gate. They had a '2' inscribed upon the plate on their belt and introduced themselves as Gu Yue Fang Zheng.
"Are you perhaps...?" Tie Xue Leng wondered.
"Yes, Fang Yuan is my twin brother," Fang Zheng said. "He apologizes for not being able to greet you directly; he is currently occupied with a vital issue related to our clan. You have to understand that with current events, there are multiple things which need his attention."
Tie Xue Leng waved his hand. "That is fine. Don't worry."
Although someone like Tie Xue Leng would normally expect the clan head to greet him whenever he came to a village, they had dropped by unannounced.
On top of which, at most, the Gu Yue Village would have had one day's worth of notice to prepare if the Bai or Xiong clans had informed them.
Still, Tie Xue Leng would usually expect at least Rank 3 elder to greet them. He was unsure what Gu Yue Fang Yuan meant by sending this person to greet them instead.
It could normally be seen as an affront to send a Rank 2 Gu Master instead of a Rank 3 elder. At the same time, this person was his younger brother, a family member and potential future elder of the clan as well. It was not necessarily true that those with higher cultivation ranks necessarily carried more political power. Jia Jin Sheng was such an example, despite being only Rank 1; as the caravan leader's younger brother he carried a great deal of authority. He had been able to do almost whatever he pleased unless his elder brother put his foot down.
It could be the same in this case.
By being Fang Yuan's brother, it was possible that Fang Zheng had the political clout equivalent to an elder.
"Come with me."
The difference between Gu Yue Village and the other two villages was apparent even before they walked in, but was even more stark on the inside.
While most of the buildings also showed signs of damage, many of them had also been repaired and seemed to be mostly functional.
Not only were there more people within the village, Tie Ruo Nan also felt that they were... for lack of a better word, more lively and optimistic. There was a shine and glimmer in their eyes, which the Xiong and the Bai clansmen, particularly the Xiong clansmen, seemed to lack. 'Is this all because of Fang Yuan?' she thought to herself. 'Is that why they remain so hopeful?'
Fang Zheng led them to a repurposed guesthouse, which had originally been a flat for one of the elders. Given the shortage of elders currently, it was vacant. A meal had already been prepared for them, and while it could not be said to be fine cuisine, given the situation the village was in, it was clear that they had put a great amount of care and thought into what they were serving them.
"Thank you for this warm welcome," Tie Xue Leng said.
"My older brother asked me to guide you around the village," Fang Zheng said, cupping his hands. "If there's anything that you need, please do not hesitate to ask. As it is, I really do hope that you succeed in your investigation and get to the root of events."
Tie Xue Leng noted that the boy's feelings seemed to be genuine, and he seemed to be thankful that the two of them were here.
"Don't worry, we'll do our best to find the culprit," Tie Ruo Nan said. Tie Xue Leng gently nudged her. It was not a good idea to make promises, especially ones that you were not sure you could keep.
"Yes, please bring those people to justice!" Fang Zheng said eagerly, with a small smile on his face.
"Do you want me to tell you about what happened, or would you prefer to wait after lunch?"
"No, it's fine. We can talk and eat too," Tie Xue Leng said.
"So this is what happened," Fang Zheng said, and started narrating the events which had occurred with Lord of the Mysteries.
It was then that the two Tie clansmen realized something. There was a reason that Fang Zheng was so eager to help them out, and there was another reason why it seemed that Fang Yuan had asked for Fang Zheng to be the one to help them: because Fang Zheng had been involved hand in foot in the matter that they had been originally called to investigate. As a matter of fact, he had been the victim in question, whose cultivation aptitude had fallen significantly!
Tie Ruo Nan choked a little on what she was eating as she thought about this.
"Need some water?"
"No, I'm fine," Tie Ruo Nan said. Her father was far more composed than she was.
Fang Zheng looked so eager and hopeful when he looked at the two of them. She didn't have the heart to tell him that they weren't really here to investigate what had happened to him.
Also, she felt slightly guilty. She had written off this initial incident as being nothing more than a small issue that she didn't really have to worry about. However, upon seeing Fang Zheng's state, and thinking that he could likely have been a Rank 3 elder by this point had this not happened, she realized that, no matter how small the crime was, it did not appear so to the victim in question.
'I'm sorry Fang Zheng, but we probably won't be able to help you,' she thought, sinking into her seat a little.

chapters.title: Chapter 198 198: Tie Clan Investigators: Part Seven
chapters.content:
Once they were done eating, Fang Zheng said, "Shall I take you to the scene of the crime?"
The father and daughter duo exchanged glances. This was not why they were here. However, it was why they had been called here, and so it would seem odd if they refused Fang Zheng's request. As they walked towards where Fang Zheng said the incident had happened, they asked him questions regarding the village.
"We had heard that there was a Blood Path demonic Gu Master on this mountain as well," Tie Xue Leng said.
"Oh, that," Fang Zheng said. "Yeah, there was one that my elder brother had to deal with. His name was Zuo Chen."
"No, not that," Tie Xue Leng said. "I mean before that."
Fang Zheng frowned. "I can't really think of any demonic Gu Master who was on our mountain." He was telling the truth, because despite first gen Gu Yue's actions, he still did not consider that person in question to be demonic. To Fang Zheng, there was a division between demonic cultivators and righteous path cultivators. Being part of a clan meant that one was righteous, regardless of their actions. Many righteous path cultivators could be hypocrites, not all of them were upstanding people like Fang Yuan or Qing Shu, after all.
And Tie Ruo Nan found that Fang Zheng did not seem to know all that much. Despite being Fang Yuan's younger brother, he had only been at the scene of the fighting and had his elder brother chase away the demonic 'crane-wielding Gu Master,' as he called it. But they could not get much more out of him. As it was, he knew which points to keep his mouth shut on.
When the topic came to the new changes in the Bai and the Xiong clans recently, particularly the Bai Clan's external elder. "Yes," Fang Zheng said. "I heard that this lady, Ling Ding Ching, is trying her best to work as an elder of the Bai Clan, despite her disability."
"Disability?" Tie Ruo Nan asked. They had not heard of something like that, and she seemed perfectly able when they had seen her. "What kind of disability?"
"The worst kind- the fact that she's a woman," Fang Zheng said.
Now, he was saying that in the context of the fact that he knew that Bai Ning Bing had been a man before and such a change would be greatly mentally scarring. He did not reveal the full details of this to them, of course. What he had said was more of a slip of a tongue that he was inwardly chastising himself for, therefore deciding to keep quiet for the time being so that he wouldn't reveal anything else.
However, as you can imagine, this tiny slip of the tongue did put an odd impression on both of them.
'Are we still in the Southern Border? Where did this kind of Northern Plains attitude come from?' Tie Xue Leng wondered.
He glanced over at his daughter, wondering what she was thinking.
Needless to say Tie Ruo Nan's head was reeling. Fang Zheng had seemed like such a polite and upstanding youngster up until now. This statement had seemingly come out of nowhere and threw here for a spin. She hadn't thought there was this kind of side to him! Not to mention, it would be one thing if he had said something like this to her father. But the audacity to say it while she was here?
'Hey you dumb boor! If you really think that, then why don't we have a fight and see who's really 'disabled?'' she thought. She wanted to challenge Fang Zheng, but held off on it. It woudn't do to cause that kind of commotion here, and there was important work to be done.
Fang Zheng, for his part, barely noticed this change and continued walking like before.
Tie Ruo Nan though, thought that she really hoped that his twin brother also wasn't the same way. No, how could someone gain a reputation like Gu Yue Fang Yuan's if they behaved like this?
The rest of their journey was far more silent interrupted only by the odd question or two, Fang Zheng oblivious to the cold attitude the two of them had towards him now.
"So this is where it happened," Fang Zheng said.
The area had once been used for the academy's field test, but was now barren of most of its foliage. That might make finding clues either, though Tie Ruo Nan felt there was some other issue with it. "Fang Zheng, with such damage done to the area, we likely won't be able to find anything."
"Oh, is that so?" Fang Zheng said, disappointed. He had thought that given how famous they were, they might've been able to find something. And maybe in a different time they would've been able to -before Bai Ning Bing's detonation, that is.
"We'll see what we can find," Tie Xue Leng said.
Fang Zheng went into detail regarding what had happened. "So, he was right there and then leaped out of the bushes. Then, there was a fight and..."
While his testimony was detailed, no signs of what had happened remained.
"This unique gu worm that he used - Testicular Torsion Gu, does your clan still have it?" Tie Xue Leng asked.
"Well that ah..." Fang Zheng said, trailing off. "My brother refined it from Rank 3 to Rank 4. I don't think that there would be any clues there then..." Refinement completely purified a gu worm, removing any prior traces or impurities it might have.
"No clues we can get from there then," Tie Xue Leng said. "In that case, is there still a body to examine?"
"Yes! The old clan head had it preserved in case you happened to drop by. We couldn't find anything on him, but you probably can!" Fang Zheng said hopefully.
The only other thing that he'd really wanted after having his cultivation crippled other than seeing his aunt and uncle get their comeuppance was to find who was responsible for sending that demonic Gu Master who'd done it in the first place.
Even his brother had been unable to deduce any clues, and he'd almost lost all hope given recent events. Whatever traces might've remained were wiped away by the ice- so he felt. But there was still a small shred of hope in his heart. The corpse was still intact, meaning that there could be clues there.
On the way back, Fang Zheng still lead the way, with the two trailing behind him.
"I don't really like him," Tie Ruo Nan whispered to her father, no longer feeling very sorry for what had happened to him. "Do we still need to keep this up?"
"We may found something else while taking a look at this," Tie Xue Leng said. "Remember that we might stumble upon something that might help us with our true mission..."
Tie Ruo Nan nodded, though she still shot a nasty look at Fang Zheng, who was still marching on ahead, blissfully unaware at the hostility that he'd provoked.

chapters.title: Chapter 199: Tie Clan Investigators: Part Eight
chapters.content:
Fang Zheng took the Tie clansmen to the place where the body was being kept. If there was one upside of the ice that had encased the mountain after Bai Ning Bing's detonation, it was the fact that it made body preservation quite easy. At the very least, the body hadn't been destroyed.
It was Tie Ruo Nan's first time looking at an unclothed dead body, though she knew that her father oftentimes had to do these sorts of things to look for clues.
"No markings as far as I can tell," Tie Xue Leng said, turning the body over and examining every single part of it. His gu worms also detected little abnormal. "Nothing abnormal about his aperture either. Do you happen to know where his other gu worms are, other than the Rank 3 Testicular Torsion Gu?"
"Yes," Fang Zheng replied. "Some of them were taken by clan members. But... many of them might be dead. We had to cull a few gu worms since we couldn't feed them at first. And as for the records of what happened to their Gu worms? They might be there in the clan records, but I'll have to check."
"Let's go see them then," Tie Ruo Nan said.
Fang Zheng looked hesitant. "I'm sorry, but I can't allow you to see the clan records; those are for clan members only."
"That is... not a problem," Tie Xue Leng said. "I think we can trust Gu Yue Fang Zheng here. We'll wait while you go search the records yourself."
"The thing is, even I can't access those records," Fang Zheng said. "They are for elders only. I'll have to get an elder to help out with that." Fang Zheng didn't want to ask Qing Shu for anything. However, in the current circumstance, he had to rely on someone, and the others were busy. "Let's see. There was a... no, that person's dead, and their gu worms are gone. And... no, it looks like this Gu worm was destroyed in the fighting."
"I'm sorry, it doesn't look like there was anything that could lead us there," Fang Zheng said to Tie Xue Leng after reviewing the records.
"I don't happen to recognize his face either," Tie Xue Leng said. "I can send word to the Tie Clan about him to see if they have any records or a picture. However, if he was a small-time demonic cultivator, we might not find anything at all." Their 'investigation' into this matter pretty much hit a stone wall at this point, as there was nothing more to go on.
Later that evening, Fang Yuan greeted them himself. The reason that he had been absent earlier in the day was because he had been busy hiding the traces of first gen Gu Yue in the Blood River Graveyard.
That place was massive, and it had many entry points. Even if he tried to barricade the direct entry under the clan, it didn't mean that Tie Xue Leng wouldn't be able to get there. If anything, if he dug deep enough, he would eventually run into that blood lake, much like the Flower Wine Monk had.
If word got out that the Gu Yue Clan's ancestor had been a Blood Path cultivator, they would be labeled as the fruit of a demonic path Gu Master, and it would cause endless headaches for them.
If the Immortal Crane Sect tried to push for it, they might even be attacked by other clans.
As such, Fang Yuan had put away things like the Gu Yue Ancestor's coffin, as well as his Blood Chariot Wheel, which had been sufficiently fed for now. As for the Dollhouse, it had its own stealth mechanism, which was more than enough to hide it from a Rank 5 Gu Master and had been placed away to hide it.
"My apologies for not being able to see you sooner," Gu Yue Fang Yuan said. The Tie Clan father and daughter duo took a look at this youngster. He looked exactly like Fang Zheng did, but without a doubt, there were some key differences. He stood more upright, was more confident, and there was an aura of righteousness about him. Tie Ruo Nan instantly felt far more warmth towards him than she did towards Fang Zheng, not the least because of Fang Zheng's off-handed comment earlier.
Now this was how a true righteous cultivator was supposed to behave.
"No worries. I can understand the problems of a small clan such as this," Tie Xue Lang said.
Fang Yuan was eager to get rid of these two as soon as possible, but he couldn't exactly just chase them away. It was creating a massive headache for him, as he was now busy trying to deflect their investigation rather than doing quite literally anything else. Not to mention, they had decided to come right after the Blood Path demonic Gu Masters had attacked, not during that time, during which they would have actually been somewhat helpful.
"How is your investigation going?" Fang Yuan asked. "I am quite eager to know who the underlying organization might have been behind the person who attacked my younger brother."
"Regarding that," Tie Xue Leng said, "we unfortunately have found no more clues than you were able to, or any leads. Given this, it's likely that he was a demonic cultivator acting on his own."
