By the time the first rays of dawn appeared on the horizon, Bei Gu Mountain was already visible.
"Why are we stopping here? It doesn't look like there's a primeval spring here - shouldn't we be looking at a mountain?" Bai Ning Bing asked as Fang Yuan descended near a forest.
It looked like they were still a half-day's distance away from the mountain if they were walking on foot.
"It's been a long trip," Fang Yuan said. Even with his gu worm's protection, he still needed to warm up somehow, either through a fire or relevant gu worm. His primeval essence had also run low at this time, so it was a good idea to replenish it. "Let's eat before we head up to the mountain."
"Is that where the primeval spring is?"
"It should be there, yes," Fang Yuan said.
"'Should be?'" Bai Ning Bing asked, suspiciously. "Are you saying that you're not certain?"
"When are people ever certain of anything? These are all based on rumors and the like, of course," Fang Yuan said, nonchalantly. Of course, he knew for a fact that there was something on Bei Gu Mountain; otherwise, he wouldn't have come here. But he couldn't very well reveal that to Bai Ning Bing. "Anyway, there's a specific reason I wanted to land down here. The surrounding forest has a large number of grass skirt monkeys. Why don't you go ahead and capture a few for breakfast while I make a fire?"
"And why don't you go ahead and do it?" Bai Ning Bing asked.
"My primeval essence is almost out," Fang Yuan said, "and we need me to work the White Form Immortal Snake, don't we?"
The White Form Immortal Snake's preferred food was fresh spring water. This seemed easy enough to get, but it had to be absolutely fresh. It could not be contaminated in any way, otherwise it would refuse to drink it. It had recently been fed, meaning it wouldn't need to be fed for another few months or so, but it could drink up an entire waterfall when it did feed.
Bai Ning Bing took it back into her own aperture, not wanting to leave it with Fang Yuan as he started making a fire.
As Bai Ning Bing went out to go hunt for some food, she sneezed.
As much as she hated to admit it, she had felt rather cold on top of the White Form Immortal Snake, especially toward the later half of the journey. Her stubbornness had prevented her from voicing her concern, assuming that she would feel better once they had landed. However, the early morning air was still quite frosty.
It would be some time before the sun came up. The monkeys were already awake, though, already starting to jump around as Bai Ning Bing prepared the materials needed to catch them.
Fang Yuan had started a fire in a nearby cave once he had scouted out the area and determined that it was safe. On the journey here, they had not run into any major encounters. However, that was because they were flying.
When he came here with the village in the future, they would need to come on foot, meaning the likelihood of getting sidetracked by either wild beasts, wild gu worms, or demonic Gu Masters was far higher than it was here.
Already, he was making a note of the surrounding terrain and any dangers that might be lurking there. While plotting out a route in his head, they could try to come down here by Huang Long River.
However, that was incredibly dangerous and would likely result in the loss of several people unless they had the appropriate gu worms to do so. Going over land was safer but would take far more time and would have its own dangers.
So long as they traveled as a group, just like a merchant caravan would, the casualties could be minimized. However, that was the thing: they would be minimized but not reduced to zero. Given their already anemic state, could they really afford to lose any more people? The amount of dao marks that he was getting everyday by increasing the Gu village's population would double eventually, but that day seemed to be shrinking further and further along the timeline. Just trying to move them all here was going to be a massive headache.
Bai Ning Bing returned shortly thereafter, a string of grass skirt monkeys tied around her waist. They looked like ordinary monkeys but were called such because they tended to wear skirts made of leaves around their hips.
The monkeys, upon seeing the fire, immediately began shaking and trying to run as they realized what was going to happen to them next. Bai Ning Bing used the fire to try to warm her hands. There was a time when she could convert her entire body to ice and wouldn't have minded. However, that was when her extreme physique was at its peak and she had the needed gu worms, many of which she had been unable to get back after she had lost them after detonating.
"Wait, don't do that," Fang Yuan said as Bai Ning Bing prepared to chop the head off one of the monkeys. "There's a better way to eat them."
He took one and after applying minimal primal essence, used the Vermilion Blood Moon Gu to cut the top of the monkey's skull off, almost like he was trying to open up a coconut. The monkey, still alive, began screeching in pain. However, Fang Yuan paid it no heed as he took out a spoon and then scooped some of its brain out.
"Here. Try some of this."
"Like this? Without cooking it?" Bai Ning Bing asked. Her nose started running, and she coughed in the middle of speaking this.
"Yes, it's quite good," Fang Yuan said. He noted Bai Ning Bing's symptoms. Hopefully, the heat from the fire would mean that she would not develop any severe symptoms, otherwise, that could greatly delay their journey here.
Bai Ning Bing took a spoonful of the grass skirt monkey's brain and tasted it. "Huh? Oh, wow. This tastes..." It tasted far better than she had anticipated. It melted in her mouth like a creamy dessert and was surprisingly cold. And yet, at the same time, it was the same temperature as the monkey's normal brain and didn't make her symptoms worse.
Fang Yuan took a spoonful himself. It tasted a lot like ice cream and was quite a nice delicacy. The grass skirt monkey in question continued screaming as Fang Yuan scooped its brains out until it finally died.
The other captive grass skirt monkeys were even more agitated now as they saw what was going to happen to them. However, the two of them paid them no heed as they continued to chop their skulls off and devour their brains before cooking their meat.

chapters.title: Chapter 224: Bei Gu Mountain: Part Four
chapters.content:
"Someone is approaching," Bai Ning Bing muttered, noting footsteps coming from outside.
"Relax. It's a Tracker puppet," Fang Yuan said. He had sent it out in order to see what the surrounding area was like, so at least they would have part of their journey mapped out if they tried to come here on foot.
The tracker puppet relayed what the surrounding dangers were. There was a wolf pack nearby. Also, there was a multicolored bird in the sky, which Fang Yuan assumed was a Xuan Yuan Divine Pheasant based on its description. That was not much of an issue. It would not attack them as long as they had the White Form Immortal Snake with them, as it was only a Rank 4 Beast King. However, if they were traveling via a long caravan, it might be a different story altogether.
'Moving really is going to be a massive pain,' Fang Yuan thought to himself. Even if he killed the Xuan Yuan Divine Pheasant right here and now in anticipation of their future journey, it would just eventually be replaced by a different beast king.
"Now that we're done with breakfast," Fang Yuan said, "there's something else I wanted to do here."
Bai Ning Bing snorted. Of course. She had figured that there was another reason for him to stop at this particular place. "And what is that?"
"Well, the grass skirt monkeys have a big group over there, right? You just happened to catch some of the members hanging out at the periphery. What do monkeys happen to make?"
Bai Ning Bing recalled The Legends of Ren Zu. "Monkey wine?"
Fang Yuan nodded. "I run a wine tavern back in Gu Yue Village. However, wine is a bit hard to come by, especially high-quality wine like that now." He intended to advance Fang Zheng's vital Gu, but if he wanted to do that, he would need wine in order to feed it. First-class wine like those made by monkeys was the best for this purpose.
The grass skirt monkey group consisted of just under a thousand monkeys, with 3 of them being Hundred Beast Kings.
Normally, it would be troublesome for someone like Bai Ning Bing to attempt to fight them all off even with her Rank 3 Peak Stage cultivation, but Fang Yuan was at Rank 5 right now. Even if he lacked any Rank 5 Gu worms other than the Blood Deity, which he did not want to show here, taking care of this kind of group was easy enough.
His Vermillion Crimson Moonblade shot out forward, easily hacking through over 30 monkeys in one fell swoop. Bai Ning Bing swerved around, striking out at them.
The monkeys were mainly troublesome because, much like humans, they tended to band together in a group, and after seeing that they were under attack, they would all group together and swarm them. However, they still lacked the intelligence of humans. Fang Yuan and Bai Ning Bing were able to use the surrounding terrain to limit their enemy's movements while picking them off.
Midway through the battle, after Fang Yuan had killed the 3 Hundred Beast Kings, the monkeys seemed to realize that they were done for and scattered out in all directions, even abandoning the monkey wine that they had. 'That's a smart decision on their part,' Fang Yuan thought. He and Bai Ning Bing took the barrels of monkey wine.
Although it was called monkey wine simply because it was made by monkeys, this was more of a general term for all the kinds of wines that monkeys could make. It could still come in various flavors and varied greatly in quality. However, for Fang Yuan to advance Four Flavors Liquor Worm, he needed different kinds of spices, as well as another Four Flavors Liquor Worm, neither of which he had right now.
That was not to say that this wine could not be useful, as he stored it away.
"Should we go out and kill the remaining monkey group?" Bai Ning Bing asked.
"Why? We already have what we came for," Fang Yuan said.
"But when we come back later on with our villages, won't they bear a grudge from all of this? What if a thousand beast king or the like grows among them?"
Fang Yuan thought about it. The issue wasn't killing all of the monkeys. The problem was that it would just take too much time for what he thought was worthwhile.
"We will deal with that problem when it comes," Fang Yuan said, waving his hand. "Even if they bear a grudge, it'll still take some time for another hundred beast king to emerge, let alone another thousand beast king, leaving that even a ten thousand beast king will be a problem once we come back. What's more important is that we deal with this issue as soon as we can. I have work left in the village."
The monkeys had scattered in various directions, which would make it very difficult to go and hunt them down one by one. Not impossible, mind you, but it might take a day or longer if they really wanted to make sure that the grass was pulled out by the roots - time that could be better spent doing something else.
"My primeval essence has recovered a lot," Fang Yuan said. "Let's fly up to the top of the mountain."
He was still at Rank 5 Initial Stage. He had a Purple Crystal Relic Gu in his inventory, but he had not seen cause to use it up until now.
If he happened to get two more, of course, he would use them gladly. But with Bai Ning Bing's help and the Equality Gu, he could nurture his aperture at a rate that would be otherwise impossible, and so he was saving that for a rainy day. Before leaving, Fang Yuan made sure that they hid all traces that they had been there, which took another two hours, and then they flew up.
"Where are you going? The mountain's down there," Bai Ning Bing asked.
"Yes, but I think there's something near the mountain top," Fang Yuan said.
Bai Ning Bing frowned. A primeval spring, if it was present, would more likely than not be present near the core of the mountain rather than at its very top. Even at Qing Mao Mountain, the Gu Yue village was not literally located at the mountaintop, but rather some distance beneath it.
Bei Gu Mountain from a distance looked almost entirely white, shining in the sun's rays and reflecting it like the moon. There were a number of bones which had been deposited upon it, hence its name. Fang Yuan knew that in the future, two children from the Bei Clan would find an inheritance at the top left by a Bone Path Gu master who was known only by his title as 'Flesh Bone Lord.'
There were a number of Bone Path Gu worms that he felt would be quite useful, but among them, the most useful was the Bone Flesh Unity Gu! It was said to be a gu worm that would help in dual cultivation, much like Equality Gu did. He wanted to see if he could use it to advance Fang Zheng's aptitude to Rank 4 with more success than he had using the Equality Gu. While it was useful for his own cultivation, improving Fang Zheng's resulted in far too much of a loss and annoyance to continue being effective.
"Let's land here," Fang Yuan said.
As per the story, the two children had been wandering in some caves when they managed to find a bone spiral which they touched, leading to the inheritance. Fang Yuan could try to use the Hundred Li Earthwolf Spider to burrow into the mountain and maybe chance upon it. However, that might risk destroying the inheritance or damaging it in such a way that he would not have access to its full content. It was a righteous path inheritance, after all. Better to play by the rules.

chapters.title: Chapter 225 225: Bei Gu Mountain: Part Five
chapters.content:
"Alright. Let's look around these caves," Fang Yuan said. They spent the rest of the day exploring the caves. Although Fang Yuan did not find anything that resembled what he was looking for, Bai Ning Bing also did not find any traces of a primeval spring.
"I think we should look below this if we want to find a primeval spring," Bai Ning Bing said.
Fang Yuan replied, "Let's continue searching the top. If we don't find anything here, then we can go down."
Bai Ning Bing, feeling too tired to protest Fang Yuan's idea, tried to snort, but it ended up as a sneeze. They searched the next day as well, but Fang Yuan still had come up with nothing. By evening, however, they had a new problem on their hands: Bai Ning Bing had started to feel feverish and had slowed down as she developed a cough.
"You caught a cold, didn't you?" Fang Yuan said, sighing as he took out some medicine from his storage and started applying it to Bai Ning Bing.
She really did feel sick at this point and could only lie down as Fang Yuan used his medicine to try to get her to feel better. She had felt so tired, as a matter of fact, that at some point in the evening, she thought she saw two shadows in the cave above - one Fang Yuan and another person. She even felt that she had dreamed up snippets of a conversation going on around her because of the fever.
"She has a cold, can you do anything about it..."
"Young Master, she seems to be a bit too warm to be having a 'cold'... ahaha... ah, Young Master, please don't hit me..."
She did feel marginally better by next morning, though still not well enough to go around.
"Relax. You can stay here," Fang Yuan said to her he wandered off to go check on more of the caves. Bai Ning Bing was beginning to think that they had wasted their time coming here. Fang Yuan had not even told her how it was that he thought there was a primeval spring in this mountain. It was certainly possible... and he wouldn't have come all the way here if he hadn't been certain...
Fang Yuan returned only two hours later.
"What happened?" Bai Ning Bing asked him.
"There are some people approaching," Fang Yuan said, sighing.
"There are some people approaching?"
"They probably either saw us specifically or are just scouting out the area. More likely than not, they are Bei clansmen. Do you feel good enough to get up?"
"Yes," Bai Ning Bing said. Her body still ached all over, but she could still walk the distance to the mouth of the cave. If it came to fighting, Fang Yuan realized that she would not be of much help unless he used the full might of his Doctor Gu upon her.
The reason why he hadn't done so was, simply put, so that he could make it seem as if it had taken longer for her to recover than it actually had. He did want Bai Ning Bing to eventually become dependent upon him. The threat of detonating the Yang Rotation Gu was just one way that he could control her. However, there was too much at stake here, namely the Dollhouse and its associated inheritance, for him to simply leave things at that. If he had healed her up too fast, it would seem as if he had done nothing. That was why he had dragged out the process, only healing her as much as necessary to make it seem as if he had really tried his hardest.
If it came to a fight, though, he would likely need her full fighting strength.
"Who are they? Demonic Gu masters?" Bai Ning Bing asked, not having paid attention to Fang Yuan's speech entirely.
Fang Yuan shook his head. He could see their uniforms from this distance. "When I tell you to do so, take out your White Form Immortal Snake. Those are Bei clansmen - a clan which lives near this mountain."
As far as Fang Yuan knew, the Bei Clan had only come to this mountain in about 10 years' time. It was very odd to see them here right now, unless... 'Of course,' he realized.
Much like him, the Bei Clan had decided to take the initiative and find another location for their clan before things got too bad. That was why they were here, just to scout out this mountain and to see if there was a primeval spring that they could use.
The group that was headed towards them was consisting of mainly Rank 2 Gu masters, with a Rank 3 elder, Bei Mo Xing, at the head. The elder was approaching seventy years old by now. He had nearly gone into retirement.
However, his niece, the current Bai clan leader, had requested his help with this matter. Given the fact that he had already given up so much of his life towards the clan's benefit, he felt like he could not abandon them during their time of need, certainly not now when their primeval spring was about to run dry. The future of the clan's survival was at stake.
They were part of an early scouting party simply to examine the mountain and to see if there was a primeval spring there, which they could obtain. If there was, then they would start priming the mountain as the new home of the Bei Clan. However, this morning, one of their members had seen something near the top of the mountain.
"There's movement up there," they had said. "It almost looks like a person."
All of them froze.
Why would there be people here? It couldn't possibly be a mortal; otherwise, they would have died already. So then there was only one possible explanation: Gu Masters.
"Are there demonic Gu masters up there?" his nephew said. "If so, we should go ahead and check it out."
Bei Mo Xing, however, frowned. If they could make their way all the way up to this mountain, they had to have at least Rank 3 battle strength. While his group did outnumber them, demonic Gu Masters were oftentimes very good at fighting simply out of necessity and experience.
Their group would no doubt take casualties if they happened to fight. At the same time, they simply could not ignore this either. After all, if those demonic Gu masters were near this mountain, they were also near their own village, meaning they might end up coming to cause trouble for the Bei Clan later on.
"Alright. Keep alert, but let's go up," he said. "How strong do you think they are, and how many?"
"I only saw one person," a scout replied. There were signs that the surrounding trail had been disturbed somewhat, they found as they went up, meaning that indeed, there was someone here. Fang Yuan did not have the time to hide those traces yet.
"Rank 3," one of the scouts said as they approached the entrance of a cave, and all of them paused.
There was a woman there with long, silvery hair. Although Bai Ning Bing still felt sick, it only added to her pale complexion. She was quite a stunning beauty and, without a doubt, had made them all hold their breaths for a moment. None of them really noted the fact that she was slightly slumped over against the cave's wall or the fact that she gently moved one of her hands behind her and signaled to Fang Yuan, who was hiding near the rear of the cave.
"Hello and good morning," Bai Ning Bing said with a faint smile, snapping them out of their reverie.
"Oh, right, uh, good morning," Bei Mo Xing replied. Even in this strange situation, they were righteous path Gu masters, after all, and the instinct of courtesy kicked in before they could make another move.
However, they were suddenly enveloped by an oppressive presence coming from within the cave.
"Rank 5 aura!"

chapters.title: Chapter 226: Bei Gu Mountain: Part Six
chapters.content:
"This is..."
"That's not Rank 3! That's Rank 5!"
Fang Yuan emerged from the cave. Compared to Bai Ning Bing, he was far more ordinary, dressed neatly but not extravagantly. His dark eyes contrasted with Bai Ning Bing's mostly white appearance, looking like abyssal pits.
However, there was no denying the oppressive Rank 5 aura, which emanated from him, nor the '5' written on a bronze plate at his waist. Both sides froze instantly. Bai... something considered fleeing at that moment. However, before the might of a Rank 5 Gu master, they might as well have been done for. Fleeing was of very little use.
And why were these two people on Bei Gu Mountain? If they were going to run away, though, they would have to run away in various directions, much like the grass skirt monkeys had done earlier. Only then could they hope that at least one of them might survive and bring news to their clan head about this.
Bai Ning Bing took out the White Form Immortal Snake Gu. Its Rank 5 aura mingled with Fang Yuan's, causing the Bei clansmen to feel even more oppressed than before. 'Not just a Rank 5 Gu master, but a Rank 5 Gu master with a Rank 5 Gu worm!'
That was possibly the worst situation they could have found themselves in. Many Rank 5 Gu masters, particularly ordinary ones, did not have a single Rank 5 gu worm to their name. Oftentimes, only Rank 6 Gu Immortals could have a complete set of Rank 5 Gu. However, even a single Rank 5 gu worm was more than enough to completely turn the tide of a fight.
"It's okay, we don't need to do any of that. These are righteous path Gu masters, after all. If I'm not wrong, all of you are Bei clansmen, correct?"
Bei Mo Xing hesitated on whether to answer truthfully or not. After considering it, he said, "Yes, we are Bei clansmen."
"Well met," Fang Yuan said. "My name is Gu Fang Yuan. I am the clan leader of the Gu Yue Clan, which is located on Qing Mao Mountain. How are all of you doing today?"
"We are doing fine, thank you," Bei Mo Xing said. Immediately, questions began emerging in his mind. If this young lad really was the clan head of the Gu Yue Clan, why wasn't he with them instead of standing here, far away from Qing Mao Mountain? Was he really who he said he was, or a demonic path cultivator pretending to be Gu Yue Fang Yuan?
Fang Yuan waved a hand towards Bai Ning Bing. "This is Lady Ting King Sing, an external elder of the Bai clan, which is also on Qing Mao Mountain."
Bai Ning Bing snorted. "The name is Ling Ding Ching."
"Oh, my apologies," Fang Yuan said, smiling without batting an eye. "I get names confused sometimes. But what could possibly bring you Bei clansmen here? If I'm not wrong, you're located some distance from this mountain, isn't it? I would not have come here had it not been that this mountain is unclaimed...."
'We should be asking you those questions,' Bei Mo Xing thought. They were quite close to their home turf. However, Fang Yuan was the one who had come quite a distance away.
"Oh, that. We were just on a hunting expedition and looking for certain bone path resources we can find on this mountain."
"I see, I see," Fang Yuan said. "Well, you see, there is a reason that the two of us have come to this mountain. As it turns out, in the past, long ago, there was a Gu Yue clan elder who had fallen in love with the daughter of a Bai clan elder on Qing Mao Mountain. They would often meet together near a waterfall that used to exist between our two villages whenever they had time under the pale moonlight, strengthening their love with every single meeting." Bai Ning Bing wondered what Fang Yuan was up to but could realize that he was definitely spinning this tale for a specific reason. "During this time, the Bai and the Gu Yue clans were at war. However, those two could not live without each other, and given that society would not allow them to be together, they ended up eloping, running away from Qing Mao Mountain. Truly, a tragic tale of two lovers who could not live without each other, but the world could not let them be with each other either." Fang Yuan said this and sighed, an ashen expression on his face, as if he had been personally affected by this issue.
"However, in the tablet they left behind, they said that they would be settling on Bei Gu Mountain and that if there came a time in the future when the Gu Yue and the Bai clans were at peace, their families could reach them in this location and ask them to rejoin with them. Granted, that was some time ago," Fang Yuan added. "I bet they must have their own grandchildren or even great-grandchildren by this point. I don't know if you happen to know the recent tragedy that happened on Qing Mao Mountain - when we were attacked by a demonic Gu Master and many of my clansmen barely escaped with their lives. The Gu Yue clan and the Bai clan have indeed decided to put aside their differences and come together. Given this and the message left at the tablet, I thought that I would come here and see if there were any other Gu Yue clan descendants or Bai clan descendants and welcome them back into our village."
Fang Yuan opened his arms in a magnanimous gesture. "I was greatly moved when I heard of this tragic love story. I want to cleanse the sins committed by our clans in the past and honor those two as brave individuals who were willing to sacrifice everything for love. In addition, by bringing their descendants back into my village, I want to continue promoting a culture of peace and harmony between my clan and the Bai clan."
The Bei clansmen were speechless when they heard Fang Yuan's reason for being there. Bei Mo Xing wanted to scream, "What on earth is this kind of nonsense story? Do you really expect us to believe that a clan head would come all the way here, just on that basis? Quit messing with us!"
"Clan head, I am surprised that one such as you would come all that distance on himself rather than sending his representatives," Bei Mo Xing asked in a far more polite manner.
"What can I say?" Fang Yuan said, almost wiping away a tear from the corner of one of his eyes. "The thing was, I could have sent someone else, but who could I spare during these times? I could have left it out for later, like the other clan heads did, but my heart was so moved by the beauty of this love story that I felt like I just had to do them justice."
"And so," Fang Yuan continued, "along with another Bai clansman, I came here."
Bei Mo Xing still did not believe a single word of what Fang Yuan was saying. However, what could he do to repudiate it? His mind was still working in overdrive, wondering what it was that Fang Yuan really wanted by coming here.
The other Bei clansmen had their disbelief written over their faces, but Bei Mo Xing was a practiced elder and knew that this matter had to be handled gently.
"Well, in such a case," Bei Mo Xing said, "why don't you all come by and rest by the Bei clan? Let us all host you and treat you just like our esteemed guests."
"How could we possibly impose upon you like that?" Fang Yuan asked, waving his hand.
"Oh no, no," Bei Mo Xing said. "You are not imposing on us at all - if anything, it is the Bei clan's great fortune to have encountered an esteemed one like Lord Fang Yuan and having the opportunity to host him."
Fang Yuan frowned slightly. "You must understand that I am clan head of the Gu Yue clan. I am rather busy and cannot get sidetracked from my objective. We do have somewhere to go after this, after all."
"I understand that," Bei Mo Xing said. "However, our clan has kept meticulous records of the area around this mountain for a while. If you are searching for something, we can go ahead and look that up for you. A small detour like this may ultimately expedite your search."

chapters.title: Chapter 227: Bei Gu Mountain: Part Seven
chapters.content:
Fang Yuan seemed to consider the offer for a moment before saying, "Alright. We will impose on you for a while."
"Haha, as I said, it is nothing," Bei Mo Xing said.
Fang Yuan turned around to Bai Ning Bing and whispered, "Do you feel well enough to travel?"
"No," she answered.
"Well then, take this," he said, pulling something out from his aperture. "It's a special medicine that should help you feel better." In truth, there was no such medicine. Fang Yuan was simply, while handing it over to her, using Doctor Gu while they brushed against each other for a moment, which would have an almost instantaneous effect now. Doctor Gu was quite effective but needed physical contact if he wanted to heal someone else, unless he was using something like Charity Gu alongside it.
"Why didn't you give this to me earlier?" she hissed back.
"There are some possible side effects, and I didn't want to risk it," Fang Yuan said, "but I'm sure it's safe enough now." The mixture was just dried herbs collected together. They wouldn't taste very good, but it was enough to meet some of the nutritional requirements that would not have come from eating meat.
Fang Yuan and the Bei clansmen traveled down the mountain toward some tents set up near the foot of the mountain. It looked like the Bei clansmen had arranged for some kind of mobile base here.
"What is this?" Fang Yuan asked.
"Oh, we were just holding a hunting expedition to temper the hearts of some of our young masters," Bei Mo Xing said.
In truth, the purpose of the expedition was to hunt monsters and to find a proper trail that they could use to lead up to a new primeval spring. They had just barely begun to stitch together this party, so the Bei clan leader was not here. However, Bei Mo Xing something said that he would call for her.
In total, there were only about 40 or so Bei clansmen at this encampment. The majority were Rank 2 with only a few Rank 3 elders scattered among them.
Fang Yuan noted this. It looked like the Bei clan had been planning to come here for a few months beforehand. 'Perhaps I should have made a move on this inheritance sooner,' he thought to himself.
However, there was no way he could have possibly known this from beforehand. His memory from his past life told him that they would only properly settle here 10 years later and that the inheritance would not be found until after then.
As it was it looked like the Bei clansmen were also only in their beginner phase of trying to explore the mountains. This might have even been their first foray up there, and without a doubt, it would take a long time, perhaps even several years, for them to fully establish themselves on the mountain.
Both him and Bai Ning Bing sat down to a lunch hosted by a Bei clan elder.
Many of the younger clansmen stared at them with curiosity.
This was partly because of Bai Ning Bing's beauty, but also because of Fang Yuan's Rank 5 aura. Most of them had never seen a Rank 5 Gu master in their entire lives, with the highest being Rank 4, the Bei clan leader. Of course, they all made a note to do nothing that could possibly offend the two of them.
They were naturally shocked at how much progress those two had made. At first, they would have come and thought that it was incredible that Bai Ning Bing was Rank 3, but to see Fang Yuan at Rank 5 short-circuited many of their minds. While getting to Rank 3 was impressive, it was at least understandable if Bai Ning Bing was an accomplished genius.
On the other hand, to see Fang Yuan, who looked to be about the same age, to be at Rank 5 was almost inconceivable to them.
"Did he have some kind of heaven-defying talent or stumbled upon some precious inheritance?" That seemed to be the only explanation that they could have.
"Where is Bei Mo Xing?" Fang Yuan asked, noting his absence at lunch.
"Apologies, but he had to attend to a message from our clan leader," one of the other Bei clan elders said.
Bei Mo Xing was communicating with their clan elder, who was still back in Bei clan village, and updating her about the situation in a different tent. Once he was done, the Bei clan head fell into deep thought.
After a pause, Bei Mo Xing asked, "Do you think that there is any truth to his claim that there was actually ever a Gu Yue and Bai clansman on that mountain?"
"Of course not," the Bei clan head said, shaking her head. "Otherwise, we would have heard about it."
Bei Mo Xing sighed as he, of course, had come to that very conclusion.
"So, then why is he here?"
The Bei clan head had several theories, but the most obvious one was the one she put forth. "They're here to try and claim the mountain."
"What? Claim the mountain? But don't they already have a home on Qing Mao Mountain? Why would they want this other mountain? They couldn't even properly defend it even if they happened to successfully claim it. And..." Bei Mo Xing then trailed off as he realized what the Bei clan head was saying. As far as they knew, Qing Mao Mountain was still operable as a home even after recent events. However, the recent events there could have potentially destroyed their spirit spring, or the spirit spring just might be coming to an end of its life, much like theirs was.
"And if their spring is dying, Fang Yuan isn't going to openly say it now, then, was he? Either their spirit spring is dying," the Bei clan head said, seeing that Bei Mo Xing had understood, "or their mountain has been damaged to such an extent that they have to relocate."
"Why all of this nonsense about a pair of eloped lovers, then?"
The Bei clan head smiled wryly. "Fang Yuan may be strong, he might be at Rank 5, but he is still a righteous path Gu master. The righteous path has its own rules. He simply can't come into our own territory and then declare that it is his." Bei Gu Mountain did not technically belong to the Bei clan. However, because it was situated right next to them, it was considered half of their territory so to speak, although they had made no formal claim to it.
"So the reason that he has cooked up the story is so that..." he said, the gears turning in his head, "so that they would have some reasonable explanation as to why they're claiming the mountain?!"
"Exactly," the Bei clan head said. "Normally, there would be people asking why he is moving his clan there, when it is right next to us. Even if we have never staked a formal claim to it, others would think that he is courting war by settling his clan right next to ours. However, if he can say that there had always been a Bai and Gu Yue clansman living there, he can say that the mountain technically belongs to the Gu Yue clan, since our clan never formally had any settlement there."

chapters.title: Chapter 228: Bei Gu Mountain: Part Eight
chapters.content:
Bei Mo Xing punched the ground in frustration. This was a man who was not one to give in to problems like this as he had faced countless ones in his life. However, he saw no real way out of this quagmire. To think that their luck would be so bad as to have invited this kind of calamity in addition to their spirit spring dying! It was true what they said - blessings rarely come in pairs, but misfortunes seldom come alone!
Killing intent rose in his heart, but there was no way that they could possibly fight Fang Yuan, who was confirmed to have at least one Rank 5 Gu worm. Even if he didn't have more than one he knew that they did not have the capability to resist.
All of their planning, however, would turn to ash if Fang Yuan's plan was allowed to succeed.
"What can we possibly do, then?"
"Allow me to check through the records one more time," the Bei clan head said. "I'll see if there really is any sort of credence to his claim. If not, then we will show him that there was no Bai or Gu Yue clansmen who came to the mountain, which will remove his reason for moving his clan there. Perhaps he will be dissuaded and seek some other place to settle down."
Mountains were areas where spiritual energy concentrated naturally and so any large mountain like Bei Gu Mountain most certainly had a spirit spring. But it wasn't the only uninhabited mountain in the entire Southern Border.
If they could put up a token resistance, even though they could not fight Fang Yuan head-on, they could make it extremely tedious for him to try to take the mountain. If they did so, he would likely just look somewhere else.
It wasn't like it was entirely difficult for him to find another one. The main problem would be fighting numerous beasts to get to another one. However, with Rank 5 strength, he could easily do so.
"If anything, we may be able to use this partly to our advantage," the Bei clan head said. "Perhaps when I speak with him later this evening, he might end up revealing something which would help us during our own endeavor. He might have come here because he got a hint from somewhere that Or perhaps even we can have him lead the way during one of our expeditions and allow him to take much of the heat from the surrounding beasts away from our own clansmen."
Bei Mo Xing nodded, but he knew he would have to tread carefully. Fang Yuan's issue was not a light matter. If they provoked a war, it would be the Bei clan which would no doubt be on the losing end.
When he returned to the tent that Fang Yuan and Bai Ning Bing were dining in, he told them, "The clan head said that she can be here by this evening if our esteemed guests do not mind waiting for that long."
"Alright then, but when she gets here, I'd like to have an audience with her immediately if possible," Fang Yuan said. "I know that I'm imposing on you, but like I said, both my companion and I have issues at home to sort after we figure this situation out."
Bei Mo Xing also wanted to be rid of this person as soon as possible, but if Fang Yuan was leaving to bring the rest of his clan here, that was something he absolutely did not want.
If anything, their best bet was to try to create a settlement for themselves before this could happen so they could state that they had already settled down there.
However, they lacked the necessary manpower to do so.
They were somewhat aware of where the primeval springs on Bei Gu Mountain must be, or were most likely to be located.
Wherever there would be a primeval spring, beasts would be nurtured and numerous there. As such, if they wanted to find out where it was, they just had to find out where most of the beasts were on Bei Gu Mountain and go to that place.
Of course, there was a problem with that: they could still be very off from where they wanted to go, and it was difficult, even for Rank 3 elders, to deal with many of the beasts as this was their natural habitat. This was different from a village attempting to resist a beast tide as they would be fighting on the beast's turf. Because of this, if Fang Yuan had any kind of foreknowledge, it would greatly cut down their losses
Later that evening, the Bei clan head arrived, and Fang Yuan went to greet her.
"Gu Yue clan head," she said. "It is a pleasure to meet you. I do not see your companion with you?"
"Pardon her absence, she has a mild cold, nothing to worry about, but she wanted to rest," Fang Yuan said. "And it is likewise a pleasure to meet you here," Fang Yuan said, also cupping his hands as they went into her tent to discuss things. As they talked about a few minor issues for a few minutes, Fang Yuan's demeanor suddenly changed. "If I may confide in you something personal?"
The Bei clan head's heart fluttered at the mention of that, but did not let it show. "What is it, Lord Gu Yue Fang Yuan?"
"The thing is, I was not entirely truthful regarding my reason for coming here," Fang Yuan said greatly eliciting her interest. "I'm sure that Bei Mo Xing has already told you what we said, but there is more to the story than that. You see, the reason why I was so eager to come to Bei Gu Mountain is because the Gu Master from the Gu Yue clan who eloped with the daughter of a Bai clan elder, he was a relative of mine."
The Bei clan head paused. This was a twist in the story she hadn't been expecting. "Because of that, and because I'm one of the few remaining survivors of my family, I felt that I had to go ahead and ensure that this was done."
Fang Yuan sighed. "You see, when I inherited my parents' legacy, there was a letter from my father who said that his grandfather, on his deathbed, greatly regretted what he had done during that time which had led to his brother, the Gu Yue clansmen in question, to run away. He regretted his actions and wanted to search for his brother for some time but was unable to find the individual in question, and even on his deathbed his heart was filled with regret. My father and his father also wished to remedy this problem, but were unable to because of circumstances. I'm aware that since there are no traces of them on Bei Gu Mountain, it means that they have likely died out and there is no one to actually bring back. But since these are my ancestors' remains, I wish to bring them back to my clan."
The Bei clan head was deep in thought. Could it be that Fang Yuan was actually being genuine when he said that that was the only reason he was coming there? Perhaps they had read too much into the situation, and this really was his intent?
If that were so, it may indeed be possible for them to give him a few hints and then have him go away without bothering them anymore.
"I have tried looking through my records, and we do not know of any Gu Yue or Bai clansmen who might've settled on that mountain," the Bei clan head said.
"Perhaps they hid their identities, fearing persecution?" Fang Yuan offered.
"Actually we have no records of anyone staying on that mountain for any extended period of time," the Bei clan head said.
"Could you be mistaken or have missed someone?"
"Unlikely as we send hunters out to the mountain from time to time," the Bei clan head answered. "I am saddened to say this, but it might be possible that your ancestor perished on his journey here. The wilderness is filled with dangers, after all."
"So... could it be that we came here for nothing?" Fang Yuan pondered.

chapters.title: Chapter 229 229: Bei Gu Mountain: Part Nine
chapters.content:
When Fang Yuan said this, he looked so despondent, and his acting was so on point, that even the experienced Bei clan head for a moment began to wonder whether her initial assessment was correct or not.
He did, as a matter of fact, look like someone who was just coming to try and fulfill his filial duties towards his parents, and not for some other nefarious reason. Of course, the Bei clan head was experiencing, so she did not completely buy this performance, especially not from someone like Fang Yuan.
The mere fact that he had managed to become clan head at an age where most people would not have even become an elder meant that there was definitely something special about him, and one did not rise to that rank without learning a thing or two.
"It is possible, yes," the Bei clan head said. "However, as a consolation, while we are exploring the mountain during our hunting trip, if we happen to find any such remains, we can reach out to you, should you leave behind the appropriate gu worms."
Fang Yuan considered it for a moment and then shook his head. "I'm sorry, but I need to at least make sure myself before I go ahead and leave back home. Otherwise, I would be letting my family down and doing my village a disservice." He spoke with a righteous aura. "In the tablet that they had left behind, they said that they would be staying somewhere near the back of the mountain. I'm not sure why, and perhaps they had heard of something being there, but that was what they said. If you don't mind, can I see a map of the mountain?"
The reason why Fang Yuan said this was because in the tale of the Bei clan twins who had found the Flesh Bone Lord's inheritance, they mentioned that they had wandered into a cave near the back of the mountain. The Bei clan head felt the gears inside her head turning slowly. 'Could it be that the spirit spring is somewhere towards the posterior of the mountain?'
It was true that the Bei clan had a map of the region. However, there was a good reason that they didn't give these out to outsiders, because otherwise understanding the geography of an area was unreliable.
It made attacking them far more difficult, even if it was an area which technically did not belong to them, it was going to be their new home in the future.
If the Gu Yue and the Bei clans ever began to have a conflict in the future, that could be a great detriment to the Bei clan, were they to try to defend their area. However, at the same time, she did not want to refuse Fang Yuan. He was a Rank 5 Gu master, after all, and this could result in a possible conflict.
Keeping this in mind, she said, "Alright, it will take me a while to prepare them. As you can understand, we don't keep very detailed records of Bei Gu Mountain as it isn't our home. We have to piece together the map from various scouting parties who have been sent there over the centuries, but I'm sure I can put something together and have it ready for you, ready within about an hour or so."
Fang Yuan nodded. "I thank you for your help."
The Bei clan head needed this time in order to insert errors into the map so that it was not 100% reliable, as they did have a one-to-one map of the mountain. Many details also needed to be removed from it, like the locations of dangerous wild beasts.
By the time the Bei clan would settle there, the topography would have changed based on the simple fact that they were there, and it would have been less reliable anyway.
The reason why the Bei clan head wanted Fang Yuan to see the map in her tent and not have it delivered to him was so that she could see if perhaps he had some kind of secret regarding the primal spring.
'The lad said that his ancestor wanted to head towards the posterior part of the mountain. Could it be that the primeval spring is there?' she thought to herself. There were wild beasts all around, and it was difficult to navigate, let alone get a detailed idea of the deeper parts of the mountain. If they had a region locked down, they might be able to find a spirit spring within the next six months; even something as vague as 'on the posterior side of the mountain' was of great help to them.
Fang Yuan observed the map carefully.
The Bei clan head had handed him an information path Gu worm, which displayed it on the floor of the tent, much like an Audio-Visual Gu worm. Inwardly, his eyes were flashing, because he realized where it was that the Bei twins had managed to find that inheritance. Outwardly, though, he was still passive, and then he pointed to a location which was about 50 li away from where he would be going.
"I think this is the most likely area," he said, tapping it with his finger. "I think I'll go ahead and check this out myself before turning to Gu Yue village." He turned towards the Bei clan head and smiled. "I thank you for your help."
The Bai clan head noted the region where Fang Yuan had pointed and thought to herself, 'If this lad really does find a primeval spring, there's nothing I can actually do to stop it. If he does manage to find it, all we can really do is wash away our bitter feelings and curse our luck.'
There was an alternative: that was to look for another primeval spring on Bai Gu Mountain. That was not impossible, as most mountains tended to have two or three primeval springs. Qing Mao Mountain was an easy example of this, where there were three clans and three primeval springs.
However, there was no guarantee of that, and moving their clan next to the Gu Yue clan had many issues. The Bai clan were surrounded by other enemy clans, and if they were going to put their backs against a clan which had a Rank 5 Gu Master, it would be quite bad for them. Not only that, but Fang Yuan might not take kindly to them settling near his base of operations. He might even consider that to be good enough reason to declare war on them.
'What should I do?' the Bei clan head continued to wonder. 'Should we go ahead and check some other area as a place where we can move the clan?' Bei Gu Mountain was the ideal place because it was basically right next to them, and the dangers were fewer if they wanted to migrate. On the other hand, if they wished to travel a long distance, much like the Gu Yue clan had to while coming here, they would lose a large number of the clansmen as well as resources.
Merchant caravans were delayed all the time and oftentimes ran into trouble, and moving the clan was like moving a massive merchant caravan. The main difference was that they did not have a Rank 5 Gu master and as such, could potentially encounter dangers that they would not be able to deal with. 'No, maybe I'm thinking about this too much,' she thought to herself. 'Maybe he really is here just for his ancestors' remains. If that's so, then hopefully in the best case scenario he'll leave, otherwise we'll try to put scouts around the mountain and see where he goes.'
She wanted to do something - anything. However, in the moment she felt helpless. What could she offer Fang Yuan that he did not have? She could not really give him any of the Bei clan's secrets regarding Rank 5 Gu worms, as that would only increase his strength if he did fight them in the future.
As for primeval stones, while she could provide a price that might satisfy a Rank 5 Gu Master, the fact still remained that this Fang Yuan would have this entire clan to look after, and that could not be equivalent to that. As for beauties, she considered showing him some of the more beautiful Bei clan women in case some of them caught his eye. However, he already had Lady Ling Ding Ching with him, and so there was little chance of them being able to honeypot him.

chapters.title: Chapter 230 230: Bei Gu Mountain: Part Ten
chapters.content:
'A wise man submits to circumstances,' the Bei clan head thought to herself. All she could do right now was watch the situation and wait for it to play out. 'There is one alternative. I could take that woman hostage,' she considered. It looked like the two of them had a very close relationship with each other. However, that lady was Rank 3 Peak Stage, and even if she had a cold, it would not be easy to subdue her even if she went out to fight herself. And there was a high chance that Fang Yuan would find out. 'It's too risky,' she thought, ultimately concluding that there indeed was little that they could do, no matter how much she hated to admit it.
"Bai Ning Bing, let's go," Fang Yuan said, walking into their tent. "You can take out the White Form Immortal Snake Gu."
Bai Ning Bing got up. She felt far better after taking whatever medication that Fang Yuan had given to her and was eager to leave. She could feel it deep down within her: the stares of the Bai clansmen.
They were not welcome here, even if they were called guests. The only reason that they were not trapped here was because of Fang Yuan's cultivation level, and because of the White Form Immortal Snake. Gu Without that, she felt like these Bei clansmen would very soon pounce upon them.
"Alright, let's leave," she said. To her surprise, Fang Yuan did not take them straight to Bei Gu Mountain, but rather in the other direction towards the forest where they had come from. The Bei clansmen had naturally set up investigative methods and relayed this back to the Bai clan head.
'He didn't head towards the mountain. He went towards the forest,' she thought to herself. 'But why?'
Their scouts could not keep up with Fang Yuan and a Rank 5 Gu worm, of course, especially not in the wilderness where it was not possible for anyone lower than Rank 3 to survive, but it looked definitive that they had gone in that direction, and they had not circled back to Bei Gu Mountain as of yet.
'Did he get dissuaded and leave?' the Bei clan head thought to herself. She thought it very unlikely, but if that was the outcome, it was one of the best ones. 'Maybe all of that talk about wanting to check himself was just blather.' She checked the map in the place where Fang Yuan had pointed to. 'Maybe we should arrange for our hunting expedition to be near that point?'
Despite all of this and the fact that she should be relaxing due to the fact that Fang Yuan was gone, she had an uneasy feeling developing in her stomach as if she had missed out on something.
"Fang Yuan, where are we going?" Bai Ning Bing asked.
"To get some gu worms," Fang Yuan answered.
"I think I know where it is that we have to go on the mountain," Fang Yuan said. "However, my gu worms aren't suitable for fighting bone creatures."
His strongest offensive gu other than the Blood Guillotine, was the Vermillion Blood Moon Gu. Its main use was the fact that it could cause bleeding and hemorrhage. However, bone-type beasts, which littered Bei Gu Mountain, did not have very well-developed vascular systems and its effectiveness was greatly blunted against them.
Even during his initial scouting of the area, he had found that he was having far more difficulty than a Rank 5 Gu Master should be having while fighting through the beast ranks. Thankfully, there was a source of Rank 4 gu worms nearby.
"Rank 4 gu worms from where?" Bai Ning Bing asked, as Fang Yuan was talking as if he intended to stroll into a shop and buy them.
Fang Yuan circled upon an area and she realized what it was that he planned to do.
"You plan to fight the Xuan Yuan Divine Pheasant? You have guts I'll give you that..."
This was the area in which the Tracker Puppet had seen it, and Fang Yuan was able to identify it easily enough.
It was easily seen even in the fading dusklight, it had a very characteristic appearance, being very brightly colored. In addition, being a Myriad Beast King, it did not often encounter those who could attack it. If anything, it was the predator and the others were the prey.
It would go around attacking and killing Thousand Beast Kings with wanton fury. If Fang Yuan had been Rank 3 and had wandered into the wilderness like he had initially planned, he would have had no choice but to hide until it left.
The Xuan Yuan Divine Pheasant looked like it was about to settle in for the night when it felt the White Form Immortal Snake's aura. It immediately turned its eyes straight at Fang Yuan and Bai Ning Bing, who were descending upon it rapidly. Its speed could not match up to the White Form Immortal Snake, and it realized that it had to attack or be killed.
It was an existence that was very difficult for even Rank 4 Peak Stage Gu Masters to fight. The fact that Fang Yuan did not know what kind of gu worms they had made it all the more dangerous.
However, there was a reason why he chose to fight it rather than going straight to fight the bone beasts located on Bei Gu Mountain. He separated from the White Form Immortal Snake once they got close, his wings sprouting from his back as he left Bai Ning Bing to control the White Form Immortal Snake, which danced around the phoenix as it spread its wings and got ready for battle.
The sky suddenly became illuminated in all seven colors of the rainbow. It looked much like the Aurora Borealis back on Earth, except multiplied by a factor of ten.
Even though by now the sun had almost completely set, it looked like the sky was illuminated as if it was still mid-afternoon. Fang Yuan had many of his clansmen's will kept in his integration Gu, and so he activated them right now.
Mortal Killer Move - Hope of the Clansman!
He used this to boost the power of his Vermillion Blood Moon Blade. It was less effective against the bone beasts of Bei Gu Mountain, however, against the Xuan Yuan Divine Pheasant the wide arc made a massive gash on its body and it began bleeding severely, the blood mixing in and tainting its otherwise colorful plumage.
It shrieked in pain and agony. Before, it had its attention split between the White Form Immortal Snake and Fang Yuan, but now its entire attention was focused on Fang Yuan. It opened its beak and a stream of rainbow light shot out at Fang Yuan, who activated his defensive gu worm in time, Moonlight Plate Armor Gu. If he had not been Rank 5, his primeval essence likely would have ran out before he could continue sustaining the armor. However, with Rank 5 Initial Stage essence, it was more than enough of an easy matter to do so.
It shrieked in rage, and then suddenly its body began to glow.
It was activating a movement type gu worm!
Fang Yuan shouted out at Bai Ning Bing who understood what to do. The phoenix then shot out into the sky almost as fast as a flash of light, or at least tried to. At the last moment before its gu could fully activate, the White Form Immortal Snake immediately bit its leg, weighing it down and slowing it down during its ascent. Its movement speed was still nothing to laugh at despite this handicap. It could almost rival that of the Rank 5 White Form Immortal Snake with the help of this gu worm, but it could only be sustained for five breath's of time. Not enough to get away from them.
Droplets of blood rained down onto the ground with each wingbeat from the Xuan Yuan Divine Pheasant. Its initially glorious appearance with a shining golden crown was marred by the crimson liquid almost completely coating it. The droplets stained the forest below the color of dark red. There were screams of various beasts all around as they saw the fight, many of them realizing that they were outmatched and scampering far away from wherever it was going on.

chapters.title: Chapter 231 231: Flesh Bone Lord: Part One
chapters.content:
'Should I use the Blood Guillotine?' Fang Yuan thought to himself. 'It could end the battle very quickly, but at the same time, I can't discount the fact that even in the wilderness, there might be people watching. The Bei Cla may still be watching us and have some method of detecting it. I don't have a Rank 5 method of hiding its aura.'
Thinking of such, his wings began flapping faster as he chose another method of attack.
The White Form Immortal Snake Gu by itself was almost a match for the Xuan Yuan Divine Pheasant Phoenix, depending on what kind of gu worms it had.
With Fang Yuan added to the mix, the battle was all but sealed as he sent out another Vermillion Moonblade at it, nearly tearing one of its wings off.
It fell to the ground, shooting out blasts of rainbow light in all directions, but in its pain, it was unable to target it properly and ended up striking many of the beasts on the ground, killing them within seconds. However, it could not strike either Bai Ning Bing or the White Form Immortal Snake. It crashed onto the ground, blood now completely coating its body, as it glared at Fang Yuan with hatred.
However, this only lasted for three breaths' time. By the time Fang Yuan thought that it might actually do something, it collapsed and stopped breathing.
"Now!"
Fang Yuan folded his wings, dropping down like a rock towards the ground as several small specks began running off from the corpse of the Xuan Yuan Divine Pheasant. Its body was still warm.
However, the Gu worms on it must have realized that it was done for and were abandoning it like rats jumping off of a sinking ship. The entire reason that Fang Yuan had started this fight was for these gu worms. He unleashed the Spring Autumn Cicada's Rank 6 aura, and they froze as he refined three of them. Two of them got away, but if the one he wanted happened to be among them, he would just have to curse it and chalk it up to his bad luck.
There was one Rank 3 and two Rank 4 Gu worms. The Rank 3 gu worm took the shape of a ladybug whose carapace was colored in all colors of the rainbow.
It was Rainbow Movement Gu, which would create a rainbow in the sky and then allow the gu master to traverse it as if the rainbow was made of solid matter and not light. This was good for climbing. However, to the Xuan Yuan Divine Pheasant which could fly, it was next to useless.
The second was the Rainbow Flash Gu, which is the movement type gu worm it had used to try to escape from them before the White Form Immortal Snake had stopped it.
And the third was the one that he was actually after - Rainbow Cannon Gu! It was in the form of a beetle that was holding a piece of rainbow-colored gemstone between its pincers. It was the attack that the Xuan Yuan Divine Pheasant had used in a desperate attempt to strike him and kill him.
It shot out a rainbow at the enemy, dealing damage wherever it happened to land. Despite its name, it lacked the speed of a ray of light, but it was very fast nonetheless. It was without a doubt a very good offensive Rank 4 Gu and far more suitable for fighting the beasts on Bei Gu Mountain than his other Gu worms.
Fang Yuan picked up various body parts of the Xuan Yuan Divine Pheasant, including its eyeballs, beak, meat, feathers, etc. They all could be used as part of gu refinement materials for light path gu worms and otherwise could be sold. The parts of a myriad beast king could go for a very nice price, as they were not easy to hunt.
"Are you alright?" Fang Yuan asked Bai Ning Bing.
"Indeed," she said, pupils dilated from the thrill of the fight.
"Then let's go back to Bei Gu Mountain."
The Bei clan scouts had mostly gone to sleep or retreated back to their tents by now, but there were still some who were on alert. One of them naturally caught the shadow of the White Form Immortal Snake moving across the moonlight and landing near the back of the mountain.
"They've returned. Clan head, they've returned," he said, sending word to the Bei clan head, although she was fast asleep. This information was vital to get to her regardless of the time.
'Oh, so he happened to return,' she thought to herself, a sinking feeling forming in her stomach. This meant that Fang Yuan had not simply given up and gone home. This late at night, there was no way that they could catch up to them, especially given the fact that Fang Yuan had a flying mount. They really could do nothing other than just see what happened.
Fang Yuan recognized the area he was looking for and landed there. Bai Ning Bing hopped off the White Form Immortal Snake.
"Why are we stopping here again? We're near the top of the mountain, Fang Yuan. We should be moving down if you want to look for a primeval spring," she said.
"Oh, come on with me. I'm sure that we will find the bones of those two lovers here," Fang Yuan said.
Bai Ning Bing snorted, still not understanding why Fang Yuan had decided to give that kind of tale, though it looked like he was cooking something even if it had led to nowhere with the Bei clan.
There were two caves which Fang Yuan felt met the description he had read about. One of them was blocked by some wild beasts, so they went to the other one instead. But Fang Yuan quickly realized that this was not the one they were looking for. As for the wild beasts, they fell to Rainbow Cannon Gu quickly enough, and he and Bai Ning Bing walked.
'This matches their description perfectly,' Fang Yuan thought to himself. It was said that while playing, they had wandered into a cave filled with bone spirals, some of which had strange markings on them. They twisted one of them, and it led to the open passageway.
Rainbow Cannon Gu could be used offensively, but by putting just a trickle of primeval essence into it, it also illuminated the inside of the cave.
"There's nothing here," Bai Ning Bing said. "Like I said, Fang Yuan, we've been wasting our time looking in these areas. We should go further down if you want to..."
Fang Yuan found a particularly interesting bone spiral and then twisted it like the story had described. Part of the cave moved away, revealing an entrance that led deeper into the mountain. Bai Ning Bing stopped whatever it was that she had been saying. Fang Yuan turned towards her with a wry smile.
"Oh, it looks like we happened to find something. How lucky of us!"
Bai Ning Bing was almost frozen at the spot, unable to comprehend this development at first before following him.
"Looks like our ancestors truly did leave something for us, hehe..."

chapters.title: Chapter 232 232: Flesh Bone Lord: Part Two
chapters.content:
Bai Ning Bing's thoughts were reeling as she followed Fang Yuan into the corridor. Up until now, she had thought that his talk about there being this pair of eloped lovers from the Bai and Gu Yue clans was just a story he had made up.
However, he had seemed to know that this inheritance was here, which is why he had been searching near the top of the mountain rather than for a primeval spring somewhere else.
Of course, Bai Ning Bing still thought that Fang Yuan was lying, simply because it was Fang Yuan.
However, at the same time, it appeared that there was some grain of truth to whatever he had been saying. Perhaps there had been a Bai or Gu Yue clansman who had visited this area and left behind an inheritance. It would explain how Fang Yuan happened to know about it.
The corridor that they walked into was filled with bone spikes and was quite narrow. Bai Ning Bing was prepared to break them, but Fang Yuan waved his hand and then gripped a particular bone spike and pulled it. The bone spikes surrounding them then retreated into the walls, leaving the hallway open while the door behind them closed.
"Do you think that we were followed?" Fang Yuan asked. His investigative gu worms revealed nothing.
"I doubt it. How could they come to this part of the mountain so quickly?" Bai Ning Bing asked as they walked forward.
The hallway opened up into a massive cavern, where there was a vat in the middle of it. There was liquid pouring out, but it wasn't water. It was thick and white. Basically, this was a milk spring. The liquid was much like milk, and it could be very nutritious for both infants and adults. 'I knew that I would happen upon this from my memories of what the inheritance had, so the tale released by the Bei clan was not nonsense,' Fang Yuan thought to himself.
"Are there gu worms inside this?" Bai Ning Bing said, surprised as she walked near the vat of liquid.
"Why don't you check what's inside?" Fang Yuan asked. He was pretty sure that it was safe to put his hands inside, but if it was dangerous, why not make Bai Ning Bing do it instead?
Bai Ning Bing put her hand inside and then pulled out a handful of Gu worms. An entire handful. They were all Rank 1, looking like bony fingers, which were Bone Spear Gu.
"There must be thousands of them in here," Bai Ning Bing said, eyes widening. Even if they were only Rank 1 Gu worms, the fact that they were so numerous in quantity and had a ready food source right next to them would make them quite valuable.
"Yes, without a doubt," Fang Yuan said. "This would be a good resource point for our clans." Since Bei Gu Mountain was made up mainly of bones and had very little soil, it might be hard for them to continue to harvest moon orchids. However, that didn't mean that the Gu Yue clan couldn't pivot towards making something else. As a matter of fact, there had been talks of changing their surname - they could change it from 'Gu Yue' to 'Bei Gu' if this sort of development advanced enough and they really wanted a new identity for themselves.
The Bei Gu clan, for that matter, had actually specialized nearly entirely in the bone path after they had obtained this inheritance, and it would often sell the milk as a refinement material and food source.
"That's not all that's in there, though," Bai Ning Bing said. "There are Rank 2 Gu worms as well. Look," she said, pulling them out. These were Spiral Bone Spear Gu. Just like the Rank 1 Gu worms, they were extremely huge in number and also quite valuable. Bai Ning Bing figured that if they sold this entire vat full of gu worms, they could easily net one million primal stones if they could find a buyer who had that much and had such a demand forgu worms. The issue was, of course, taking them out, refining them, and keeping them fed.
Her eyes widened once more as Fang Yuan put his hand inside and began removing scoopfuls of gu worms, refining them instantly using the Spring Autumn Cicada. He had Rank 5 primeval essence, so merely a thin wisp of it was more than enough to refine a large number of them. Bai Ning Bing watched as he refined thousands upon thousands of Gu worms instantly, a feat that would have taken her months at the very least.
'Just what kind of secret is he hiding?' Bai Ning Bing wondered. Up until now, she had been wary of Fang Yuan. After all, he had managed to get to Rank 5 somehow before her and seemed to be quite knowledgeable when it came to matters he should have no business knowing. However, he also seemed to know secrets that no one else seemed to know, as well as this odd refinement ability of his.
"Can you actually feed all of them?" Bai Ning Bing asked.
"I can feed them all long enough," Fang Yuan said. "We can take this milk spring with us." The milk spring was made by an underground water source, which was powered by the nutrients made from decaying bone matter, which resulted in the milk spring that rose up towards this vat. They might need it to feed all these gu worms, so while the vat itself had very little water comparatively speaking, it was the massive underground spring which was needed to feed so many of them. But Fang Yuan did not want to leave them for the Bei clan in on the off chance that they had been followed. "Whatever we can't take, let's destroy it," Fang Yuan said.
Bai Ning Bing hesitated. These gu worms were extremely precious. She knew that as a genius of the Bai clan, she had often been favored and given whatever gu worms that she wanted by the clan heads. However, she had matured somewhat after her aptitude had fallen and began understanding the troubles endured by the common Bai Clan Villager. She was well aware that for ordinary Gu Masters, Rank 1 and Rank 2 worms were hard to come by. Many of them only had two or three at most which they still struggled to feed.
"In case the Bei clan gets here, let's not give them weapons to fight us if they turn into our enemies," Fang Yuan said.
Bai Ning Bing sighed. Fang Yuan's paranoia was far too high, she felt. After all, how could anyone possibly have gotten here? Didn't he have his own investigative methods? And yet, Fang Yuan's firm stance told her that he would not budge, and that if she would not destroy the Gu worms, then he would. She sighed, destroying them, turning something that was worth at least a hundred thousand primal stones in total into nothing but mush on the ground.
They walked further down the hall to a room with three pillars into each was carved a human hand. There were gu worms in the palm of each one.
"Three, choose one, satisfied at heart. Bei Gu Inheritance, left for future descendants." - this was inscribed into the pillars.
"Remember," Fang Yuan said. "This is a righteous path inheritance. The lines tell us to take only one gu worm, and that's what we should do." It wasn't as if they would be punished for taking any of the taking too much, at least not directly, not like they would with a demonic path inheritance.
Instead, what would happen was that they would be unable to get the true treasure and future rewards would be diminished.
Of the three Gu worms present there, none of them were of particular interest to Fang Yuan, who was Rank 5, and neither to Bai Ning Bing. However, they took one and continued on the path.

chapters.title: Chapter 233 233: Flesh Bone Lord: Part Three
chapters.content:
Further in, they found the skeletal remains of a person with a book next to him.
"The book of the Flesh Bone Lord," Fang Yuan said, picking it up. He rifled through it. The person who had written it did not leave behind their name, but that didn't mean that he could not forge something of the sort later on.
It described how the Flesh Bone Lord, or Gray Bone Scholar as he was also called, had often struggled with cultivation due to a lack of aptitude. He had thought of how to fix this problem but had not reached a conclusion even as he died.
"It says here that we should kowtow and take the Gu worm within his skull," Fang Yuan said.
Fang Yuan withdrew a few paces and then kowtowed. It was a proper kowtow with his forehead knocking on the ground three times.
Bai Ning Bing was quite surprised by this. However, for Gu Yue Fang Yuan, kowtowing like this was nothing. Even if a Rank 9 Venerable were to kowtow towards him, he would not feel anything. And even if he were told to kowtow towards a mortal, he no longer felt anything either.
"He was a Rank 4 Gu Master," Bai Ning Bing noted, flipping through the pages herself. She chuckled. "It looks like this inheritance wasn't worth your while, Fang Yuan."
That meant that the odds of there being a Rank 5 Gu worm were very low, and so it was likely from his point of view that this was a massive waste of time. After Fang Yuan kowtowed, and the three slams on the floor echoed through the cave, another passageway opened.
Bai Ning Bing's eyes widened. "Oh, so that's why you did it. Well, then there should be a valuable gu worm in his skull."
Fang Yuan stopped her. "Wait," he said. There were two tests here, much like there had been a test with the prior area. There, the test had been to test one's self-control. One was only supposed to take one of the gu worms and not get greedy. Here, the test was to see if one would give the proper reverence towards this old senior who had created this inheritance. If one smashed the skull, it would mean that they had disrespected that person's corpse.
He remembered this from the details of his prior life.
Five minutes passed and Bai Ning Bing began to get antsy. But Fang Yuan still told her to stay put. It was only then that another passageway opened.
"That is the true passageway," Fang Yuan said. He then went over and smashed the man's skull in question. "Bone Spike Gu," he said, chuckling to himself. It was a Rank 3 gu worm, by this point, meaningless to him.
"You refined this one instantly as well?" Bai Ning Bing noted with some shock.
They went down this third passageway, upon which there was they entered and saw that the walls, roof, and floor were all made of a strange kind of wobbly substance that felt like flesh. It was unsteady to walk upon, as if they were trying to walk on jelly.
Lining the walls of the cave were a bunch of smiling mouths, much like the Xiong clan's signature Rank 5 Gu. These could also be used for storage.
"We have to knock their teeth out and see what we can find," Fang Yuan said. The mouths each had 10 teeth, five above and five below. One had to knock out five of them in order to get what was within.
It was not a difficult process, but it was tedious as Fang Yuan could not use his full strength without destroying whatever was inside. And there were numerous mouths, so it would take quite a bit of time for them to look through all of them.
That said, it wasn't as if they were going anywhere. And even if the Bei clan had understood what was going on, they would without a doubt still take time to get here.
Bai Ning Bing was the first person to get something. "Look at this! Bone-Flesh Gu," she said, smiling. Bone-Flesh Gu was a very powerful healing type Gu.
"Hmm, that's good. Let's keep looking," Fang Yuan said. He was the next one to get something. It was the Footless Bird. 'What a wonderful kind of movement type Gu,' he thought to himself. 'With a flying White Form Immortal Snake and Hundred Li Earthwolf Spider, its usefulness is somewhat limited to me, however.'
Given the fact that it was just a single-use gu worm, it could take the user 10,000 li, which was beyond the scope of either of the other Gu worms in question, but they could be used over and over again.
They continued smashing the teeth. "Jade Bone Gu," Fang Yuan said, happening upon it. Bai Ning Bing stared at it. She wanted it because it could make one's bones extremely strong, combined with her ice muscles. It would greatly increase her own fighting power.
"You can exchange it for ownership of the Dollhouse," Fang Yuan said with a wry smile on his face.
"Gu Yue Fang Yuan," Bai Ning Bing said, stopping in her tracks. "When do you intend to give me the Yang Rotation Gu?"
Fang Yuan had earlier said that he would give it to her as long as she helped him, but she knew Fang Yuan's true nature. He would take back his words as easily as eating or drinking, and the chances that he would willingly hand over the Yang Rotation Gu were next to nothing.
At the same time, he was not someone she could trifle with. Although she could not fight Fang Yuan in a head-on fight, that didn't mean that she couldn't severely injure him, especially once her Northern Dark Ice Soul physique returned.
"Now, now, Bai Ning Bing," Fang Yuan said. "Didn't you hear what they said at the Dollhouse? There's another inheritance waiting for us, a possible immortal inheritance, don't you want that? Do you really want to turn into a man if it will disqualify you from getting that?"
Bai Ning Bing paused. The White Form Immortal Snake had taken her to the Bai clan's true inheritance, where she had learned how it might be possible for her to survive, even with the Northern Dark Ice Soul physique. Even if she got the Yang Rotation Gu right now, and turned back into a man, eventually she would end up just going back to square one when her Extreme Physique going out of control. In order to survive, she had to ascend to become immortal and get an immortal gu worm of either the Snow or the Ice path.
Where would she get it? Although she had half the recipe for an Immortal Gu, that was still only half. Where would she get the ingredients and all? The only person who could potentially help her was an Immortal. An Immortal, such as the one who had created the Dollhouse.
"For now, we've agreed to split custody of the dollhouse 50/50, haven't we?" Fang Yuan said, waving his hand. Bai Ning Bing snorted. Fang Yuan had refined all the gu worms in the dollhouse after tricking her initially and could detonate them all at will, even if the house spirit would not completely follow him. If he wished to, he could turn the Dollhouse into nothing in the worst case scenario and both of them would end up with nothing.
Bai Ning Bing doubted that he would, given the fact that there were thousands of gu worms in there. However, if he were pushed to it, there was nothing that she felt that this crazy demon couldn't possibly do.
'I need to find Poison Vow Gu,' she thought to herself, 'and then get him into a binding contract.' Even if she didn't want to use the Yang Rotation Gu right now, as long as she had it, that would always leave the pathway open for the future.
They continued smashing in the teeth until what felt like dawn. And it was then that Fang Yuan happened upon it. After he had smashed half the teeth in this mouth, a passageway opened up for them. He smiled. "It looks like we've found our way into the true inheritance!"
